text.title: 大主教玛拉达尔
text.objectives: 到艾洛多尔南边的灵龙平台与大主教玛拉达尔谈一谈。
text.description: 议会成员基本已经集结到位了：奥萨尔、我自己、哈塔鲁和奈丽都已做好准备。只剩下大主教玛拉达尔了。自从他逃离钢铁部落的魔爪后，就一直表现得不太正常……可守备官玛尔拉德还是找到了他的落脚点。$b$b到位于城镇中央南边的灵龙平台去找玛拉达尔吧。
text.completion: $n, my Alliance friend from Tanaan! I have not forgotten my debt to you.$b$bI will do everything in my power to convince the council to support you in every way possible. However...$b$b<The Exarch lowers his voice.>$b$bI have grave concerns about our safety here.
text.completed: 到影月谷艾洛多尔南边的灵龙平台与大主教玛拉达尔谈一谈。

english.title: Exarch Maladaar
english.objectives: Speak with Exarch Maladaar at the Fey Landing south of Elodor.
english.description: The council is almost assembled: Othaar, myself, Hataaru and Naielle are ready. Only Exarch Maladaar remains. He has not been himself since he returned from his capture at the hands of the Iron Horde... but Vindicator Maraad was able to track him down.$b$bFind Maladaar at the Fey Landing, just south of the town center.
english.completion: $n, my Alliance friend from Tanaan! I have not forgotten my debt to you.$b$bI will do everything in my power to convince the council to support you in every way possible. However...$b$b<The Exarch lowers his voice.>$b$bI have grave concerns about our safety here.
english.completed: Speak with Exarch Maladaar at the Fey Landing south of Elodor in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 主教之友
text.objectives: 选择一位追随者（安德伦、切尔或欧纳拉），然后与大主教奈丽谈一谈。
text.description: 虽然主教议会的成员只剩下三个人了，可我们全都对你感激不尽。我们一致通过了这个决议——将在德拉诺全力支持你所在的联盟。$b$b我们还准备任命一位德莱尼代表接受你的直接领导。三位候选人已经在院子里等你了。去跟他们聊聊，选出你中意的那一位——我们会立刻把那个人派到你的要塞！
text.completion: An excellent choice! We'll send your pick directly to your garrison to help with any missions you encounter.$b$bNow, about those supplies you requested...
text.completed: Speak with Exarch Naielle at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Friend of the Exarchs
english.objectives: Choose a follower (either Andren, Chel, or Onaala) and then speak with Exarch Naielle.
english.description: Only three members remain of the Exarch Council, but we are all deeply indebted to you. The vote is unanimous: Your Alliance will have our full support on Draenor.$b$bWe are also going to place a draenei representative under your direct command. Three potential candidates are here in the courtyard. Speak to them and choose who you want - we will dispatch him or her immediately to your garrison!
english.completion: An excellent choice! We'll send your pick directly to your garrison to help with any missions you encounter.$b$bNow, about those supplies you requested...
english.completed: Speak with Exarch Naielle at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 死者代言人
text.objectives: 到沙塔尔祭坛东边的悬崖处与大主教玛拉达尔见面。完成仪式，净化并询问哈塔鲁的尸体。
text.description: 一定是出了内鬼。除此之外没有其它解释了。现在大主教们都对彼此充满了猜疑——尤其是我。可奥萨尔和阿卡玛只会谴责律法。我们要做的则是挖出这个叛徒，而唯一的办法就是与尸体对话！$b$b到位于东边峭壁顶端的沙塔尔祭坛外面找我。我跟缚魂者尼娅米会举行一场招魂仪式，挽救哈塔鲁不朽的灵魂……或许还能查出对他下手的那个人究竟是谁。$b$b你信任我吗，$n？
text.completion: One of the five Exarchs is dead. Another is a traitor. Dark times.$b$bWe will end this here and now. Can I count on you for one final task?
text.completed: Return to Exarch Maladaar at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Speaker for the Dead
english.objectives: Meet Exarch Maladaar at the cliffs east of the Altar of Sha'tar. Complete the ritual to cleanse and interrogate Hataaru's corpse.
english.description: This was a betrayal from within. There's no other explanation for it. None of the Exarchs trust each other now - especially me. But Othaar and Akama can damn their laws. We've got to rout out the traitor and the only way to do it is to speak to the corpse!$b$bJoin me just outside the Altar of Sha'tar atop the eastern cliffs. Soulbinder Nyami and I will perform an exorcism to save Hataaru's immortal soul... and maybe learn who did this to him.$b$bDo you trust me, $n?
english.completion: One of the five Exarchs is dead. Another is a traitor. Dark times.$b$bWe will end this here and now. Can I count on you for one final task?
english.completed: Return to Exarch Maladaar at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 钉刺
text.objectives: 从月光孢子蝠身上取得一根新鲜的孢子蝠钉刺。
text.description: 大主教们似乎很信任你，$c。你是要冒险进入黯影沼泽吗？$b$b这里的孢子蝠通常都很温顺，但眼下却好像都被什么东西给激怒了。当它们攻击时，会用尖刺环抱住目标裸露在外的四肢。我曾见过它们像撕扯纸片一般轻而易举地将加厚的皮革撕得粉碎。不知它们是怎么做到的？$b$b你能不能给我找根新鲜的孢子蝠钉刺来？我愿意好好研究一下。
text.progress: Most draenei avoid the Umbrafen, but we rangari seem drawn to the most dangerous places - that's where you really learn how the world works.
text.completion: Would you look at that - the entire tentacle is barbed. Uggh. No wonder the wounds they inflict tend to get infected. We could learn something from this. I wonder if rangari explorers should start equipping themselves with whips?$b$bThank you, $n. This Alliance that you come from must be quite the collection of heroes!
text.completed: Bring the stinger to Rangari Chel at the Rangari Enclave in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: The Sting
english.objectives: Acquire a Pristine Sporebat Stinger from a Moonglow Sporebat.
english.description: The exarchs seem to trust you, $c. Are you venturing into the Umbrafen?$b$bThe Sporebats in this area are usually docile, but something's got them all riled up. When they attack, their stingers wrap around exposed limbs. I've seen them tear through reinforced leather like it was paper. How do they work, I wonder?$b$bCould you bring me a pristine sporebat stinger? I'd love to study it.
english.progress: For the most part, the Drenees try to avoid Tenetopi, but we, the rank-and-file people, are drawn to the most inhospitable and dangerous places, because only there you can fully understand the world order.
english.completion: Would you look at that - the entire tentacle is barbed. Uggh. No wonder the wounds they inflict tend to get infected. We could learn something from this. I wonder if rangari explorers should start equipping themselves with whips?$b$bThank you, $n. This Alliance that you come from must be quite the collection of heroes!
english.completed: Bring the stinger to Rangari Chel at the Rangari Enclave in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 警告主教
text.objectives: 在影月谷的沙塔尔祭坛与大主教玛拉达尔谈一谈。
text.description: 你把书烧了，但还是看到了书中的内容。那个恶魔书卷的用途是为了给武器灌注邪恶能量。看来目标似乎是为了诱捕牺牲者的灵魂。$b$b必须要向主教们发出警告，让他们知道，叛徒就在他们中间！议会此刻应该正在东边的山上召开集会。
text.completion: Dead! Exarch Hataaru is dead! His body was discovered moments ago, stabbed in the back. The weapon that killed him was fel in origin. Tell me everything you know.$b$b<Maladaar nods as you describe what you found.>$b$bYes. The traitors wanted to capture Hataaru's soul. Someone wants something he knows, dead or alive... We must act at once.
text.completed: 在影月谷的沙塔尔祭坛与大主教玛拉达尔谈一谈。

english.title: Warning the Exarchs
english.objectives: Talk to Exarch Maladaar at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: You set the book ablaze, but not before noting its contents. The demonic tome was dedicated to enchanting weapons with fel energy. It looked as though the goal was to ensnare the victim's soul.$b$bThe Exarchs must be warned that traitors are among them! The Council should be meeting now just up the hill to the east.
english.completion: Dead! Exarch Hataaru is dead! His body was discovered moments ago, stabbed in the back. The weapon that killed him was fel in origin. Tell me everything you know.$b$b<Maladaar nods as you describe what you found.>$b$bYes. The traitors wanted to capture Hataaru's soul. Someone wants something he knows, dead or alive... We must act at once.
english.completed: Talk to Exarch Maladaar at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 叛徒真正的名字
text.objectives: 把焦镜放到影月谷大主教高地的顶上。
text.description: 我们必须让叛徒无处遁形。我这里有一面焦镜，可以使藏匿在暗处的邪恶能量现身。如果把它放在高处，它就能像信标那样照出镇上所有遭到邪能腐化的人。$b$b在北边大主教高地的顶上有个祈祷阵，正好符合我们的要求。把焦镜放到那里去，$n。如有任何发现，就地解决。然后去下方找我。
text.completion: <The Exarch listens to your tale, his face contorting into concern, grief, and finally anger.>$b$bSo Othaar has lost his way. "Socrethar" he calls himself now. At last we have our answer. I fear my capture at the hands of the Iron Horde was his doing. There may be other traitors amongst us - I must hurry back to Auchindoun and make sure we are safe.$b$bIn the meantime, I believe the Exarchs owe you a decision...
text.completed: Return to Exarch Maladaar at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: The Traitor's True Name
english.objectives: Plant the Focusing Lens atop the Exarch's Rise in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: We must give the traitor no place to hide. I have a focusing lens that will illuminate cloaked fel energy. If it were placed on a high point, it could act like a beacon, lighting up anyone in town who reeks of the fel taint.$b$bThere is a prayer circle atop the Exarch's Rise to the north that will serve our purpose. Plant the focusing lens, $n. If you reveal anything, deal with it. Then meet me below.
english.completion: <The Exarch listens to your tale, his face contorting into concern, grief, and finally anger.>$b$bSo Othaar has lost his way. "Socrethar" he calls himself now. At last we have our answer. I fear my capture at the hands of the Iron Horde was his doing. There may be other traitors amongst us - I must hurry back to Auchindoun and make sure we are safe.$b$bIn the meantime, I believe the Exarchs owe you a decision...
english.completed: Return to Exarch Maladaar at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 纳格兰的战火
text.objectives: 与纳格兰车队的石头守卫布罗克斯谈一谈。
text.description: 头儿，很高兴见到你。$B$B杜隆坦建议我们在纳格兰建立一处据点，所以我擅自做主派出了一些人手。$B$B据萨尔报告，哨站已接近完工。他让我转告你，他们已经在等你了。$B$B我已经为你准备好了一只双足飞龙，等你准备好了就可以随时出发，它会把你送到驮满最新物资的车队那里，$g先生:女士;。
text.completion: They came at us... from... nowhere.$B$B<The stoneguard nearly passes out.>

english.title: Taking the Fight to Nagrand
english.objectives: Speak with Stone Guard Brox at the caravan in Nagrand.
english.description: Boss-mon, good to see ya.$b$bDurotan recommended dat we be gettin' a foothold in Nagrand, so I taken the liberty of dispatchin' some of da boys.$b$bThrall's already reportin' that the outside be nearly complete. He been askin' me to let ya know they be ready for ya.$b$bA windrider be waitin' to catch ya up with the latest caravan shipment whenever you be ready, $g sir:ma'am;.
english.completion: Они напали... словно из ниоткуда.$B$B<Каменный страж вот-вот потеряет сознание.>

text.title: 战歌氏族的力量
text.objectives: 在沃尔瓦与萨尔谈一谈。
text.description: <军官承受着巨大的痛苦。他显然不久于世了。>$B$B战歌氏族发起了突然袭击。$B$B往火刃……的方向跑了……$B$B<他歇了一会继续说道。>$B$B他们带走了……图纸……$B$B<这些就是他的遗言。>
text.completion: Commander $n. It's good to see you. We have much to discuss.$B$BThe situation in Nagrand is rapidly deteriorating. The Warsong clan is on the move.$B$BTo make matters worse, Grommash has named Garrosh their new warlord.$B$B<Thrall shakes his head sadly, but remains resolute.>

english.title: The Might of the Warsong
english.objectives: Speak with Thrall at Wor'var.
english.description: <The officer is in a great deal of pain. It's clear that he's not long for this world.>$B$BThe Warsong. Surprise attack.$B$BHeaded into... the Burning Blade....$B$B<He takes a moment, before continuing.>$B$BThey took the... blueprints....$B$B<These are his last words.>
english.completion: Commander $n. It's good to see you. We have much to discuss.$B$BThe situation in Nagrand is rapidly deteriorating. The Warsong clan is on the move.$B$BTo make matters worse, Grommash has named Garrosh their new warlord.$B$B<Thrall shakes his head sadly, but remains resolute.>

text.title: 不幸的朝圣者
text.objectives: 收集$1oa份徘徊者的血、$2oa片金鱼草复叶和1只跳蛙眼。
text.description: 我是个谦恭的朝圣者，我发誓。请不要伤害我！$B$B我是跟妹妹一起去奥金顿祭悼祖母的，走着走着突然撞到了一块翻转的石块，车子就失去了控制。我好不容易活了下来，可我的妹妹却……$B$B<纳杜尔哭了。>$B$B求你帮帮我，我已经绝望了。要是你能帮我找来一些徘徊者的血、金鱼草复叶和一只跳蛙眼，我就能制成药剂让她起死回生。我一定能做到……
text.progress: Tuliaa isn't just my sister. She's my best friend.
text.completion: Thank you, stranger.
text.completed: Return to Nadur in Talador.

english.title: A Pilgrimage Gone Awry
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Prowler Blood, $2oa Snapdragon Fronds, and a Riverhopper Eye.
english.description: I am a humble pilgrim, I swear. Please don't hurt me!$B$BMy sister and I were traveling to Auchindoun to pay our respects to my grandmother when we hit an overturned rock and lost control of our caravan. I managed to survive, but my sister...$B$B<Nadur cries.>$B$BPlease, you have to help me. I'm desperate. If you could bring me some prowler blood, snapdragon flowers, and a riverhopper eye, I can fashion a potion to bring her back. I just know it....
english.progress: Tuliaa isn't just my sister. She's my best friend.
english.completion: Thank you, stranger.
english.completed: Return to Nadur in Talador.

text.title: 不幸的朝圣者
text.objectives: 收集$1oa份徘徊者的血、$2oa片金鱼草复叶和1只跳蛙眼。
text.description: 我妹妹跟我是前往奥金顿悼念祖母的，结果半路撞上了一块翻转的石块，车子失去了控制。我好不容易活了下来，可我的妹妹却……$B$B<纳杜尔哭了。>$B$B拜托了，我需要你的帮助。要是你能帮我找来一些徘徊者的血、金鱼草复叶和一只跳蛙眼，我就能制成药剂让她起死回生……我一定能做到……
text.progress: I don't know what I would do without Tuliaa... she's not just my sister. She's my best friend.
text.completion: Thank you, a thousand times thank you.
text.completed: Return to Nadur in Talador.

english.title: A Pilgrimage Gone Awry
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Prowler Blood, $2oa Snapdragon Fronds, and a Riverhopper Eye.
english.description: My sister and I were traveling to Auchindoun to pay our respects to my grandmother when we hit an overturned rock and lost control of our caravan. I managed to survive, but my sister...$B$B<Nadur cries.>$B$BPlease, I need your help. If you could bring me some prowler blood, snapdragon flowers, and a riverhopper eye, I can fashion a potion to bring her back... I just know I can...
english.progress: Не знаю, что бы я делал без Тулиаа... она для меня больше, чем просто сестра. Она и моя лучшая подруга.
english.completion: Спасибо тебе! У меня слов нет, чтобы выразить мою благодарность.
english.completed: Return to Nadur in Talador.

text.title: 树倒猢狲散
text.objectives: 在沃金之傲外面消灭邪齿。
text.description: 你的斥候们发现虎人的头领就在我们的门外！$B$B指挥官，我相信只要干掉这个目标，所有剩下的这些乌合之众就会统统逃回自己的洞穴。$B$B我也不愿意再麻烦你，但你是唯一能胜任这项任务的人选了。$g先生:女士;。
text.completion: For $n! For the Horde!
text.completed: Return to Provisioner Naya in Vol'jin's Pride.

english.title: Send Them Running
english.objectives: Slay Vicegnaw just outside Vol'jin's Pride.
english.description: Your scouts have located the saberon's alpha male just outside our gates!$B$BCommander, I believe that dispatching this target will send any of these remaining vermin running back to their caves.$B$BI do not wish to ask more of you, but you are the only one capable of this task, $gsir:ma'am;.
english.completion: For $n! For the Horde!
english.completed: Return to Provisioner Naya in Vol'jin's Pride.

text.title: 消灭头领
text.objectives: 在乌瑞恩堡外面消灭裂胆。
text.description: $G先生:女士;，我们发现虎人的头领就在我们的门外！$B$B我们相信只要除掉他，所有剩下的虎人都会夹着尾巴落荒而逃，可那野兽确实太庞大了！$B$B我也不愿意再麻烦你一次，但你是唯一能胜任这项任务的人选了。
text.completion: Victory! For the Alliance!
text.completed: Return to Quartermaster O'Riley in Fort Wrynn.

english.title: Not In Your House
english.objectives: Slay Ripgut just outside Fort Wrynn.
english.description: $GSir:Madame;, we have located the saberon's alpha male just outside our gates!$B$BWe believe that slaying him will send any remaining saberon running with their tails between their legs, but the beast is positively massive!$B$BI do not wish to call upon you once more, but you are the only one capable of this task.
english.completion: Victory! For the Alliance!
english.completed: Return to Quartermaster O'Riley in Fort Wrynn.

text.title: 回声猎手
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa只回声猎手。
text.description: 虽然我不是什么魔法师，但我却在过去的岁月中涉猎了几种法术——足以让我神不知鬼不觉地从别人的眼皮底下遛过去。$B$B可惜，这片树林中的吸血蝙蝠并非是靠眼睛分辨物体的。它们在一里外都能听见我长袍的摩挲声和珀西没完没了的咯咯声。$B$B帮我把沿途的这些蝙蝠清理干净可以吗？
text.completion: Blasted things. Nothing more than flying rats if you ask me!
text.completed: Speak with Reshad at the Terokkar Wayshrine.

english.title: Echo Hunters
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Echo Hunters.
english.description: I am no sorcerer, but I've picked up a few spells in my time - enough for me to pass unseen by the naked eye.$B$BUnfortunately, the vampire bats in these woods don't use their eyes. They will hear my shuffling robes and Percy's incessant clucking a mile away.$B$BClear them away from the path, would you?
english.completion: Blasted things. Nothing more than flying rats if you ask me!
english.completed: Speak with Reshad at the Terokkar Wayshrine.

text.title: 修剪魔荚
text.objectives: 找魔荚人报仇。
text.description: 瑞恩的尸体就倒在洞穴的墙边。他浑身遍布微小的齿印。$b$b魔荚人显然是你和你要塞的威胁。$b$b是时候做些清理工作了。
text.completion: <You've drastically reduced the podling numbers.$b$bHopefully they won't be growing back anytime soon.>
text.completed: xxxx

english.title: Prune the Podlings
english.objectives: Take revenge on the podlings.
english.description: The blood soaked body of Ryan is slumped up against the cave wall. Tiny teeth marks cover his body.$b$bThe podlings clearly are a threat to you and your garrison.$b$bIt's time to do a little pruning.
english.completion: <You've drastically reduced the podling numbers.$b$bHopefully they won't be growing back anytime soon.>
english.completed: xxxx

text.title: 更多懒惰的苦工
text.objectives: 激励$1oa名懒惰的苦工。
text.description: 我们眼下有个难得的机会，可以直捣战歌氏族的要害。但我们需要你的智慧和领导力。$B$B你必须作出最重要的决定，选择究竟是建造兽栏还是坦克工厂。这个选择关系到我们对抗兽人的战局。$B$B塔兹利尔会立刻动手建造。你愿意去帮他一把吗？$B$B他好像在激励苦工干活的问题上遇到了点麻烦。
text.completion: I knew it was a mistake to bring these guys with me from the Valley of Trials.
text.completed: Speak with Foreman Thazz'ril at Wor'var.
text.giverWindow: 这是胜利的敌人！这会阻碍部落的成功！适当激励他一下！

english.title: More Lazy Peons
english.objectives: Motivate $1oa Lazy Peons.
english.description: We have a rare opportunity to strike at the heart of the Warsong. But, we need your wisdom and leadership.$B$BThe most important decision will be your choice between building a corral or a tankworks. This choice will setup our approach to the fight against the Warsong.$B$BThazz'ril will head up our building efforts. Will you give him a hand?$B$BIt looks like he's having trouble motivating his peons to work.
english.completion: I knew it was a mistake to bring these guys with me from the Valley of Trials.
english.completed: Speak with Foreman Thazz'ril at Wor'var.
english.giverWindow: This is the enemy of Victory! This stands in the way of the Horde's success! Properly motivate him!

text.title: 矿物学课程
text.objectives: 收集$oa个大地之核。
text.description: <加兹莫夫指了指附近那台巨大的机器。>$b$b我制造这台机器，是为了把源质矿分解为基本元素。如你所见，不仅是埋在地下的物质才是宝贵的，大地本身也一样宝贵！$b$b就拿我们下方的土元素来举个例子吧，在每个土元素之内，都有一个大地之核，里面蕴藏着丰富的贵金属！$b$b那些元素足以让我们发家致富！收集几个大地之核，把它们放进自动炼金器9000里，好处少不了你的！
text.completion: <The Gold-O-Matic 9000 crunches and grinds through the elemental remains.>$b$bchakk-chackk-chak-chak, chak-a-chak-akk-chk-chk-chk.

english.title: A Lesson in Mineralogy
english.objectives: Collect $oa Earthen Cores.
english.description: <Gazmolf gestures at the large machine nearby.>$b$bI built this machine to break down elementium minerals into base elements. You see, it's not just what's buried within the ground that can be valuable; but also the ground itself!$b$bTake, for example, the earth elementals below us; inside every earth elemental is an earthen core, dense in precious metal!.$b$bThose elementals are going to make us rich! Collect several earthen cores, place them in the Gold-O-Matic 9000, and I'll give you a cut!
english.completion: <The Gold-O-Matic 9000 crunches and grinds through the elemental remains.>$b$bchakk-chackk-chak-chak, chak-a-chak-akk-chk-chk-chk.

text.title: 加兹莫夫·弗兹万格勒与悬槌圣战奇兵
text.objectives: 与加兹莫夫·弗兹万格勒谈一谈。
text.description: 我是来纳格兰为热砂保护协会招募成员的。我们是热砂集团的考古学分队。$b$b我们来此搜集纳格兰的各种文物、遗物、古董和奇珍异宝！目前，虚位以待的职位有勘测员、挖掘工和冒险家……总有一种适合你！$b$b要是你有兴趣跟我们大干一场的话，就到岩壁峡谷找加兹莫夫·弗兹万格勒谈一谈吧。他是负责此次考察行动的地精！
text.completion: It's good to see that there's still an interest out there in real archaeology!$b$bThere's a lot of misconceptions out there about how archaeology is really done, but have no fear! The great and famous Gazmolf Futzwangler is here to educate you.
text.completed: 与加兹莫夫·弗兹万格勒谈一谈。

english.title: Gazmolf Futzwangler and the Highmaul Crusade
english.objectives: Speak with Gazmolf Futzwangler.
english.description: I'm here in Nagrand recruiting for the Steamwheedle Preservation Society. We're the archaeological branch of the Steamwheedle Cartel.$b$bWe're here to collect all of the artifacts, relics, antiquities and oddities that Nagrand has to offer! Currently, we're hiring surveyors, excavators, adventurers... you name it!$b$bIf you're interested in getting your hands dirty, talk to Gazmolf Futzwangler over at Stonecrag Gorge. He's the goblin in charge of this expedition!
english.completion: It's good to see that there's still an interest out there in real archaeology!$b$bThere's a lot of misconceptions out there about how archaeology is really done, but have no fear! The great and famous Gazmolf Futzwangler is here to educate you.
english.completed: Speak with Gazmolf Futzwangler.

text.title: 好帮手难觅
text.objectives: 收集$1oa件纳格兰古董。
text.description: 挖掘队罢工了！$b$b工头萨维克斯跟他的伙计们以为不干活就能从热砂保护协会手里榨取到更多酬劳。$b$b我现在需要一个恶人，一个罢工破坏者，一个愿意接手他们的工作，对他们施压的人！$b$b到峡谷里去，替我挖点古董上来，我会给你和那些懒惰的蠢蛋一样的报酬！
text.progress: Do you have the Nagrand Antiquities?
text.completion: Great work, $n!$b$bThat bunch of good-for-nothing's came crying when they found out someone else was making their money! I don't think Thazwix, or his cronies, will be much trouble from here on out.$b$bAs promised, here's the pay I owe you for a job well done!
text.completed: Return to Trixi Leroux at the Preservation Society camp.

english.title: Good Help is Hard to Find
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Nagrand Antiquities.
english.description: The excavation team is on strike!$b$bForeman Thazwix and his cronies think they can squeeze the Steamwheedle Preservation Society for some extra dough by refusing to work.$b$bWhat I need is a scab, a strikebreaker; someone to put some pressure on them by doing the job they refuse to do!$b$bGo down into the gorge, dig up some antiquities for me, and I'll pay you what I would have payed those lazy numbskulls!
english.progress: Do you have the Nagrand Antiquities?
english.completion: Great work, $n!$b$bThat bunch of good-for-nothing's came crying when they found out someone else was making their money! I don't think Thazwix, or his cronies, will be much trouble from here on out.$b$bAs promised, here's the pay I owe you for a job well done!
english.completed: Return to Trixi Leroux at the Preservation Society camp.

text.title: 结交朋友
text.objectives: 跟随大法师卡德加，并在赞加拉与魔导师克雷拉斯谈一谈。
text.description: 要知道，看到还有别人也对奥术魔法之道深感兴趣，真是难得啊。这年头哪里还有这种人！$B$B可惜我现在必须去找科达娜商谈要事，不能亲自把你的法师塔连接进网。但我们运气好！我在肯瑞托的一位好朋友已经答应帮你把奥秘圣殿接入能量线网。$B$B他正在我的塔里等着你呢。我们赶紧出发，让你们彼此认识一下吧。
text.completion: I am Magister Krelas. Pyromaniac.$B$BPleasure.

english.title: Making Acquaintances
english.objectives: Follow Archmage Khadgar and speak with Magister Krelas in Zangarra.
english.description: It's nice to see someone else taking a vested interest in the arcane arts, you know. It's all too rare these days if you ask me!$B$BUnfortunately, I must meet Cordana to handle an important matter, but we're in luck! One of my good friends in the Kirin Tor has agreed to help you connect your arcane sanctum to the ley line network.$B$BHe's waiting at my tower. Let's leave immediately and introduce you to one another.
english.completion: I am Magister Krelas. Pyromaniac.$B$BPleasure.

text.title: 结交朋友
text.objectives: 跟随大法师卡德加，并在赞加拉与魔导师赛琳娜谈一谈。
text.description: 要知道，看到还有别人也对奥术魔法之道深感兴趣，真是难得啊。这年头哪里还有这种人！$B$B可惜我现在必须去找科达娜商谈要事，不能亲自把你的法师塔连接进网。但我们运气好！我在肯瑞托的一位好朋友已经答应帮你把奥秘圣殿接入能量线网。$B$B她正在我的塔里等着你呢。我们赶紧出发，让你们彼此认识一下吧。
text.completion: Nice to meet you.$B$BI am Magister Serena. Frost mage extraordinaire!
text.completed: Speak with Magister Serena in Zangarra.

english.title: Making Acquaintances
english.objectives: Follow Archmage Khadgar and speak with Magister Serena in Zangarra.
english.description: It's nice to see someone else taking a vested interest in the arcane arts, you know. It's all too rare these days if you ask me.$B$BUnfortunately, I must meet Cordana to handle an important matter, but we're in luck! One of my good friends in the Kirin Tor has agreed to help you connect your arcane sanctum to the ley line network.$B$BShe's waiting at my tower. Let's leave immediately and introduce you to one another.
english.completion: Рада встрече.$B$BЯ – магистр Серена. Ледяной маг высочайшего уровня!
english.completed: Speak with Magister Serena in Zangarra.

text.title: The Chase is On
text.objectives: Reach the Kargathar Proving Grounds.
text.description: Let us move quickly. The orc's heroism will only buy us so much time.
text.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at the Kargathar Proving Grounds.

english.title: The Chase is On
english.objectives: Reach the Kargathar Proving Grounds.
english.description: Let us move quickly. The orc's heroism will only buy us so much time.
english.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at the Kargathar Proving Grounds.

text.title: 祭坛争斗
text.description: Save the prisoners from the Altar.$b$b[NOTE: THIS QUEST WILL GET SIGNIFICANT REVAMP ONCE WE GET THE ALTAR IN]

english.title: Altar Altercation
english.description: Save the prisoners from the Altar.$b$b[NOTE: THIS QUEST WILL GET SIGNIFICANT REVAMP ONCE WE GET THE ALTAR IN]

text.title: 他们叫他兰特瑞索·火刃
text.objectives: 在哈瓦洛找到兰特瑞索·火刃。
text.description: 当战歌兽人洗劫你的车队时，要塞图纸被带到火刃村了。没有那些图纸，我可造不出建筑。$B$B据传有位年轻的剑圣，已经被逐出氏族很多年了。他们管他叫兰特瑞索·火刃。$B$B我们的斥候近来看见他返回哈瓦洛挑战剑圣领袖，结果却身陷囹圄。$B$B他也许还活着。也许会帮你找回图纸。
text.completion: Who are you?$B$BDon't you know death by sight, $c?

english.title: They Call Him Lantresor of the Blade
english.objectives: Find Lantresor of the Blade in Hallvalor.
english.description: The garrison blueprints were taken to the Burning Blade village when the Warsong sacked your caravan. I can't construct this building without those plans.$B$BThere's been talk of a young blademaster who's been exiled from the clan for many years. They call him Lantresor of the Blade.$B$BOur scouts recently saw him return to Hallvalor to challenge the blademaster leadership. Instead, they clapped him in chains.$B$BMaybe he's still alive. Maybe he'll help you recover the blueprints?
english.completion: Who are you?$B$BDon't you know death by sight, $c?

text.title: 采集水果
text.objectives: 采集$1oa颗纳格兰樱桃。
text.description: 噢不！它们一定是食草动物。$B$B这些雷象需要的是水果，很多的水果。在这附近的大树底下长满了樱桃。$B$B你不会介意帮我找点来的，对吧？
text.progress: I heard the worst rumor about how you have to obtain those things.$B$BSomething about talbuk first eating them and then 'processing' them, and then... well, I don't want to talk about it.
text.completion: You got them all? I just know this is going to work.
text.completed: Return to Digrem Orebar at the Ring of Trials.

english.title: Fruitful Ventures
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Nagrand Cherries.
english.description: Oh no! They must be vegetarians.$B$BWhat these elekk need is fruit and lots of it. There are cherries all over the place around here under the trees.$B$BYou wouldn't mind grabbing me some, would ya?
english.progress: I heard the worst rumor about how you have to obtain those things.$B$BSomething about talbuk first eating them and then 'processing' them, and then... well, I don't want to talk about it.
english.completion: You got them all? I just know this is going to work.
english.completed: Return to Digrem Orebar at the Ring of Trials.

text.title: 失踪的伐木工
text.objectives: 查明雪莉和失踪伐木工们的下落。
text.description: 雪莉和她的同伴还没从幽影林地回来。$b$b都已经过去好几天了……我希望一切正常。
text.completion: This is one of the pack mules Shelly and her crew took to Gloomshade Grove.

english.title: Lost Lumberjacks
english.objectives: Find out what happened to Shelly and the missing lumberjacks.
english.description: Shelly and her crew haven't returned from Gloomshade Grove.$b$bIt's been days... I hope everything is okay.
english.completion: This is one of the pack mules Shelly and her crew took to Gloomshade Grove.

text.title: 我们缺什么
text.objectives: 收集$1oa份奴隶船残骸。
text.description: 我听说你们在离开塔纳安丛林的途中劫持了一艘船并且失事了。$b$b就像我爸爸常说的那样——失事者的船只残骸，正是地精的工作车间。$b$b你应该前往要塞西边的海岸，看看能不能找到任何可以回收的材料。噢，呃……另外还要多加小心。据说在那里有食人魔强袭者作乱。
text.progress: How's the salvage operation comin'?
text.completion: Hey... now that is some nice salvage. Say what you will about the Iron Horde, but they got some serious raw materials to work with.
text.completed: Return to Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: What We Need
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Drudgeboat Salvage.
english.description: I heard you guys hijacked and wrecked a ship on your way out of Tanaan.$b$bIt's like my daddy always said: One man's wreck is another goblin's workshop.$b$bYou should head down to the coast west of the garrison and see if you can't find any materials we might salvage. Oh, and uh... should probably watch yourself. I hear there are ogre raiders in the area.
english.progress: How's the salvage operation comin'?
english.completion: Hey... now that is some nice salvage. Say what you will about the Iron Horde, but they got some serious raw materials to work with.
english.completed: Return to Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 活着的独眼魔？
text.objectives: 消灭古罗格。
text.description: 指挥官，据我们的霜狼盟友报告称，刀塔食人魔在我们的西边建了座哨站，领头的是个独眼魔。$b$b我听说过许多关于独眼魔的传说，但还从没亲眼见过。它们是一种凶残的怪物，来自某个……最好不要提起的年代。据说大多数独眼魔都在原始部落创建时被杀死了。它们善于用残暴、武力和贪婪来弥补自己智慧方面的不足。$b$b我建议尽快消灭这个怪物。
text.completion: Well done, boss-mon. The Bladespire ogres been pullin' back their raiding parties. But ya can bet dey be comin' back, and in larger numbers. The threat from their citadel must be dealt with soon.
text.completed: Return to Rokhan at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge.
text.giverWindow: 奴隶主

english.title: The Ogron Live?
english.objectives: Slay Groog.
english.description: Commander, our Frostwolf allies reportin' dat the Bladespire ogres have an outpost to our west led by an ogron.$b$bI heard tales of da ogron but never seen one. Dey be brutes, creatures from a time that was best left forgotten. Dey say most were slain during the forming of the original horde. What dey lack in wisdom they make up for in violence, force, and greed.$b$bI counsel dispatchin' dis creature as soon as possible.
english.completion: Well done, boss-mon. The Bladespire ogres been pullin' back their raiding parties. But ya can bet dey be comin' back, and in larger numbers. The threat from their citadel must be dealt with soon.
english.completed: Return to Rokhan at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge.
english.giverWindow: The Slave Maker

text.title: 我们有什么
text.objectives: 命令斯卡基特让苦工们开始干活，调查你的要塞储物箱，并找到II级资深苦工。
text.description: 每个要塞都离不开三样东西。$b$b第一：劳工！去找到斯卡基特，命他让我们的劳工回到工作岗位上来。$b$b第二：建筑材料。我让苦工们在你离开的时候把资源存放在宝箱里。你应该去看看。$b$b第三：经验丰富的健壮苦力！在要塞里建造建筑物需要花上一些时间，可我想我们可以雇佣斯卡基特新提拔上来的II级资深苦工来加快你第一座建筑物的建造速度。去找他，跟他说是我叫你去的。
text.completion: Yeah, that's the stuff. Lumber, stone, peons, more peons. It's like we are building you a stronghold or something.
text.completed: Return to Gazlowe in your Garrison at Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: What We Got
english.objectives: Have Skaggit get the peons working, investigate your Garrison Cache, and find Senior Peon II.
english.description: Every fortress needs three things.$b$bOne: peons! Find Skaggit and have him get our peons back to work.$b$bTwo: building materials. I had the peons set up a cache for you where they will store resources they create while you are away. You should check it out.$b$bAnd three: raw experienced muscle! Constructing buildings in a garrison can take some time but I think we can speed up your first building by hiring Skaggit's recently promoted Senior Peon II. Find him and tell him I sent ya.
english.completion: Yeah, that's the stuff. Lumber, stone, peons, more peons. It's like we are building you a stronghold or something.
english.completed: Return to Gazlowe in your Garrison at Frostfire Ridge.

objectiveDetails.description: 命令斯卡基特指挥苦工

text.title: 我敌人的朋友
text.objectives: 在哈瓦洛消灭$1oa名火刃兽人。
text.description: 哈瓦洛是火刃氏族古老的家园。作为战歌氏族可靠的朋友，剑圣们被允许留在纳格兰。$B$B虽然我们勇猛善战，可一旦火刃氏族发起攻击，我们也难以取胜。还是先发制人比较明智。
text.completion: A great victory over the Burning Blade!$B$BThis new Warlord Azuka Bladefury sounds formidable. We will have to keep an eye on her and her blademasters.
text.completed: Return to Thrall at Wor'var.

english.title: The Friend of My Enemy
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Burning Blade forces at Hallvalor.
english.description: Hallvalor is the ancestral home of the Burning Blade clan. Since they're such fast friends, the Warsong have allowed the blademasters to remain in Nagrand.$B$BWe are fierce, but we won't win if the Burning Blade attack us. It would be wise to strike first.
english.completion: A great victory over the Burning Blade!$B$BThis new Warlord Azuka Bladefury sounds formidable. We will have to keep an eye on her and her blademasters.
english.completed: Return to Thrall at Wor'var.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭哈瓦洛的火刃兽人

text.title: 最后的鸦爪祭司
text.objectives: 在黯影丛林伊沙尔的小屋里喝下暗影药剂。
text.description: 鸦爪祭司们秘密地生活在我们中间，守护着利爪之王回归的仪式。$B$B你在斯克提斯里找到的那份信徒公告，提到了有两名鸦爪祭司就居住在北边的黯影丛林里。兽人们已经进入了那片区域，信徒的光束武器也已经把阿卡拉兹鸦巢变成了浓烟滚滚的大坑。$B$B如你所见，我的族人已经被敌人重重包围了。$B$B鸦爪祭司伊沙尔还活着，他藏了起来。在他的小屋附近喝下这瓶药剂，观察暗影，然后与他取得联系。
text.completion: Hm, not what I was expecting when I heard that Iskar was sending help.$B$BNo matter. You'll have to do.
text.completed: Speak with Talonpriest Ishaal in the Shadowglade.

english.title: Last of the Talonpriests
english.objectives: Drink the Elixir of Shadow at Ishaal's Hut in the Shadowglade.
english.description: Talonpriests live among us in secret, guarding the rites of the Talon King's return.$B$BThe Adherent proclamation you acquired in Skettis revealed two of them living in the Shadowglade to the north. Orcs have moved into the region, and the Adherent's beam weapon left Veil Akraz a smoking crater.$B$BAs you can see, my people are beset by enemies on all sides.$B$BTalonpriest Ishaal survived and is in hiding. Drink this elixir near his hut to peer into the shadows and make contact with him.
english.completion: Hm, not what I was expecting when I heard that Iskar was sending help.$B$BNo matter. You'll have to do.
english.completed: Speak with Talonpriest Ishaal in the Shadowglade.

text.title: 伊沙尔的宝珠
text.objectives: 从棘痕营地里找到伊沙尔的宝珠。
text.description: 信徒们前来找我，可我早就藏好了。我从暗影里看着他们洗劫了我的小屋。$B$B然后又看着碎手兽人来到这里，像切瓜砍菜一样地屠杀了他们。近来我们可真是炙手可热啊。$B$B其中有个兽人暴徒夺走了我的占卜宝珠。如果我想帮艾斯卡的忙，就必须得把它找回来。
text.progress: Have you found the orb?
text.completion: Hmm... something's not right. She's been tampered with.$B$BSomeone else has used my orb to enter the realm of shadows.
text.completed: Return to Talonpriest Ishaal in the Shadowglade.

english.title: Ishaal's Orb
english.objectives: Retrieve Ishaal's Orb from Camp Thornscar.
english.description: The Adherents came for me, but I was already hiding. I watched from the shadows as they ransacked my hut.$B$BThen I watched the Shattered Hand orcs arrive and butcher them like dinner fowl. Seems everyone is after us these days.$B$BOne of those orc thugs made off with my scrying orb. I will be needing it back if I am to be of any use to Iskar.
english.progress: $gFound:Found; scope?
english.completion: Hmm... something's not right. She's been tampered with.$B$BSomeone else has used my orb to enter the realm of shadows.
english.completed: Return to Talonpriest Ishaal in the Shadowglade.

text.title: 新邻居
text.objectives: 在棘痕营地里消灭$1oa个碎手兽人。
text.description: 碎手氏族是由无家可归的兽人组成的。他们是嗜杀成性的战士，不惜摧残自己的身体，或许是为了体现团结，又或者仅仅是因为享受那份痛楚。$B$B这不重要。重要的是这些兽人正在扩张自己的领土，屠杀任何碍事的人。$B$B必须解决掉他们。
text.completion: Blood for blood, as it should be.
text.completed: Return to Talonpriest Ishaal in the Shadowglade.

english.title: New Neighbors
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Shattered Hand orcs in Camp Thornscar.
english.description: The Shattered Hand clan is made up of orcs who can call no other clan home. They are sadistic warriors who maim their bodies, perhaps in a show of solidarity or perhaps because they simply enjoy the pain.$B$BIt does not matter. What matters is that they are expanding their territory, butchering anyone in their path.$B$BThey must be dealt with.
english.completion: Blood for blood, as it should be.
english.completed: Return to Talonpriest Ishaal in the Shadowglade.

text.title: 暗影之界
text.objectives: 在阿卡拉兹鸦巢的塞尔利克小屋里饮用强效暗影药剂。
text.description: 在兽人袭来后不久，阿卡拉兹鸦巢就被一道来自通天峰的光束夷为废墟。$B$B<当伊沙尔凝视宝珠时，他的眼睛亮闪闪的。>$B$B看来他们错过了真正的目标。塞尔利克还在那，藏在暗影界里。$B$B另外……还有别人。是用过我宝珠的那个兽人。$B$B拿上这药。在阿卡拉兹鸦巢里把它喝下去，找到塞尔利克。$B$B噢，千万要小心。它比上一瓶要烈一些。你会领教的……
text.completion: Well, you are not stabbing me yet.$B$BThat is a good sign.
text.completed: Speak with Talonpriest Zellek in Veil Akraz.

english.title: Behind the Veil
english.objectives: Drink the Major Elixir of Shadows at Zellek's hut in Veil Akraz.
english.description: Soon after the orcs swept in, Veil Akraz was laid to waste by a beam of light from Skyreach.$B$B<Ishaal's eyes glass over as he peers into his orb.>$B$BIt seems they missed their true target. Zellek is still there, hiding in the realm of shadow.$B$BAnd... someone else as well. The orc assassin who used my orb.$B$BTake this. Drink it in Veil Akraz and find Zellek.$B$BOh, and be careful. It's a little more potent than the last one. You'll see...
english.completion: Well, you are not stabbing me yet.$B$BThat is a good sign.
english.completed: Speak with Talonpriest Zellek in Veil Akraz.

text.title: 萤月花
text.objectives: 摘取$1oa朵萤月花。
text.description: 我多么想把凯拉拥在怀里。$b$b不管是月亮还是繁星，在她的美丽面前都会相形失色。$b$b唉，我只不过是个村野匹夫。$b$b如果我有时间，能够从这倒霉的工作岗位上忙里偷闲，为凯拉摘些萤月花来就好了。$b$b要是没有礼物，我可不敢向她表达我的爱意。
text.progress: How can I help you, $C?
text.completion: Lunarblossoms! You are too kind! I can't wait to give these to Kat'la.
text.completed: Return to Zukaza at Exile's Rise.

english.title: Lunarblossom
english.objectives: Pick $1oa Lunarblossoms.
english.description: How I long to hold Kat'la.$b$bNo star or moon can compare to her beauty.$b$bAlas, I am but a simple boar farmer.$b$bIf only I could find time to sneak away from this pathetic excuse for a job and pick some lunarblossoms for Kat'la.$b$bI wouldn't dare confess my love to her without a gift.
english.progress: Я могу тебе чем-нибудь помочь, |3-6($c)?
english.completion: Lunarblossoms! You are too kind! I can't wait to give these to Kat'la.
english.completed: Return to Zukaza at Exile's Rise.

text.title: 前往戈杜尼
text.objectives: 前往古尔达要塞，并与莫克斯·剑吼会面。
text.description: 我们军械库里现在有充足的木铁了，可矿井里的储备也支撑不了我们多久。在南边有座山，满山都是这种材料，但有一个问题——食人魔！$b$b戈杜尼食人魔就住在山顶上，而且他们已经开始把木铁卖给钢铁部落了。$b$b我们得到那里去，把材料夺过来。$b$b我会打包一些补给品，到南边他们的要塞附近与你会合。
text.completion: I crafted a few things before we left that we may need: some bombs, a grappling hook, even was able to get one of the goblins to get a spare rocket pack.$B$BI'm sure we'll find a use for everything.

english.title: Going to the Gordunni
english.objectives: Travel to Gordal Fortress and meet up with Morketh Bladehowl.
english.description: We have a good supply of jovite in the arsenal now but there just isn't enough of the material in the mine to keep us in stock for long. Down south of here there's a mountain that's just full of the stuff but there's one problem; Ogres!$b$bThe Gordunni live on top of that mountain and they have begun trading the jovite to the Iron Horde.$b$bWe need to go down there and secure the minerals for ourselves.$b$bI'll pack some supplies and meet you near their fortress down south.
english.completion: I crafted a few things before we left that we may need: some bombs, a grappling hook, even was able to get one of the goblins to get a spare rocket pack.$B$BI'm sure we'll find a use for everything.

text.title: 伊奇的蛋
text.objectives: 在黯影丛林里帮助伊奇从卡里鸟蛋里孵出来。
text.description: <这枚鸟蛋奇迹般地躲过了破坏者的洗劫。$B$B在蛋的底部十分有爱地贴着一张小纸条，上面写着“伊奇”。>
text.completion: <The hatchling springs immediately to flight, then looks at you expectantly and cheeps.>
text.completed: Speak with Ikky in the Shadowglade.

english.title: Ikky's Egg
english.objectives: Help Ikky hatch from the Kaliri Egg in Shadowglade.
english.description: <Miraculously, this single egg has eluded the ravagers.$B$BA small tag has been lovingly tied around the base of the egg. It reads "Ikky.">
english.completion: <The hatchling springs immediately to flight, then looks at you expectantly and cheeps.>
english.completed: Speak with Ikky in the Shadowglade.

text.title: 投弹
text.objectives: 在古尔达要塞里召唤火炮轰击戈杜尼投石车营地。
text.description: 通往戈杜尼食人魔要塞的路只有一条，而且沿途有重兵把守，以抵御大规模攻击。$b$b幸好他们不会料到只有我们两个人偷偷闯进去。$b$b这是个瓦解他们防御力量的大好机会，还能让我们军械库的炮手们练练打靶。$b$b拿上这些烟雾弹，召唤火炮支援，按照我们的提示轰击他们的投石车。
text.completion: Now that we're inside we have much to do.
text.completed: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl within Gordal Fortress.

english.title: Dropping Bombs
english.objectives: Call artillery strikes on the Gordunni Boulderthrower encampments within Gordal Fortress.
english.description: The Gordunni have only a single path to their fortress and it is well-defended from a large attack.$b$bThankfully they wont be expecting just the two of us to be attempting to break in.$b$bThis is a great opportunity to take out their defenses and get some target practice for our artillery gunners back at the arsenal.$b$bTake these smoke grenades and use it to call in an artillery strike on their catapults as we head up.
english.completion: Now that we're inside we have much to do.
english.completed: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl within Gordal Fortress.

text.title: The Den of Skog
text.objectives: Kill Skog.
text.description: Olin Umberhide appears to have discovered the parent of the gronnlings and is outmatched by himself. He will be slain without help.
text.completed: Return to Gazlowe at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge
text.giverWindow: Mother and/or father of the local gronnlings.

english.title: The Den of Skog
english.objectives: Kill Skog.
english.description: Olin Umberhide appears to have discovered the parent of the gronnlings and is outmatched by himself. He will be slain without help.
english.completed: Return to Gazlowe at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge
english.giverWindow: Mother and/or father of the local gronnlings.

text.title: We Require More Resources
text.objectives: Gather $1oa Garrison Resources.
text.description: So what we got here is a good start, but you are looking for something that can support ARMIES!$b$bTruth is, we ain't building anything without the materials to build it, and our supplies from Azeroth are limited.$b$bI got some ideas on how to get you started but you are going to have to keep your eyes open for more materials when out in the field. Lots of useful stuff out there we can change into usable material.
text.completed: Return to Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: We Require More Resources
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Garrison Resources.
english.description: So what we got here is a good start, but you are looking for something that can support ARMIES!$b$bTruth is, we ain't building anything without the materials to build it, and our supplies from Azeroth are limited.$b$bI got some ideas on how to get you started but you are going to have to keep your eyes open for more materials when out in the field. Lots of useful stuff out there we can change into usable material.
english.completed: Return to Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: Lurking in the Shadows
text.objectives: Kill Shadowmoon Disrupters.
text.description: There are reports of Shadowmoon clan members lurking around the ruins by the shore.$b$bThis is a popular spot for young lovers to gaze at the stars and confess their affection for each other.$b$bAs you can see we are not a village of warriors.$b$bI will pay you handsomely if you go to the ruins and make sure the Shadowmoon orcs keep their distance.
text.completed: Return to Hara Bloodfury at Exile's Rise.

english.title: Lurking in the Shadows
english.objectives: Kill Shadowmoon Disrupters.
english.description: There are reports of Shadowmoon clan members lurking around the ruins by the shore.$b$bThis is a popular spot for young lovers to gaze at the stars and confess their affection for each other.$b$bAs you can see we are not a village of warriors.$b$bI will pay you handsomely if you go to the ruins and make sure the Shadowmoon orcs keep their distance.
english.completed: Return to Hara Bloodfury at Exile's Rise.

text.title: 钓鱼大战
text.objectives: 找到一位能够帮助我们的当地渔夫。
text.description: 我们这有个适合垂钓的钓鱼地点，但好像用什么鱼饵都钓不上鱼来！我们得找个熟悉情况的当地渔夫来帮忙。你觉得你能完成任务吗？
text.completed: 回你的要塞找马克金。

english.title: Fish Fight
english.objectives: Find a local fisherman that can help our cause.
english.description: We have an accessible fishing spot here, but no bait seems to work!  We need to find a local fisherman with some knowledge of the area to help us out.  Think you are up to the task?
english.completed: Return to Mak'jin at your Garrison.

objectiveDetails.description: Find a local fisherman and recruit him as a follower

text.title: 禁忌之爱
text.objectives: 找到卡拉扎。
text.description: 我的儿子卡拉扎简直太不听话了。$b$b在我们脱离影月氏族后，他仍然保持着和一位年轻影月兽人的关系。$b$b我不许他再见她。结果他却在今天早上跑了，到现在也没回来。$b$b我不信任多玛克，她跟其他影月兽人一样，都在继续干着关于虚空的勾当。
text.completion: Aka'Magosh, $c. I knew that void witch was no good.
text.completed: Return to Dulga at Exile's Rise.

english.title: Forbidden Love
english.objectives: Find Kral'za.
english.description: My son, Kral'za, is beyond stubborn. $b$bAfter we split from the Shadowmoon Clan he refused to let go of his relationship with a young Shadowmoon orc.$b$bI forbid him to see her anymore. He ran off earlier today and has not returned. $b$bI don't trust Dol'mak. Like the other Shadowmoon orcs she continues to dabble in the void.
english.completion: Aka'Magosh, $c. I knew that void witch was no good.
english.completed: Return to Dulga at Exile's Rise.

text.title: To Even the Odds
text.objectives: Find Shattered Hand weapons and give them to Battered Frostwolf Prisoners or Battered Karabor Prisoners.
text.description: [TEMP] The Shattered Hand orcs are using their prisoners as living training dummies. Let's even the odds and give them some weapons.
text.completed: Return to Olin Umberhide at Kargathar Proving Grounds in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: To Even the Odds
english.objectives: Find Shattered Hand weapons and give them to Battered Frostwolf Prisoners or Battered Karabor Prisoners.
english.description: [TEMP] The Shattered Hand orcs are using their prisoners as living training dummies. Let's even the odds and give them some weapons.
english.completed: Return to Olin Umberhide at Kargathar Proving Grounds in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 剑在人在
text.objectives: 从教头朗克身上找回兰特瑞索的长剑。
text.description: 当他们给我戴上镣铐时，那个名叫千里眼朗克的火刃教头抢走了我的长剑。他是一位可敬的兽人，尽管他的训练技巧产生了反效果。$B$B我想拿回我的长剑，$c。然后我就能自行挣脱枷锁。
text.progress: A blademaster without a blade is no blademaster at all.
text.completion: If you can defeat Luhk, then perhaps there's some hope for you after all.
text.completed: Return to Lantresor of the Blade at Hallvalor.
text.giverWindow: 剑圣训练师拿走了兰特瑞索的长剑。

english.title: The Blade Itself
english.objectives: Retrieve Lantresor's Blade from Instructor Luhk.
english.description: When they clapped me in irons, the Burning Blade instructor, Luhk the Keen-Eyed, took my blade. He's an honorable orc, even if his training techniques are counter-productive.$B$BI want my blade back, $c. Then, I'll break myself free.
english.progress: Мастер клинка без клинка – не мастер клинка.
english.completion: If you can defeat Luhk, then perhaps there's some hope for you after all.
english.completed: Return to Lantresor of the Blade at Hallvalor.
english.giverWindow: This trainer of blademasters has Lantresor's Blade.

text.title: 荣誉即吾命
text.objectives: 在火刃宝箱里找到剑圣的旗帜。
text.description: 剑圣随身携带的重要物品不只有长剑而已。$B$B在剑圣洞穴里通过最终试炼后，剑圣就会获得携带火刃旗帜的荣耀。$B$B当我请求恢复我在氏族中应有的地位时，那些懦夫装聋作哑地无视了我，还把我的这份荣耀也一并剥夺了。$B$B我的旗帜肯定被放在了哈瓦洛的某个地方。如果他们没在第一时间烧毁它的话，就会把它交给其它志向高远的剑圣。
text.progress: Do you have my banner?
text.completion: I don't expect you to understand the importance of what you've done.$B$BPerhaps one day you will.
text.completed: Return to Lantresor of the Blade at Hallvalor.

english.title: Not Without My Honor
english.objectives: Find the Blademaster's Banner in a Burning Blade Locker.
english.description: The blade is not the only important item a blademaster carries.$B$BOnce he has passed his final tests in the Masters' Caverns, the blademaster is given the honor of wearing the Burning Blade's banner.$B$BWhen my petition to reclaim my rightful place with the clan fell upon deaf and craven ears, I was stripped of that honor.$B$BNo doubt, my banner has been stored away somewhere in Hallvalor. They'll give it to some other aspiring blademaster if they don't burn it first.
english.progress: Мое знамя у тебя?
english.completion: I don't expect you to understand the importance of what you've done.$B$BPerhaps one day you will.
english.completed: Return to Lantresor of the Blade at Hallvalor.

text.title: 插曲：戈魯克
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个鬣蜥人卵簇、$2oa个冰铸噬铁者和巢母里戈艾克。
text.description: 鬣蜥人是危险的敌人，尤其是在他们人多势众的时候，更别说我们身边还跟着一个没用的瞎眼老萨满。$b$b幸运的是，他们都很短命。而不幸的是，他们繁衍很快，生长更快。$b$b如果我们想要完成这个任务，就得找到巢母。消灭她和她的卵，就能令鬣蜥人的攻势放缓。去检查一下熔炉之门附近的洞穴吧，我会尽量不让他们发现德雷克塔尔的气味。
text.completed: 回霜火岭的熔炉之门找德拉卡。

english.title: Vignette: Gruuk
english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters, $2oa Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.
english.description: Goren are dangerous, especially in large numbers, and especially when we have a blind, under powered shaman with us.$b$bFortunately, they have very short lifespans. Unfortunately, they multiply fast and grow faster.$b$BIf we are going to do this we need to find the brood mother. Slaying her and her eggs should slow down the onslaught of goren. Check the burrows near the Forge Gates and I will to keep them off of Drek'Thar's scent.
english.completed: Return to Draka at the Forge Gates in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 各个击破
text.objectives: 消灭元老沃戈什、元老祖尔莫克和元老克罗矛格。
text.description: 为了夺取要塞，我们得消灭巫师领主莫库克才行，可我不认为应该就这么径直去找他。$B$B他的三位副官——沃戈什、祖尔莫克和克罗矛格都是强大的法师，而且都对莫库克无比忠诚。$B$B一旦我们跟巫师领主交上手，他们恐怕就会立刻赶来助战。让我们先干掉他们，防止那种情况出现吧。
text.completion: Now with the viziers gone the whole Gordunni enchantment trade with the Iron Horde will come crashing down!$B$BWe can now turn our attention to dealing with Morkurk.
text.completed: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl within Gordal Fortress.

english.title: Punching Through
english.objectives: Slay Vizier Vorgorsh, Vizier Zulmork, and Vizier Cromaug.
english.description: To secure the fortress we need to kill Witch Lord Morkurk, but I don't think we should go straight after him.$B$BHis three lieutenants - Vorgorsh, Zulmork, and Cromaug - are all powerful mages, and all of them are fiercely loyal to Morkurk.$B$BI suspect that if we engage the Witch Lord that they will rush to his aid. Let's take them out so that cannot happen.
english.completion: Now with the viziers gone the whole Gordunni enchantment trade with the Iron Horde will come crashing down!$B$BWe can now turn our attention to dealing with Morkurk.
english.completed: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl within Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 跟蹤目標：被逐出洞穴的獸人

english.title: Tracking Flag: Orcs Kicked Out of Cave

text.title: 取回爱物
text.objectives: 从古尔达要塞的戈杜尼痛击者或戈杜尼劈砍者身上收集$1oa根戈杜尼“牙签”。
text.description: 钢铁部落把我武器的复制品作为礼物送给了戈杜尼食人魔。可他们用来干什么呢？剔牙！$b$b就算那些武器都是低级复制品，可仍然是我的设计，我不能容忍它们在食人魔手里多待一秒钟了！$b$b$g先生:女士;，既然我们已经来了，你能不能帮我把那些武器从他们手里夺过来！
text.progress: Were you able to get all of my blades back?
text.completion: Thank you, commander. With this another stain on my honor has been removed.
text.completed: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl within Gordal Fortress.

english.title: Prized Repossessions
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Gordunni "Toothpick's" from Gordunni Bashers or Gordunni Cleavers within Gordal Fortress.
english.description: The Gordunni were given copies of my blades as a gift from the Iron Horde. But what do they use them for? Toothpicks!$b$bSure the blades are low grade copies but it's still MY design and I can't stand to think of them in those ogre hands for a moment longer!$b$b$gSir:Ma'am;, While we are in here can you do me a favor and get those blades out of their hands!
english.progress: Were you able to get all of my blades back?
english.completion: Thank you, commander. With this another stain on my honor has been removed.
english.completed: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl within Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 找回补给品
text.objectives: 取回$1oa份钢铁部落货物。
text.description: 我们似乎来得正是时候！$b$b戈杜尼食人魔一直在给钢铁部落的军备附魔，而且看来他们还没把最新一批货物领走。$b$b我们应该把那些装备用在更有用的地方！让我们去劫取他们的货运集装箱吧，我带来了一些信号弹，等拿到货物之后，可以发射信号弹召唤空运力量。
text.completion: Alright, that should be the last one we need. $B$BNothing feels as good as knowing you are stronger than your enemy!
text.completed: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl within Gordal Fortress.

english.title: Supply Recovery
english.objectives: Recover $1oa Iron Horde Shipments.
english.description: We seem to have arrived at just the right time!$b$bThe Gordunni have been enchanting armaments for the Iron Horde and it looks like they haven't picked up the latest shipment.$b$bWe could put that gear to far better use! Lets go hunt down their shipping containers. I brought some signal flares that we can use to call in an air pick-up when we've secured the shipment.
english.completion: Alright, that should be the last one we need. $B$BNothing feels as good as knowing you are stronger than your enemy!
english.completed: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl within Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 我们需要一支军队
text.objectives: 与战争大师佐格谈一谈。
text.description: 看来新酋长决定派战争大师佐格协助你管理当地的运作事宜。佐格！$b$b我听说那家伙声名在外，组织联盟和部落大军在安其拉之门对抗异种蝎。$b$b不管怎样，要是你把兵营完工的消息告诉他，他肯定知道如何有效发挥它的作用。$b$b你可以在要塞大厅找到佐格。
text.completion: Commander, it is an honor to serve you.
text.completed: 到你在霜火岭的要塞与战争大师佐格谈一谈。

english.title: We Need An Army
english.objectives: Speak with Warmaster Zog.
english.description: So the new warchief decided to send you Warmaster Zog to handle local operations. Zog!$b$bI heard that guy was notorious for organizing the Alliance AND the Horde to face off against the silithid at the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.$b$bHe was a general back then.$b$bAnyway, if you go let him know about the barracks being done I'm sure he'll have some thoughts on how to put it to good use.$b$bYou can find Zog up at the town hall.
english.completion: Commander, it is an honor to serve you.
english.completed: Speak with Warmaster Zog at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 到洞穴里见我
text.objectives: 到剑圣洞穴里与兰特瑞索·火刃见面。
text.description: 是时候了，$c。你该去拿你的设计图了。$B$B我们该去面对剑圣了。
text.completion: You made it. Good.$B$BGetting in here was nothing compared to what's to come.

english.title: Meet Me in the Cavern
english.objectives: Meet up with Lantresor of the Blade inside the Masters' Cavern.
english.description: It's time, $c. Time for you to get your blueprints.$B$BTime for us to face the masters.
english.completion: You made it. Good.$B$BGetting in here was nothing compared to what's to come.

text.title: 戈尔隆德的秘密
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德与杜隆坦碰头。
text.description: 指挥官，我会让我的军队留下守卫小径，但在敌人准备发起新一轮攻击的同时，我绝不能坐以待毙。$b$b我要将战火引向钢铁部落在黑石的中心据点，因此必须要到兽人罕至的地方去。$b$b那就是戈尔隆德。$b$b戈尔隆德是一片荒蛮之地，到处都是各种巨人和怪物。$b$b你敢不敢跟我一起闯进这片荒野，直捣钢铁部落的铸造厂？
text.completion: Gorgrond is no place for armies, commander. We are now stepping into the domain of legends.
text.completed: 在戈尔隆德与杜隆坦碰头。

english.title: The Secrets of Gorgrond
english.objectives: Meet Durotan in Gorgrond.
english.description: Commander, I will leave my forces to secure this pass, but I will not sit idle while our enemy prepares for another attack.$b$bI want to take the fight to the heart of the Iron Horde at Blackrock, and to do that we are going to need to go where few orcs dare tread.$b$bGorgrond.$b$bIt is a savage place, filled with giants and monsters of every sort.$b$bWill you dare these wilds with me so that we might strike at the foundries of the Iron Horde?
english.completion: Gorgrond is no place for armies, commander. We step into the lands of ancient legends.
english.completed: Meet Durotan in Gorgrond.

text.title: 剑圣的挑战
text.objectives: 凭借战技通过火刃的试炼，并取得要塞图纸。
text.description: 向火刃剑圣们发起挑战的时刻到了。$B$B到洞穴后方去。你会在那里找到竞技场，剑圣们就在上方俯视着。$B$B在竞技场中央亮出武器，发起你的挑战吧。我的氏族把荣耀看得比什么都重要，会尊重你以战斗决胜负的请求。$B$B作为奖励，你将获准带着你的图纸活着离开。前提是你没战死的话。
text.progress: Do you have the garrison blueprints, commander?
text.completion: The garrison blueprints. Outstanding.$B$BThere's only one thing left to do.
text.completed: Return to Foreman Thazz'ril at Wor'var.

english.title: Challenge of the Masters
english.objectives: Survive the Burning Blade's trial by combat and retrieve the Garrison Blueprints.
english.description: The time has come to challenge the Burning Blade masters.$B$BGo to the back of the cavern. There you will find the challenge ring and the masters watching over it from above.$B$BPull the blade from the middle of the ring to issue your challenge. My clan values honor above all else and will respect your claim to trial by combat.$B$BAs reward, you will be allowed to walk away with your blueprints and your life. Or, you will be dead.
english.progress: Командир, чертежи гарнизона у тебя?
english.completion: The garrison blueprints. Outstanding.$B$BThere's only one thing left to do.
english.completed: Return to Foreman Thazz'ril at Wor'var.

text.title: 嘎嘣脆鸡肉味
text.objectives: 从纳格兰的风鹏身上取得$1oa块生风鹏肉。
text.description: 你有空吗，$g帅哥:美女;？我遇到了雷象一般大的麻烦。$B$B有人……呃……把这两个小家伙卖给了我，可它们却病怏怏的。我什么办法都试过了，就是不见好转！$B$B我想它们肯定是饿坏了。我听说雷象喜欢生吃风鹏。这在我看来真是太野蛮了。$B$B不管怎么说吧，在你外出办事的途中，能不能帮我找点那种鸟肉来？
text.progress: Windrocs? Yeah, Nagrand's filthy with them.$B$BThey seem to like high places and rock outcroppings.$B$BI don't know. What do I look like - a windroc whisperer? You're the $C.
text.completion: It sure doesn't smell like chicken!$B$BOkay, okay, hand it over. I'll feed them and then everyone will be happy and I can turn a tidy - er, um... they'll feel better.$B$BYeah.
text.completed: Return to Digrem Orebar at the Ring of Trials.

english.title: Tastes Like Chicken
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Raw Windroc from windroc in Nagrand.
english.description: You got a moment, $g bub:beautiful;? I've got an elekk-sized problem.$B$BSomeone, um, sold me... yeah, sold me these two, but they're sick. I've tried everything, but nothing I do makes any difference!$B$BI think they must be starving. I heard that elekk like raw windroc. Gross if you ask me.$B$BAnyway, while you're out doing your thing, you mind picking me up some bird meat?
english.progress: Windrocs? Yeah, Nagrand's filthy with them.$B$BThey seem to like high places and rock outcroppings.$B$BI don't know. What do I look like - a windroc whisperer? You're the $C.
english.completion: It sure doesn't smell like chicken!$B$BOkay, okay, hand it over. I'll feed them and then everyone will be happy and I can turn a tidy - er, um... they'll feel better.$B$BYeah.
english.completed: Return to Digrem Orebar at the Ring of Trials.

text.title: 戈杜尼之主
text.objectives: 在古尔达要塞里击败巫师领主莫库克并取回“熔炉之怒”。
text.description: 巫师领主莫库克是戈杜尼食人魔的首领。正是他缔结了与钢铁部落之间的贸易协定，更糟糕的是，我的前任老板还把我最好的一把锤子送给了他！$b$b我们得把我的锤子拿回来！我是说……我们得干掉他才能给你的军械库弄到木铁！$b$b莫库克是个老练的法师，所以你最好做好准备。来，拿上这个火箭包，在你需要快速躲闪攻击或类似的情况下使用。$b$b另外，要是你碰巧找到我锤子的话，我希望你能帮我取回它。
text.progress: Do you have my mace?
text.completion: Fine work commander! Your combat skills are clearly second to none. I am honored to be your armorer!$B$BLet's get back to the outpost so we can take stock of our new inventory. I saved a few flares to call us in a ride back.
text.completed: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl within Gordal Fortress.

english.title: The Lord of the Gordunni
english.objectives: Defeat Witch Lord Morkurk within Gordal Fortress and obtain "Fury of the Forge".
english.description: Witch Lord Morkurk is the leader of the Gordunni. He's the one that set up the Iron Horde trade and, even worse, my former boss gave him one of my best maces!$b$bWe got to get my mace back! I mean... we need to kill him to secure the jovite for your arsenal!$b$bMorkurk is an accomplished mage so you better be prepared. Here, take the rocket pack and use it if you need to dodge an attack quickly or something.$b$bAlso, if you happen to find my mace I'd like to get it back.
english.progress: Do you have my mace?
english.completion: Fine work commander! Your combat skills are clearly second to none. I am honored to be your armorer!$B$BLet's get back to the outpost so we can take stock of our new inventory. I saved a few flares to call us in a ride back.
english.completed: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl within Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 重拾珍貴的財產任務追蹤
后续步骤
text.objectives: 在沃金之傲与魔导师克雷拉斯谈一谈。
text.description: 你的热情简直在燃烧！$B$B我制作卷轴需要用到的东西都备齐了。你的奥秘圣殿很快就会闪烁着奥术能量的火花。$B$B我要传送到沃金之傲去混合试剂并集结你的军队。等你有时间就去那找我吧。
text.completion: Your forces burn with passion for your cause.$B$BNot easy against such towering foes. Well done.
text.completed: Speak to Magister Krelas at Vol'jin's Pride.

english.title: Next Steps
english.objectives: Speak to Magister Krelas at Vol'jin's Pride.
english.description: You are positively on fire!$B$BWe have everything I need to create the scroll. Your arcane sanctum will be brimming with arcane energy in no time.$B$BI will teleport to Vol'jin's Pride to combine the reagents and marshal your forces. Meet me there when you can.
english.completion: Your forces burn with passion for your cause.$B$BNot easy against such towering foes. Well done.
english.completed: Speak to Magister Krelas at Vol'jin's Pride.

text.title: 后续步骤
text.objectives: 在乌瑞恩堡与魔导师赛琳娜谈一谈。
text.description: 我们做到了！我们已经具备了卷轴需要的所有试剂。过不了多久，你的奥秘圣殿就会成为德拉诺住民口中的热门话题。$B$B我要返回乌瑞恩堡去完成它并集结你的兵力。去那找我吧。
text.completion: Now we can tackle getting that artificial nexus for your tower.
text.completed: Return to Magister Serena in Khadgar's Tower.

english.title: Next Steps
english.objectives: Speak to Magister Serena at Fort Wrynn.
english.description: We did it! We have all of the reagents for the scroll. Your arcane sanctum will be the talk of Draenor before long.$B$BI'll go back to Fort Wrynn to finish it and gather your men. Meet me there.
english.completion: Теперь пора подумать об искусственном нексусе для твоей башни.
english.completed: Return to Magister Serena in Khadgar's Tower.

text.title: 露拉失去的爱人
text.objectives: 检查松软泥土，找到老露拉的丈夫。
text.description: 噢，那真是太可怕了。$b$b我跟我丈夫当时正在沼泽里钓鱼，我睡着了，等我醒来时发现他已经被变成了一只蟾蜍！$b$b我想肯定是某个臭名昭著的影月兽人干的。$b$b还没等我抓住他，他就跳进了泥水里。$b$b你能帮我找回失去的爱人吗，$c？
text.progress: 根据我对我丈夫的了解，他此刻很可能正在冬眠。你能检查下沼泽里的松软泥土，找找他吗？
text.completion: Hmm... I'm sure one of these toads is my husband.
text.completed: Return to Old Loola at Twilight Glade.

english.title: Loola's Lost Love
english.objectives: Search Loose Mud for Old Loola's husband.
english.description: Oh it was horrible.$b$bMy husband and I were fishing in the marsh, I fell asleep and when I woke up he had been turned into a toad!$b$bI'm sure it was one of those Shadowmoon orcs I hear so much about.$b$bHe jumped into the muddy waters before I could catch him.$b$bWill you help me find my lost love, $c?
english.progress: Based on what I know about my husband, he is probably hibernating at the moment. Can you check the soft soil in the swamp and find him?
english.completion: Hmm... I'm sure one of these toads is my husband.
english.completed: Return to Old Loola at Twilight Glade.

text.title: 阻截援军
text.objectives: 摧毁通往悬槌堡的传送门。
text.description: 根据我的调查，在这里和悬槌堡之间有一道永久性的奥术传送门。$b$b它周围守卫森严，但要是你能抓住敌人的喘息之机，要想破坏它应该也不会太困难。
text.completion: Excellent.  I doubt they will rebuild it after we've completed all of our objectives here.$b$bThis place will return to being a failing outpost for the Gorian Empire.
text.completed: Return to Rangari D'kaan at Telaari Station in Nagrand.

english.title: Removing the Reinforcements
english.objectives: Destroy the Portal to Highmaul.
english.description: My own investigations have uncovered a permanent arcane portal from here to Highmaul itself.$b$bIt is guarded but shouldn't be too hard to disrupt once you've gotten some breathing room.
english.completion: Excellent.  I doubt they will rebuild it after we've completed all of our objectives here.$b$bThis place will return to being a failing outpost for the Gorian Empire.
english.completed: Return to Rangari D'kaan at Telaari Station in Nagrand.

objectiveDetails.description: 摧毁通往悬槌堡的传送门

text.title: 要塞脚下
text.objectives: 在古尔达要塞的入口处与魔导师克雷拉斯谈一谈。
text.description: 我们点燃了你军队士兵们的热情，卷轴也已经准备就绪。$B$B现在该开始第二阶段的行动了——从重兵把守的食人魔营地里偷取一块连结水晶。$B$B我们要把卷轴留到对抗戈杜尼巫师领主时再用，把援军召唤到我们身边。让我们在古尔达丘陵山脚下见面吧，把应该属于你的全都夺回来！
text.completion: My apologies for teleporting away. It's cheating, I know.$B$BI merely wanted to put a fire under your feet to get here quickly!

english.title: The Foot of the Fortress
english.objectives: Speak to Magister Krelas at the entrance to Gordal Fortress.
english.description: We've enkindled your forces and the scroll is ready.$B$BIt's time for phase two - stealing a nexus crystal from a heavily fortified ogre compound.$B$BWe'll save the scroll to bring in reinforcements in our confrontation with the Gordunni Witch Lord. Let's meet at the base of the Gordal Foothills and take what is more or less rightfully yours!
english.completion: My apologies for teleporting away. It's cheating, I know.$B$BI merely wanted to put a fire under your feet to get here quickly!

text.title: 上等的进门方案
text.objectives: 帮助魔导师克雷拉斯摧毁$1oa辆戈杜尼投石车。
text.description: 巫师领主莫库克可不是傻子。$B$B他在丘陵各处，一直到他们营地的沿途都安放了投石车。$B$B不要紧，我有办法解决这些东西。$B$B消灭看守攻城武器的食人魔，然后给攻城武器做好标记。我正在准备一种漩涡法术，可以从远处干掉目标。$B$B然后我们在他们的大门外面会合吧。
text.completion: Before we take on Morkurk we have some business to attend to in the fortress proper.
text.completed: Speak to Magister Krelas in Gordal Fortress.

english.title: Dropping In
english.objectives: Help Magister Krelas destroy $1oa Gordunni Boulderthrowers.
english.description: Witch Lord Morkurk is no fool.$B$BHe has catapults set up throughout the foothills leading into their compound.$B$BNo matter, I have a way to handle them.$B$BTake out the ogres guarding the siege weapons and mark them once they're clear. I'm readying a vortex spell that will handle things from there.$B$BWe'll meet just outside their gate afterwards.
english.completion: Before we take on Morkurk we have some business to attend to in the fortress proper.
english.completed: Speak to Magister Krelas in Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 土、风、火……还有水
text.objectives: 从元素高地收集活体精华，每种4个。
text.description: 元素高地变得不稳定了，因此必须开始重生循环。$b$b作为我们生命循环中自然而然的一部分，随着时间的推移，杂质会在元素体内聚积。$b$b当污染达到一定程度时，元素就会变得不稳定，在某些情况下还会具有爆炸性。$b$b重生的一个必要环节需要用到纯净的活体精华，你可以在元素高地上或者元素之魂的体内找到它们。$b$b把精华带来交给我，我们将开始重生循环。
text.progress: Bring to me the living essences of the elements, that I may plant the seeds of rebirth.
text.completion: You have done well.$b$bAlthough the Elemental Plateau is no longer stable, the cycle of rebirth will soon take place and the elements will be born anew.
text.completed: Return to Incineratus.

english.title: Earth, Wind and Fire...and Water
english.objectives: Collect 4 of each living essence from the Elemental Plateau.
english.description: The Elemental Plateau has become unstable, and so the cycle of rebirth must begin.$b$bIt is a natural part of our life cycle that impurities are accumulated in the elemental body over time.$b$bWhen enough contamination has taken place, an elemental will become unstable and in some cases volatile.$b$bA necessary part of rebirth is pure, living essence which can be found atop the Elemental Plateau, as well as in the body of an elemental spirit.$b$bReturn to me with the essence and we shall begin the rebirth.
english.progress: Принеси мне субстанции жизни стихий, и тогда я смогу посадить семена возрождения.
english.completion: You have done well.$b$bAlthough the Elemental Plateau is no longer stable, the cycle of rebirth will soon take place and the elements will be born anew.
english.completed: Return to Incineratus.

text.title: 黑暗中的利刃
text.objectives: 在阿卡拉兹鸦巢里消灭马尔洛克·棘痕。
text.description: 是那些兽人夺走了伊沙尔的宝珠对吧？那就能解释比你早几步闯进这里的那个长相危险的家伙究竟是什么人了。$B$B并非人人都能像你这么……优雅地应对这种转变。那呆子直到现在还在跟他自己的意志对抗，跌跌撞撞，满口胡言。$B$B他很快就会再次被宝珠吸引，很有可能会被带到泰罗克鸦巢。$B$B最好趁他神志不清时把他解决掉。
text.completion: He was a big boy, wasn't he? The fiends will make quite a feast of him.
text.completed: Return to Talonpriest Zellek in Veil Akraz.
text.giverWindow: 因闯入暗影界而变得精神失常。仍然很危险。

english.title: Blades in the Dark
english.objectives: Slay Malrok Thornscar in Veil Akraz.
english.description: Those orcs got hold of Ishaal's orb, did they? That would explain the dangerous-looking fellow who crossed into this realm shortly before you.$B$BNot everyone handles the transition as... gracefully as you did. The oaf is still grappling with his own mind, stumbling about and muttering nonsense.$B$BSoon he will be drawn to the orb again, which would presumably lead him to Veil Terokk.$B$BBetter to take him out now while he's still befuddled.
english.completion: He was a big boy, wasn't he? The fiends will make quite a feast of him.
english.completed: Return to Talonpriest Zellek in Veil Akraz.
english.giverWindow: Driven mad by crossing into the shadow realm. Still dangerous.

text.title: 暗影盛宴
text.objectives: 收集$1oa份暗影之尘。
text.description: 有许多鸦人在阿卡拉兹鸦巢里死去了。从外面看，一切似乎都显得平静而空寂。$B$B可在这两个世界交界的地方，死亡从来不会被忽视。$B$B游离的生命精华从另一边渗入，成为潜藏在这里的生物口中的大餐。$B$B干掉这里的暗影生物，从它们的尸体上收集它们制造出来的细粉尘。我需要很多这样的粉尘来举行利爪之王的仪式。
text.progress: You know those elixirs you have been so eagerly quaffing?$B$BThey are made of this stuff.
text.completion: Good. With this much dust we can delve deep enough to reach the Talon King's refuge.
text.completed: Return to Talonpriest Zellek in Veil Akraz.

english.title: A Feast of Shadows
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Shadow Dust.
english.description: Many arakkoa died in Veil Akraz. From the outside, all seems still. Empty.$B$BBut in this place between worlds, death never goes unnoticed.$B$BStray life essence seeps through from the other side; a feast for the beings who prowl here.$B$BSlay the shadow creatures here, and gather from their corpses the fine dust they produce. I will need much of it to perform the rites of the Talon King.
english.progress: Эти эликсиры, которые ты глотаешь как воду...$B$BИх варят вот из этого.
english.completion: Good. With this much dust we can delve deep enough to reach the Talon King's refuge.
english.completed: Return to Talonpriest Zellek in Veil Akraz.

text.title: 卡利鸟驯养者
text.objectives: 从斯卡基克那里找回旧木槌。
text.description: 在附近的黯影丛林里住着一位重要的联系人。他性格温顺，但却训练着体型巨大且相当危险的卡利鸟。$B$B他有一次甚至号称这些卡利鸟能把双头飞龙从天上给打下来，可我还是相信眼见为实。$B$B斯卡基克帮我保管着一样珍贵的宝贝。要是你能行，就去找到他，把他送回泰罗克鸦巢。反正至少要把我托付给他的木槌找回来。
text.progress: Any word on Skizzik?
text.completion: I see. Well, at least the gavel is safe.$B$BAs you may have guessed, it is another of the Talon King's relics.
text.completed: Return the Old Gavel to Reshad in Veil Terokk.

english.title: The Kaliri Whisperer
english.objectives: Recover the Old Gavel from Skizzik.
english.description: An important contact lives in the nearby Shadowglade. He is meek, but trains kaliri of monstrous size which are quite dangerous.$B$BHe once claimed they could knock a rylak out of the sky, but I'll believe that when I see it.$B$BSkizzik is holding a valuable treasure for me. Seek him out and get him back to Veil Terokk if you can. At the very least, recover the gavel I entrusted to him.
english.progress: Any word from Skeezziek?
english.completion: I see. Well, at least the gavel is safe.$B$BAs you may have guessed, it is another of the Talon King's relics.
english.completed: Return the Old Gavel to Reshad in Veil Terokk.

text.title: 棘母
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个影背掠食者和影背棘母。
text.description: <斯卡基克手掌摊开，底下的泥土里写着几行字：$B$B棘$B$B母$B$B碎手氏族带来的掠食者已经占领了鸟园，并且迅速繁殖。假如任由其发展下去，过不了几天，就将席卷整个地区——包括泰罗克鸦巢。>
text.completion: Shame about Skizzik's aviary. That's where Percy came from. Skizzik wasn't interested in the "runts" after he started breeding the big ones full-time.$B$BTo be honest, I never liked those monstrous things.
text.completed: Speak with Reshad in Veil Terokk.
text.giverWindow: 消灭她和她的掠食者。

english.title: Mother of Thorns
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Shadeback Ravagers and the Shadeback Thornmother.
english.description: <Beneath Skizzik's outstretched hand, letters are scrawled into the dirt:$B$Bt h o r n$B$Bm o t h e r$B$BRavagers brought in by the Shattered Hand have taken over the aviary and are breeding fast. If left alone, they could be swarming the entire area - including Veil Terokk - in a matter of days.>
english.completion: Shame about Skizzik's aviary. That's where Percy came from. Skizzik wasn't interested in the "runts" after he started breeding the big ones full-time.$B$BTo be honest, I never liked those monstrous things.
english.completed: Speak with Reshad in Veil Terokk.
english.giverWindow: Slay her and her ravagers.

text.title: 小小鸟
text.objectives: 在黯影丛林里收集$1oa只掠食蛆虫。
text.description: <伊奇又啾啾叫了起来，然后开始咬它的脚。$B$B你放眼眺望附近的山坡，发现有只小小的掠食蛆虫正在草地上蠕动。>
text.progress: <Ikky looks up at you, foot clamped in his beak, and lets out a muffled cheep.>
text.completion: <You hold the handful of grubs out, steel yourself, and prepare to chew them up as a mama bird would.$B$BThankfully, Ikky snatches them from your hand before you can proceed.$B$BApparently kaliri don't do that.>
text.completed: Return to Ikky in the Shadowglade.

english.title: Baby Bird
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Ravager Grubs in the Shadowglade.
english.description: <Ikky cheeps again, then begins gnawing on his foot.$B$BLooking out across the nearby hillside, you spy tiny ravager grubs inching along the grass.>
english.progress: <Ikki looks at you with his beak in his paws and makes a choked squeak.>
english.completion: <You hold the handful of grubs out, steel yourself, and prepare to chew them up as a mama bird would.$B$BThankfully, Ikky snatches them from your hand before you can proceed.$B$BApparently kaliri don't do that.>
english.completed: Return to Ikky in the Shadowglade.

text.title: 邻里优势
text.objectives: 收集$1oa颗戈杜尼符文珠。
text.description: 啊，傲慢的食人魔。$B$B总是喜欢搬起石头砸自己的脚。$B$B莫库克一直在用施有魔法的手环给他的爪牙们灌注奥术之力。$B$B我们可以分解掉那些手环，把它们变成附魔材料，那无疑将对你的奥秘圣殿大有帮助。你愿意帮我们收集些手环来吗？
text.progress: Most mages discount the use of arcane dust these days, but they're wrong.
text.completion: Yes, these will definitely be useful! Trust me.
text.completed: Return to Magister Krelas in Gordal Fortress.

english.title: While We're in the Neighborhood
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Gordunni Runebeads.
english.description: Ah, the hubris of ogres.$B$BIt always backfires.$B$BMorkurk has been using enchanted bracelets to empower his minions with arcane strength.$B$BWe can disenchant these bracelets into reagents that will no doubt be useful to your arcane sanctum. What do you think about collecting some while we're here?
english.progress: Most mages discount the use of arcane dust these days, but they're wrong.
english.completion: Yes, these will definitely be useful! Trust me.
english.completed: Return to Magister Krelas in Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 险恶的元老
text.objectives: 消灭元老沃戈什、元老祖尔莫克和元老克罗矛格。
text.description: 虽然我们的目标是巫师领主莫库克，可我们不该直接跑去找他。$B$B他有三位副官——沃戈什、祖尔莫克和克罗矛格，是戈杜尼食人魔中仅存的三位得力法师，而且狂热地忠于莫库克。$B$B我担心他们会在我们攻击巫师领主时前来增援。还是先把他们干掉吧。
text.completion: Now that they're out of the way, Morkurk is exposed.
text.completed: Return to Magister Krelas in Gordal Fortress.

english.title: Vicious Viziers
english.objectives: Slay Vizier Vorgorsh, Vizier Zulmork, and Vizier Cromaug.
english.description: We're after Witch Lord Morkurk, but we shouldn't charge straight at him.$B$BHis three lieutenants - Vorgorsh, Zulmork, and Cromaug - are the only other capable mages left of the Gordunni, and are fiercely loyal to Morkurk.$B$BI suspect that if we engage the Witch Lord that they will rush to his aid. Let's take them out first.
english.completion: Now that they're out of the way, Morkurk is exposed.
english.completed: Return to Magister Krelas in Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 能量宝珠
text.objectives: 摧毁$1oa个星界结界。
text.description: 在实行我的计划之前，我们还得解决个小麻烦。$B$B莫库克在古尔达要塞各处都布下了强大的结界，以阻止任何群体召唤法术——这下我们的群体传送卷轴就完全没有用武之地了。$B$B幸好，那些食人魔无论如何都想不到区区一两个敌人竟然有胆量独闯他们的地盘。
text.completion: There's nothing Morkurk can do to stop us now.$B$BWell done indeed!
text.completed: Return to Magister Krelas in Gordal Fortress.

english.title: Orbs of Power
english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Astral Wards.
english.description: There's a minor fire we'll need to put out before we can enact my plan.$B$BMorkurk has placed powerful wards throughout Gordal Fortress that will prevent any sort of mass summoning - awfully detrimental to our scroll of mass teleportation.$B$BThankfully, no ogre would ever consider that a single enemy or two would have the gall to breach their walls.
english.completion: There's nothing Morkurk can do to stop us now.$B$BWell done indeed!
english.completed: Return to Magister Krelas in Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 最后一步
text.objectives: 在古尔达要塞里击败巫师领主莫库克并取得奥术枢纽。
text.description: 现在是时候以暴制暴了。$B$B我们已经将莫库克逼到了绝境。他的防御结界全都失效了。在你与莫库克交战时使用那个卷轴……$B$B……然后好好欣赏一场焰火表演吧。
text.progress: Ogres. It's always ogres.
text.completion: That's what we were after.$B$BLet's get out of here!
text.completed: Speak to Magister Krelas in Gordal Fortress.

english.title: The Final Step
english.objectives: Defeat Witch Lord Morkurk and retrieve the Arcane Nexus in Gordal Fortress.
english.description: It's time to fight fire with fire.$B$BWe have Morkurk cornered. His protections gone. Use the scroll once you engage Morkurk...$B$B...and enjoy the fireworks.
english.progress: Ogres. It's always ogres.
english.completion: That's what we were after.$B$BLet's get out of here!
english.completed: Speak to Magister Krelas in Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 元素协调
text.objectives: 找到全部四根元素之柱。
text.description: 有很多萨满祭司都在寻求元素王座的青睐。$b$b当一名萨满祭司与元素之怒建立起元素连结之后，他不仅会了解到德拉诺世界中元素的意志，同时还将得以接近元素力量的伟大源泉。$b$b如果你想要查明戈达乌消失的真相，就需要做到其他人做不到的事，并完成融合仪式。$b$b首先，你必须做好准备。到高地上寻找元素之柱，使你的灵魂与元素共鸣。
text.completion: You have done well, $n.$b$bBy linking with each of the four elemental pillars you have attuned your life energy with each of the elements on Draenor.$b$bYou are now ready to undertake the Ritual of Binding.$b$bSpeak to me when your work upon the Elemental Plateau is finished, and we shall begin.
text.completed: Return to Farseer Drek'Thar.

english.title: Elemental Attunement
english.objectives: Seek out the four elemental pillars.
english.description: Many shaman have sought the favor of the Throne of Elements.$b$bForming an elemental bond with the furies allows a shaman to not only know the will of the elements on Draenor, but also tap into a great font of elemental power.$b$bIf you are to discover the truth behind Gordawg's disappearance, you will need to succeed where others have failed and undertake the Ritual of Binding.$b$bFirst, you must prepare yourself. Seek out the elemental pillars upon the plateau and attune your spirit with the elements.
english.completion: You have done well, $n.$b$bBy linking with each of the four elemental pillars you have attuned your life energy with each of the elements on Draenor.$b$bYou are now ready to undertake the Ritual of Binding.$b$bSpeak to me when your work upon the Elemental Plateau is finished, and we shall begin.
english.completed: Return to Farseer Drek'Thar.

text.title: 高地守护者
text.objectives: 消灭元素高地上堕落的守护者。
text.description: 元素高地是纳格兰元素之魂的圣所。$b$b高地元素当中最伟大的无疑是那些守护者—它们是强大的元素之魂，看守着自己的领地。$b$b守护者是纯净而强大的灵魂，可一旦大自然的平衡被打破，这些灵魂就会变得不再稳定，腐化周围的次级元素。$b$b为了重铸高地的平衡，必须消灭这些守护者。只有到那时，重生循环才能开始。
text.completion: Each of the guardians you put to rest were once mighty and noble elemental spirits.$b$bIn time each shall be reborn anew through the cycle of rebirth, but Gordawg must be found and balance restored lest the plateau become unstable yet again.
text.completed: Return to Incineratus.

english.title: Guardians of the Plateau
english.objectives: Destroy the corrupted guardians atop the Elemental Plateau.
