english.description: The Elemental Plateau is sanctuary to the elemental spirits of Nagrand.$b$bThe greatest among the elementals on the plateau are the guardians; mighty elemental spirits that stand watch over their domain.$b$bThe guardians are pure and mighty spirits but a disturbance in the natural balance has caused them to grow unstable, corrupting the lesser elementals around them.$b$bIn order to restore balance to the plateau, the guardians must be destroyed. Only then will the cycle of rebirth begin.
english.completion: Each of the guardians you put to rest were once mighty and noble elemental spirits.$b$bIn time each shall be reborn anew through the cycle of rebirth, but Gordawg must be found and balance restored lest the plateau become unstable yet again.
english.completed: Return to Incineratus.

text.title: 罕见的花朵
text.objectives: 从元素高地上找到燃烬之花。
text.description: 许多年前，我曾有过一位终生伴侣，她叫达哈卡。我们相守的时间不长，没过多久我就失去了她。$b$b在那之后，我独自一人活了许多年，可再也没有经历过比与她诀别那天更大的痛苦。当时我还年轻，简直痛不欲生，就连脚下的大地都因我的怒火而震颤。我把她埋在了这座峭壁上。$b$b不久后，我也将在这里与她同眠，不过要先请你帮我个忙。$b$b在高地火红炽热的地下有个洞穴，里面生长着一种罕见的花。那是她生前的最爱。$b$b在我临死前，我想最后一次将这花献给她，放在她的墓前。
text.progress: Do you have the Ember Blossom?
text.completion: This is a fine Ember Blossom that you have brought to me. I know the danger you faced to retrieve it and I thank you.
text.completed: Return to Gar'rok.

english.title: A Rare Bloom
english.objectives: Retrieve the Ember Blossom from the Elemental Plateau.
english.description: Many years ago I had a life-mate, Dahaka. We were only bound a short time before she was taken from me.$b$bI have lived long, but I have never known greater pain than that day. I was young and my grief was great; the earth quaked beneath my rage. I laid her to rest upon this cliff.$b$bIt is here where I too will rest, but first a favor.$b$bA rare bloom grows in a cave within the fiery, molten earth of the plateau. It was her favorite.$b$bI would lay the flower upon her grave one last time before I die.
english.progress: Ну что, углецвет у тебя?
english.completion: This is a fine Ember Blossom that you have brought to me. I know the danger you faced to retrieve it and I thank you.
english.completed: Return to Gar'rok.

text.title: 集结游侠
text.objectives: 找到$1oa名潜伏的游侠。
text.description: 你的目光很是锐利，$c。$b$b在暗夜沼泽各处都潜伏着像我一样的游侠。$b$b我需要从他们每个人那里搜集报告，来确保地区的安全。$b$b也许你能帮帮我？
text.completion: Thank you for the report, $n. We must keep a close eye on these southern wilds.
text.completed: Return to Rangari Veka at the Nightmarsh.

english.title: Rangari Roundup
english.objectives: Find the $1oa Hidden Rangari.
english.description: You have a keen eye, $c.$b$bThere are Rangari like myself hidden throughout the Nightmarsh.$b$bI need reports from each of them to ensure the area is safe.$b$bPerhaps you can help me?
english.completion: Спасибо за отчет, $n. За этими южными пустошами нужно постоянно приглядывать.
english.completed: Return to Rangari Veka at the Nightmarsh.

text.title: 伊奇
text.completion: <Ikky cheeps at you excitedly.$B$BIt seems you've made a new friend.>

english.title: Ikky
english.completion: <Ikky cheeps at you excitedly.$B$BIt seems you've made a new friend.>

text.title: 作出选择
text.objectives: 用绘图桌来选择建造兽栏还是坦克工厂。
text.description: 我们已经准备好开始建造了。现在只需要你来作出选择。$B$B图纸就在绘图桌上。去看看吧。$B$B然后把你的决定告诉我，究竟是要建造兽栏还是坦克工厂。
text.completion: This is a momentous occasion, commander. Thazz'ril and his peons will get to work right away.$B$BYou'll see; this decision is going to be critical in our efforts against the Warsong.
text.completed: Speak with Thrall at Wor'var.

english.title: A Choice to Make
english.objectives: Use the Drafting Table to choose between the construction of a Corral or a Tankworks.
english.description: We're ready to start building. All that we need is for you to make a choice.$B$BThe blueprints are on the drafting table. Take a look.$B$BThen, let me know if we're going to construct a corral or a tankworks.
english.completion: This is a momentous occasion, commander. Thazz'ril and his peons will get to work right away.$B$BYou'll see; this decision is going to be critical in our efforts against the Warsong.
english.completed: Speak with Thrall at Wor'var.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择建造兽栏还是坦克工厂

text.title: 新的幼崽
text.objectives: 诱捕$1oa只软蹄草地践踏者。
text.description: 情况好些了，可还是有点不对劲。我都要绝望了，$n。$B$B能找你帮忙吗，$n？很好。$B$B听着，我想我现在弄明白了。我知道哪里不对了。$B$B它们丢了孩子！$B$B没错！当它们初来此地时，那些……呃……丢下它们的该死的猎手说……把它们的孩子留在身后了。$B$B如果我们想帮它们摆脱苦难，如果我们想救下那些幼崽，<小声说>并趁机捞上一笔的话，我们就得给它们找些新孩子来！
text.completion: You did it, $n! Mama, papa, and family. It brings a tear to my eye.$B$BHere, take this runty one. Now that I have the whole herd, this one's just an extra mouth to feed and won't fetch anything at market.
text.completed: Return to Digrem Orebar at the Ring of Trials.

english.title: New Babies
english.objectives: Coax $1oa Tenderhoof Meadowstompers.
english.description: That's better, but there's still something wrong. I'm getting desperate here, $n.$B$BCan I call ya, $n? Great.$B$BLook, I think I have it now. I know what's wrong.$B$BThey miss their babies.$B$BYeah! When they first came here, the, uh... the bastard hunters that... abandoned them said they left the babies behind.$B$BIf we're going to save them from a life of misery, if we're going to save those babies, <under his breath> and turn a tidy profit, we've got to get them some new babies!
english.completion: You did it, $n! Mama, papa, and family. It brings a tear to my eye.$B$BHere, take this runty one. Now that I have the whole herd, this one's just an extra mouth to feed and won't fetch anything at market.
english.completed: Return to Digrem Orebar at the Ring of Trials.

text.title: 插曲/寶藏：澙湖水池/巨蚌
要塞脚下
text.objectives: 在古尔达要塞的入口处与魔导师赛琳娜谈一谈。
text.description: 你的军队已经整装待发，卷轴也已经准备就绪。$B$B现在该开始第二阶段的行动了——从重兵把守的食人魔营地里偷取一块连结水晶。$B$B我们要把卷轴留到对抗戈杜尼巫师领主时再用，把援军召唤到我们身边。让我们在古尔达丘陵的山脚下见面吧，以适当的方式进入要塞吧。
text.completion: Let's not waste any time. Gordal Fortress awaits just up this hill.

english.title: The Foot of the Fortress
english.objectives: Speak to Magister Serena at the entrance to Gordal Fortress.
english.description: Your forces are at the ready and the scroll is prepared.$B$BIt's time for phase two - stealing a nexus crystal from a fortified ogre compound.$B$BWe'll save the scroll to bring in reinforcements in our confrontation with the Gordunni Witch Lord. Let's meet at the base of the Gordal Foothills to head into the fortress proper.
english.completion: Не будем тратить время впустую. Крепость Гордал стоит на вершине этого холма – осталось совсем немного.

text.title: 邻里优势
text.objectives: 收集$1oa颗戈杜尼符文珠。
text.description: 帝国的食人魔以冷酷无情、精于算计著称。$B$B幸好他们的算计经常出错。$B$B莫库克一直在用施加魔法的手环给他的爪牙们灌注奥术能量。$B$B既然我们迟早要解决这些家伙，不如顺便用这些奥术之力制造些附魔材料出来。
text.progress: Ah, arcane powder. Reminds me of my days as an apprentice.
text.completion: They're not amazing, but I do think these have some worth to us.
text.completed: Return to Magister Serena in Gordal Fortress.

english.title: While We're in the Neighborhood
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Gordunni Runebeads.
english.description: Ogres from the empire are known for being cold and calculating.$B$BWe are fortunate that their calculations are rarely spot on.$B$BMorkurk has been using enchanted bracelets to empower his minions with arcane strength.$B$BSince we're going to have to dispatch them anyways, we might as well get some reagents out of it.
english.progress: О, порошок чар. Мне сразу вспомнилась пора моего ученичества.
english.completion: Не лучшие экземпляры, но, по-моему, польза от них будет.
english.completed: Return to Magister Serena in Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 险恶的元老
text.objectives: 消灭元老沃戈什、元老祖尔莫克和元老克罗矛格。
text.description: 我们可不能就这么大摇大摆地走进去，直取巫师领主莫库克的首级，然后转身离开。$B$B他的三位副官——沃戈什、祖尔莫克和克罗矛格——都狂热地效忠于莫库克，并且都有着过人的实力，是值得重视的法师。$B$B我担心只要我们一开始攻击巫师领主，他们三位就会即刻赶来与他并肩作战。因此我们得先解决掉他的副官才行。
text.completion: Now that they're out of the way, Morkurk is exposed.
text.completed: Return to Magister Serena in Gordal Fortress.

english.title: Vicious Viziers
english.objectives: Slay Vizier Vorgorsh, Vizier Zulmork, and Vizier Cromaug.
english.description: We can't just skate in, kill Witch Lord Morkurk, and leave.$B$BHis three lieutenants - Vorgorsh, Zulmork, and Cromaug - are all fiercely loyal to Morkurk, and are all respectable mages in their own right.$B$BI suspect that if we attempt to engage the Witch Lord immediately that they will rush to his aid and overwhelm us. We need to take out his lieutenants first.
english.completion: Теперь, когда мы с ними разобрались, Моркурк остался без защиты.
english.completed: Return to Magister Serena in Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 能量宝珠
text.objectives: 摧毁$1oa个星界结界。
text.description: 眼下恐怕有个小麻烦。$B$B莫库克在古尔达要塞各处都布下了强大的防御结界，任何类型的集体召唤法术都无法发挥作用——这跟我们的计划有些冲突。$B$B幸好那些食人魔怎么都想不到会有区区一两个敌人前来攻击，我们应该能相当容易地溜进他们的要塞。
text.completion: Destroying those wards was key to our success. Well done indeed!
text.completed: Return to Magister Serena in Gordal Fortress.

english.title: Orbs of Power
english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Astral Wards.
english.description: Minor issue, I'm afraid.$B$BMorkurk has placed powerful wards throughout Gordal Fortress that will prevent any sort of mass summoning - not wonderful considering our plan.$B$BThankfully, no ogre would ever consider that a single enemy or two would attack, so we should be able to slip through their fortress relatively easily.
english.completion: Уничтожив стражей, мы обеспечили себе победу. Прекрасно!
english.completed: Return to Magister Serena in Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 最后一步
text.objectives: 在古尔达要塞里击败巫师领主莫库克并取得奥术枢纽。
text.description: 莫库克已经走投无路了。他现在犹如瓮中之鳖。在你跟莫库克交战时使用卷轴……$B$B……然后好好欣赏你的大军如暴风雪那样砸在他的头上吧。
text.progress: It's all come down to this moment.
text.completion: Looks like Morkurk was no match for the two of us, huh?
text.completed: Return to Magister Serena at Gordal Fortress.

english.title: The Final Step
english.objectives: Defeat Witch Lord Morkurk and retrieve the Arcane Nexus in Gordal Fortress.
english.description: We have Morkurk cornered. He's all ours now. Use the scroll once you engage Morkurk...$B$B...and enjoy the blizzard of your forces raining down on his head.
english.progress: Наступил судьбоносный момент. Скоро все решится.
english.completion: Похоже, Моркурк ничего не смог нам противопоставить, а?
english.completed: Return to Magister Serena at Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 上等的进门方案
text.objectives: 帮魔导师赛琳娜摧毁$1oa辆戈杜尼投石车。
text.description: 要塞领袖——巫师领主莫库克，在通往他们据点的路边架设了投石车。$B$B那对我们构不成什么威胁。$B$B干掉投石车附近的食人魔，然后帮我做好标记。我准备的这个漩涡法术能帮你做完剩下的事。$B$B等解决掉投石车之后，到要塞大门处来找我吧。
text.completion: We have the scroll of mass teleportation ready, but we can't use it just yet. We must take proper precautions to ensure our success.
text.completed: Return to Magister Serena in Khadgar's Tower.

english.title: Dropping In
english.objectives: Help Magister Serena destroy $1oa Gordunni Boulderthrowers.
english.description: Witch Lord Morkurk, the leader of the fortress, has catapults set up along the road into their compound.$B$BThat won't be a problem for us.$B$BTake out the ogres around the catapults and mark them for me. This vortex spell I have prepared will handle the rest.$B$BWe'll meet at the gate to the fortress once the catapults are gone.
english.completion: Свиток массовой телепортации готов, но прямо сейчас он не сработает. Чтобы закрепить успех, мы должны принять определенные меры.
english.completed: Return to Magister Serena in Khadgar's Tower.

text.title: 临时目标：塔拉
text.objectives: 到塔拉与暗影猎手卡加莎谈一谈。
text.description: 我们收到报告，德莱尼在塔拉的领地已被战歌氏族攻陷。$B$B我派出了一支暗影猎手小队前去探查情况。$B$B卡加莎是他们的队长。你愿意去那找她吗？
text.completion: Glad dat Aggra send ya, Commanda.$B$BDey situation is grim, an' it's 'bout ta get grimma.

english.title: Target of Opportunity: Telaar
english.objectives: Speak with Shadow Hunter Kajassa at Telaar.
english.description: We've received reports that the draenei enclave at Telaar has fallen to the Warsong.$B$BI sent a small group of shadow hunters to check on the situation.$B$BKajassa is their leader. Will you meet her there?
english.completion: Glad dat Aggra send ya, Commanda.$B$BDey situation is grim, an' it's 'bout ta get grimma.

text.title: 我会帮你消灭他们
text.objectives: 在塔拉消灭$1oa名战歌兽人。
text.description: 战歌氏族攻来并杀死了不少德莱尼游侠。决不能让他们占据这里。$B$B指挥官，现在只能靠你跟我去对付他们所有人了。$B$B你去吸引他们的注意力，让我来解决掉他们。等着瞧吧。
text.completion: Oh, dat was fun. We workin' nicely togetha, you an' me, $n.
text.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Kajassa at Telaar.

english.title: I Help Ya Kill Dem
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Warsong forces at Telaar.
english.description: Warsong come in an' kill de draenei rangers. No lettin' dem have dis place.$B$BYou an' me, Commanda. We gonna kill dem all.$B$BYou be distractin' dem an' I usin' me Loa ta finish dem off. You see.
english.completion: Oh, dat was fun. We workin' nicely togetha, you an' me, $n.
english.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Kajassa at Telaar.

text.title: 萨米迪的祝福
text.objectives: 对暗影猎手的尸体使用萨米迪神物。
text.description: 总共有三位暗影猎手跟我一起来到了这里。结果他们却惨死在战歌氏族的手上。$B$B我们得帮他们的灵魂得到安息。要是你先找到他们的话，就对他们的尸体使用这个。$B$B它会把他们的灵魂送回安息之所萨米迪。
text.completion: Dey movin' onta a betta place. Samedi be sendin' dem on all dey missions now.$B$BDank ya, $n.
text.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Kajassa at Telaar.

english.title: The Blessing of Samedi
english.objectives: Use the Fetish of Samedi on the corpses of the dead shadow hunters.
english.description: Three of mah shadow huntas come here wit' me. De Warsong kill dem.$B$BWe need ta help dey souls move on. Jus' in case ya find dem first, use dis on dere bodies.$B$BIt send dere souls ta Samedi, Loa of de Grave.
english.completion: Dey movin' onta a betta place. Samedi be sendin' dem on all dey missions now.$B$BDank ya, $n.
english.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Kajassa at Telaar.

text.title: 启用护盾！
text.objectives: 激活4块塔拉水晶。
text.description: 战歌兽群领袖正在试图启用塔拉的护盾。要是卡戈拉成功了，战歌氏族就会拥有一个牢不可破的据点。$B$B虽然他们目前只完成了护盾的初始化，但这样一来，主水晶旁的兽群领袖和她的萨满祭司正好处在防护范围内。$B$B激活塔拉边界上的水晶，这会使护盾进入完全部署形态。$B$B这样一来，你和卡戈拉就一同处于护盾的内部了。
text.completion: Soon de shield gonna cover all of Telaar. Den we all be trapped inside togetha.$B$BDen we go kill de packleader.
text.completed: Speak with Shadow Hunter Kajassa at Telaar.

english.title: Shields Up!
english.objectives: Activate the four Telaari Crystals.
english.description: The Warsong packleader is trying to raise Telaar's shield. If Kargora does that, the Warsong will have an impervious base.$B$BSo far, they've only managed to initiate the shield. This has the undesirable side effect of protecting the packleader and her shaman at the main crystal.$B$BActivate the crystals on the perimeter of Telaar. That will force the shield to fully deploy.$B$BOnce you do that, Kargora will be exposed.
english.completion: Soon de shield gonna cover all of Telaar. Den we all be trapped inside togetha.$B$BDen we go kill de packleader.
english.completed: Speak with Shadow Hunter Kajassa at Telaar.

text.title: 破坏护盾！
text.objectives: 消灭兽群领袖卡戈拉并摧毁阿肯尼特护盾。
text.description: 时机已到，指挥官。兽群领袖卡戈拉和阿肯尼特护盾不再受保护了。$B$B我们现在就去杀了她，摧毁那块护盾水晶。
text.completion: I'm sorry to hear about Kajassa's shadow hunters, but we couldn't afford to let the Warsong have Telaar.$B$BWith the death of Kargora and her pack, we're one step closer to the invasion of the Warsong's home, Grommashar.$B$BOne step close to justice.
text.completed: Return to Thrall at Wor'var.
text.giverWindow: 决不能让她把塔拉打造成战歌氏族铜墙铁壁般的基地。

english.title: Shields Down!
english.objectives: Kill Packleader Kargora and destroy the Arkonite Shield.
english.description: De time has come, commanda. Packleader Kargora an' de Arkonite Shield no longa protected.$B$BWe need ta kill her an' destroy de shield crystal.
english.completion: I'm sorry to hear about Kajassa's shadow hunters, but we couldn't afford to let the Warsong have Telaar.$B$BWith the death of Kargora and her pack, we're one step closer to the invasion of the Warsong's home, Grommashar.$B$BOne step close to justice.
english.completed: Return to Thrall at Wor'var.
english.giverWindow: Keep her from using Telaar as an impenetrable base for the Warsong clan.

text.title: 狂热的鸦语者
text.objectives: 在瘤木小径把安苏之羽放进祭品篮里。
text.description:
这些流亡者并不是唯一在阿兰卡定居的受诅咒的鸦人。

有个奇怪的教派，将卡鲁奉若神明，她是我的配偶和子嗣的看护者。这个教派的行为显得相当……诡异。

不管怎么说，流亡者们需要他们的帮助。少了渡鸦的翅膀，艾斯卡永远都不能到尖塔上决一死战。

拿上这片羽毛，把它放在南边的祭品篮里。那一定会引起所谓“鸦语者”的注意。
text.completion: Ah, you come to learn the truth of things.$b$bWe will need to test your dedication first, yes!
text.completed: Speak to Iktis of the Flock in Gnarlwood Pass.

english.title: Cult of the Ravenspeakers
english.objectives: Place the Plume of Anzu in the Offering Basket in Gnarlwood Pass.
english.description:
These outcasts are not the only cursed arakkoa holding their ground in Arak.

A curious cult has formed in worship of Ka'alu, my consort and the keeper of my brood. They are considered to be quite... odd.

Regardless, the outcasts will need their help. Without the wings of the ravens, Iskar can never take his fight to the spires.

Take this feather and place it in the offering basket south of here. The so-called "Ravenspeakers" will surely take notice.
english.completion: Ah, you come to learn the truth of things.$b$bWe will need to test your dedication first, yes!
english.completed: Speak to Iktis of the Flock in Gnarlwood Pass.

text.title: 鸦母之语
text.objectives: 找回$1oa个鸦语者卷轴残片。
text.description: 我们来这里是为了举行召回鸦母的仪式。我们已经把卷轴的各个章节分发给了每一个人，刚刚开始就遭到了血鬃虎人的袭击。现在鸦群的大部分成员都遭到了屠杀，卷轴碎片也散落到了我们家园的各个角落。$b$b尽管仪式失败了，可我们决不允许这些恶棍粉碎我们的信仰，我们必须继续在这里祷告，可要是你能帮我们找回那些丢失的卷轴碎片，一定会令我们感激不尽的。
text.progress: We must have all the sacred texts! We cannot afford to leave even a single one unaccounted for!
text.completion: Ah! The copies of the ritual!$b$bPraise the Raven Mother!$b$bHand them to me but only one at a time. We must not risk summoning the light.
text.completed: Return to Ravenspeaker Sekara within the Ravenskar.

english.title: Words of the Raven Mother
english.objectives: Recover $1oa Ravenspeaker Scroll Fragments.
english.description: We came here to perform the ritual of calling to bring the return of the Raven Mother. We had distributed parts of the scroll to everyone and had just begun when we were attacked by the Bloodmane. Now most of the flock has been killed and fragments lay scattered across our homeland.$b$bThe ritual was a failure but we will not allow these mongrels to break our faith. We must continue our prayers here but we would be grateful if you can recover the scroll fragments for us.
english.progress: Нам нужны все священные тексты, все до единого! Мы не имеем права ничего упустить!
english.completion: Ah! The copies of the ritual!$b$bPraise the Raven Mother!$b$bHand them to me but only one at a time. We must not risk summoning the light.
english.completed: Return to Ravenspeaker Sekara within the Ravenskar.

text.title: 血鬃虎人
text.objectives: 消灭狩猎大师哀牙和$1oa个血鬃刀爪战士。
text.description: 我们刚来到这里，开始为无头鸦念诵祷文，血鬃虎人就突然冒出来攻击我们了。$b$b显然，鸦母肯定是想要用这个测试一下她的子民。不用怕，我们信仰坚定，无论发生什么都无法阻止我们继续狂热地祈祷！$b$b<瑟卡拉贴近你悄悄地加了一句。>$b$b不过，假如你可以解决掉血鬃虎人跟他们的首领，这也能算是鸦母给我们的恩赐。
text.completion: Your strength has given us time to rest and continue our rituals.$B$BMay the Raven Mother ever keep you in her shadow.
text.completed: Return to Ravenspeaker Sekara within Ravenskar.

english.title: The Bloodmane
english.objectives: Slay Huntmaster Sorrowfang and $1oa Bloodmane Razorclaws.
english.description: We had just arrived and begun the service of the headless fowl when the Bloodmane attacked out of nowhere.$b$bClearly, this means that the Raven Mother wishes to test the worthiness of her children. Fear not, we are steadfast and will fervently continue our prayers regardless of what may come!$b$b<Sekara leans in and whispers to you.>$b$bAlthough, if you can get rid of the Bloodmane and their leader that would be a blessing as well.
english.completion: Thanks to you, we had time to rest and continue the rituals. You will be shadowed by the ancestor of the ravens.
english.completed: Return to Ravenspeaker Sekara within Ravenskar.

text.title: 偷蛋贼
text.objectives: 收集$1oa枚恐惧渡鸦的蛋。
text.description: 血爪虎人嗜杀成性，他们之前就袭击过渡鸦之痕，还把圣鸦的蛋给偷走了！$b$b当你进入血爪虎人的领地后，记得留心那里的蛋。$b$b我会拿着我拼尽全力收集的一篮篮渡鸦的蛋在巢穴里等你的。
text.progress: Were you able to find the stolen raven eggs?
text.completion: These poor ravens have avoided a horrible future in the Bloodclaw lands.$B$BWe will take far better care of them.$B$BThank you!
text.completed: Return to Vakora of the Flock within the Nest of the Ravenspeakers.

english.title: The Egg Thieves
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Dread Raven Eggs.
english.description: The Bloodclaw are sadistic creatures. They have attacked the Ravenskar before and have stolen the eggs of the sacred ravens.$b$bWhile you are within the Bloodclaw lands keep an eye out for the eggs.$b$bI'll be waiting for you at the nest with as many baskets for them as I can gather.
english.progress: Тебе удалось найти похищенные яйца воронов?
english.completion: There was a terrible fate in the clutches of the Bloody Claw. But now it's over, and we'll take care of them. Thank you!
english.completed: Return to Vakora of the Flock within the Nest of the Ravenspeakers.

text.title: 肃清钢铁王座
text.objectives: 到附近的建筑里，从监工高崔格身上取得贾纳尔的镣铐钥匙。
text.description: 这些臭烘烘的黑石懦夫以为这样就能羞辱到我。$b$b他们只会让我更加愤怒。$b$b那边屋子里的监工高崔格身上有打开我镣铐的钥匙。如果我想离开这里，就必须要拿到那把钥匙才行。然后……你就等着看复仇的好戏吧。
text.progress: You'll have to pry that key out of his cold, ugly hand.
text.completion: <Ga'nar works his neck out of the shackle.>$b$bMuch better.
text.completed: Return to Ga'nar at the Blackrock Quarry in the Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: Polishing the Iron Throne
english.objectives: Obtain Ga'nar's Shackle Key from Overseer Gotrigg in the nearby building.
english.description: These stinking Blackrock cowards think they're humiliating me.$b$bThey're just making me angrier.$b$bOverseer Gotrigg, in the hut over there, carries my shackle key. If I'm going to get out of there, I'm going to need that key. Then... vengeance can begin.
english.progress: Этот ключ тебе придется вырвать из его хладной уродливой руки.
english.completion: <Ga'nar works his neck out of the shackle.>$b$bMuch better.
english.completed: Return to Ga'nar at the Blackrock Quarry in the Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: Get to High Ground!
text.objectives: Report to Drek'thar in the Blackrock Quarry in Tanaan Jungle.
text.description: This dam is about to burst. Hopefully.$b$bFarseer Drek'Thar fights atop the peak to the south of here. You should be safe near him.$b$bDon't worry about me.

english.title: Get to High Ground!
english.objectives: Report to Drek'thar in the Blackrock Quarry in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: This dam is about to burst. Hopefully.$b$bFarseer Drek'Thar fights atop the peak to the south of here. You should be safe near him.$b$bDon't worry about me.

text.title: 骗子的伪装
text.objectives: 与查尔莉交谈以查明真相。
text.description: 在距离这里不远的一个洞穴里，住着一位名叫查尔莉的老太婆。$b$b我从年轻时就认识她，至今已经相识很多年了。尽管我如今已经变得年纪老迈，两鬓斑白，她却仍然保持着青春美颜。$b$b查尔莉嫉妒我跟达哈卡的感情，而且我一直怀疑她跟达哈卡的死有关。不管怎么说，没有证据我就不能让她得到应有的制裁。$b$b去见见查尔莉，跟她说我将不久于人世。告诉她我希望能在离开这个世界以前，知道达哈卡死亡的真相。
text.completion: Challe, that iniquitous wretch!$b$bIf only I had proof of her treachery long ago, I would have ripped the villainous heart from her chest and crushed it beneath my foot!$b$bYou have brought me the truth as I asked, for that you have my thanks.
text.completed: Inform Gar'rok of Challe's treachery.

english.title: Guise of the Deceiver
english.objectives: Speak with Challe to discover the truth.
english.description: In a cave not far from here, there lives an old woman named Challe.$b$bI knew Challe many years ago when I was young; though as I have become old and grey, she has kept her youth and beauty.$b$bChalle was jealous of my love for Dahaka and I have long suspected that Challe had a part in her death. However, without evidence I could not bring justice against her.$b$bMeet with Challe and tell her that I am dying. Tell her that I wish to know the truth of Dahaka's fate before I leave this world.
english.completion: Challe, that iniquitous wretch!$b$bIf only I had proof of her treachery long ago, I would have ripped the villainous heart from her chest and crushed it beneath my foot!$b$bYou have brought me the truth as I asked, for that you have my thanks.
english.completed: Inform Gar'rok of Challe's treachery.

text.title: 寶藏：席娜女士的特別寶藏
寶藏：史卡吉特的特別寶藏
拉尔夏莱之死
text.objectives: 杀死拉尔夏莱。
text.description: 在旭日手札中写到，“晨起进食，必戕幼卵”。$b$b血鬃主母拉尔夏莱把神圣的鸦卵当成餐点，大快朵颐。真是胆大包天！她必须以死偿还自己的罪孽！$b$b沿路向南，翻过山就能抵达血鬃该死的老巢了。$b$b别忘了带上这件饰物，某天它从天而降，成为了鸦母垂青于我们的信号。有了它你就有了战胜拉尔夏莱的机会。
text.completion: Let it be known that on this day the stranger has returned victorious from slaying the feared foe of the Flock!$B$BPraise the Raven Mother!
text.completed: Return to High Ravenspeaker Krikka within the Nest of the Ravenspeakers.

english.title: Ralshiara's Demise
english.objectives: Kill Ralshiara.
english.description: It was said in the Journal of the Rising Sun that eating in the mornings cannot be done without harming a few eggs.$b$bThe Bloodmane matron, Ralshiara, feasts upon sacred raven eggs for her snacks. How dare she! She must die for her sins!$b$bTake the path south over the mountains to reach the accursed home of the Bloodmane.$b$bTake this trinket, it fell to us from the heavens as a sign of the Raven Mother's favor and with it you might have a chance.
english.completion: Yes, the news is that today the $gstranger defeated: the stranger defeated; the worst enemy of the pack! $b$bGlory to the Raven Ancestor!
english.completed: Return to High Ravenspeaker Krikka within the Nest of the Ravenspeakers.

text.title: 斩除血鬃之爪
text.objectives: 收集$1oa只血爪萨满的爪子。
text.description: 在布道卷轴里写着：“咬断袭来的利爪。”$b$b沿着南边的路一直走，越过高山，抵达西部的血鬃山谷。你在那里会找到一些会使用原始魔法的虎人。干掉他们，然后取下他们的爪子。$b$b等你拿到几只爪子后，就把它们带回巢穴里交给我。我好把它们进贡给鸦母！
text.progress: It is written in the Scroll of Sermons that the Raven Mother is not patient, and neither am I.$B$BDo you have the paws of the Bloodmane for me?
text.completion: Yes, these will do nicely as an offering to the Raven Mother! May she feast upon our enemies!
text.completed: Return to High Ravenspeaker Krikka

english.title: Declawing The Bloodmane
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Bloodclaw Shaman Paws.
english.description: It is written in the Scroll of Sermons to "Bite the claw that strikes you."$b$bTake the path south from here that leads over the mountain to the Bloodmane valley in the west. There you will find those of their tribe who can use a primitive form of magic. Slay them and remove their paws.$b$bOnce you have obtained a few bring them back to me in the nest so that they may be offered to the Raven Mother!
english.progress: The Scroll of Instruction says that the Raven-Ancestor is impatient. And I, by the way, too. $B$BYou $Gbrought:brought; do I have the legs of a bloody mane?
english.completion: Это станет достойным подношением Прародительнице воронов! Да возрадуется она останкам наших врагов!
english.completed: Return to High Ravenspeaker Krikka

text.title: 我们共同的宿命
text.objectives: 与加洛克谈一谈。
text.description: 没有人能永远留住这些被我们唤作身体的凡人躯壳。身体是大地的馈赠，总有一天要归于尘土。$b$b现在轮到我的身体回归到元素的怀抱中了。$b$b你已让我这颗饱经沧桑的心卸下了重负，$n。我将毫无遗憾地告别这个世界。我曾为我的族人和这片土地倾力战斗，曾为元素贡献力量，也曾深深爱过。$b$b要是你能在我弥留之际陪在我身边的话，我将感到不胜荣幸，$c。
text.completion: Gar'rok was a loyal keeper and a true friend. He will be missed, but so is the cycle of life on this world.$b$bIn time we will call a new keeper of the elements, and he will serve us as Gar'rok did before him.
text.completed: Return to Kalandrios.

english.title: The Debt We Share
english.objectives: Speak with Gar'rok.
english.description: These mortal shells that we call bodies are not ours to keep. The body is a gift of earth that must one day be returned from whence it came.$b$bThe time has come for this body to return to the elements.$b$bKnow that you have lifted the weight from an old heart, $n. As I pass on from this realm, I do so without regret. I have fought on behalf of my people and my land, I have served the elements, and I have loved.$b$bIt would honor me if you would stay during these final moments, $c.
english.completion: Gar'rok was a loyal keeper and a true friend. He will be missed, but so is the cycle of life on this world.$b$bIn time we will call a new keeper of the elements, and he will serve us as Gar'rok did before him.
english.completed: Return to Kalandrios.

text.title: 绕道折回
text.objectives: 在泰罗克鸦巢里与暗影贤者艾斯卡谈一谈。
text.description: 我们必须开始利爪之王回归的准备工作了。$B$B我能从这个界域快速前往泰罗克鸦巢。$B$B可你只能返回另一边。你很强大，会引起不必要的注意。
text.completion: Excellent work. Ishaal and Zellek have already begun the rites.
text.completed: 在泰罗克鸦巢里与暗影贤者艾斯卡谈一谈。

english.title: Back from Beyond
english.objectives: Speak with Shadow Sage Iskar in Veil Terokk.
english.description: We must begin preparations for the Talon King's return.$B$BFrom within this realm, I can travel quickly to Veil Terokk.$B$BYou, however, should be returned to the other side. You are powerful, and will attract unwanted attention.
english.completion: Excellent work. Ishaal and Zellek have already begun the rites.
english.completed: Speak with Shadow Sage Iskar in Veil Terokk.

text.title: 老朋友
text.objectives: 与加洛克谈一谈。
text.description: 从一开始，就有一位萨满祭司受命担任元素王座的守护者。这是一项终身的使命，只有在上一位萨满守护者过世之后，才会产生新的继任者。$b$b加洛克多年来一直都是我们忠实的守护者，在无数个重生循环期间净化着元素高地。$b$b如今我们的守护者将不久于人世，很快就会有新人来取代他的位置。他不该孤零零地一个人度过临终的时刻。去找他吧，$n。$b$b尽量减轻他的痛苦。
text.completion: Kalandrios sent you to me? I am honored.$b$bThe furies are wise, they know the burdens of my heart.$b$bYou may not know, but you have been sent to grant a last request to a dying shaman.$b$bFor this, I am grateful.
text.completed: I need text.

english.title: An Old Friend
english.objectives: Speak with Gar'rok.
english.description: Since the beginning, a shaman has been called to serve the Throne of Elements as its keeper. It is a lifelong calling and a new keeper is only called after the last has passed on.$b$bGar'rok has been our loyal keeper for many years, cleansing the Elemental Plateau during countless cycles of rebirth.$b$bOur keeper is dying, and soon another will be called in his place. When he passes, he should not be alone. Go to him, $n.$b$bEase his pain.
english.completion: Kalandrios sent you to me? I am honored.$b$bThe furies are wise, they know the burdens of my heart.$b$bYou may not know, but you have been sent to grant a last request to a dying shaman.$b$bFor this, I am grateful.
english.completed: I need text.

text.title: 切割者手册
text.objectives: 找到钢铁切割者拆解指令。
text.description:
嘿！我听说在附近有个奇怪的东西。斥候们说那可能是什么切割者手册。

去替我瞧瞧可以吗？我想知道它究竟跟我一直听说的这个新式样机有没有关系……
text.completion: These orders appear to have come from Orgrim Doomhammer.

english.title: Shredder Manual
english.objectives: Find the Iron Shredder Decommission Orders.
english.description:
Hey! I hear there's a curious object nearby. Scouts say it's some kind of shredder manual.

Go check it out for me, will ya? I wonder if it has to do with this new prototype I've been hearin' about...
english.completion: These orders appear to have come from Orgrim Doomhammer.

text.title: 切割者手册
text.objectives: 找到钢铁切割者拆解指令。
text.description:
我听说钢铁部落的工程师们正在全力打造这种新式的切割者样机。

我想我们应该展开调查。有位暗影猎手发现了某种切割者手册，也许跟那台样机有点关系。
text.completion: These orders appear to have come from Orgrim Doomhammer.

english.title: Shredder Manual
english.objectives: Find the Iron Shredder Decommission Orders.
english.description:
I've been hearing rumors of this new prototype shredder the Iron Horde's engineers have been working on.

I think we ought to investigate. A shadow hunter spotted some sort of shredder manual, and it might have something to do with that prototype.
english.completion: Похоже, эти приказы поступили от Оргрима Молота Рока.

text.title: 加入战斗
text.completion: We've had quite the journey in getting your tower burning bright. If it's agreeable to you, I'd like to join your campaign.

english.title: Joining the Ranks
english.completion: We've had quite the journey in getting your tower burning bright. If it's agreeable to you, I'd like to join your campaign.

text.title: 恐惧活塞
text.objectives: 摧毁恐惧活塞。
text.description:
就在附近，有一群钢铁部落成员以迅雷不及掩耳之势夺取了一处战略要地。

他们使用了一台称作恐惧活塞的机器，在战斗中取得了可怕的效果，而且我相信我们得先摧毁那台机器，才能与图雷姆的钢铁部落展开全面交锋。
text.completion: An infernal machine.
text.completed: Speak to Durotan at Durotan's Toehold.

english.title: Dreadpiston
english.objectives: Defeat Dreadpiston.
english.description:
Nearby, a group of Iron Horde took over a key strategic position with surprising alacrity.

They used a machine they call Dreadpiston to terrible effect in the siege, and I believe we need to destroy that machine before moving against the Iron Horde in Tuurem.
english.completion: An infernal machine.
english.completed: Speak to Durotan at Durotan's Toehold.

text.title: 他们叫他兰特瑞索·火刃
text.objectives: 在哈瓦洛找到兰特瑞索·火刃。
text.description: 哈瓦洛的火刃氏族正在给战歌氏族提供武器与兵力。我们不能让这种局面再继续下去了。$B$B有位年轻的剑圣，他于多年前遭到了火刃氏族的流放。他们叫他兰特瑞索·火刃。$B$B我的游侠近来发现他返回了哈瓦洛，目的是想要挑战剑圣的领导权。结果却被他们用锁链囚禁了起来。$B$B也许他还活着。也许他能帮你对付火刃氏族。
text.completion: Who are you?$B$BDon't you know death by sight, $C?

english.title: They Call Him Lantresor of the Blade
english.objectives: Find Lantresor of the Blade in Hallvalor.
english.description: The Burning Blade clan at Hallvalor is supplying the Warsong with weapons and warriors. We cannot let this continue.$B$BThere's a young blademaster who's been exiled from the Burning Blade for many years. They call him Lantresor of the Blade.$B$BMy rangari recently saw him return to Hallvalor to challenge the blademaster leadership. Instead, they clapped him in chains.$B$BMaybe he's still alive. Maybe he'll help you deal with the Burning Blade.
english.completion: Кто ты?$B$BНеужели ты не знаешь, как выглядит смерть, |3-6($c)?

text.title: 我敌人的朋友
text.objectives: 在哈瓦洛消灭$1oa名火刃兽人。
text.description: 哈瓦洛是火刃氏族古老的家园。鉴于他们是如此可靠的朋友，战歌氏族便允许剑圣和他们的萨满祭司继续留在纳格兰，把所有其他氏族都赶了出去。$B$B闲话少叙。$B$B我的意思就是，如果他们是我敌人的朋友，那他们就同样是我的敌人，我只需要知道这一点就足够了！
text.completion: You done us a solid with them Burning Blade, lad, and we're not the forgettin' kind.$B$BLet's celebrate o'er a pint in an hour. Drinks are on me.
text.completed: Return to Hansel Heavyhands at Telaari Station.

english.title: The Friend o' My Enemy
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Burning Blade forces at Hallvalor.
english.description: Hallvalor is the ancestral home o' the Burning Blade clan. Since they be such fast friends, the Warsong allow the blademasters an' their shaman to remain in Nagrand when all o' the other clans are forced out.$B$BBlah, blah, blah.$B$BI say, if they're the friend o' my enemy, then they're my enemy, and that's all I need to know!
english.completion: Ты $gсделал:сделала; для нас большое дело, $gмальчик:девочка;, а мы добро помним.$B$BДавай через часок отпразднуем, выпьем по кружечке. Я угощаю.
english.completed: Return to Hansel Heavyhands at Telaari Station.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭哈瓦洛的火刃兽人

text.title: 火刃之血
text.objectives: 在哈瓦洛消灭$1oa名火刃兽人。
text.description: 哈瓦洛是我们火刃氏族古老的家园。自从新督军一家上位以后，我就因为混血儿的身份被逐出了氏族。$B$B我要寻求公正的待遇。$B$B我想你应该不介意为此杀戮，再说你也没有其它选择。
text.completion: You done us a solid with them Burning Blade, lad, and we're not the forgettin' kind.$B$BLet's celebrate o'er a pint in an hour. Drinks are on me.
text.completed: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands at Telaari Station.

english.title: Blood of the Burning Blade
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Burning Blade forces at Hallvalor.
english.description: Hallvalor is the ancestral home of my clan, the Burning Blade. When the new warlord and his family came to power, I was exiled for being a half-breed.$B$BI want justice.$B$BI suspect you won't mind killing along the way. Not that you'll have any choice.
english.completion: You done us a solid with them Burning Blade, lad, and we're not the forgettin' kind.$B$BLet's celebrate o'er a pint in an hour. Drinks are on me.
english.completed: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands at Telaari Station.

objectiveDetails.description: Burning Blade forces at Hallvalor slain

text.title: 剑在人在
text.objectives: 从教头朗克身上找回兰特瑞索的长剑。
text.description: 当他们给我戴上镣铐时，那个名叫千里眼朗克的火刃教头抢走了我的长剑。他是一位可敬的兽人，尽管他的训练技巧产生了反效果。$B$B我想拿回我的长剑，$c。
text.progress: A blademaster without a blade is no blademaster at all.
text.completion: If you can defeat Luhk, then perhaps there's some hope for you after all.
text.completed: Return to Lantresor of the Blade at Hallvalor.
text.giverWindow: 剑圣训练师拿走了兰特瑞索的长剑。

english.title: The Blade Itself
english.objectives: Retrieve Lantresor's Blade from Instructor Luhk.
english.description: When they clapped me in irons, the Burning Blade instructor, Luhk the Keen-Eyed, took my blade. He's an honorable orc, even if his training techniques are counter-productive.$B$BI want my blade back, $c.
english.progress: Мастер клинка без клинка – не мастер клинка.
english.completion: Раз уж ты $Gсмог:смогла; победить Лухка, значит, из тебя еще выйдет толк.
english.completed: Return to Lantresor of the Blade at Hallvalor.
english.giverWindow: This trainer of blademasters has Lantresor's Blade.

text.title: 荣誉即吾命
text.objectives: 在火刃宝箱里找到剑圣的旗帜。
text.description: 剑圣随身携带的重要物品不只有长剑而已。$B$B在剑圣洞穴里通过最终试炼后，剑圣就会获得携带火刃旗帜的荣耀。$B$B当我请求恢复我在氏族中应有的地位时，那些懦夫装聋作哑地无视了我，还把我的这份荣耀也一并剥夺了。$B$B我的旗帜肯定被放在了哈瓦洛的某个地方。如果他们没在第一时间烧毁它的话，就会把它交给其它志向高远的剑圣。
text.progress: Do you have my banner?
text.completion: I don't expect you to understand the importance of what you've done.$B$BPerhaps one day you will.
text.completed: Return to Lantresor of the Blade at Hallvalor.

english.title: Not Without My Honor
english.objectives: Find the Blademaster's Banner in a Burning Blade Locker.
english.description: The blade is not the only important item a blademaster carries.$B$BOnce he has passed his final tests in the Masters' Caverns, the blademaster is given the honor of wearing the Burning Blade's banner.$B$BWhen my petition to reclaim my rightful place with the clan fell upon deaf and craven ears, I was stripped of that honor.$B$BNo doubt, my banner has been stored away somewhere in Hallvalor. They'll give it to some other aspiring blademaster if they don't burn it first.
english.progress: Мое знамя у тебя?
english.completion: Не думаю, что сейчас ты осознаешь важность содеянного.$B$BНо, может быть, такой день когда-нибудь придет.
english.completed: Return to Lantresor of the Blade at Hallvalor.

text.title: 到洞穴里见我
text.objectives: 到剑圣洞穴里与兰特瑞索·火刃见面。
text.description: 是时候了，$c。我们该去面对剑圣了。
text.completion: You made it. Good.$B$BGetting in here was nothing compared to what's to come.

english.title: Meet Me in the Cavern
english.objectives: Meet up with Lantresor of the Blade inside the Masters' Cavern.
english.description: It's time, $c. Time to face the masters.
english.completion: Итак, ты здесь. Хорошо.$B$BДобраться сюда было нелегко, но это ничто по сравнению с тем, что нам предстоит.

text.title: 剑圣的挑战
text.objectives: 通过战斗活着完成火刃的试炼。
text.description: 向火刃剑圣们发起挑战的时刻到了。$B$B到洞穴后方去。你会在那里找到竞技场，剑圣就在上方俯视着。$B$B在竞技场中央亮出武器，发起你的挑战吧。我的氏族把荣耀看得比什么都重要，会尊重你以战斗决胜负的请求。$B$B作为奖励，你将获准活着离开。前提是你没战死的话。
text.completion: A great victory over the Burning Blade!$B$BThis new Warlord Azuka Bladefury sounds formidable. We'll have to keep an eye on her and her blademasters.
text.completed: Return to Rangari D'kaan at Telaari Station.

english.title: Challenge of the Masters
english.objectives: Survive the Burning Blade's trial by combat.
english.description: The time has come to challenge the Burning Blade masters.$B$BGo to the back of the cavern. There you will find the challenge ring and the masters watching over it from above.$B$BPull the blade from the middle of the ring to issue your challenge. My clan values honor above all else and will respect your claim to trial by combat.$B$BAs reward, you will be allowed to walk away with your life. Or, you will be dead.
english.completion: Мы одержали над Пылающим Клинком славную победу!$B$BИх новый предводитель, Азука Ярость Клинка, очень опасна.
english.completed: Return to Rangari D'kaan at Telaari Station.

text.title: 灭世者的阴影
text.objectives: 从黑石采石场的黑石兽人身上取得灭世者结构图。
text.description: 看来我们很快就要遇到新的障碍了：他们对准黑暗之门的那辆大得出奇的坦克。我想他们管它叫作钢铁灭世者。$b$b如果我能找到一些阐释它工作原理的文件，也许就能研究出关闭它的方法。在那些机械师和劳工身上可能会有关于它工作原理的说明文件？
text.progress: Any luck?
text.completion: Mmm... yes... simple enough.$b$b<The dwarf flips through the pages and no longer seems to notice your presence.>
text.completed: Return to Thaelin Darkanvil in the Blackrock Quarry.

english.title: The Shadow of the Worldbreaker
english.objectives: Obtain the Worldbreaker Schematics from Blackrock Orcs in the Blackrock Quarry.
english.description: Looks like we'll soon have another obstacle in our way: that ridiculously large tank that they have pointed at the Dark Portal. The Iron Worldbreaker, I think they call it.$b$bIf I had some documentation on how it might work, then I might be able to figure out how to shut it down. Maybe some o' those machinists and laborers have some documentation on how it works?
english.progress: Ну, как успехи?
english.completion: Mmm... yes... simple enough.$b$b<The dwarf flips through the pages and no longer seems to notice your presence.>
english.completed: Return to Thaelin Darkanvil in the Blackrock Quarry.

text.title: 恐惧活塞
text.objectives: 击败恐惧活塞。
text.description:
钢铁部落毫不留情地占领了一处和平的德莱尼哨站。

他们使用了一台名叫恐惧活塞的机器，在短短几分钟内就夷平了镇子。

去摧毁它。
text.completion: They will not use that machine to kill any more draenei. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Speak to Maraad at Redemption Rise.

english.title: Dreadpiston
english.objectives: Defeat Dreadpiston.
english.description:
The Iron Horde overtook a peaceful draenei outpost without mercy.

They used a machine they call Dreadpiston to level the town in minutes.

Destroy it.
english.completion: They will not use that machine to kill any more draenei. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Speak to Maraad at Redemption Rise.

text.title: 大自然的馈赠
text.objectives: 收集$1oa份冰冻植物提取物。
text.description: 战栗壕沟的寒冰藤对低温环境有着强大的抵抗力。把它们整合到要塞的建筑材料中来，应该会大有益处。
text.progress: Look at you, bein' all resourceful.
text.completion: Now this is some handy stuff. This weather has been cutting through our supplies of rope so quick we need something we can use to provide an alternative. Looks like you scored the jackpot.
text.completed: Return to Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: The Land Provides
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Frozen Plant Matter.
english.description: The icevines of the Shivering Trench have developed a powerful resistance to cold temperatures. Integrating them into the construction materials of the garrison should prove useful.
english.progress: Look at you, bein' all resourceful.
english.completion: Now this is some handy stuff. This weather has been cutting through our supplies of rope so quick we need something we can use to provide an alternative. Looks like you scored the jackpot.
english.completed: Return to Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 卡德加的计划
text.objectives: 在沙塔斯的城门附近与卡德加交谈。
text.description:
多亏有你帮忙，我们现在已经将钢铁部落逼到绝境了。

现在差不多是时候进入沙塔斯城，将他们击退。

首先，我们必须跟卡德加和一些新盟友见个面。
text.completion: You have done great work with Durotan, Draka, and Gazlowe.

english.title: Khadgar's Plan
english.objectives: Speak with Khadgar near the gates of Shattrath.
english.description:
We have the Iron Horde backed into a corner now, thanks to you.

It is almost time to enter the city of Shattrath and repel them.

First, we must meet Khadgar and some new allies.
english.completion: You have done great work with Durotan, Draka, and Gazlowe.

text.title: 卡德加的计划
text.objectives: 在沙塔斯的城门附近与卡德加交谈。
text.description:
决不能让沙塔斯落入钢铁部落手中。是时候让敌人血债血偿了。

必须通知卡德加，我们已经准备好攻进沙塔斯，夺回原本属于我们的一切。
text.completion: You have done great work with Maraad, Yrel, and Thaelin.

english.title: Khadgar's Plan
english.objectives: Speak with Khadgar near the gates of Shattrath.
english.description:
Shattrath must not fall into the hands of the Iron Horde. It is time again for me to get my hands bloody.

We will tell Khadgar we are ready to enter the city and take back what is rightfully ours.
english.completion: You have done great work with Maraad, Yrel, and Thaelin.

text.title: 先知在等待
text.objectives: 在元素王座找到先知德雷克塔尔。
text.description: 有人想让你去一趟元素王座，$n。$b$b先知德雷克塔尔在风中听到了元素之怒的呼唤，并已动身前去与它们进行沟通。$b$b先知传话来，让你到元素王座加入他。$b$b过去看看元素们想让你干什么吧。
text.completion: Throm-Ka, $n. All is not right in Nagrand, it is good that you are here.
text.completed: 与德雷克塔尔谈一谈。

english.title: The Farseer Awaits
english.objectives: Find Farseer Drek'Thar at the Throne of Elements.
english.description: Your presence has been requested at the Throne of Elements, $n.$b$bFarseer Drek'Thar heard the call of the furies upon the wind and made the journey to commune with the elements.$b$bThe Farseer has sent word that you are to join him at the Throne of Elements.$b$bGo and see what the elements would have of you.
english.completion: Throm-Ka, $n. All is not right in Nagrand, it is good that you are here.
english.completed: Speak with Drek'Thar.

text.title: 王座的召唤
text.objectives: 与元素王座的元素之怒沟通。
text.description: 我刚到纳格兰不久，风中就传来了卡拉迪奥斯对我的呼唤。$b$b收到元素王座的召唤无疑是莫大的荣耀，但我的心却因深知缘由而感到沉重。$b$b空气中弥漫着黑暗不安的气氛，在我们周围的每个角落里都能感受得到。它包围着……席卷着……压制着这里的万物。$b$b来吧，是时候与元素之怒交流，向它们提供帮助了。一道无形的暗影正在笼罩这片山谷，也许只能靠我们将它移除。
text.completion: I fear that this disturbance is more dire than I had anticipated.$b$bWhatever it is...it threatens to unravel the elemental bonds that hold this world together.
text.completed: Speak with Farseer Drek'Thar.

english.title: Called to the Throne
english.objectives: Commune with the furies at the Throne of Elements.
english.description: It was not long after I arrived in Nagrand that the voice of Kalandrios called out to me upon the wind.$b$bIt is a great honor to be called to the Throne of Elements, but my heart was heavy sensing the purpose.$b$bThere is dark malaise in the air, it can be felt all around us. It surrounds all life here...enveloping...smothering...$b$bCome, it is time we commune with the furies and lend them our aid. An invisible shadow has been cast upon this valley and it may be up to us to remove it.
english.completion: I fear that this disturbance is more dire than I had anticipated.$b$bWhatever it is...it threatens to unravel the elemental bonds that hold this world together.
english.completed: Speak with Farseer Drek'Thar.

objectiveDetails.description: 与先知德雷克塔尔交谈

text.title: 暗月钢铁套牌
text.objectives: 当暗月马戏团来到镇上的时候，把钢铁套牌交给他们。
text.description: 你现在已经收集到了套牌的所有卡片，与前8张的背面图案完全一样的第9张卡片神秘地出现在你手中。在这张卡片上写着，“将这些卡片拿到暗月马戏团去，你就将获得奖励。”你听说每个月暗月马戏团的入口都会出现在莫高雷和闪金镇。
text.completed: 去找萨杜斯·帕雷教授。

english.title: Darkmoon Iron Deck
english.objectives: Return the Iron Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
english.description: Now that you have gathered all of the cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight.   On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded."  You have heard that the entrance to this faire appears near Mulgore and Goldshire every month.
english.completed: Return to Professor Thaddeus Paleo.

text.title: 唯一的旅行方式
text.objectives: 在沃金之傲与莫克斯·剑吼谈一谈。
text.description: 也许是我太过谨慎了，但我留了几发信号弹，以备撤离时使用。$b$b没能用上真是太好了，不过我们还是可以利用回收直升机返回军械库。$b$b你准备好了吗，$g 先生:女士;？
text.completion: The outpost is now fully up and running and we have enough material to outfit an army - your army!
text.completed: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl within Gordal Fortress.

english.title: The Only Way to Travel
english.objectives: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl in Vol'jin's Pride.
english.description: Call me cautious but I kept a few flares just in case we needed to evac.$b$bI'm glad that wasn't needed but we could still use the ride back to the arsenal.$b$bAre you ready, $g sir:ma'am;?
english.completion: The outpost is now fully up and running and we have enough material to outfit an army - your army!
english.completed: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl within Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 暗月月亮套牌
text.objectives: 当暗月马戏团来到镇上的时候，把月亮套牌交给他们。
text.description: 你现在已经收集到了套牌的所有卡片，与前8张的背面图案完全一样的第9张卡片神秘地出现在你手中。在这张卡片上写着，“将这些卡片拿到暗月马戏团去，你就将获得奖励。”你听说每个月暗月马戏团的入口都会出现在莫高雷和闪金镇。
text.completed: 去找萨杜斯·帕雷教授。

text.description: 你现在已经收集到了套牌的所有卡片，与前8张的背面图案完全一样的第9张卡片神秘地出现在你手中。在这张卡片上写着，“将这些卡片拿到暗月马戏团去，你就将获得奖励。”你听说每个月暗月马戏团的入口都会出现在莫高雷和闪金镇。
