On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded."  You have heard that the entrance to this faire appears near Mulgore and Goldshire every month.
english.completed: Return to Professor Thaddeus Paleo.

text.title: 投弹
text.objectives: 在古尔达要塞里召唤火炮轰击戈杜尼投石车。
text.description: 通往戈杜尼食人魔要塞的路只有一条，而且沿途有重兵把守，以抵御大规模攻击。$b$b幸好他们不会料到只有我们两个人偷偷闯进去。$b$b这是个瓦解他们防御力量的大好机会，还能让我们炮塔上的炮手们练练打靶。$b$b拿上这些烟雾弹，召唤火炮支援，按照我们的提示轰击他们的投石车。
text.completion: Now that we're inside we have much to do.
text.completed: Speak to Miall within Gordal Fortress.

english.title: Dropping Bombs
english.objectives: Call artillery strikes on the Gordunni Boulderthrower encampments within Gordal Fortress.
english.description: The Gordunni have only a single path to their fortress and it is well-defended from a large attack.$b$bThankfully they wont be expecting just the two of us to be attempting to break in.$b$bThis is a great opportunity to take out their defenses and get some target practice for our gunners back at the artillery tower.$b$bTake these smoke grenades and use it to call in an artillery strike on their catapults as we head up.
english.completion: Now that we're inside we have much to do.
english.completed: Speak to Miall within Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 找回补给品
text.objectives: 取回$1oa份钢铁部落货物。
text.description: 我们似乎来得正是时候！$b$b戈杜尼食人魔一直在给钢铁部落的军备附魔，而且看来他们还没把最新一批货物领走。$b$b我们应该把那些装备带回炮塔，用在更有用的地方！让我们去劫取他们的货运集装箱吧。我带来了一些信号弹，等到拿到货物之后，可以发射信号弹召唤空运力量。
text.completion: Alright, that should be the last one we need. $b$bIt isn't the same as retaking Shattrath, but knowing the Iron Horde won't be getting these supplies gives me a bit of satisfaction.
text.completed: Speak to Miall within Gordal Fortress.

english.title: Supply Recovery
english.objectives: Recover $1oa Iron Horde Shipments.
english.description: We seem to have arrived at just the right time!$b$bThe Gordunni have been enchanting armaments for the Iron Horde and it looks like they haven't picked up the latest shipment.$b$bWe could put that gear to far better use in our artillery tower! Lets go hunt down their shipping containers. I brought some signal flares that we can use to call in an air pick-up when we've secured the shipment.
english.completion: Alright, that should be the last one we need. $b$bIt isn't the same as retaking Shattrath, but knowing the Iron Horde won't be getting these supplies gives me a bit of satisfaction.
english.completed: Speak to Miall within Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 取回爱物
text.objectives: 从古尔达要塞的戈杜尼痛击者或戈杜尼劈砍者身上收集$1oa把沙塔斯守卫战锤。
text.description: 自沙塔斯建成的那天起，戈杜尼食人魔就一直在滋扰城中的住民。随着时间的推移，他们通过一次次入侵积累了大量从我们防御者手里夺取的武器。$b$b当务之急是要把这些武器重新分发给我们的士兵，我个人非常希望把它们从食人魔手中抢回来。$b$b趁我们现在在这，你能不能帮我把找到的所有武器都收集起来？
text.progress: Were you able to find any weapons?
text.completion: Thank you, commander. With this a great dishonor on the legacy of Shattrath has been removed.
text.completed: Speak to Miall within Gordal Fortress.

english.title: Prized Repossessions
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Shattrath Guardian Maces from Gordunni Bashers or Gordunni Cleavers within Gordal Fortress.
english.description: The Gordunni have plagued the people of Shattrath ever since the city was founded. Over time they amassed quite a hoard of weapons they captured from our defenders in raids.$b$bGetting these weapons in the hands of our soldiers would be practical and I personally would like to get them out of the hands of the ogres.$b$bWhile we are in here can you do me a favor and gather up any of those weapons you come across.
english.progress: Were you able to find any weapons?
english.completion: Thank you, commander. With this a great dishonor on the legacy of Shattrath has been removed.
english.completed: Speak to Miall within Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 各个击破
text.objectives: 消灭元老沃戈什、元老祖尔莫克和元老克罗矛格。
text.description: 为了夺取要塞，我们得消灭巫师领主莫库克才行，可我不认为应该就这么径直去找他。$B$B他的三位副官——沃戈什、祖尔莫克和克罗矛格都是强大的法师，而且都对莫库克无比忠诚。$B$B一旦我们跟巫师领主交上手，他们恐怕就会立刻赶来助战。让我们先干掉他们，防止那种情况出现吧。
text.completion: Now with the viziers gone the whole Gordunni enchantment trade with the Iron Horde will come crashing down!$b$bWe can now turn our attention to dealing with Morkurk.
text.completed: Speak to Miall within Gordal Fortress.

english.title: Punching Through
english.objectives: Slay Vizier Vorgorsh, Vizier Zulmork, and Vizier Cromaug.
english.description: To secure the fortress we need to kill Witch Lord Morkurk, but I don't think we should go straight after him.$B$BHis three lieutenants - Vorgorsh, Zulmork, and Cromaug - are all powerful mages, and all of them are fiercely loyal to Morkurk.$B$BI suspect that if we engage the Witch Lord that they will rush to his aid. Let's take them out so that cannot happen.
english.completion: Now with the viziers gone the whole Gordunni enchantment trade with the Iron Horde will come crashing down!$b$bWe can now turn our attention to dealing with Morkurk.
english.completed: Speak to Miall within Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 戈杜尼之主
text.objectives: 在古尔达要塞里击败巫师领主莫库克。
text.description: 巫师领主莫库克是戈杜尼食人魔的首领。我们得干掉他才能给炮塔找到木铁。$b$b莫库克是个老练的法师，所以你最好做好准备。来，拿上这个火箭包，在你需要躲开他致命法术的情况下使用。$b$b祝你好运！
text.completion: Fine work commander! Your combat skills are clearly second to none. I am honored to be your armorer!$b$bLet's get back to the outpost so we can take stock of our new inventory. I saved a few flares to call us in a ride back.
text.completed: Speak to Miall within Gordal Fortress.

english.title: The Lord of the Gordunni
english.objectives: Defeat Witch Lord Morkurk within Gordal Fortress.
english.description: Witch Lord Morkurk is the leader of the Gordunni. We need to kill him to secure the jovite for use in our artillery tower.$b$bMorkurk is an accomplished mage so you better be prepared. Here, take the rocket pack and use it if you need to avoid any of his deadly magic.$b$bArchenon poros!
english.completion: Fine work commander! Your combat skills are clearly second to none. I am honored to be your armorer!$b$bLet's get back to the outpost so we can take stock of our new inventory. I saved a few flares to call us in a ride back.
english.completed: Speak to Miall within Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 唯一的旅行方式
text.objectives: 在乌瑞恩堡里与米阿尔谈一谈。
text.description: 也许是我太过谨慎了，但我留了几发信号弹，以备撤离时使用。$b$b没能用上真是太好了，可我们还是可以用它们来召唤坐骑，返回炮塔。$b$b你准备好了吗，$g 先生:女士;？
text.completion: The outpost is now fully up and running and we have enough material to outfit an army - your army!
text.completed: Speak to Miall within Gordal Fortress.

english.title: The Only Way to Travel
english.objectives: Speak to Miall in Fort Wrynn.
english.description: Call me cautious but I kept a few flares just in case we needed to quickly escape.$b$bI'm glad that wasn't needed but we could still use the ride back to the artillery tower.$b$bAre you ready $g sir:ma'am;?
english.completion: The outpost is now fully up and running and we have enough material to outfit an army - your army!
english.completed: Speak to Miall within Gordal Fortress.

text.title: 装备大军
text.completion: It took a lot of hard work but we have made a beautiful artillery tower here.$b$bSir, I've been able to outfit your soldiers here with new equipment but I'd like to do more.$b$bI'd be deeply honored if you would let me work for you in your main garrison.

english.title: Armor Up
english.completion: It took a lot of hard work but we have made a beautiful artillery tower here.$b$bSir, I've been able to outfit your soldiers here with new equipment but I'd like to do more.$b$bI'd be deeply honored if you would let me work for you in your main garrison.

text.title: 重拾珍貴的財產任務追蹤
火药计谋
text.objectives: 找到一个黑石火药桶，并把它交给汉瑟尔·重拳。
text.description: 你好，$g小伙子:小姑娘;！我们这遇到了点麻烦。$b$b我的老伙计塞林用备用的黑石零件捣鼓出了这个起爆器——他不愧是个工程学奇才——可我们得找到些火药才能真正造成破坏。
text.progress: Don't go doin' anything inappropriate with that gunpowder, now.
text.completion: Woo hoo hoo haaaaa!
text.completed: Return to Hansel Heavyhands at the Blackrock Quarry in the Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: The Gunpowder Plot
english.objectives: Find a Blackrock Powder Keg and return it to Hansel Heavyhands.
english.description: Ey, $gpal:lady;! We got an issue, here.$b$bMe ol' pal Thaelin's rigged together this here plunger out of spare Blackrock parts - engineerin' whiz that he is - but we're gonna need some gunpowder if we really want ta' do any damage.
english.progress: Не вздумай только чего-нибудь учудить с этим порохом.
english.completion: Woo hoo hoo haaaaa!
english.completed: Return to Hansel Heavyhands at the Blackrock Quarry in the Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 前去……救人？
text.objectives: 从瘤木小径的巨兽石鳞手中救出“提里克”。
text.description: 在尘埃手稿中写道：“让那些无羽者自相残杀，别弄脏了我们的爪子！”高阶鸦语者居然预见到了这一天的到来，多么睿智啊。$b$b在西边的山坡上住着一只巨兽，名叫石鳞。它掳走了一只鸦人，尽管我们费尽力气，却还是没能将它击败。$b$b去吧，消灭那只巨兽，救出提里克，从而证明你自己的实力！以鸦母之名实现你的命运吧！
text.progress: Tillik's disappearance caused great sadness to the Flock.
text.completion: Tillik! Dear friend I'm so glad you have returned! All of the acolytes missed your witty banter after the evening chants.$b$b<Iktis looks back towards you.>$b$bYes, now your great test is done. You have fulfilled the requirements of The Parchment of Dust!
text.completed: Return to Iktis of the Flock in Gnarlwood Pass

english.title: To the... Rescue?
english.objectives: Rescue "Tillik" from the beast Stonescale in Gnarlwood Pass.
english.description: The Parchment of Dust reads: "Put the featherless against one another so that our claws remain unsullied!" How wise the high Ravenspeaker is to foresee this day.$b$bThere is a great beast on the hillside to the west by the name of Stonescale. It has abducted one of the flock and despite our many attempts we have been unable to defeat it. $b$bGo, prove yourself by slaying the beast and rescuing Tillik! Fulfill your destiny in the name of the Raven Mother!
english.progress: The disappearance of Tillik greatly saddened the pack.
english.completion: Tillik! Dear friend I'm so glad you have returned! All of the acolytes missed your witty banter after the evening chants.$b$b<Iktis looks back towards you.>$b$bYes, now your great test is done. You have fulfilled the requirements of The Parchment of Dust!
english.completed: Return to Iktis of the Flock in Gnarlwood Pass

text.title: 青春永驻
text.objectives: 为比吉尔收集青春之根。
text.description: 坐在这里无所事事可是生意人的大忌。$b$b我得想办法赢回一些失去的利润才行。$b$b那些德莱尼女子终日沉迷于打理自己的犄角。$b$b我听到她们当中有个人提起过一种生长在刃月密林的根须，据说能延缓犄角脱落的速度还是怎么的。$b$b我敢打赌，要是把那种根须卖给她们的话，肯定能大赚一笔。$b$b如果你肯帮我找到货源，好处少不了你的。
text.progress: Did you find any Youngroot?
text.completion: Hmm... How am I going to package this?$b$bI have an idea!$b$b<Beezil writes Youngroot on a label and slaps it onto a bottle of adder oil.>$b$b< He throws the Youngroot in the bushes behind him.>$b$bPerfect!
text.completed: Return to Beezil at Fiona's Caravan in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Forever Young
english.objectives: Pick Youngroot for Beezil.
english.description: All this sitting around is horrible for business.$b$bI have to find a way to recoup some of my lost profits.$b$bThose Draenei females are obsessed with the way their horns look.$b$bI overheard one of them talking about a root that grows in Blademoon Bloom that supposedly reduces horn shedding or something.$b$bI bet I could sell that root to them for a pretty nice profit.$b$bI'll give you a cut if you help me get a supply going.
english.progress: Удалось найти побеги младокорня?
english.completion: Hmm... How am I going to package this?$b$bI have an idea!$b$b<Beezil writes Youngroot on a label and slaps it onto a bottle of adder oil.>$b$b< He throws the Youngroot in the bushes behind him.>$b$bPerfect!
english.completed: Return to Beezil at Fiona's Caravan in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 强袭木精
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个木精。
text.description: 吉德文现在好多了。谢谢你，$n。$b$b我真不敢相信那些德莱尼居然在那么可怕的怪物身边生活了那么久。$b$b也许我们应该让这些野兽瞧瞧，招惹艾泽拉斯人会有什么下场。
text.completion: That's what I'm talking about! Great work out there, $n.
text.completed: Return to Tarenar at Fiona's Caravan in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Botani Beatdown
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Botani.
english.description: Gidwin is doing much better. Thank you, $n.$b$bI can't believe the draenei have lived alongside those horrible monsters for so long.$b$bMaybe we should show these beasts what happens when you mess with an Azerothian.
english.completion: That's what I'm talking about! Great work out there, $n.
english.completed: Return to Tarenar at Fiona's Caravan in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 腐烂的淡水兽
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个密林妖花。
text.description: 木精用某种食肉的诡异植物感染了当地的淡水兽。$b$b我担心这股感染之力会波及到我们的族人。$b$b如果你看见任何受感染的淡水兽，就把寄居在它们体内的开花植物消灭掉……别等它们先对你动手。
text.completion: This new is disturbing to say the least. I'm shocked the infestation has spread so quickly.
text.completed: Return to Rangari Duula at the Verdant Mire in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Rotting Riverbeasts
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Blooming Mandroga.
english.description: The botani are infecting the local riverbeasts with some kind of strange flesh-eating plant.$b$bI fear this infection could spread to our people.$b$bIf you see any infested riverbeasts, kill the blooming plants that inhabit their bodies... before they kill you.
english.completion: This new is disturbing to say the least. I'm shocked the infestation has spread so quickly.
english.completed: Return to Rangari Duula at the Verdant Mire in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 催眠花
text.objectives: 用收集来的鹅卵石摧毁催眠花。
text.description: 哈？……天哪，我好像又睡着了。$b$b这些催眠花真是麻烦。上一秒我还在大战木精，下一秒居然已经在梦里变身成一只雷象，跟淡水兽翩翩起舞上了。$b$b*打哈欠*我们真该对这些催眠花采取些行动*打哈欠*……ZZZZzzzzzzzz$b$b<你在酣睡的德莱尼身边收集到了一把鹅卵石。>
text.completion: You can sleep easy tonight knowing you have destroyed so many slumberblooms... just not quite as easy.
text.completed: Use the Stone to destroy the Slumberblooms at Blademoon Bloom in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Slumberbloom
english.objectives: Use the Gathered Pebbles to pop the Slumberblooms.
english.description: Huh?... Oh my, I appear to have fallen asleep again.$b$bThese slumberblooms are nothing but trouble. One second I'm fighting botani and the next I'm dreaming I'm an elekk dancing with riverbeasts.$b$b*Yawn* We really should do something about all these slumberbloo *Yawn* ... ZZZZzzzzzzzz$b$b<You gather a small handful of pebbles laying by the sleeping draenei.>
english.completion: You can sleep easy tonight knowing you have destroyed so many slumberblooms... just not quite as easy.
english.completed: Use the Stone to destroy the Slumberblooms at Blademoon Bloom in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 鸦爪岗哨
text.objectives: 将安苏之眼带给鸦爪岗哨的利爪卫士库雷克。与天爪卫士米沙尔交谈，开始飞行。
text.description: 你现在一定对整件诅咒的事情充满疑惑吧。究竟是什么能把如此庄严的鸦人扭曲成……额，这样的东西？$B$B<瑞沙德从斑驳的羽毛里伸出一只变形的手，捂住了脸。>$B$B一只渡鸦已经准备就绪，等着带你飞往鸦爪岗哨。你在那里要睁大双眼，看清诅咒的起源。$B$B把安苏之眼拿给利爪卫士库雷克看。然后他会指引你的。
text.progress: Reshad sent an outsider here? You must be very important... or very dangerous.
text.completion: <Kurekk gazes at the orb.>$B$BIs that... what I think it is?$B$BWe must get this to the Talon Altar.
text.completed: Speak with Talon Guard Kurekk in Talon Watch.

english.title: Talon Watch
english.objectives: Bring the Eye of Anzu to Talon Guard Kurekk in Talon Watch. Speak with Skytalon Meshaal for a flight.
english.description: By now you must be wondering about all of this curse business. What could distort a majestic arakkoa into... well, into this?$B$B<Reshad drags a crooked hand through the mottled feathers about his face.>$B$BA raven is prepped and waiting to fly you to Talon Watch. There shall your eyes be opened to the origin of this curse.$B$BPresent the Eye of Anzu to Talon Guard Kurekk. He will guide you from there.
english.progress: Решад прислал чужака? Ты, должно быть, важная шишка... или опасная личность.
english.completion: <Kurekk gazes at the orb.>$B$BIs that... what I think it is?$B$BWe must get this to the Talon Altar.
english.completed: Speak with Talon Guard Kurekk in Talon Watch.

text.title: 不朽的恨意
text.objectives: 从塞泰克山谷里收集$1oa滴塞泰的凝固之血。
text.description: 既殁之神塞泰的鲜血还留存在这些池子里。一同留下的还有他对鲁克玛和安苏的仇恨。$B$B这股恨意是如此强烈，以致于在他被其它两位神灵杀死了千万年后，仍在为那鲜血赋予生命力。$B$B我需要找到将那些仇恨生物凝聚在一起的凝固之血。$B$B信徒们最怕的就是这诅咒的力量——要是我们能用这股力量去对付他们，会怎么样呢？
text.progress: My attempts to bottle the pooled blood have failed. It breaks down and dissipates when it is taken away from Sethe's bones.$B$BBut I have high hopes for this congealed form!
text.completion: Excellent, excellent. Go ahead and drop those directly into the cauldron.
text.completed: Return to Kazu in Talon Watch.

english.title: Hatred Undying
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Congealed Blood of Sethe from Sethekk Holllow.
english.description: The blood of the dead god, Sethe, lingers in the pools here. And with it, his hatred of Rukhmar and Anzu.$B$BSo strong was this hate that it animates the blood even now, eons after he was slain by his fellow gods.$B$BI need the congealed blood that holds those spiteful creatures together.$B$BThere is nothing the Adherents fear more than the power of this curse - what if we could brandish it against them?
english.progress: Мне так и не удалось собрать жидкую кровь. После извлечения из костей Сете она сразу преображается.$B$BНо надеюсь, что она пригодится мне и в запекшемся виде.
english.completion: Excellent, excellent. Go ahead and drop those directly into the cauldron.
english.completed: Return to Kazu in Talon Watch.

text.title: 坠落尘土
text.objectives: 对8名被诅咒的鸦人使用安苏之眼。
text.description: 数个世代以来，信徒们一直把他们的敌人丢进这座山谷。$B$B这些池子承载着塞泰临死前的诅咒，被投入池中的鸦人将看到黑暗的幻象并承受可怕的痛苦。这诅咒扭曲他们的意志、摧残他们的身躯、并让他们的翅膀萎缩。$B$B大部分鸦人都死了或疯了。只有最坚强的人才能忍受下来——把他们找出来，并用安苏之眼帮他们找回理智。$B$B当心，塞泰的崇拜者们也在觊觎这些幸存者，想让其加入他们的行列。
text.completion: They have suffered a fate worse than death, but at least they are free.
text.completed: Return to Talon Guard Kurekk in Talon Watch.

english.title: Banished From the Sky
english.objectives: Use the Eye of Anzu on 8 Cursed Arakkoa.
english.description: The Adherents have been casting their enemies into the hollow for generations.$B$BThe pools carry Sethe's dying curse, crippling arakkoa with visions of darkness and intense pain. The mind reels, the body writhes, and the wings wither.$B$BMost arakkoa die or go insane. Only the strongest can resist - seek them out and use the Eye of Anzu to help them to their senses.$B$BBeware, for the worshippers of Sethe also prey on these survivors to fill their ranks.
english.completion: They have suffered a fate worse than death, but at least they are free.
english.completed: Return to Talon Guard Kurekk in Talon Watch.

text.title: 鸦神的凝视
text.objectives: 对着$1oa个风蛇巢穴使用安苏之眼。
text.description: 塞泰克教徒们用塞泰的血骨繁育邪恶的风蛇。有了这些怪物，他们会将天空撕裂。$B$B它们的巢穴受到了强大魔法的保护，可安苏的凝视应该能轻易穿透那道屏障。$B$B让我们到巢穴里去消灭它们吧！
text.completion: <As the orb meets the altar, the nearby candles flare up.>
text.completed: Place the Eye of Anzu upon the Talon Altar.

english.title: Gaze of the Raven God
english.objectives: Use the Eye of Anzu at $1oa Wind Serpent Nests.
english.description: The Sethekk are breeding vile wind serpents from Sethe's blood and bones. With these creatures, they will tear apart the sky.$B$BThe nests are protected by powerful magic, but Anzu's gaze should penetrate them with ease.$B$BLet us visit the nests and destroy them!
english.completion: <As the orb meets the altar, the nearby candles flare up.>
english.completed: Place the Eye of Anzu upon the Talon Altar.

text.title: 塞泰之子
text.objectives: 收集6片风蛇翅膀。
text.description: 距离最后一次有人与安苏取得联系，已经过去了许多年。他跟泰罗克一样选择了消失，退居到了暗影之中。$B$B如果我们想把他唤回，就要准备好供品。$B$B是塞泰夺走了我们的天空——用他子嗣的翅膀来献祭再合适不过了。
text.progress: <A large bowl awaits an offering for the raven god.>
text.completion: <Heaping the wings into the bowl, you hear a faint rustling of feathers from somewhere overhead.>
text.completed: Interact with the Offering Bowl at the Talon Shrine in Sethekk Hollow.

english.title: Sons of Sethe
english.objectives: Collect 6 Wind Serpent Wings.
english.description: Many years have passed since anyone has been in contact with Anzu. He faded away, as Terokk did, to take refuge in the shadows.$B$BIf we are to coax him back, we should make an offering.$B$BSethe took the sky from us all - it seems fitting to take the wings of his children.
english.progress: <A large bowl awaits an offering to the raven god.>
english.completion: <Heaping the wings into the bowl, you hear a faint rustling of feathers from somewhere overhead.>
english.completed: Interact with the Offering Bowl at the Talon Shrine in Sethekk Hollow.

text.title: 中断仪式
text.objectives: 通过踩踏以破坏三处塞泰克仪式圆环
text.description: 我无法战胜这个诅咒，因此在很久以前，我就退居到了黑暗之中。$B$B但塞泰克教徒正在举行一系列黑暗的仪式，意图将我召回，使我慢慢屈从于塞泰的意志。他们一旦得逞，塞泰就会命令我让黑暗遮蔽天际，让整个世界浸没于他的血海之中。$B$B去破坏他们的仪式，好让我带着自由的意志返回这个世界。然后，我们将一起终结塞泰的回归。
text.completion: Ah... I feel their grasp slipping.$B$BThank you, mortal.
text.completed: Speak with Anzu at the Broken Spire.

english.title: Ritual Severance
english.objectives: Stomp out the three Sethekk Ritual Circles by running over them.
english.description: I could not defeat this curse, and long ago resigned myself to rest in darkness.$B$BBut the Sethekk are performing dark rituals to draw me back, slowly binding me to Sethe's will. Should they succeed, Sethe would have me draw a dark cloak across the horizon, and bathe the world in his blood.$B$BDisrupt their rituals, so that I may return with my own free will. Then, together, we shall bring an end to Sethe's return.
english.completion: Ah... I feel their grasp slipping.$B$BThank you, mortal.
english.completed: Speak with Anzu at the Broken Spire.

text.title: 既殁之神的奴仆
text.objectives: 在塞泰克山谷杀死$1oa名塞泰克预言者和$2oa名塞泰克选民。
text.description: 即使在死后，塞泰依然在对这些被他诅咒的可怜生物施加影响。塞泰克教派便来源于此，这个教派的领袖是一名伪王，效忠的也是一名死去已久的神明。$B$B去让他们的预言者闭嘴，他们寻求的未来只有凋敝的天空和漆黑的血海。$B$B去消灭他们选出的勇士，他们选择的信仰是一个纯粹的谎言。
text.completion: Weapons and zealotry do not make one strong.$B$BThey turned to Sethe because they were too weak to face death.
text.completed: Speak with Anzu in the Broken Spire.

english.title: Servants of a Dead God
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Sethekk Prophets and $2oa Sethekk Chosen in Sethekk Hollow.
english.description: Even in death, Sethe exerts influence. The Sethekk cult was born of this influence: led by a false king in service of the dead god.$B$BSilence their prophets, for they seek a future of black seas and blighted skies.$B$BDefeat their chosen champions, for they have pledged themselves to a lie.
english.completion: Weapons and zealotry do not make one strong.$B$BThey turned to Sethe because they were too weak to face death.
english.completed: Speak with Anzu in the Broken Spire.

text.title: 准备作战
text.objectives: 获得30件黑石武器。
text.description: 这上面无处可躲。我们需要立刻离开这里，但我们想走就必须穿过钢铁部落的中心区域。$B$B为此，我们必须把这帮赤手空拳的囚犯们武装成一支军队。
text.progress: These prisoners are no less brave than you or I, $n. Give them a weapon and an ounce of hope and they will fight like the storm.
text.completion: Great work, $n.$b$bDon't put away your weapon yet - now's when the REAL work begins.

english.title: Prepare for Battle
english.objectives: Obtain 30 Blackrock Weapons.
english.description: There's nowhere to hide up here. We need to keep moving, and to do that, we need to pass right through the heart of the Iron Horde.$b$bIt's time to turn this unarmed group of prisoners into an army.
english.progress: These prisoners are no less brave than you or I, $n. Give them a weapon and an ounce of hope and they will fight like the storm.
english.completion: Great work, $n.$b$bDon't put away your weapon yet - now's when the REAL work begins.

text.title: 中毒麻痹
text.objectives: 解救失踪的旅行者。
text.description: 还有其他一些车队成员下落不明。$b$b我猜他们都被木精带进刃月密林里去了。$b$b你得去救他们，$n。你是我们唯一的希望了。$b$b带上这些我刚刚调配的药剂，你可能用得到它们。
text.completion: I can never repay you for all you have done here today, $n.$b$bI am truly in your debt.
text.completed: Return to Fiona at Fiona's Caravan in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Poison Paralysis
english.objectives: Rescue the missing travelers.
english.description: There are others from the caravan that have gone missing.$b$bMy guess is they have been taken into Blademoon Bloom by the botani.$b$bYou have to rescue them, $n. You are our only hope.$b$bHere, take some of this elixir I just made, chances are you will need it.
english.completion: I can never repay you for all you have done here today, $n.$b$bI am truly in your debt.
english.completed: Return to Fiona at Fiona's Caravan in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 和教徒碰头
text.objectives: 在渡鸦之痕与鸦语者瑟卡拉交谈。
text.description: 我们亲爱的教友瑟卡拉带人去渡鸦之痕主持伟大的净化仪式了。$b$b但一整天都还没人回巢来取补给品，或许他们仍在专心祈祷。$b$b我本来打算自己去看看，但我还得核对我的抄写员的手稿，免得她写错我最近一次布道的内容。你能帮我去看看他吗？我会去的……呃，什么时候就不一定了……
text.completion: At last, our prayers to the Raven Mother have been answered!
text.completed: Speak to Ravenspeaker Sekara in the Ravenskar.

english.title: Rendezvous with the Ritualists
english.objectives: Speak to Ravenspeaker Sekara in the Ravenskar.
english.description: Our dear brother Sekara went to the Ravenskar with some of the flock to enact the great ritual of purification.$b$bNo one has been sent back to the nest for supplies in the past day; caught up in prayers I suppose.$b$bI would go check on him but I need to make sure the scribe didn't mess up her transcription of my latest sermon. Could you do it? I'll be there in... well, who knows...
english.completion: At last, our prayers to the Raven Mother have been answered!
english.completed: Speak to Ravenspeaker Sekara in the Ravenskar.

text.title: UNUSED
text.objectives: [PH] asdf
text.description: [PH] Now that we're somewhat safer and the texts are returned go report back to the High Ravencaller. We will continue our prayers here.
text.completed: [PH] asdf

english.title: UNUSED
english.objectives: [PH] asdf
english.description: [PH] Now that we're somewhat safer and the texts are returned go report back to the High Ravencaller. We will continue our prayers here.
english.completed: [PH] asdf

text.title: 鸦母的召唤
text.objectives: 帮助高阶鸦语者科卡举行召唤仪式。
text.description: 这里的一切都已准备就绪，可以开始举行将鸦母召唤回巢的仪式了。$b$b你已经通过了我们为你设下的所有试炼，现在理应加入我们，并参与到仪式中来。$b$b很快，鸦母本尊就会在我们面前现身！噢，我的羽毛已经在兴奋地颤抖了！$b$b等你准备好就再来找我谈谈吧。
text.completion: You have done much to help my little nest of forgotten ones. The poor creatures are not quite sane but with their own kin hunting them I pity their plight.$B$BTheir flying kin, the Adherents you call them, would see the forgotten ones destroyed and my children made into slaves.$B$BThis I must not allow!
text.completed: Speak with Ka'alu at the Nest of the Ravenspeakers in Spires of Arak.

english.title: Call of the Raven Mother
english.objectives: Help High Ravenspeaker Krikka with the ritual of calling.
english.description: All is now in its place to begin the ritual of calling that will bring the Raven Mother back to the nest.$b$bYou have fulfilled all of the tests we have put before you so it is only fitting that you join with us and participate in the ritual.$b$bSoon the Raven Mother herself will appear before us! Oh my feathers are tingling in excitement!$b$bSpeak to me again when you are ready.
english.completion: Ты много $Gсделал:сделала;, чтобы помочь моему гнездышку забытых. Эти бедняги не совсем в своем уме, и на них охотятся их же собратья. Ужасно.$B$BИх летающие сородичи – у вас они зовутся Приверженцами – желают уничтожить забытых и превратить моих детей в рабов.$B$BЭтого я допустить не могу!
english.completed: Speak with Ka'alu at the Nest of the Ravenspeakers in Spires of Arak.

text.title: 高阶鸦语者
text.objectives: 找到高阶鸦语者科卡
text.description: 是的，我就知道你有本事！$b$b在信仰文书中写着：危机必然伴随着猜疑，但真正的信徒必须时刻秉持对鸦母的信任！$b$b快走，我们要去见高阶鸦语者！
text.completion: In the whispers of the Raven Mother, blessed she be, it was foretold in the Scroll of Order that upon calling for a sign that we would receive one within thirty minutes or less.$b$bThis is most fortunate, for we have already begun our preparations for her arrival and we have need of your assistance.
text.completed: Speak to High Ravenspeaker Krikka within the Nest of the Ravenspeakers.

english.title: The High Ravenspeaker
english.objectives: Locate High Ravenspeaker Krikka
english.description: Yes, I knew you were worthy!$b$bThe Writ of Faith says that great doubt will come in time of crisis but one must put their trust in the Raven Mother and all will be as it should!$b$bCome, come, we must go to the High Ravenspeaker!
english.completion: In the whispers of the Raven Mother, blessed she be, it was foretold in the Scroll of Order that upon calling for a sign that we would receive one within thirty minutes or less.$b$bThis is most fortunate, for we have already begun our preparations for her arrival and we have need of your assistance.
english.completed: Speak to High Ravenspeaker Krikka within the Nest of the Ravenspeakers.

text.title: 利爪伪王
text.objectives: 从利爪之王艾吉斯身上取得磨损的手镯。
text.description: 艾吉斯原是信徒当中一位颇有名望的先知，但由于试图找出泰罗克被贬落的真相而遭到了放逐。$B$B他被泰罗克的故事迷住了，甚至自称是泰罗克转世。他统领着塞泰克教派，要用无上的力量缔造全新的黑暗时代。$B$B听着：艾吉斯才不是什么利爪之王。去杀了这个妄想狂，并从他那里搜寻任何有用的东西。他以收集强大的饰品而闻名。
text.progress: Have you silenced the false king?
text.completion: A bracelet? Interesting... rather plain looking...
text.completed: Speak with Talon Guard Kurekk in Sethekk Hollow.
text.giverWindow: 一位疯狂的奥术师，坚信自己是泰罗克转世。

english.title: The False Talon King
english.objectives: Retrieve the Scuffed Bangle from Talon King Ikiss.
english.description: Ikiss was once a respected sage among the Adherents, but his search for the truth of Terokk's fall led to his own banishment.$B$BIkiss became obsessed with Terokk, even claiming to be the old hero reborn. He commands the Sethekk, promising untold power in a new age of darkness.$B$BKnow this: Ikiss is no Talon King. Slay the delusional fool, and search him for anything useful. He is known to collect powerful trinkets.
english.progress: Тебе удалось заткнуть рот королю-самозванцу?
english.completion: A bracelet? Interesting... rather plain looking...
english.completed: Speak with Talon Guard Kurekk in Sethekk Hollow.
english.giverWindow: A crazed arcanist who believes himself to be Terokk reborn.

text.title: 塞泰，既殁之神
text.objectives: 在碎岩峰帮助安苏击败塞泰。
text.description: 是时候为塞泰的生命彻底画上句号了。我以前曾经杀死过他，在你的帮助下，我将会再杀他一次。$B$B做好战斗的准备吧——眼看我们要弑杀他们的神祗，那些教徒决不会袖手旁观。
text.completion: Sethe has died twice, but his curse lives on. It seems we will never be rid of it.
text.completed: Speak with Anzu at Lithic's Rest.
text.giverWindow: 在塞泰克手中重生。

english.title: Sethe, the Dead God
english.objectives: Help Anzu defeat Sethe in the Broken Spire.
english.description: The time has come to put an end to Sethe. I killed him before, and with your help I shall do it again.$B$BReady yourself for a fight - the cultists will not stand idly by while we stamp out their god.
english.completion: Sethe has died twice, but his curse lives on. It seems we will never be rid of it.
english.completed: Speak with Anzu at Lithic's Rest.
english.giverWindow: Reborn at the hands of the Sethekk.

text.title: 蕾希的礼物
text.objectives: 把磨损的手镯带到蕾希之眠。
text.description: <库雷克眯着眼睛打量着那只手镯，慢慢在掌中旋转。>$B$B在内侧有一行铭文。$B$B“献给我的父亲，愿鲁克玛照亮你的道路。爱你的蕾希。”$B$B这不可能……这竟然是泰罗克的手镯！是他女儿送给他的礼物，他佩戴了许多年，直到……$B$B呃，我们最好把它还回去。$B$B泰罗克给蕾希造了个纪念碑，就在距离鸦爪岗哨不远处。应该把这只手镯放回那里。
text.progress: Who... are you? Why have you stirred me?
text.completion: That bracelet... I made it for father long ago.$B$BBefore the fall...
text.completed: Bring the Scuffed Bangle to Lithic's Rest.

english.title: Lithic's Gift
english.objectives: Bring the Scuffed Bangle to Lithic's Rest.
english.description: <Kurekk squints at the bangle, rotating it slowly in his claws.>$B$BThere is an inscription on the inside.$B$B"To my father, may Rukhmar illuminate your path. With love, Lithic."$B$BIt cannot be... This is Terokk's bangle! It was a gift from his daughter, he wore it for years until...$B$BWell, we had better return it.$B$BTerokk built a memorial to Lithic not far from Talon Watch. It should rest there.
english.progress: Кто... ты? Зачем ты $gпотревожил:потревожила; меня?
english.completion: That bracelet... I made it for father long ago.$B$BBefore the fall...
english.completed: Bring the Scuffed Bangle to Lithic's Rest.

text.title: 刃月密林
text.objectives: 在刃月密林里和游侠阿瑞菲奥见面。
text.description: 我们已别无选择。$b$b我要进入密林一探究竟。我们在里面见吧。$b$b祝你好运，$c。
text.completion: Good, you made it. I need your help.
text.completed: Return to Rangari Arepheon at Blademoon Bloom in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Blademoon Bloom
english.objectives: Meet Rangari Arepheon inside Blademoon Bloom.
english.description: We are out of options.$b$bI'm going into the bloom to find out what's going on. I'll meet you inside.$b$bGoodluck, $c.
english.completion: Good, you made it. I need your help.
english.completed: Return to Rangari Arepheon at Blademoon Bloom in Shadowmoon Valley.

objectiveDetails.description: 与游侠阿瑞菲奥谈一谈

text.title: 斩杀原祖荆兽
text.objectives: 消灭原祖荆兽。
text.description: 情况很不妙。一头原祖荆兽在密林生长起来了。$b$b这是三百多年来第一次有新的原祖荆兽在德拉诺诞生的报告。$b$b怪不得木精变得这么疯狂。它们四处出击就是为了给这头怪物寻找食物。$b$b我们必须在它长得更大前杀了它！一旦它发育完全，那就没有任何东西能够阻止那头野兽了。
text.completion: That was close.$b$bIf that genesaur would have grown any larger we would have needed an army to destroy it.$b$bThank you for all your help.
text.completed: Return to Rangari Arepheon at the Blademoon Bloom in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Gestating Genesaur
english.objectives: Kill the genesaur.
english.description: This is bad. A genesaur is starting to sprout right here in the bloom.$b$bThis is the first reported case of a genesaur being born in draenor in over three hundred years.$b$bNo wonder the botani have been acting so crazy. They are bringing back bodies to fertilize that monstrosity.$b$bWe have to kill it before it gets any larger. Once fully grown there is no stopping that beast.
english.completion: That was close.$b$bIf that genesaur would have grown any larger we would have needed an army to destroy it.$b$bThank you for all your help.
english.completed: Return to Rangari Arepheon at the Blademoon Bloom in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 割颅者基本教程
text.objectives: 从$1oa名死亡的割颅者身上拿下面具。
text.description: 我的猎人们都死光了，现在你需要加入我的猎队。$b$b找到他们的遗体，拿下他们的面具。我会选择哪些面具值得纪念，哪些直接扔掉。这就是我们的做法。$b$b我自己会进一步深入此地，看看能不能找到更多面具。
text.progress: Afraid to get your hands dirty? They are just bodies now, no need to be scared.
text.completion: This red slime covers everything, even the skulls of my hunters!  I'll make a Skulltaker of you yet though, great work!
text.completed: Return to Grulkor at Crimson Fen.

english.title: Basic Skulltaking
english.objectives: Take the skulls from $1oa dead Skulltakers.
english.description: My hunters are all dead, you will be my hunting pack now.$b$bFind their bodies and take their skulls.  I will choose which to honor and which to cast aside.  It is our way.$b$bI will go further and see what other skulls may be found here.
english.progress: Что, боишься запачкать руки? Они все уже мертвы, так что не пугайся.
english.completion: This red slime covers everything, even the skulls of my hunters!  I'll make a Skulltaker of you yet though, great work!
english.completed: Return to Grulkor at Crimson Fen.

text.title: 割颅者的复仇
text.objectives: 杀死$1oa只真菌侦察者。
text.description: 其他人……都死了，或是游荡到浓雾深处去了。它同样也在召唤我，但我的意志足够强大。我选择杀死他们，直到我的身体被他们击垮。但我还没杀够，$p，还不够！去吧，去杀死他们，告诉我的猎队领袖，当走进黑暗时，我不是孤身一人。
text.completion: Hah!  If he was that strong he'd still be alive.  Still it is good you did him honor.  Did you take his skull by any chance?

english.title: Skulltaker's Revenge
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Fungal Lurchers.
english.description: The others... gone or wandered into the haze.  It called to me as well but I am too strong.  I chose to kill until they crushed my body.  I haven't killed enough of them yet $p, not enough!  Go.  Kill more of them and tell my hunt leader that I don't go alone into the dark.
english.completion: Hah!  If he was that strong he'd still be alive.  Still it is good you did him honor.  Did you take his skull by any chance?

text.title: 准备作战
text.objectives: 获得30件黑石武器。
text.description: 这上面无处可躲。我们需要立刻离开这里，但我们想走就必须穿过钢铁部落的中心区域。$B$B为此，我们必须把这帮赤手空拳的囚犯们武装成一支军队。
text.progress: These prisoners are no less brave than you or I, $n. Give them a weapon and an ounce of hope and they will fight like the storm.
text.completion: Great work, $n.$b$bDon't put away your weapon yet - now's when the REAL work begins.

english.title: Prepare for Battle
english.objectives: Obtain 30 Blackrock Weapons.
english.description: There's nowhere to hide up here. We need to keep moving, and to do that, we need to pass right through the heart of the Iron Horde.$b$bIt's time to turn this unarmed group of prisoners into an army.
english.progress: $n, эти пленники столь же храбры, как ты или я. Дай им оружие и крупицу надежды – и они будут драться, как львы.
english.completion: Great work, $n.$b$bDon't put away your weapon yet - now's when the REAL work begins.

text.title: 神秘的豆荚
text.objectives: 把发光的红色豆荚带给赤红沼泽的戈鲁科尔。
text.description: 这颗豆荚和在这附近其他尸体上及旁边所生长的极为相似，但它却诡异地搏动着。戈鲁科尔可能对这东西有所了解。
text.completion: What's this?  Let me check if it has a skull...

english.title: Mysterious Pod
english.objectives: Bring the Glowing Red Pod to Grulkor at Crimson Fen.
english.description: This pod is similar to the ones growing on or near the bodies around here, except this one is pulsating weirdly.  Grulkor might know more about this.
english.completion: What's this?  Let me check if it has a skull...

text.title: 点亮黑暗
text.objectives: 用幽灵火把点燃先祖之地里的那些仪式柴堆。
text.description: 一直以来，我们祖先的灵魂都受到沃舒古圣山的吸引。而现在，我自己也能感受到它在吸引我的灵魂……可有些情况不太对劲。$B$B召唤着我们的那个存在变得黑暗而不祥。它在吞噬亡者的灵魂——我们祖先的灵魂，$n。$B$B必须采取行动了。$B$B拿上这支幽灵火把，点燃先祖之地里的那些仪式柴堆。$B$B幽灵火把的火焰可以平息灵魂们的躁动，使他们免遭虚空的吞噬。
text.completion: Now that the flame of the spirit torch is upon the pyres, the spirits of my ancestors have been insulated from the call of the void within Oshu'gun.$b$bHowever, more must still be done if the spirits here are to rest peacefully.
text.completed: Return to the spirit of Gar'rok.

english.title: Lighting The Darkness
english.objectives: Use the Spirit Torch to light the Ceremonial Pyres within the Ancestral Grounds.
english.description: The spirits of my ancestors have always been drawn to the mountain of Oshu'gun. Now, I too feel this pull deep within my soul...but something is not right.$b$bThe presence that beckons us has grown dark and ominous. It consumes the souls of the dead, the souls of my ancestors, $n.$b$bSomething must be done.$b$bTake hold of the spirit torch and light the ceremonial pyres in the Ancestral Grounds.$b$bThe flame of the spirit torch upon the pyres will calm the restless spirits being drawn into the void.
english.completion: Now that the flame of the spirit torch is upon the pyres, the spirits of my ancestors have been insulated from the call of the void within Oshu'gun.$b$bHowever, more must still be done if the spirits here are to rest peacefully.
english.completed: Return to the spirit of Gar'rok.

text.title: 过往的残影
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个受难残影。
text.description: 当虚空吞噬掉一个灵魂以后，这个灵魂的残影依然会存留在世间。$B$B但无论是在物质界还是灵魂界，这些残影都不能算是“活着”的。残影只是灵魂被吞噬时留下的痛苦而扭曲的映像。$B$B要是置之不理，这些残影就会对活物展开攻击，并使坟墓中的亡者无法安眠。$B$B为了恢复先祖之地的安宁，我们必须让这些残影安息。
text.completion: Do not mourn the twisted echoes of the dead, they are merely the distorted reflections of once noble spirits.$b$bInstead, mourn the loss of those souls consumed by the dark void that grows within Oshu'gun.
text.completed: Return to the spirit of Dahaka.

english.title: Echoes of the Past
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Tormented Echoes.
english.description: When a spirit is consumed by the void, an echo of the soul is all that is left behind.$b$bNeither in the physical or spiritual sense of the word would these echoes be considered 'alive.' The echo is merely a twisted reverberation of the anguish left behind by the soul as it is consumed.$b$bIf left unchecked, the echoes will lash out against the living and stir the spirits of the dead from their graves.$b$bIn order to restore peace to the Ancestral Grounds, these echoes must be put to rest.
english.completion: Do not mourn the twisted echoes of the dead, they are merely the distorted reflections of once noble spirits.$b$bInstead, mourn the loss of those souls consumed by the dark void that grows within Oshu'gun.
english.completed: Return to the spirit of Dahaka.

text.title: 高尔玛什·地狱咆哮
text.objectives: 击败高尔玛什·地狱咆哮的灵魂。
text.description: 在惨烈的战斗中阵亡的人，灵魂无法安宁地进入灵魂界。高尔玛什·地狱咆哮便是其中之一。$B$B他的身躯被一只巨大的戈隆咬碎了。但高尔玛什在临死前还是用尽力气将他的战斧血吼劈入了这只巨兽的眼中。在他们轰然倒下的时候，先死的反而是那只戈隆。$B$B这种英勇的死法是每个战歌兽人都梦寐以求的，虽然极少有人能真正做到。但事实上，高尔玛什强大的灵魂仍在此地逗留，非但得不到应有的安宁，还影响到了其他灵魂的安息。$B$B请让这个强大的灵魂安眠吧，$n。
text.completion: Golmash was a mighty warrior in life.$b$bFew orcs have been as honored by their clans and feared by their enemies as the great Giantslayer... the father of the Hellscream name. With the mighty spirit of Golmash Hellscream finally put to rest, the ancestral grounds may once again be a place of peace and reverence.$b$bYou have our thanks, $n.
text.completed: Return to the spirit of Gar'rok.
text.giverWindow: 必须让高尔玛什·地狱咆哮的灵魂安息！

english.title: Golmash Hellscream
english.objectives: Defeat the spirit of Golmash Hellscream.
english.description: Those who die in brutal combat often enter the spirit world in unrest. So it was with Golmash, father of Grommash Hellscream.$b$bCrushed within the jaws of a hulking gronn, Golmash still found the strength to bury his axe Gorehowl deep into the eye of the monster. When they fell, it was the gronn who died first.$b$bSuch is the heroic death that every Warsong dreams of, yet few attain. But Golmash's mighty spirit lingers restlessly, stirring the other spirits into unrest.$b$bPut his mighty soul to rest, $n.
english.completion: Golmash was a mighty warrior in life.$b$bFew orcs have been as honored by their clans and feared by their enemies as the great Giantslayer... the father of the Hellscream name. With the mighty spirit of Golmash Hellscream finally put to rest, the ancestral grounds may once again be a place of peace and reverence.$b$bYou have our thanks, $n.
english.completed: Return to the spirit of Gar'rok.
english.giverWindow: The spirit of Golmash Hellscream must be put to rest!

text.title: 我们有伴了
text.objectives: 调查硫磺盆地中的钢铁部落营地。
text.description: 外来者，我在附近发现了钢铁部落的士兵。$b$b即便对于他们来说，擅闯这片危机四伏的土地也太过大胆了。$b$b要是你不解决掉他们的话，那些家伙一定会对你的营地构成威胁。
text.completion: Thank you, friend. I am in your debt.$B$BThis arrogant Iron Horde has made a dangerous enemy today.
text.completed: Speak to Rexxar at Sulfur Basin.

english.title: We Have Company
english.objectives: Investigate the Iron Horde camp in Sulfur Basin.
english.description: Outsider, I've spotted Iron Horde soldiers nearby.$b$bIt is bold, even for them, to venture into such deadly territory.$b$bIf you do not deal with their presence, they will surely be a threat to your camp.
english.completion: Thank you, I owe you one.$B$BToday, the arrogant Iron Horde made a dangerous enemy.
english.completed: Speak to Rexxar at Sulfur Basin.

text.title: 康复中
text.objectives: 从汽怒元素身上找到$1oa个淬火之水。
text.description: 尼莎会好起来的。$b$b这场遭遇让她元气大伤。眼下她需要多饮水，休息静养。$b$b我会把她带到我的营地里去，让她好好养伤。$b$b你能带些清水去那找我们吗？
text.progress: <Nisha raises her head.>
text.completion: <Nisha laps up the water.>
text.completed: Speak to Rexxar at Breaker's Crown.

english.title: On the Mend
english.objectives: Recover $1oa Quenching Waters from Steamfury elementals.
english.description: Nisha will heal.$b$bThis ordeal has taken a toll on her. She needs water and rest.$b$bI will bring her to my camp and make her comfortable.$b$bWill you meet us there with some fresh water?
english.progress: <Nisha raises her head.>
english.completion: <No drinking water greedily. >
english.completed: Speak to Rexxar at Breaker's Crown.

text.title: 清除路障
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个覆菌蹒跚者。
text.description: 看来亡者才是最强大的。那些弱者四处游荡，杀死闯入沼泽的入侵者。$b$b杀死他们……似乎有些……过分，可他们都是没用的渣子，挡了我们的路。去消灭那些蹒跚的蠢货，好让我们更加畅通无阻地深入这片沼泽。
text.completion: You take too long. Something calls to us deeper in there. Whatever it is, I will have its skull or die trying.
text.completed: Return to Grulkor at Crimson Fen.

english.title: Clearing the Way
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Fungus Covered Shamblers.
english.description: The dead ones were the strong ones it seems. The weak ones wander about killing invaders to this marsh.$b$bIt feels... wrong... to kill them, but they are worthless and get in our way. Kill these shambling fools so we can move further into the marsh easily.
english.completion: You take too long. Something calls to us deeper in there. Whatever it is, I will have its skull or die trying.
english.completed: Return to Grulkor at Crimson Fen.

text.title: 真菌的秘密
text.objectives: 采集$1oa朵荧光蘑菇。
text.description: 这里有股气味，还有低语声。$b$b我能感觉到在这里的植物和野兽间存在着某种联系。似乎有种特殊的蘑菇吸引了野兽的注意力。$b$b去给我找些这种蘑菇来。我……需要……它们。
text.progress: Where are my mushrooms?!
text.completion: Yes, they smell... wonderful. These will help me find the power of this marsh and take it for my own.
text.completed: Return to Grulkor at Crimson Fen.

english.title: The Secret of the Fungus
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Glowing Mushrooms.
english.description: It smells here and there are whispers.$b$bI feel there is a connection between the plants and beasts here. Special mushrooms seem to focus the beasts' attention.$b$bGo and get some of these for me. I... need... them.
english.progress: Where are my mushrooms?!
english.completion: Yes, they smell... wonderful. These will help me find the power of this marsh and take it for my own.
english.completed: Return to Grulkor at Crimson Fen.

text.title: 恐怖的收割者
text.objectives: 从真菌践踏者身上收集$1oa枚孢子囊，并把它们带给戈鲁科尔。
text.description: 那些更大的怪物是影响我命运的关键，我能感觉到这一点。在它们身上生长的孢子囊比你之前给我带来的还要大。帮我收集几枚来，很快就会……发挥它们的用处。
text.progress: I need more of those pods! Many more!
text.completion: These will aid me greatly.  I must consume them and take their power.  We are close to the end $p, I can feel it.
text.completed: Return to Grulkor at Crimson Fen.

english.title: A Grim Harvest
english.objectives: Bring Grulkor $1oa Spore Pods from the Fungal Stompers.
english.description: The larger monsters are the key to my destiny, I can feel it. The pods growing on them are even bigger than the one you brought me earlier.  Get me a few of these, they will be... helpful... soon.
english.progress: I need more of those pods! Many more!
english.completion: These will aid me greatly.  I must consume them and take their power.  We are close to the end $p, I can feel it.
english.completed: Return to Grulkor at Crimson Fen.

text.title: 寻心之旅
text.objectives: 调查赤红沼泽的奇怪现象。
text.description: 我能感觉到在沼泽中存在一股强大的力量，$p。它在吸引着我。我们必须前去弄清真相。你先走一步吧，我得把这些蘑菇吃完。
text.completion: We are so close I can almost touch it!  We will have to go deeper, much deeper!
text.completed: Return to Grulkor at Crimson Fen.

english.title: A Heartfelt Search
english.objectives: Investigate the strange presence at Crimson Fen.
english.description: I can feel a powerful presence in the marsh $p.  I feel drawn to it.  We must go and take what is there.  Go on ahead, I must finish consuming these mushrooms.
english.completion: We are so close I can almost touch it!  We will have to go deeper, much deeper!
english.completed: Return to Grulkor at Crimson Fen.

objectiveDetails.description: 查看奇怪的真菌生长地

text.title: 进入苦痛堡垒
text.objectives: 在大门上使用苦痛碎片。然后破坏黑暗印记、暗影印记和苦痛印记。
text.description: 鲁尔坎送你的苦痛碎片可以让你不受阻碍地进入要塞。上楼后在大门上使用这块碎片就可以进入广场。$B$B你会在广场上发现三座用来给魔法屏障充能的祭坛。$B$B毁掉这些符文，伊瑞尔和我就能进去跟你一同对付耐奥祖了。
text.completion: <You hear Prophet Velen's voice in your mind.>$B$BGood work, $n! The barriers are down. We are on our way.

english.title: Into Anguish
english.objectives: Use the Fragment of Anguish at the main doorway. Then destroy the Mark of Darkness, Mark of Shadows, and Mark of Anguish.
english.description: Rulkan's gift to you, the Fragment of Anguish, will allow you to pass into the fortress unhindered. Go up these stairs to the doorway, then use the fragment to enter the compound.$B$BOnce you are inside, you will find three altars powering the magical barrier around their stronghold.$B$BDestroy these runes, and Yrel and I will be able to join you in finding Ner'zhul.
english.completion: <You hear Prophet Velen's voice in your mind.>$B$BGood work, $n! The barriers are down. We are on our way.

text.title: 欢迎来到戈尔隆德
text.objectives: 沿着荒林洼地找到奈丽的岗哨。
text.description: 戈尔隆德是德拉诺最为危机四伏的地区。$b$b只有最老练的游侠才敢深入荒野。$b$b我们现在要到他们的营地去。如果你愿意先走一步，那就沿着这条路一直走，然后向右就行了。$b$b我跟玛尔拉德随后就到。在我们离开这里之前，还有些后勤工作要做。
text.completion: You have chosen a very unfortunate time to visit our camp, my friend.

english.title: Welcome to Gorgrond
english.objectives: Follow the Wildwood Wash to Naielle's Watch.
english.description: Gorgrond is one of the most untamed landscapes in all of Draenor.$b$bOnly the most skilled of rangari venture this deep into the wilds.$b$bIt is their camp we are heading for. If you wish to travel ahead, it can be found down this path and to the right.$b$bMaraad and I shall follow after you momentarily. We still have some logistics to work out before we leave the landing.
english.completion: You have chosen a very unfortunate time to visit our camp, my friend.

objectiveDetails.description: 先行探路，前往奈丽的岗哨

text.title: 挫骨扬灰
text.objectives: 焚烧$1oa具古树携种者的尸体。
text.description: 当这些携种者被杀死后，它们的种子会存活下来。继而长成新的携种者，这一过程用不了几年之久，在短短几小时内就能完成。$b$b如果把它们的遗骸留在这，你的营地很快就会受到威胁。$b$b要是你想保住自己的营地，就去烧光它们吧，外来者。
text.completion: Watch them burn!
text.completed: Return to Bony Xuk at Affliction Ridge.

english.title: Seedbearers of Bad News
english.objectives: Burn $1oa Ancient Seedbearer corpses.
english.description: When these seedbearers are slain their seeds survive. From them spring new seedbearers, not over years, but hours.$b$bLeaving their remains here would soon cause your camp to be overrun.$b$bBurn them, outsider, if you wish your camp to endure.
english.completion: Смотри, как они горят!
english.completed: Return to Bony Xuk at Affliction Ridge.

text.title: 这是你的同伴吗？
text.objectives: 与雷克萨交谈，并为嗜骨如命的艾苏克做担保。
text.description: 我发现这家伙躲在附近。他号称是你的同伴。$b$b这是真的吗？还是说他只是在我的篝火附近炖东西吃？
text.completion: That half-orc burned my toes!
text.completed: Speak to Bony Xuk at Breaker's Crown.

english.title: Is This One of Yours?
english.objectives: Talk to Rexxar and vouch for Bony Xuk.
english.description: I found this one skulking nearby. He claims to be an ally of yours.$b$bIs this true? Or does he cook slowly over my fire?
english.completion: Этот полуорк подпалил мне пальцы на ногах!
english.completed: Speak to Bony Xuk at Breaker's Crown.

objectiveDetails.description: 为嗜骨如命的艾苏克担保

text.title: 一探究竟
text.objectives: 调查碎牙之殁的钢铁部落营地。
text.description: 从下方的峡谷中不断传来尖叫和咆哮声——甚至比平时更加不同寻常。$b$b我不敢把尼莎单独留在这儿。$b$b你能去调查下那些噪音吗，$n？
text.completion: They are enslaving gronn? This is an even bigger problem than it might seem.
text.completed: Return  to Rexxar at Breaker's Crown.

english.title: Bad at Breaking
english.objectives: Search the Iron Horde camp at Crushfang's End.
english.description: Screams and growls echo from the canyon below - even more than usual.$b$bI don't dare leave Nisha here alone yet.$b$bWill you investigate those noises, $n?
english.completion: Они хотят подчинить себе гроннов? Похоже, ситуация более опасная, чем кажется на первый взгляд.
english.completed: Return  to Rexxar at Breaker's Crown.

text.title: 嗜骨如命的艾苏克是什么人？
text.objectives: 从长牙吞噬者身上收集$1oa块鬣蜥人水晶。
text.description: 看到你毫发无伤真是太好了，$n。艾苏克也一样。$b$b当你深入峡谷时，艾苏克来到这里贡献自己的力量。艾苏克是不会让你自己去取那些头骨的！$b$b艾苏克会跟你分享在我氏族中世代相传的强大灵魂魔法。在艾苏克做准备时，你必须去收集材料。$b$b首先，我们需要鬣蜥人尸体外皮上的水晶。它们的尸体就在峡谷里。
text.progress: Laughing Skull have some dirty tricks behind our masks.
text.completion: Yes... we don't need their bones, but we do need their crystals.
text.completed: Return to Bony Xuk at Breaker's Crown.

english.title: What the Bony Xuk?
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Goren Crystals from Longtooth Gorgers.
english.description: Good to see your bones are still intact, $n. Xuk's too.$b$bWhen you set off into the heart of the canyon, Xuk came to offer my services. Xuk not letting you take all of the skulls!$b$bXuk will share with you powerful spirit magics my clan has passed down for many generations. While Xuk make preparations, you must gather the reagents.$b$bFirst, we'll need crystals from husks of goren corpses. You can find their bodies in the canyon.
english.progress: Мы, бойцы клана Веселого Черепа, скрываем за своими масками парочку сюрпризов.
english.completion: Yes ... We do not need their bones, but we need their crystals.
english.completed: Return to Bony Xuk at Breaker's Crown.

text.title: 沼泽之心
text.objectives: 跟随戈鲁科尔深入赤红沼泽，并应对出现的状况。
text.description: 要是没有这些树冲着我尖叫的话，我就能更加冷静地分析情况了。不用担心，它们只是树而已。$B$B这颗心已经耗尽了，但我感觉到沼泽的更深处有一个更为强大的存在。我现在就去那，把应该属于我的都夺回来！$B$B然后我会跟……所有人分享……
text.completion: Grulkor was crazy to think he could harness the power of those mushrooms, but then, most Laughing Skull are crazy.$b$bStill, not a complete waste of time.
text.completed: Return to Marrow at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.

english.title: Heart of the Fen
english.objectives: Follow Grulkor deeper into the Crimson Fen and deal with what comes.
english.description: If only the trees here weren't screaming at me I could concentrate better. Never mind, they are only trees.$b$bThis spot is used up but now I can feel a much stronger presence deeper in the marsh.  I will go there now and take what is rightfully mine!$b$bThen I will share it... with everyone...
english.completion: Grulkor was crazy to think he could harness the power of those mushrooms, but then, most Laughing Skull are crazy.$b$bStill, not a complete waste of time.
english.completed: Return to Marrow at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.

text.title: 艾苏克教你诈！
text.objectives: 使用鬣蜥人伪装服，探索戈尔隆德的各个地点。
text.description: 完成了。$b$b有了这个魔法做掩护，你不仅能大摇大摆地在鬣蜥人面前行走，还能像他们那样移动。$b$b你现在可以轻松地在戈尔隆德各地往来旅行了。你可以安全地进入原本不可能靠近的地方。$b$b这都是托艾苏克祖先的福。
text.progress: What has that orc done to you?!
text.completion: It is good that you still have your wits about you. You do... have your wits about you?
text.completed: Return to Bony Xuk at Breaker's Crown.

english.title: Xuk It!
english.objectives: Use the goren disguise to explore locations in Gorgrond.
english.description: It is done.$b$bWith this enchantment, not only can you roam amongst the goren freely, but you can move as they do.$b$bYour travels through Gorgrond are now made simple. You have safe access to places otherwise impossible to reach.$b$bXuk's ancestors have made it so.
english.progress: Что это орк с тобой сделал?
english.completion: Хорошо, что ты еще не $gрастерял:растеряла; находчивости. Ты ведь... не $gрастерял:растеряла; находчивости?
english.completed: Return to Bony Xuk at Breaker's Crown.

objectiveDetails.description: 查看第一条隧道通往哪里
查看第二条隧道通往哪里
查看第三条隧道通往哪里
检查格罗姆卡信使尸体
沿着隧道返回毁灭者之冠

text.title: 纪念艾瑞德
text.objectives: 在塔拉多的乌瑞恩堡中与米阿尔交谈。
text.description: 我的师傅已随圣光而去，但我会继承他的事业。$B$B<米阿尔看着艾瑞德>$B$BShanai ortar，艾瑞德。$B$B我将把他的遗体送去奥金顿。现在，先让我看看你的炮塔吧。
text.completion: This is a beautiful and well equipped structure. Thank you for allowing me to work here.$b$bI am positive with this place I can carry on my master's legacy. You will not regret this!

english.title: In Ared's Memory
english.objectives: Speak to Miall inside of Fort Wrynn in Talador.
english.description: My master has gone on to the Light, but I will continue his work.$b$b<Miall looks to Ared >$b$bShanai ortar, Ared.$b$bI will have his body sent to Auchindoun. For now, show me this artillery tower of yours.
english.completion: This is a beautiful and well equipped structure. Thank you for allowing me to work here.$b$bI am positive with this place I can carry on my master's legacy. You will not regret this!

objectiveDetails.description: 在军械库与米阿尔见面

text.title: 解救游侠
text.objectives: 找到游侠拉洁丝、游侠科兰和游侠乔纳。
text.description: 我们有许多游侠掉队了。看来他们是被艾韵的追随者给带走了。$b$b我们会继续在这片区域内寻找幸存者。$b$b与此同时，你则沿着荒林洼地向西前往高山走廊，寻找我们游侠同伴留下的任何蛛丝马迹。$b$b我的同胞们个个都是生存大师，他们可比你想象得有本事。让他们在路边等着，等这个……矮人家伙……修好他的机械装置，我们就立即跟上。
text.completion: The rangari are stout survivalists. I knew they would not go down without a fight.$b$bThank you, $p, for your help in this. You have done us a great honor.

english.title: Rescue Rangari
english.objectives: Find Rangari Rajess, Rangari Kolaan, and Rangari Jonaa.
english.description: Many of our rangari have not been accounted for. It would seem the followers of Iyu have taken captives.$b$bWe will continue to search the area for survivors.$b$bIn the meantime, follow the Wildwood Wash west toward Highpass and look for any signs of our rangari comrades.$b$bOur people are stout and capable survivors. You may find more than you expect. Have them stay near the road and we will follow as soon as this... dwarf creature... has fixed his mechanical vessel.
english.completion: The rangari are stout survivalists. I knew they would not go down without a fight.$b$bThank you, $p, for your help in this. You have done us a great honor.

text.title: 失踪的钻探机
text.objectives: 找到失踪的钻探机。
text.description: 几乎没人能比黑铁矮人更了解黑石氏族了。$b$b于是在离开塔纳安之后，我们派出了几台钻探机，到戈尔隆德建造一处监听哨站来监视他们。$b$b结果我自己的钻探机却因脱轨而掉队了。后来没过多久，我就发现所有其它钻探机也都偏离了轨道。$b$b从我坦克上显示的信息来看，在西边出现了一台钻探机。$b$b我们得留下让这坦克恢复运转，你愿意先过去瞧瞧吗？
text.completion: Well, that's one down, and about a dozen others to go. We best get a base goin'. Sounds like we might be here a while.

english.title: Lost Mole Machines
english.objectives: Find the Missing Mole Machine.
english.description: Few people know the Blackrock clan better than Dark Iron dwarves.$b$bSo after Tanaan, we sent a bunch of mole machines to Gorgrond to build a listenin' post to keep an eye on them.$b$bMe own mole machine got way off course an' I got separated. It didn't take long to figure out all the other mole machines got off course as well.$b$bAccordin' to the readin's in me tank, a mole machine surfaced somewhere way to the west of here.$b$bMind scoutin' ahead while we get this tank operational?
english.completion: Well, that's one down, and about a dozen others to go. We best get a base goin'. Sounds like we might be here a while.

text.title: Vignette XP reward - Frostfire
text.description: This quest is a placeholder until Task 67719 is complete.

english.title: Vignette XP reward - Frostfire
english.description: This quest is a placeholder until Task 67719 is complete.

text.title: 神秘合剂
text.objectives: 在你的要塞与洛纳什谈一谈。
text.description: 这瓶中的液体显然是某种强效炼金药剂，但凭你目前的技术无法辨识其作用。$b$b听说你的要塞里有个来自岩牙岗哨的难民懂点德拉诺炼金知识。也许你可以问问他？
text.completion: Ah. I see you have found a creation of Draenor alchemy.
text.completed: 与你的要塞中的洛纳什谈一谈。

english.title: The Mysterious Flask
english.objectives: Speak to Lo'nash at your garrison.
english.description: The liquid swirling around inside the flask clearly has strong alchemical properties, but its nature is beyond your training.$b$bYou have heard that one of the Stonefang refugees at your garrison has some knowledge of the alchemy of Draenor. Perhaps he could tell you more?
english.completion: Ah. I see you have found a creation of Draenor alchemy.
english.completed: Speak to Lo'nash at your garrison.

text.title: 河畔会面
text.objectives: 在伊瑞尔的哨所与守备官伊瑞尔交谈。
text.description: 守备官伊瑞尔已经把我们大部分军队带去了北面。她在天歌湖边建立了前哨基地。$B$B把我们可以随时移师格罗玛什尔的情报汇报给她。$B$B顺便你还能帮她解决洛克拉斯的战歌兽人。
text.completion: It's good to see you, commander. When I'd heard about your garrison caravan being destroyed....$B$BWell, let's just say that I feared the worst.$B$BWhat word from Telaari Station?

english.title: Along the Riverside
english.objectives: Speak with Vindicator Yrel at Yrel's Watch.
english.description: Vindicator Yrel has taken most of our forces north. She's establishing a forward base along the Skysong River.$B$BShe'll want to know that we're almost ready to move against Grommashar.$B$BI'm sure she can also use your help dealing with the Warsong orcs at Lok-rath.
english.completion: Рада видеть тебя, командор. Когда до меня дошли вести об уничтожении вашего каравана...$B$BСкажем так, мне подумалось самое худшее.$B$BЕсть ли новости с Телаарской станции?

text.title: 投降条件
text.objectives: 去洛克拉斯讯问乌鲁克·破敌。
text.description: 说了你也许不信，不过我有个好消息：我们已经拿下了洛克拉斯。$B$B<守备官的双眼放出自豪的光芒。>$B$B绝大部分的战歌兽人都被我们的战士俘获了，包括他们的头领——乌鲁克·破敌。$B$B我把接受他投降的殊荣留给你了。他们正在里面等着你呢，指挥官。
text.completion: Commander $n.$B$B$B$BTerms of surrender? Hmm... let me think.
text.giverWindow: 谈妥投降条件，并把他带回伊瑞尔的哨所。

english.title: Terms of Surrender
english.objectives: Address Uruk Foecleaver at Lok-rath.
english.description: Believe it or not, I have good news: we've already taken Lok-rath.$B$B<The vindicator beams with pride.>$B$BOur soldiers have captured most of the Warsong, including their leader, Uruk Foecleaver.$B$BI saved the honor of accepting his surrender for you. They're waiting for you inside, commander.
english.completion: Командир $n.$B$B<Урук Гроза Врагов смотрит на вас и усмехается.>$B$BУсловия капитуляции? Хм... дай-ка подумать...
english.giverWindow: Secure terms of surrender and escort him back to Yrel's Watch.

text.title: 洛克拉斯的傲骨
text.objectives: 杀死乌鲁克·破敌。
text.description: 你以为战歌氏族那么容易被打败？$B$B<你听到了金属摩擦绳子的声音。>$B$B我早已厌倦了你们这帮联盟不说，你们还带人入侵我们的家园？$B$B<乌鲁克·破敌的双眼紧盯着你，那声音变得更明显了。>绝不投降！战歌氏族不会向任何人屈服！
text.completion: Unfortunate, but I'm glad you made it out of that trap alive.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Yrel at Yrel's Watch.
text.giverWindow: 杀死洛克拉斯的战歌指挥官乌鲁克·破敌。

english.title: The Pride of Lok-rath
english.objectives: Kill Uruk Foecleaver.
english.description: You think the Warsong are so easily defeated?$B$B<There's a rasping sound, like rope on metal.>$B$BI'm already tired of you Alliance, and you've just invaded my homeland.$B$B<The sound becomes more pronounced as Uruk Foecleaver looks you straight in the eye.>$B$BThere will be no surrender. The Warsong bow to no one!
english.completion: Too bad it happened. Well, at least you managed to get out of this trap alive ;.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Yrel at Yrel's Watch.
english.giverWindow: Kill the Warsong Commander of Lok-rath.

text.title: 攻占洛克拉斯
text.objectives: 到塔拉岗哨与游侠达坎谈一谈。
text.description: 他们的领袖一死，剩下的战歌兽人就容易对付了。$B$B等解决了这里，我就会带部队离开洛克拉斯，向格罗玛什尔进军。$B$B假如你顺路要去塔拉岗哨，是否介意帮我知会达坎一声？
text.completion: If you hadn't gone to Lok-rath, our forces would have been decimated.$B$BI'm sorry to hear they laid a trap for you. I guess you have a reputation now.

english.title: Lok-rath is Secured
english.objectives: Speak with Rangari D'kaan at Telaari Station.
english.description: With their leader dead, the remaining Warsong will be easier to finish.$B$BAs soon as that's done, I'll pull our soldiers out of Lok-rath and head for Grommashar.$B$BIf you're heading back to Telaari Station, would you please inform D'kaan?
english.completion: If you had not gone; to the Loc'rat, our warriors would have suffered a sad fate. I am sorry to hear there was a trap waiting for you. I think you've won; a worthy reputation.

text.title: 我们需要一座岗哨
text.objectives: 使用绘图桌在伐木场和格斗竞技场之间作出选择。
text.description: 指挥官，我们已经收集到了足够的材料来建造岗哨，好帮助我们实现战胜钢铁部落的使命。$b$b接下来该怎么进行呢？$b$b伐木场可以在南边茂密的林地间收集木料，但我们得对抗守卫林地的植物怪。$b$b另一方面，对战竞技场则可以帮助我们打造出一支勇猛善战的大军，用来攻入北边的玛戈隆荒原。$b$b等你准备好，就在桌上作出选择吧。
text.completion: Well, that is one thing ta pick. Tell you what, you get this building up and running at full steam and I'll see if I can't adapt these blueprints to work for the space in your garrison.

english.title: We Need An Outpost
english.objectives: Use the Drafting Table to craft a Lumber Yard or a Sparring Arena.
english.description: Commander, we've gathered enough materials to build an outpost that will support our mission against the Iron Horde.$b$bHow shall we proceed?$b$bA lumber yard would be valuable for gathering resources in the dense overgrowth to the south, and in confronting the plant monstrosities that defend it.$b$bOn the other hand, a sparring arena would provide us the brutish forces we'd need to push through the magnaron wastelands to the north.$b$bWhen you're ready, make your choice on the table.
english.completion: Well, that is one thing ta pick. Tell you what, you get this building up and running at full steam and I'll see if I can't adapt these blueprints to work for the space in your garrison.

text.title: 收割者来了
text.objectives: 消灭收割者奥姆鲁。
text.description: 阻挡原祖荆兽就是这个下场。而原祖荆兽所到之处，必有木精紧紧相随。$b$b我看见一个木精闯进了我们在营地北边的藏身洞穴。$b$b它正在指挥魔荚人收集我们死去同胞的尸体，我们必须加以阻止。$b$b我要留下照料伤者，还要为我们准备路上用的补给品。$b$b如果你真想成为英雄的话，就到洞穴里去消灭这个木精吧。
text.completion: I dread to think what the botani had intended to do with the corpses of our fallen.
text.giverWindow: 它是原祖荆兽艾韵的武器。

english.title: A Harvester Has Come
english.objectives: Slay Harvester Ommru.
english.description: This is what happens when one stands in the path of a genesaur. And where a genesaur walks, the botani follow.$b$bI saw one entering our shelter cave along the northern side of the camp.$b$bIt is commanding the podlings to gather the corpses of our fallen brethren and must be stopped.$b$bI must tend to our wounded, and gather supplies for our departure.$b$bIf you are serious about being a hero, venture into the cave and slay this botani.
english.completion: I dread to think what the botani had intended to do with the corpses of our fallen.
english.giverWindow: He is a weapon of the genesaur, Iyu.

text.title: 熔火鱿鱼
text.objectives: 马克金要你去霜火岭获取10份熔火鱿鱼卵。
text.description: 我们必须增加要塞鱼塘中的本地鱼储备。我需要你去霜火岭的水域中寻找能够支持储备的鱼苗。一旦你把鱼给钓上来，就剖开他们的肚子寻找里面的鱼籽。
text.progress: Anything biting?
text.completion: These will do nicely, $n! Thank you!
text.completed: Return to Mak'jin at your Garrison.

english.title: Fire Ammonite
english.objectives: Mak'jin wants you to collect 10 Fire Ammonite Eggs from Frostfire Ridge.
english.description: We need to stock the garrison pond with local fish.  I need you to search the waters in Frostfire Ridge for fish that we can stock up with.  Once you have the fish, you will need to slice them up and look for eggs inside.
english.progress: Anything biting?
english.completion: These will do nicely, $n! Thank you!
english.completed: Return to Mak'jin at your Garrison.

text.title: 摧毁战争机器
text.objectives: 摧毁$1oa辆钢铁部落战争机器。
text.description: 钢铁部落通过铁拳港的港口为洛克拉斯提供了战争机器。不消多时，这些战争机器便会夷平伊瑞尔的哨所。$B$B必须有人去破坏它们！
text.completion: Thank you, commander. I thought we were done for sure.
text.completed: Speak with Captain "Victorious" Chong at Yrel's Watch.

english.title: Silence the War Machines
english.objectives: Destroy the $1oa Iron Horde War Machines.
english.description: The Iron Horde supplied Lok-rath with war machines from Ironfist Harbor. It won't take long for them to level Yrel's Watch.$B$BSomeone has to silence those war machines!
english.completion: Спасибо, командор. Я уж думал, что нам конец.
english.completed: Speak with Captain "Victorious" Chong at Yrel's Watch.

text.title: 他们要是不投降……
text.objectives: 在洛克拉斯消灭$1oa个敌人。
text.description: 这支部队将是我们开往格罗玛什尔对付加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮的中坚部队，可不能在这里和他们耗。$B$B假如他们不肯投降，那我们别无选择，只能灭了战歌氏族。
text.completion: Regrettable, but I understand the pride of the Warsong. I would never surrender.
text.completed: Speak with Captain "Victorious" Chong at Yrel's Watch.

english.title: If They Won't Surrender...
english.objectives: Kill $1oa enemy forces at Lok-rath.
english.description: This is the backbone of the army we intend to send against Garrosh Hellscream and Grommashar.$B$BIf they won't surrender, we have no choice but to eliminate the Warsong.
english.completion: It’s a pity that it happened, but I understand perfectly the orcs of the War Song clan. I would not give up in their place either.
english.completed: Speak with Captain "Victorious" Chong at Yrel's Watch.

text.title: 纳格兰魔王
text.objectives: 从沙戈尔身上获得沙戈尔的项圈。
text.description: <一名阵亡战士的尸体倒在这里。血迹一路延伸到北面的洞穴入口处。>$B$B<从洞中的嚎叫声和周围的惨状来分析，里面肯定有无比可怕的怪物。>
text.progress: Commander. How may I help you?
text.completion: That's the beast's collar? I heard its howls all the way over here!
text.completed: Speak with Captain "Victorious" Chong at Yrel's Watch.
text.giverWindow: 获得沙戈尔的项圈。别让阵亡的将士们白死。

english.title: Terror of Nagrand
english.objectives: Collect Shagor's Collar from Shagor.
english.description: <The body of a fallen soldier lies here. Blood and gore trail back from the corpse to the entrance of the cave just to the north.>$B$B<Judging by the howls and the carnage surrounding the den, something truly terrifying must be in there.>
english.progress: Commander. How may I help you?
english.completion: Это ошейник той самой твари? Ее вой слышно было даже здесь!
english.completed: Speak with Captain "Victorious" Chong at Yrel's Watch.
english.giverWindow: Get Shagor's Collar. Don't let the fallen soldier's death have been in vain.

text.title: 关掉它们
text.objectives: 关闭艾洛多尔挖掘场中的失控的共鸣水晶。
text.description: 有一帮叫做“鬣蜥人”的当地生物一直在我们的水晶矿洞里到处挖掘隧道。从我们在门口观察到的情形来看，很可能是我自己的实验性共鸣水晶刺激了这些当地的野生生物。$B$B进入北边的艾洛多尔挖掘场，关闭里面失控的共鸣水晶！$B$B当心——我的塑土者们报告说矿洞里蛰伏着不少鬣蜥人。
text.completion: Excellent. I will send in some peacekeepers to quell any remaining problems.$b$bExarch Naielle may be right - perhaps I am too aggressive in adapting our technology to this world. Still, I will never quit. Our civilization must move forward!
text.completed: Return to Exarch Hataaru Outside the Elodor Dig in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Shut 'er Down
english.objectives: Disable the Malfunctioning Resonance Crystal in the Elodor Dig.
english.description: Burrowing native creatures known as "goren" have tunneled into our crystal mines. Judging from our experience at the gates, I suspect my own experimental resonance crystal is whipping the native wildlife into a frenzy.$b$bEnter the Elodor Dig to the north and disable the malfunctioning resonance crystal!$b$bBe careful - my earthworkers report that the mine is crawling with those beasts.
english.completion: Excellent. I will send in some peacekeepers to quell any remaining problems.$b$bExarch Naielle may be right - perhaps I am too aggressive in adapting our technology to this world. Still, I will never quit. Our civilization must move forward!
english.completed: Return to Exarch Hataaru Outside the Elodor Dig in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 无颚潜鱼
text.objectives: 马克金要你去戈尔隆德获取10份无颚潜鱼鱼卵。
text.description: 我们必须增加要塞鱼塘中的本地鱼储备。我需要你去戈尔隆德的水域中寻找能够支持储备的鱼苗。一旦你把鱼给钓上来，就剖开他们的肚子寻找里面的鱼籽。
text.progress: Anything biting?
text.completion: These will do nicely, $n! Thank you!

english.objectives: Mak'jin wants you to collect 10 Jawless Skulker Eggs from Gorgrond.
english.description: We need to stock the garrison pond with local fish.  I need you to search the waters in Gorgrond for fish that we can stock up with.  Once you have the fish, you will need to slice them up and look for eggs inside.

text.title: 消灭真菌
text.objectives: 使用QR58烈焰喷射者摧毁20个孢子脓疱。
text.description: 你看见那些真菌在水里的生长速度了吗？它简直长得比安戈洛环形山的幼年暴掠龙还要快，如果我们不加以控制的话，零件工厂就会像我们之前的村庄那样惨遭毁灭了。$b$b克里希叔叔总是告诫说，一定要烧掉那些红色真菌，它们似乎是蔓延的罪魁祸首。$b$b你能不能帮我们点一把火，清理掉一些那样的孢子？
text.completion: Hey good job out there! I couldn't have done it any better myself.

english.title: Defungination
english.objectives: Use the QR58 Flame Blaster to destroy 20 Spore Pustules.
english.description: Have you seen the fungus out there in the water? It's growing faster than a baby ravasaur from Un'goro, and if we don't get it under control, the Gearworks is gonna be ruined like our last village.$b$bUncle Krixel used to tell me to burn away the red fungus because that's what makes it grow so fast.$b$bYou could help us out by taking a flame blaster and clearing out some of those spores down in the shallows.
english.completion: Hey good job out there! I couldn't have done it any better myself.

text.title: 杀菌炮台
text.objectives: 启动6台杀菌炮台。
text.description: 我们遇到突发事件了！$b$b一群孢子漂流者入侵了这片海滩，还破坏了我们的杀菌炮台。$b$b我们眼下真是手足无措了！要是不能尽快让炮台恢复工作的话，那些孢子就会径直飘进镇子里，然后宾奇维斯拓殖点的悲剧又要重演了！$b$b我们得到那去手动开启它们。$b$b怎么样？你愿意帮忙吗？
text.completion: Hey you got the dispensers going again.$b$bNice job $Gpal:babe;!

english.title: Spore-be-Gone
english.objectives: Activate 6 Spore-be-Gone Turrets.
english.description: We got an emergency!$b$bA bunch of spore drifters have infested the shore and tore up our Spore-B-Gone turrets.$b$bWe're caught with our armor off here! If we don't get those turrets back online then those spores are going to float right in to town and then we'll have another Pinchwhistle Point on our hands!$b$bWe need to get out there and manually activate them.$b$bWell? Are you in?
english.completion: Hey you got the dispensers going again.$b$bNice job $Gpal:babe;!

text.title: 矿脉号
text.objectives: 去矿脉号残骸找基姆兹·宾奇维斯。
text.description: 嘿，我们这遇到麻烦了！我们的飞艇“矿脉号”撞上了南边的山脉。$b$b它原本只是去执行观察任务的，究竟出了什么事？$b$b我们得快点赶过去瞧瞧，而且我需要你的帮助。$b$b你愿意跟我走吗？
text.completion: Oh my gosh, this is way worse than I thought it was gonna be. I'm really going to need a hand with getting these survivors out of here.$b$bGood thing I have you on the payroll.

english.title: The Mother Lode
english.objectives: Meet up with Kimzee Pinchwhistle at the Wreck of the Mother Lode.
english.description: Hey we got ourselves a crisis here! Our zeppelin "The Mother Lode" crashed onto the south mountain range.$b$bIt was supposed to only be on an observation mission, what could have happened?$b$bWe got to get down there quick and I'm going to need your help on this.$b$bAre you with me?
english.completion: Oh my gosh, this is way worse than I thought it was gonna be. I'm really going to need a hand with getting these survivors out of here.$b$bGood thing I have you on the payroll.

objectiveDetails.description: 与基姆兹·宾奇维斯见面

text.title: 清理之前需要先清场
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个赤翼巨蜂。
text.description: 情况是这样的。$B$B我们得尽快开始回收工作，可这艘船却不偏不倚地捅了黄蜂巢。$B$B但现在这些恼人的虫子到处都是，我没法让我的人展开工作。$B$B快去扑杀那些黄蜂，越多越好，我会给你分成的。
text.completion: That's how ye do it! As soon as my crew gets here we can start work.$b$bHere's your pay. Thanks for doing the job.

english.title: Clearing Out Before Cleaning Up
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Crimsonwing Wasps.
english.description: Here's the situation.$b$bWe need to get this salvage operation moving ASAP, but the ship went down right in the middle of the wasp nests.$b$bThe ugly bugs are all over the place, and I can't call my team in here to start work until they're taken care of.$b$bGo kill as many of 'em as you can and I'll cut you in on some of the haul.
english.completion: That's how ye do it! As soon as my crew gets here we can start work.$b$bHere's your pay. Thanks for doing the job.

text.title: 拯救船员
text.objectives: 救助6名受伤的船员。
text.description: 噢天哪，山坡上到处都是残骸碎片。如果不尽快采取行动，那些幸存者也要撑不住了。他们需要治疗！$B$B快，用我的绷带去给他们包扎伤口。
text.completion: Good work, $n.$b$bOnce Gazwitz gets his team up here we can get the crewmen back to the Gearworks.

english.title: Getting the Crew Back Together
english.objectives: Revive 6 Injured Crewmen.
english.description: Oh wow, the debris is all over the mountainside! The survivors won't make it if we don't do something quick. They need healing NOW!$b$bHere, take my bandages and go patch them up.
english.completion: Good work, $n.$b$bOnce Gazwitz gets his team up here we can get the crewmen back to the Gearworks.

text.title: 破坏仪式
text.objectives: 摧毁仪式图腾。
text.description: 战歌氏族不再致力于与元素合为一体，反而滥用自己的力量，引导虚空的黑暗之力。$b$b我决不能再让这些仪式继续下去。找到战歌兽人用来引导虚空力量的仪式图腾，并将其摧毁。$b$b那些兽人不该恣意亵渎和玩弄元素的慷慨馈赠。
text.completion: Dark shamanism is a dangerous practice, $n.$b$bIt is true that the void can be a source of terrible power, but it is the kind of power that comes at a price.$b$bThese woods are safer now that you have put an end to the rituals.

text.completion: The gift of shamanism is not one to be taken lightly. When the gift is abused, the elements will rise up in indignation and smite the shaman.

text.objectives: 使用虚空道标，前往扭曲虚空。
text.description: 仪式已被破坏，可虚空道标仍然闪烁着能量光芒……$b$b唯一的解释就是——道标的力量来自扭曲虚空内部！$b$b必须截断与虚空的联系！要想做到这一点只有一个办法，你必须消灭那些正在维系与我们世界的连结的虚空生物。$b$b将你的双手放在道标上，然后前往扭曲虚空。等你抵达另一侧后，找到一块萨满之石并用它来与我取得联系。
text.completion: The Shamanstone appears to be working, even from within the Twisting Nether.$b$bThere is much that needs to be done, $n. The monsters of the void are gathering upon Oshu'gun and must be stopped, else they invade our realm.

english.description: The rituals have been disrupted, yet the nether beacons still glow with power....$b$bThis can only mean that the beacons are powered from within the Twisting Nether itself!$b$bThe connection to the void must be severed! There is but one way to accomplish this; you must slay the void creature that maintains the connection with our world.$b$bLay your hands upon a beacon and travel into the Twisting Nether. When you have arrived on the other side, locate a Shamanstone and use it to contact me.

text.title: 虚空的大军
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa只虚空恐魔和$2oa根虚空触须。
text.description: 虚空中的可憎怪物们正躲在扭曲虚空的纱幕背后，向沃舒古大举进犯。在高山深处滋长的伟大虚空之力将它们犹如飞蛾扑火般地吸引而来。$b$b这些怪物们一波又一波地从虚空涌到这座山上，将自己献祭给伊瓦里杜斯。决不能任由虚空领主伊瓦里杜斯大肆享用其它虚空生物，否则它的力量就会变得太过强大而无法被阻止了。
text.completion: The void lord must be stopped. Thanks to your effort, the tide of void creatures has waned... but if we are to defeat Invalidus we must act swiftly.

english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Void Terrors and $2oa Void Tendrils.
english.description: Hidden behind the veil of the Twisting Nether, the abominations of the void march upon Oshu'gun. The great void growing deep within the mountain has drawn them like moths to a flame.$b$bWave upon wave, the creatures of the void march upon the mountain and sacrifice themselves to Invalidus. The void lord Invalidus cannot be allowed to feast upon the other void creatures, else it will become too powerful to stop.

text.objectives: 摧毁$oa座虚空传送门。
text.description: 通过与扭曲虚空建立联系，战歌萨满的行动酿成了他们未曾预料到的严重后果。$B$B看看你的四周，你会看到有无数传送门正要打开，这表明扭曲虚空现在反过来想要连接德拉诺。$B$B一旦这些传送门成功开启，各种各样的恶魔和虚空怪物将会畅通无阻地席卷这片山谷。
text.completion: If those portals were to fully expand and open, the path would have been clear for the horrors of the Twisting Nether to march upon Nagrand.$b$bThe Warsong have been careless in their mad pursuit of power and glory.

english.description: By connecting with the Twisting Nether, the Warsong shaman have created a ripple effect that they could not have anticipated.$b$bLook around and you will see countless portals beginning to open, signs that the Twisting Nether seeks to connect to Draenor.$b$bShould these portals successfully open, the path will be clear for all manner of demons and void creatures to rampage across this valley.
english.completion: If those portals were to fully expand and open, the path would have been clear for the horrors of the Twisting Nether to march upon Nagrand.$b$bThe Warsong have been careless in their mad pursuit of power and glory.

text.objectives: 召唤并击败伊瓦里杜斯。
text.description: 除掉虚空领主的时机到了。伊瓦里杜斯每分钟都在变得更加强大，所以如果你想要击败那怪物的话，就必须抓紧时间了。$b$b在每一处战歌仪式场所，都有一块虚空水晶，这些水晶是用来从扭曲虚空里传输能量的。$b$b去破坏这些水晶，伊瓦里杜斯就会感受到你的存在。$b$b做好战斗的准备，只要水晶一被破坏，伊瓦里杜斯就会立即前来消灭你。
text.completion: With Invalidus destroyed and the Warsong rituals halted, the threat of the Twisting Nether has subsided.

english.objectives: Summon and defeat Invalidus.
english.description: The moment has come to take on the void lord. Invalidus grows more powerful by the minute, so you must move with haste if you are to defeat the monster.$b$bAt each of the Warsong ritual locations there is a void crystal; these crystals are used to channel the energy of the void from within the Twisting Nether.$b$bDisturb the crystal, and Invalidus will sense your presence below.$b$bBe ready, as soon as the crystal is disturbed, Invalidus will waste no time hunting you down.
