text.title: 捞油水
text.objectives: 收集$1oa份易燃油膏。
text.description: 那架飞行器是我们离开这里的唯一途径，可燃料箱里却连一滴油都不剩了！$b$b油田就在我们边上，可那里到处都是被感染者，我们也没时间从这里铺设输油管，必须想个折中的办法才行。$b$b在油泵附近的油污怪身上充满了烈性混合物，我可以直接把它们身上的油灌进油箱里。去帮我找些油来，然后我们就快能离开这里了。
text.progress: Do ya have that oil for me yet?
text.completion: Yea that's the stuff!$b$bNow I just need to connect the spark plugs and patch up a few holes and it'll be nearly in working order!

english.title: Skimming Off the Top
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Volatile Oil.
english.description: That flying machine is our ticket out of here but its fuel tank is bone dry!$b$bWe're right next to the oil fields but with the infected out there we don't have time to run a line up here so we need to improvise.$b$bThe oil creatures moving next to the pumps out there are full of a highly potent mixture that I can drop right into the tank. Grab some of that oil for me and we'll be one step closer to getting out of here.
english.progress: Ну, есть у тебя смесь-то?
english.completion: Yea that's the stuff!$b$bNow I just need to connect the spark plugs and patch up a few holes and it'll be nearly in working order!

text.title: 合适的零件
text.objectives: 在损坏的伐木机附近使用G-14爆裂火箭，取得耐用齿轮。
text.description: 克里希叔叔是个硬汉，但是再硬的汉子拖着一条断腿也哪都去不了。$b$b他从艾泽拉斯带来了一架飞行器，可以把我们送出去。现在的问题是，引擎坏了。$b$b我需要用到一些零件来修好它。我的车都报废了，可镇子外面那些损坏的伐木机应该能够提供我们需要的零件。没时间去用手拆卸它们了，带上这台火箭发射器，把它们全都炸开。只有足够结实的零件才能经受得住这通爆炸，正好能拿来修理引擎。
text.progress: Got any parts for me?
text.completion: Great work $n!$b$bGive me some time and I'll have this thing ready to roll out!

english.title: The Right Parts for the Job
english.objectives: Use the G-14 Buster Rocket near Broken Shredders to retrieve Serviceable Gears.
english.description: Uncle Krixel's a tough one but he won't be going anywhere on foot with his leg broken.$b$bHe has a flying machine he brought from Azeroth that can fly us out of here. Problem is, the engine's busted.$b$bI'll need some parts to fix the thing. My car's wasted but those broken shredders just outside of town should have what we need. We don't have time to break them down by hand so just use this rocket launcher and blow 'em apart. Anything that survives the blast should be strong enough to use on the engine.
english.progress: Ну, что там с запчастями?
english.completion: Great work $n!$b$bGive me some time and I'll have this thing ready to roll out!

text.title: 孢子杀手
text.objectives: 在宾奇维斯拓殖点消灭$1oa个孢子蹒跚者。
text.description: 真讨厌，恶心至极，简直看了就生气！$b$b我是在说行走在宾奇维斯拓殖点附近的那些孢子怪。$b$b我要留在这处理这台机器，你能不能去干掉一些孢子生物？要是能少点那种怪物在附近游来荡去，我会好过些。
text.completion: Thank you, $n.$b$bThe less of those spore beasts around the safer we all are.

english.title: Sporicide
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Spore Shamblers in Pinchwhistle Point.
english.description: It's revolting, absolutely disgusting, infuriating even!$b$bI'm talking about seeing those spore creatures walking around Pinchwhistle Point.$b$bWhile I'm working on the machine here how about you go out and kill off some of those spore creatures? I'll feel a bit better knowing there are less of those things moving around.
english.completion: Thank you, $n.$b$bThe less of those spore beasts around the safer we all are.

text.title: The Portal's Power
text.objectives: Speak with Gul'dan underneath the Dark Portal.
text.description: The mana bombs were not enough. This was always a risk.$b$bThis is unfortunate.$b$bGul'dan, the orc beneath these grates, says he can shut down this portal. Find a way in there, and do whatever it takes to slow this portal down.$b$b<The archmage's eyes lock with yours.>$b$bWHATEVER IT TAKES.

english.title: The Portal's Power
english.objectives: Speak with Gul'dan underneath the Dark Portal.
english.description: The mana bombs were not enough. This was always a risk.$b$bThis is unfortunate.$b$bGul'dan, the orc beneath these grates, says he can shut down this portal. Find a way in there, and do whatever it takes to slow this portal down.$b$b<The archmage's eyes lock with yours.>$b$bWHATEVER IT TAKES.

text.title: 月之阴暗面
text.objectives: 找到耐奥祖。
text.description: 伊瑞尔和我已经查明了督军耐奥祖的下落。他正在那座俯瞰痛楚堡垒的最高的祭坛上与格罗玛什·地狱咆哮会面。$B$B和我们在那边碰头吧。我们必须阻止他。
text.completion: We saved everyone we could, $n. We were too late for the others... including my sister.$B$BProphet Velen is right. When it is asked of us, we ALL must fight. I promise this: I will never again let my loved ones suffer.$B$BNer'zhul is close to calling down the Dark Star. We are the only ones who can stop him.
text.completed: Return to Yrel at Embaari Village.

english.title: The Dark Side of the Moon
english.objectives: Find Ner'zhul.
english.description: Yrel and I have located Warlord Ner'zhul. He is meeting with Grommash Hellscream atop the highest altar overlooking Anguish Fortress.$B$BMeet us there. We must stop him.
english.completion: We saved everyone we could, $n. We were too late for the others... including my sister.$B$BProphet Velen is right. When it is asked of us, we ALL must fight. I promise this: I will never again let my loved ones suffer.$B$BNer'zhul is close to calling down the Dark Star. We are the only ones who can stop him.
english.completed: Return to Yrel at Embaari Village.

objectiveDetails.description: 在众星平台上找到维伦和伊瑞尔

text.title: A Deal with Darkness
text.objectives: Report back to Archmage Khadgar atop the Dark Portal.
text.description: <With Gul'dan gone, the Dark Portal is disabled, and the threat to Azeroth is suspended.>

english.title: A Deal with Darkness
english.objectives: Report back to Archmage Khadgar atop the Dark Portal.
english.description: <With Gul'dan gone, the Dark Portal is disabled, and the threat to Azeroth is suspended.>

text.title: 河畔会面
text.objectives: 去河畔岗哨和杜隆坦谈一谈。
text.description: 杜隆坦已经把我们大部分军队带去了西面。他在天歌湖边建立了前哨基地。$B$B把我们可以随时移师格罗玛什尔的情况汇报给他。$B$B我想他也会很高兴你能去帮他对付洛克拉斯的战歌兽人的。
text.completion: It's good to see you, commander. When I'd heard about your garrison caravan being destroyed....$B$BWell, let's just say that I feared the worst.$B$BWhat word from Wor'var?

english.title: Along the Riverside
english.objectives: Speak with Durotan at Riverside Post.
english.description: Durotan has taken most of our forces west. He's establishing a forward base along the Skysong River.$B$BHe'll want to know that we're almost ready to move against Grommashar.$B$BI'm sure he'll also appreciate your help dealing with the Warsong orcs at Lok-rath.
english.completion: It's good to see you, commander. When I'd heard about your garrison caravan being destroyed....$B$BWell, let's just say that I feared the worst.$B$BWhat word from Wor'var?

text.title: 投降条件
text.objectives: 去洛克拉斯找乌鲁克·破敌。
text.description: 我有个好消息：我们已经拿下了洛克拉斯。$B$B<大酋长笑了起来。>$B$B大部分战歌兽人都被部落的战士们俘获了，包括他们的头领——乌鲁克·破敌。$B$B我把接受他投降的殊荣留给你了。他们正在里面等着你呢，指挥官。
text.completion: Commander $n.$B$B<Uruk Foecleaver looks at you and grins.>$B$BTerms of surrender? Hmm... let me think.
text.giverWindow: 谈妥投降条件，并把他带回河畔岗哨。

english.title: Terms of Surrender
english.objectives: Address Uruk Foecleaver at Lok-rath.
english.description: I have good news, commander: we've already taken Lok-rath.$B$B<The warchief grins.>$B$BThe Horde's soldiers have captured most of the Warsong, including their leader, Uruk Foecleaver.$B$BI saved the honor of accepting his surrender for you. They're waiting for you inside, commander.
english.completion: Commander $n.$B$B<Uruk Foecleaver looks at you and grins.>$B$BTerms of surrender? Hmm... let me think.
english.giverWindow: Secure terms of surrender and escort him back to Riverside Post.

text.title: 洛克拉斯的傲骨
text.objectives: 杀死乌鲁克·破敌。
text.description: 你以为战歌氏族那么容易被打败？$B$B<你听到了金属摩擦绳子的声音。>$B$B我早已厌倦了你们这帮部落不说，你们还带人入侵我们的家园？$B$B<乌鲁克·破敌的双眼紧盯着你，那声音变得更明显了。>绝不投降！战歌氏族不会向任何人屈服！
text.completion: Unfortunate, but you made it out of the trap alive and Lok-rath is dealt with.
text.completed: Return to Durotan at Riverside Post.
text.giverWindow: 杀死洛克拉斯的战歌指挥官乌鲁克·破敌。

english.title: The Pride of Lok-rath
english.objectives: Kill Uruk Foecleaver.
english.description: You think the Warsong are so easily defeated?$B$B<There's a rasping sound, like rope on metal.>$B$BI'm already tired of you Horde, and you've just invaded my homeland.$B$B<The sound becomes more pronounced as Uruk Foecleaver looks you straight in the eye.>$B$BThere will be no surrender. The Warsong bow to no one!
english.completion: Unfortunate, but you made it out of the trap alive and Lok-rath is dealt with.
english.completed: Return to Durotan at Riverside Post.
english.giverWindow: Kill the Warsong Commander of Lok-rath.

text.title: 攻占洛克拉斯
text.objectives: 在沃尔瓦与萨尔谈一谈。
text.description: 他们的领袖一死，剩下的战歌兽人就容易对付了。$B$B等解决了这里，我就会带部队离开洛克拉斯，向格罗玛什尔进军。$B$B假如你要回沃尔瓦，记得告诉萨尔我们就快准备好了。
text.completion: If you hadn't gone to Lok-rath, our forces would have been decimated.$B$BI'm sorry to hear they laid a trap you. You have a reputation now.

english.title: Lok-rath is Secured
english.objectives: Speak with Thrall at Wor'var.
english.description: With their leader dead, the remaining Warsong will be easy pickings.$B$BAs soon as that's done, I'll pull our soldiers out of Lok-rath and head for Grommashar.$B$BIf you're heading back to Wor'var, inform Thrall that we'll be ready soon.
english.completion: If you hadn't gone to Lok-rath, our forces would have been decimated.$B$BI'm sorry to hear they laid a trap you. You have a reputation now.

text.title: 摧毁战争机器
text.objectives: 摧毁$1oa辆钢铁部落战争机器。
text.description: 钢铁部落通过铁拳港的港口为洛克拉斯提供了战争机器。不消多时，这些战争机器便会夷平河畔岗哨。$B$B必须有人去破坏它们！
text.completion: Thank you, commander. I thought we were done for sure.
text.completed: Speak with Blood Guard Ehanes at Riverside Post.

english.title: Silence the War Machines
english.objectives: Destroy the $1oa Iron Horde War Machines.
english.description: The Iron Horde supplied Lok-rath with war machines from Ironfist Harbor. It won't take long for them to level Riverside Post.$B$BSomeone has to silence those war machines!
english.completion: Thank you, commander. I thought we were done for sure.
english.completed: Speak with Blood Guard Ehanes at Riverside Post.

text.title: 他们要是不投降……
text.objectives: 在洛克拉斯消灭$1oa个敌人。
text.description: 这支部队将是我们开往格罗玛什尔对付加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮的中坚部队，可不能在这里和他们耗。$B$B假如他们不肯投降，那我们别无选择，只能灭了战歌氏族。
text.completion: Regrettable, but I understand the pride of the Warsong. I would never surrender.
text.completed: Speak with Blood Guard Ehanes at Riverside Post.

english.title: If They Won't Surrender...
english.objectives: Kill $1oa enemy forces at Lok-rath.
english.description: This is the backbone of the army we intend to send against Garrosh Hellscream and Grommashar.$B$BIf they won't surrender, we have no choice but to eliminate the Warsong.
english.completion: Regrettable, but I understand the pride of the Warsong. I would never surrender.
english.completed: Speak with Blood Guard Ehanes at Riverside Post.

text.title: 纳格兰魔王
text.objectives: 从沙戈尔身上获得沙戈尔的项圈。
text.description: <一名阵亡的战士倒在这里。血迹一路延伸到北面的洞穴处。>$B$B<从洞中的嚎叫声和周围的惨状来分析，那洞里定是有什么怪物。>
text.progress: Commander. How may I help you?
text.completion: That's the beast's collar? I heard its howls all the way over here!
text.completed: Speak with Blood Guard Ehanes at Riverside Post.
text.giverWindow: 获得沙戈尔的项圈。别让阵亡的将士们白死。

english.title: Terror of Nagrand
english.objectives: Collect Shagor's Collar from Shagor.
english.description: <The body of a fallen soldier lies here. Blood and gore trail back from the corpse to the entrance of the cave just to the north.>$B$B<Judging by the howls and the carnage surrounding the den, something truly terrifying must be in there.>
english.progress: Commander. How may I help you?
english.completion: That's the beast's collar? I heard its howls all the way over here!
english.completed: Speak with Blood Guard Ehanes at Riverside Post.
english.giverWindow: Get Shagor's Collar. Don't let the fallen soldier's death have been in vain.

text.title: 亮剑
text.objectives: 在塔拉多的沃金之傲里与莫克斯·剑吼交谈。
text.description: 谢谢你……头儿。$B$B我不会让你失望的！我甚至都没有偷拿你的某个苦工丢在我牢房外边的那把破烂剑。顺便一提，这真不是个好主意，在你把其他不那么看重名誉的人关进去之前最好把那玩意儿弄走。$B$B闲话就说到这儿，让我们瞧瞧这地方！
text.completion: We have a lot of basic arms here but I'll get them improved in no time.$B$BThanks for giving me this chance.

english.title: Unleashed Steel
english.objectives: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl inside of Vol'jin's Pride in Talador.
english.description: Thank you... boss.$b$bI won't let you down! I didn't even try to sneak one of those low quality blades here that one of your peons placed right next to the cage. Which by the way was a pretty terrible idea and that thing should be moved before you get anyone less honorable in here.$b$bEnough talk, lets check this place out!
english.completion: We have a lot of basic arms here but I'll get them improved in no time.$b$bThanks for giving me this chance.

objectiveDetails.description: 跟随莫克斯前往军械库

text.title: 炼金师
text.objectives: 去骨渣锻炉找卡达。
text.description: 我那点微末的炼金术都是跟我表姐卡达学的，她是岩牙岗哨的炼金师。如果你真想学德拉诺炼金术，那她才是你要找的人。$B$B那岗哨最近遭了攻击，希望她没事。
text.completion: My apprentice... Inside... (She dies in your arms.)
text.completed: 找到卡达。

english.title: The Alchemist
english.objectives: Find Kadar at the Boneslag.
english.description: I know a little about alchemy from my cousin Kadar. She is the alchemist at Stonefang Outpost. If you wish to learn more, she is the one with whom to speak.$b$bI only hope she has survived the attack.
english.completion: My apprentice... Inside... (She dies in your arms.)
english.completed: Find Kadar.

text.title: 学徒
text.objectives: 移除碎石，然后与安戈卡谈一谈。
text.description: 卡达的遗言……屋子里还有其他人吗？
text.completion: What... happened? Where is my master?

english.title: The Apprentice
english.objectives: Remove the rubble and speak with Ang'kra.
english.description: Kadar's last words... Is there someone still inside the hut?
english.completion: What... happened? Where is my master?

text.title: 复仇和夺回
text.objectives: 杀死谋害卡达的凶手，并取回卡达的书。
text.description: 我发誓要为老师报仇，并夺回她毕生的心血之作。这不仅仅是为了荣耀，也为了我的心。就算是死我也要让凶手付出代价。
text.progress: The murderer will pay.
text.completion: My heart is furious with you for stealing my kill, but my mind knows that I did not have the strength to avenge my master myself. I will forgive you, if you allow me to pay my debt of honor.
text.completed: Return to Ang'kra.

english.title: Avenge and Reclaim
english.objectives: Slay Kadar's killer and retrieve the book.
english.description: I will avenge my master and retrieve her life's work. Honor demands it. My heart yearns for it. If I die trying, so be it. The murderer will pay.
english.progress: The murderer will pay.
english.completion: My heart is furious with you for stealing my kill, but my mind knows that I did not have the strength to avenge my master myself. I will forgive you, if you allow me to pay my debt of honor.
english.completed: Return to Ang'kra.

text.title: 擒敌先擒王
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个独眼魔碎脊者和波罗戈。
text.description: 独眼魔跟智勇双全这个词扯不上半点关系，可他们确实要比戈隆聪明得多。独眼魔体形庞大，但跟他们的力量相比，体形根本算不上什么。$b$b波罗戈是独眼魔的领袖，是个尤其可怕的对手。我已经跟他多次交手，至今也没能消灭他。$b$b记住我说的话，朋友。在深入独眼魔巢穴时一定要多加小心。$b$b尼莎已经准备好出发了。让她送你到洞穴的入口处，我相信她一定会乐意这么做的。
text.completion: Most people cannot handle ogron in single combat.
text.completed: Speak to Rexxar outside Fissure of Fury.

english.title: Fair Warning
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Ogron Spinecrushers and Borogahn.
english.description: The ogron here are far from brilliant, but they are more intelligent than the gronn. They're large, and even stronger than they look.$b$bTheir leader, Borogahn, is especially formidable. Despite several fights, I have not yet managed to kill him.$b$bHeed my words, friend. Take caution as you explore their lair.$b$bNisha is ready to move. Ask her to take you to the mouth of the cave, and I'm sure she would be happy to.
english.completion: Не всякий справится в одиночку с огроном.
english.completed: Speak to Rexxar outside Fissure of Fury.

text.title: 孤身上路
text.objectives: 找到图卡玛下士，并获得他的情报。
text.description: 嗯。$b$b独眼魔掌握着对钢铁部落来说至关重要的东西。我相信他们还没意识到，可能只是觉得无聊，随便折腾点什么打发时间。$b$b我完全可以无视他们的所作所为，那是他们自己的命运。可我们决不能让这条线索中断。要是走运的话，它能帮我们阻止钢铁部落，以免他们将戈尔隆德最可怕的怪物变成武器。$b$b去找到这个图卡玛下士和他的笔记。我们会去跟你会合的。
text.progress: Again you've done well, friend.
text.completion: We have the notes. Let us see what they reveal about our enemy's strategy.
text.completed: Speak to Rexxar at Gronn Canyon.

english.title: Leave Every Soldier Behind
english.objectives: Find Corporal Thukmar and recover his intel.
english.description: Hmmm.$b$bThe ogron possess something of value to the Iron Horde. I'm sure they're unaware, likely just bored and in  need of something to torture.$b$bI'd be inclined to just let them be, it's a fate they deserve. But we can't afford not to follow up on this clue. With any luck, it will help us stop the Iron Horde from turning Gorgrond's most fearsome creatures into weapons.$b$bTry to find this Corporal Thukmar and his notes. We'll meet you there.
english.progress: And again you make me happy.
english.completion: Результаты его исследований у нас... Посмотрим, что в них говорится о стратегии врага.
english.completed: Speak to Rexxar at Gronn Canyon.

text.title: 钢铁锁链
text.objectives: 击败布拉克上尉，并找到玛戈隆之心。
text.description: 我们要找的神器已经在我们的控制之下了。$b$b准备迎接战斗吧。如果他们确实学会了如何控制戈隆的话，这也许会比我预想的还要困难。$b$b只要你一抵达，我就会加入战斗，与你并肩作战。
text.progress: The artifact is yours, and is well earned.
text.completion: Good work, $n. We can use this artifact against the Iron Horde when the time is right.
text.completed: Speak to Durotan at Beastwatch.

english.title: Chains of Iron
english.objectives: Defeat Captain Brak and find the Heart of the Magnaron.
english.description: The artifact we seek is within our grasp.$b$bBe prepared for a fight. If they truly have learned how to control gronn, this may be more difficult than I anticipated.$b$bI will join you in this battle as soon as you arrive.
english.progress: The artifact is yours. You deserve it.
english.completion: Отличная работа, $n. Когда придет время, мы сможем использовать этот артефакт против Железной Орды.
english.completed: Speak to Durotan at Beastwatch.

text.title: 格斗竞技场
text.objectives: 去戈尔隆德的高山走廊与游侠乔纳谈一谈。
text.description: 没有你，我们无法重获自由。我们欠你很大一份情。我和其他人讲过了，我们会一起跟你回你的要塞，教你那些所谓的“士兵”们学会怎么打架。$B$B我们也会竭尽所能，把我们的知识传授给你，指挥官。只要你在戈尔隆德有用得到我们的地方，只要喊我们一声，我们就会即刻赶到。$B$B当然，你可能会需要跟游侠乔纳通报一声我们来了的事。
text.completion: Now that we have the trainers, we can start training your forces to do something other than chop lumber. Heh heh.
text.completed: 去戈尔隆德的高山走廊与游侠乔纳谈一谈。

english.title: The Sparring Arena
english.objectives: Speak with Rangari Jonaa at Highpass in Gorgrond.
english.description: We owe you our freedom, and more. I have spoken to the others, we are willing to return with you to your garrison and teach those pitiful creatures you call "soldiers" how to properly fight.$b$bWe will also do our best to impart our knowledge to you, Commander. Should you have need of us when in the wilds of Gorgrond, simply call us.$b$bYou may wish to warn Rangari Jonaa of our coming.
english.completion: Теперь, когда у нас есть учителя, мы сможем обучить твоих солдат рубить не только дрова. Хе-хе.
english.completed: Speak with Rangari Jonaa at Highpass in Gorgrond.

text.title: 天空之眼
text.objectives: 与尼莎交谈。
text.description: 你找到的那些笔记，介绍的是一台可以制服玛戈隆的设备。$b$b在古老的传说中提到过那样的神器，那是创世者们的杰作，制造的初衷是用来制约这些怪物。我曾经将它们视作荒诞无稽的故事，但如果真实存在的话……$b$b$n，德拉诺将在劫难逃。$b$b要是敌人驾驭了这股力量，那就再也没有任何大军能够与之相对抗。我们必须阻止他们，哪怕付出生命的代价。$b$b来，我会将我们的视线附着在尼莎身上，希望她能找出这件神器的下落。
text.completion: Good. We know where we must go to acquire the artifact.
text.completed: Return to Rexxar outside Fissure of Fury.

english.title: Eye in the Sky
english.objectives: Speak to Nisha.
english.description: The notes you recovered tell of a device capable of subjugating even a magnaron.$b$bAncient legends speak of such artifacts, crafted by the worldbuilders to keep these creatures in check. I had discounted them as silly stories, but if they are true...$b$b$n, Draenor is doomed.$b$bNo army will be able to stop them if they harness this power. We must stop them or die trying.$b$bHere, I shall bind our sight to Nisha and hope she can locate this artifact.
english.completion: Хорошо. Теперь мы точно знаем, где находится артефакт.
english.completed: Return to Rexxar outside Fissure of Fury.

text.title: 塞林！
text.objectives: 抓住$1oa只小鬣蜥人。
text.description: 那个小……！$B$B<伊瑞尔尽力不让自己失态。>$B$B塞林·暗砧给我们送来了一批补给。里面本该是些机械零件之类的东西。$B$B谁知道当我们打开其中一个箱子的时候，里面竟然蹦出来一只小鬣蜥人。你知道这种家伙的破坏力有多大吗？$B$B然后它还立刻把其它的同胞都放了出来。$B$B你愿意帮我教训一下它们吗？
text.completion: Outstanding.$B$B<Vindicator Yrel beckons you closer so that the two of you can conspire.>
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Yrel at Yrel's Watch.

english.title: THAELIN!
english.objectives: Capture $1oa Baby Goren.
english.description: That little...!$B$B<Yrel tries to maintain her composure.>$B$BThaelin Darkanvil sent us a shipment. It was supposed to be engineering parts.$B$BInstead, when we just opened one of the crates, out popped a baby goren. Do you know how destructive those things are?$B$BAnd, of course, the one baby immediately set about letting all the other ones loose.$B$BWant to help me get some revenge?
english.completion: Потрясающе.$B$B<Воздаятельница Ирель подзывает вас к себе, чтобы вы могли тайно переговорить.>
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Yrel at Yrel's Watch.

text.title: 礼尚往来
text.objectives: 把小鬣蜥人装运箱送给塔拉岗哨的塞林·暗砧。
text.description: 我们要给那个讨厌鬼准备点回礼。$B$B把这些小鬣蜥人装进其中一个箱子里，然后拿去送给塞林。
text.completion: Wait a minute, $n... let's be reasonable. I can hear what's in that carrier.$B$BIt was just a harmless prank.$B$BDon't do it, please!$B$BStop!$B$BDon't open that carrier!
text.giverWindow: 把鬣蜥人当礼送。

english.title: Carrier Has Arrived
english.objectives: Deliver the Baby Goren Carrier to Thaelin Darkanvil at Telaari Station.
english.description: We're going to get some payback on that little stinker.$B$BPut the baby goren into one of those carriers and then make a special delivery to Thaelin.
english.completion: Минутку, $n... Давай не будем спешить. Я уже понял, что у тебя в переноске.$B$BЭто же была просто безобидная шутка.$B$BПожалуйста, не надо!$B$BОстановись!$B$BНе открывай!!!
english.giverWindow: Give the gift of goren.

text.title: 鬣蜥人入侵！
text.objectives: 击退鬣蜥人对你要塞的入侵。$B$B（再次与格里姆加中士交谈来开始行动）
text.description: 大地在我们脚下震颤，指挥官。我们的斥候还没回来复命。我能感觉到一场攻击迫在眉睫，可是敌人会从哪里袭来呢？
text.completion: The peons will clean this mess, Commander. Rubble and holes everywhere. The rest of us will look for hiding goren so that we may apologize to them for butchering their warleader.
text.completed: Speak with Sergeant Grimjaw in your garrison.

english.title: Goren Invasion!
english.objectives: Repel the goren invasion of your garrison.$B$B(Speak with Sergeant Grimjaw again to begin)
english.description: The earth quakes beneath us, Commander. Our scouts are not returning. I can feel an attack creeping up on us, but from where?
english.completion: The peons will clean this mess, Commander. Rubble and holes everywhere. The rest of us will look for hiding goren so that we may apologize to them for butchering their warleader.
english.completed: Speak with Sergeant Grimjaw in your garrison.

objectiveDetails.description: 与格里姆加中士谈一谈

text.title: 火刃之血
text.objectives: 在哈瓦洛消灭$1oa名火刃兽人。
text.description: 哈瓦洛是我们火刃氏族古老的家园。自从新督军一家上位以后，我就因为混血儿的身份被逐出了氏族。$B$B我要寻求公正的待遇。$B$B我想你应该不介意沿途大开杀戒吧？再说你也没有其它选择。
text.completion: A great victory over the Burning Blade!$B$BThis Flamebender Ka'graz sounds formidable. We shall have to keep an eye on her and her blademasters.
text.completed: Return to Thrall at Wor'var.

english.title: Blood of the Burning Blade
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Burning Blade forces at Hallvalor.
english.description: Hallvalor is the ancestral home of my clan, the Burning Blade. When the new warlord and his family came to power, I was exiled for being a half-breed.$B$BI want justice.$B$BI suspect you won't mind killing along the way. Not that you'll have any choice.
english.completion: A great victory over the Burning Blade!$B$BThis Flamebender Ka'graz sounds formidable. We shall have to keep an eye on her and her blademasters.
english.completed: Return to Thrall at Wor'var.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭哈瓦洛的火刃兽人

text.title: 黑暗禁锢
text.objectives: 释放$1oa个元素之灵。
text.description: 坠影峡谷的白鬼们正在奴役那里的元素，使他们屈从于自己的意志。许多元素之灵已经成为了他们的傀儡，假如我们置之不理，受奴役的元素只会不断增加。$B$B我们必须阻止白鬼，并解放那些被他们奴役的元素。$B$B前往坠影峡谷，解放那些尚未被白鬼完全奴役的元素之灵。至于那些已经完全成为了傀儡的元素，我们只能对它们展现最后的仁慈，让它们经由死亡来斩断禁锢。
text.completion: The pale have been taught by Cho'gall to enslave the elemental spirits of this land. When an elemental is enthralled in this manner, it cannot be reversed even by a Farseer such as myself.
text.completed: Return to Drek'Thar.

english.title: Dark Binding
english.objectives: Free $1oa elemental spirits.
english.description: Even as we speak, the pale within Shadowfall Canyon are enslaving the elements to their will. Many elemental spirits have already been enthralled, and more will follow.$b$bThe pale must be stopped and the elementals they enslave set free.$b$bJourney into Shadowfall Canyon and set free those elemental spirits which are not fully enthralled by the pale. As for the elementals already enslaved by the pale, the only mercy we can give them now is to release their bonds through death.
english.completion: The pale have been taught by Cho'gall to enslave the elemental spirits of this land. When an elemental is enthralled in this manner, it cannot be reversed even by a Farseer such as myself.
english.completed: Return to Drek'Thar.

text.title: 白鬼的威胁
text.objectives: 消灭格雷希尔和$2oa个白鬼兽人。
text.description: 白鬼是盘踞在地下的扭曲生物，他们一直对我们这些地上生物虎视眈眈。苍白地穴是他们的藏身处，那是沃舒古地下一个扭曲而黑暗的洞穴。$B$B假如我们想成功阻止古加尔，我们就必须从这些地下生物当中杀出一条路来。$B$B前往那座山洞，消灭盘踞在其中的邪恶生物，并除掉白鬼的领袖……格雷希尔。
text.completion: I have encountered evil in many places, $n. Even deep within my own soul, I have seen dark shadows of what could be.$b$bHowever, the evil within the hearts of the Pale defies explanation. It is dark, loathing, and miserable in a way I have never encountered.
text.completed: Return to Farseer Drek'Thar.

english.title: The Pale Threat
english.objectives: Kill Greyseer and $2oa Pale orcs.
english.description: The Pale are wretched creatures that hide beneath the ground, ever plotting against those who dwell upon the surface. They stalk the Underpale, a twisted and dark cavern beneath Oshu'gun.$b$bIf we are to succeed in stopping Cho'gall we must fight our way through their ranks beneath the earth.$b$bMake your way into the cavern, slay the vile creatures within and take out the Pale leader... the one known as Greyseer.
english.completion: I have encountered evil in many places, $n. Even deep within my own soul, I have seen dark shadows of what could be.$b$bHowever, the evil within the hearts of the Pale defies explanation. It is dark, loathing, and miserable in a way I have never encountered.
english.completed: Return to Farseer Drek'Thar.

text.title: 好博士
text.objectives: 救出哈德利·里卡德博士。
text.description: 我们探险队中的植物学家被魔荚人绑架走了！$b$b我们来纳格兰的目的是为了探险，消灭最强大的野兽，与伟大的赫米特·奈辛瓦里一起检验我们的勇气。$b$b我们刚刚抵达这里，赫米特就因为他过人的狩猎身手，被找去对抗战歌兽人了。我们不愿意坐在这里虚度光阴，于是决定继续探险！$b$b结果在探索怨叶林地时遭到了魔荚人的伏击！在乱战之中，哈德利·里卡德博士被抓走了。$b$b求你帮帮忙，我们不能把他丢下！
text.completion: Your timely arrival to rescue me from the podlings was most appreciated!$b$bThis research station has seen better days... my equipment and belongings were damaged in the ambush.$b$bHowever, with your aid, I'm sure we'll be up and running again in no time!

english.title: The Good Doctor
english.objectives: Rescue Dr. Hadley Ricard.
english.description: Our expedition biologist has been kidnapped by podlings!$b$bWe came to Nagrand to explore, to slay the mightiest of beasts, and test our mettle alongside the great Hemet Nesingwary.$b$bAs soon as we arrived, Hemet's hunting prowess was needed to combat the Warsong. Rather than sit around twiddling our thumbs, we decided to continue the expedition!$b$bWe were exploring Spiteleaf Thicket when podlings ambushed us! In the chaos, Dr. Hadley Ricard was taken captive.$b$bPlease, we can't just leave him there!
english.completion: Your timely arrival to rescue me from the podlings was most appreciated!$b$bThis research station has seen better days... my equipment and belongings were damaged in the ambush.$b$bHowever, with your aid, I'm sure we'll be up and running again in no time!

objectiveDetails.description: 营救哈德利·里卡德博士

text.title: 历史的残片
text.completion: <Sallee Silverclamp examines the fragments you've retrieved>$b$bThese will do nicely! Great work, kiddo!

english.title: Fragments of the Past
english.completion: <Sallee Silverclamp examines the fragments you've retrieved>$b$bThese will do nicely! Great work, kiddo!

text.title: 马尔高克岗哨的麻烦
text.objectives: 去马尔高克岗哨找游侠伊莲娜。
text.description: 知道吗？我们派了两个斥候去查探马尔高克岗哨的那些难闻而又高大的“文明”食人魔。$B$B但我已经有段时间没得到她们的消息了。至少是自打我在塔拉给你留了几个猎物以后。$B$B你有时间过去瞧瞧她们吗，$g小伙子:小姑娘;?
text.completion: I'm afraid we have some trouble.

english.title: Trouble at the Overwatch
english.objectives: Locate Rangari Eleena at Mar'gok's Overwatch.
english.description: Ya know, we sent a couple o' scouts ta check out those big, smelly, 'civilized' ogres at Mar'gok's Overwatch.$B$BHaven't heard from 'em in a bit. Matter o' fact, not since I saved yer bacon up at Telaar.$B$BHave some time ta ride over there and check up on 'em, $g boyo:girly;?
english.completion: I'm afraid we have some trouble.

text.title: 马尔高克岗哨的麻烦
text.objectives: 去马尔高克岗哨找阿克洛什。
text.description: 昨天，我派了两名斥候去侦察马尔高克岗哨的食人魔。$B$B但之后就一直没有听到他们的消息了。$B$B$n，你是否愿意帮我去看一下他们？应该没什么大事；那座岗哨是一座非常大的要塞。$B$B但要是能明确知道他们没事，我能更安心一些。
text.completion: I'm honored you're here to help, wolf-$g brother:sister;. Things here are worse than we thought.

english.title: Trouble at the Overwatch
english.objectives: Find Akrosh at Mar'gok's Overwatch.
english.description: Yesterday, I sent two of my best scouts to spy on the ogres at Mar'gok's Overwatch.$B$BI haven't heard back from them.$B$B$n, would you do me the honor of checking on them? I'm sure it's nothing; the Overwatch is a large fortification.$B$BI'd feel better knowing they're okay.
english.completion: I'm honored you're here to help, wolf-$g brother:sister;. Things here are worse than we thought.

text.title: 你的基地你做主
text.objectives: 在蛮兽岗哨选择建造一座伐木场或格斗竞技场。
text.description: 你在霜火岭建造的要塞令人印象深刻。我相信应该把作出下一个选择的权利留给你。$b$b戈尔隆德的某个地区盛产资源。一座伐木场可以帮我们对这些资源善加利用。$b$b另一个地区则居住着不少久经战场的角斗士。一座格斗竞技场可以有助于说服他们为我们战斗。$b$b不管建造哪种建筑，都会增强我们的实力，更加便于我们找到并削弱钢铁部落。$B$B你会选哪一个呢，指挥官？
text.completion: A fine choice. It will need more work before such a structure could be built in your garrison, but this is a start.
text.completed: Speak with Durotan at Beastwatch at Beastwatch.

english.title: Your Base, Your Choice
english.objectives: Choose to construct either a Lumber Mill or a Sparring Arena at Beastwatch.
english.description: You have already constructed an impressive garrison in Frostfire. I believe I should defer this next choice to you.$b$bOne region of Gorgrond is rich in resources. A lumber mill could help us make the most of them.$b$bAnother region harbors hardened gladiators. A sparring arena would help persuade them to fight for our cause.$b$bEither path will strengthen us as we seek to find and weaken the Iron Horde.$b$bWhich do you choose, Commander?
english.completion: A fine choice. It will need more work before such a structure could be built in your garrison, but this is a start.
english.completed: Speak with Durotan at Beastwatch at Beastwatch.

text.title: 格斗竞技场
text.objectives: 去戈尔隆德的蛮兽岗哨与断肢谈一谈。
text.description: 没有你，我们无法重获自由。我们欠你很大一份情。我和其他人讲过了，我们会一起跟你回你的要塞，教你那些所谓的“士兵”们学会怎么打架。$B$B我们也会竭尽所能，把我们的知识传授给你，指挥官。只要你在戈尔隆德有用得到我们的地方，只要喊我们一声，我们就会即刻赶到。$B$B当然，你可能会需要跟断肢通报一声我们来了的事。
text.completion: Kash'drakor is coming here?! Ha! I once saw him cut through a dozen Laughing Skulls because they had his son.$B$BHe is the purist expression of destruction.
text.completed: 去戈尔隆德的蛮兽岗哨与断肢谈一谈。

english.title: The Sparring Arena
english.objectives: Speak with Limbflayer at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
english.description: We owe you our freedom, and more. I have spoken to the others, we are willing to return with you to your garrison and teach those pitiful creatures you call "soldiers" how to properly fight.$b$bWe will also do our best to impart our knowledge to you, Commander. Should you have need of us when in the wilds of Gorgrond, simply call us.$b$bYou may wish to warn Limbflayer of our coming.
english.completion: Кас'дракор идет сюда?! Ха! Однажды я видел, как дюжина орков Веселого Черепа схватила его сына, и он зарубил их всех.$b$bЧистое воплощение насилия.
english.completed: Speak with Limbflayer at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.

text.title: 矿井里的鬣蜥人
text.objectives: 除掉要塞矿井里的石牙。
text.description: 那个废弃的矿井已经被鬣蜥人占领了！它们似乎听命于来自矿井深处的某个大家伙。如果你能干掉他的话，其他鬣蜥人可能就会落荒而逃了。$b$b等你清理掉那些鬣蜥人后，我们就能让那矿井恢复运作了！
text.completion: Nice job, $n! Let's get this mining operation started!
text.completed: Return to Gorsol at the Garrison.

english.title: Things Are Not Goren Our Way
english.objectives: Kill Stonetooth in the Garrison Mine.
english.description: The abandoned mine shaft has been overrun with goren!  They seem to be responding to commands from a big one further down in the mine.  If you can take him out, the rest will probably retreat.$b$bOnce you have those goren cleared out, we can get that mine up and working!
english.completion: Nice job, $n! Let's get this mining operation started!
english.completed: Return to Gorsol at the Garrison.

text.title: 消灭食人魔
text.objectives: 在马尔高克岗哨消灭$1oa个食人魔。
text.description: 这里现在有越来越多会用魔法的食人魔，绝对不是什么好事。$B$B这些新潮食人魔最近飞扬跋扈得很，而且在不断加大他们在这个地区的工作量。$B$B你知道怎么才能阻止食人魔努力工作吗？那就是让他们挂掉。$B$B干掉一些食人魔，让这个营地变回原本那个荒凉而又无聊的样子。
text.completion: Great! They are pretty scared now. Its hard to do research when you are afraid of being stabbed in the back at any time!
text.completed: Speak with Dalgorsh at Mar'gok's Overwatch in Nagrand.

english.title: Obliterating Ogres
english.objectives: Kill $1oa ogres at Mar'gok's Overwatch.
english.description: We got more of those magic tossing ogres here which is never a good thing.$b$bThese new ogres are especially bossy and have increased work being done here.$b$bDo you know what stops ogres from working hard? Dying.$b$bKill some ogres here and get this camp back to its normal boring self.
english.completion: Great! They are pretty scared now. Its hard to do research when you are afraid of being stabbed in the back at any time!
english.completed: Speak with Dalgorsh at Mar'gok's Overwatch in Nagrand.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭马尔高克岗哨的食人魔

text.title: 移除书面记录
text.objectives: 在马尔高克岗哨摧毁$1oa个食人魔研究盒。
text.description: 这个盒子里满是书页和图表，似乎都跟针对废除魔法所做的研究有关。$b$b最好把找到的所有研究文献全部销毁掉，让这些努力付之东流。
text.completion: Burning magical paper smells pretty bad!  Good thinking $p, keeping these ogres dumb is a solid plan!
text.completed: Speak with Dalgorsh at Mar'gok's Overwatch in Nagrand.

english.title: Removing the Paper Trail
english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Boxes of Ogre Research at Mar'gok's Overwatch.
english.description: This box is filled with writings and diagrams that oddly resemble research into the nullification of magic.  It would be best to ruin these efforts by destroying any research found.
english.completion: Burning magical paper smells pretty bad!  Good thinking $p, keeping these ogres dumb is a solid plan!
english.completed: Speak with Dalgorsh at Mar'gok's Overwatch in Nagrand.

text.title: 获得食人魔进攻命令书
text.objectives: 在马尔高克岗哨获得库尔戈洛什的命令和索尔高克的命令。
text.description: 悬崖的上方对这些食人魔来说肯定至关重要。之前有两个衣着光鲜的食人魔法师从那边下来，然后到处向其他人发号施令。$B$B把这些命令书弄来，然后去悬崖上方找我的斥候达尔戈什。这些东西对他更有用。
text.progress: Don't forget! Get the orders and take 'em to Dalgorsh further in.
text.completion: Finally some help! I barely got out alive!$b$bYou have some ogre orders? Let me see...$b$bWell that's not good news.
text.completed: Speak with Dalgorsh at Mar'gok's Overwatch in Nagrand.

english.title: Obtaining Ogre Offensive Orders
english.objectives: Collect Crulgorosh's Orders and Thulgork's Orders at Mar'gok's Overwatch.
english.description: The upper bluff must be really important to the ogres. Two fancy looking ogre mages came down from there and starting ordering all the others around.$b$bGo get those orders and meet up with my scout Dalgorsh on the upper bluff. They will be more useful to him up there.
english.progress: Ты не знаешь, откуда тут взялись эти новые огры?
english.completion: Finally some help! I barely got out alive!$b$bYou have some ogre orders? Let me see...$b$bWell that's not good news.
english.completed: Speak with Dalgorsh at Mar'gok's Overwatch in Nagrand.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到库尔戈洛什的命令

text.title: 瑞拉克的研究
text.objectives: 阻止大法师瑞拉克的研究。
text.description: 好吧，这些命令书上说瑞拉克正在主持一项叫做“毁灭者”的研究，说是能制造超级强大的食人魔。我不知道你怎么想，但我觉得这听起来不是个好消息。$B$B我受伤挺重的，你能不能一个人上去劝说瑞拉克三思而后行？
text.completion: We stopped him for the time being, but I think we'll have to come up with a more permanent solution. No doubt he's back in Highmaul plotting new versions of Breakers.$B$BI think a visit to ogre capital is far overdue.
text.completed: Return to Thrall at Wor'var in Nagrand.

english.title: Reglakk's Research
english.objectives: Stop Grand Magister Reglakk's research.
english.description: Okay so these orders say Reglakk is in charge of something called Breaker research, which makes super powerful ogres. I don't know about you but that sounds bad.$b$bI'm pretty hurt, do you think you can go up there alone and make Reglakk rethink his research?
english.completion: We stopped him for the time being, but I think we'll have to come up with a more permanent solution. No doubt he's back in Highmaul plotting new versions of Breakers.$B$BI think a visit to ogre capital is far overdue.
english.completed: Return to Thrall at Wor'var in Nagrand.

text.title: 阻截援军
text.objectives: 摧毁通往悬槌堡的传送门。
text.description: 情况不妙，$p。这些聪明的食人魔在这里设立了一座传送门，并不断把别处的食人魔带到这里来。$B$B不过要维持这座传送门似乎要花不少气力。假如你把它关上，或许可以拖延他们一段时间。
text.completion: Good, hopefully they will give up on making a portal here.
text.completed: Return to Thrall at Wor'var in Nagrand.

english.title: Removing the Reinforcements
english.objectives: Destroy the Portal to Highmaul.
english.description: Its not good $p, these smart ogres have got a portal working up there and they are bringing in more ogres from somewhere else.$b$bIt looks like it takes a lot of effort to keep it open though. If you take it down I'm guessing they will be delayed quite a while.
english.completion: Good, hopefully they will give up on making a portal here.
english.completed: Return to Thrall at Wor'var in Nagrand.

objectiveDetails.description: 摧毁通往悬槌堡的传送门

text.description: This quest is a placeholder until Task 67719 is complete.

english.title: Vignette XP reward - Talador
english.description: This quest is a placeholder until Task 67719 is complete.

text.title: 船只残骸
text.objectives: 收集$1oa箱奴隶船残骸。
text.description: 指挥官，我们的补给快要见底了。$B$B我们是不是可以去你逃来这里时所坐的船上回收点材料？$B$B按照我们目前这个增员速度，等到日落时分我们就没东西吃了……或许我该说“月落时分”？$B$B我还在努力习惯这个地方。
text.progress: Supplies are getting really low, commander.
text.completion: Wow... with all these supplies, we should be back on track.$b$bWe are blessed to have you protecting us, commander.

english.title: Ship Salvage
english.objectives: Collect $1oa crates of Drudgeboat Salvage.
english.description: Commander, we are running low on supplies.$b$bMaybe we can salvage materials from that ship you arrived on?$b$bAt the rate folks are coming through the portal we are going to be out of everything by sundown... or moondown?$b$bI'm still getting used to this place.
english.progress: С припасами беда, командир.
english.completion: Wow... with all these supplies, we should be back on track.$b$bWe are blessed to have you protecting us, commander.

text.title: 在纳格兰失踪
text.objectives: 找到曼科里克的女友奥格拉。
text.description: 嗨，$g先生:女士;，你能帮帮我吗？我认识一小女孩，她的名字叫奥格拉。她和她的父母昨天刚动身回沃尔瓦。但之后就没人见过他们了，他们也没抵达沃尔瓦。$B$B假如你要回去的话，能帮我找找她吗？$B$B她算是我的女朋友。
text.completion: Skytooth! My mama and papa....$B$B<The little girl continues to cry over the corpses of her family.>

english.title: Lost in Nagrand
english.objectives: Find Mankrik's girlfriend, Olgra.
english.description: Hey, $g mister:lady;, could you help me?$B$BThere's this girl I know. Her name's Olgra. Her and her parents went back to Wor'var yesterday. Only, they never got there and no one's seen them.$B$BIf you're heading back out, would you look for her?$B$BShe's kinda my girlfriend.
english.completion: Skytooth! My mama and papa....$B$B<The little girl continues to cry over the corpses of her family.>

text.title: 你的第一份锻造订单
text.objectives: 在熔炉处开始你的第一份锻造订单，并收集产品。
text.description: 既然你已经有了熔炉，我们可以开始为你生产真钢锭了。等你找到材料就跟我的助手说一声，开始第一份产品订单吧。
text.progress: Yes?
text.completion: Let me unpack that for you.$B$BI should let you know - while we managed to expedite this one, future work orders will take longer.
text.completed: Return to the blacksmith's assistant.

english.title: Your First Blacksmithing Work Order
english.objectives: Start and collect your first Blacksmithing work order at the Forge.
english.description: Now that the forge is complete, we can start producing truesteel ingots for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.
english.progress: Yes?
english.completion: Let me unpack that for you.$B$BI should let you know - while we managed to expedite this one, future work orders will take longer.
english.completed: Return to the blacksmith's assistant.

text.title: 为萨尔伸张正义
text.objectives: 在格罗玛什尔城门处与伊瑞尔交谈，并率领部队攻打战歌氏族。
text.description: 是时候了，指挥官。你解决了所有战歌氏族的盟友和据点。$B$B我们的部队此刻正在格罗玛什尔的大门处集结。游侠们有可靠情报称加尔鲁什就躲在战歌要塞里面。$B$B我们所有的努力都是为了这一刻。让我们除掉加尔鲁什吧。
text.completion: It's over. The Warsong are broken. Garrosh Hellscream is finally dead.$B$BSomehow, I sense it's only a matter of time before Grommash seeks vengeance.
text.completed: Speak with Vindicator Yrel at the Stones of Prophecy.

english.title: And Justice for Thrall
english.objectives: Speak with Vindicator Yrel at the Gates of Grommashar and lead the assault on the Warsong.
english.description: The time has come, commander. You've dealt with all of the Warsong's allies and holdings.$B$BOur troops are massing at the gates of Grommashar. The rangari have reliable intel that Garrosh is holed up inside the Warsong fortress.$B$BAll of our efforts have led to this moment. Let's take out Garrosh.
english.completion: It's over. The Song of War clan is defeated. Garroche Hell's Creek is finally dead. But somehow I think Gromash will want revenge sooner or later.
english.completed: Speak with Vindicator Yrel at the Stones of Prophecy.

objectiveDetails.description: 在格罗玛什尔城门处与守备官伊瑞尔谈一谈
解决加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮

text.title: 复仇的怒火
text.objectives: 杀死野蛮的沃格斯金。
text.description: 他们……他们突然就冒了出来。$B$B<小女孩边哭边含糊地指向西方。>$B$B他们骑着可怕的狼。$B$B拜托你，指挥官，这事关我家人的荣耀。你愿意帮我复仇吗？
text.completion: Thank you, commander. You really are the greatest $c like everyone says!
text.completed: Return to Mankrik at Riverside Post.
text.giverWindow: 制裁这个战歌兽人，为奥格拉的家人报仇。

english.title: Consumed by Vengeance
english.objectives: Kill Worgskin the Savage.
english.description: They... they came out of nowhere. From that direction.$B$B<The young girl points vaguely west through her tears.>$B$BThey were on their nasty wolves.$B$BPlease, commander, my family's honor is at stake. Will you get vengeance for me?
english.completion: Thank you, commander. You really are the greatest $c like everyone says!
english.completed: Return to Mankrik at Riverside Post.
english.giverWindow: Exact vengeance upon this Warsong orc for what he did to Olgra's family.

text.title: 为萨尔伸张正义
text.objectives: 在格罗玛什尔城门处与杜隆坦交谈，并率领部队攻打战歌氏族。
text.description: 是时候了，指挥官。你解决了所有战歌氏族的盟友和据点。$B$B我们的部队此刻正在格罗玛什尔的大门处集结。暗影猎手们有可靠情报称加尔鲁什就躲在战歌要塞里面。$B$B我们所有的努力都是为了这一刻。让我们彻底终结这一切吧。
text.completion: It's over. The Warsong are broken. Garrosh Hellscream is finally dead.$B$BIt's just a matter of time before Grommash seeks vengeance.
text.completed: Speak with Durotan at the Stones of Prophecy.

english.title: And Justice for Thrall
english.objectives: Speak with Durotan at the Gates of Grommashar and lead the assault on the Warsong.
english.description: The time has come, commander. You've dealt with all of the Warsong's allies and holdings.$B$BOur troops are massing at the gates of Grommashar. The shadow hunters have reliable intel that Garrosh is holed up inside the Warsong fortress.$B$BAll of our efforts have led to this moment. Let's put an end to this once and for all.
english.completion: It's over. The Warsong are broken. Garrosh Hellscream is finally dead.$B$BIt's just a matter of time before Grommash seeks vengeance.
english.completed: Speak with Durotan at the Stones of Prophecy.

objectiveDetails.description: 在格罗玛什尔城门处与杜隆坦谈一谈

text.title: 苍月之光
text.objectives: 消灭诺恩·觅血者和$2oa名白鬼搜寻者。
text.description: 我们接获了一份奇怪的报告，说附近一处名叫日暮港的德莱尼聚居地遭到了兽人的袭击。$B$B听说这群特别的兽人跟我们以前见过的那些完全不同……他们好像在搜索什么东西。$B$B他们看起来……身形消瘦，皮肤苍白。$B$B日暮港的居民需要我们的帮助，指挥官。这似乎是检验我们要塞战斗力的绝佳机会。
text.completion: This is unnerving to say the least.$b$bThose things must have come from underground.$b$bHopefully we have seen the last of them.

english.title: Pale Moonlight
english.objectives: Kill Gnaw Bloodseeker and $2oa Pale Devourers.
english.description: We are getting strange reports of an orc attack on a nearby draenei settlement called Eventide Landing.$b$bI'm hearing these particular orcs are unlike any we have encountered before.$b$bThey seem... sickly, and are pale in color.$b$bThe locals could use our help, commander. This seems like the perfect opportunity to test our garrison's capabilities.
english.completion: This is unnerving to say the least.$b$bThose things must have come from underground.$b$bHopefully we have seen the last of them.

text.title: 找到状态
text.objectives: 与雪莉谈一谈，找到助手布莱斯顿，然后查看要塞储物箱。
text.description: 活实在太多了……我都不知道该先干哪个。$b$b要让这个要塞运作起来实在不是易事。$b$b雪莉到现在还没来汇报进度，我的助手布莱斯顿跟她的手下也不知道跑哪去了，呃……我今天忙得团团转，都没时间检查我们储物箱里的资源。$b$b如果我是法师的话，你觉得我能用镜像把这些活一下子都干完吗？
text.progress: Can we speak a little later, Sir? I don't really have time to talk at the moment.
text.completion: You did what? You are a life saver, commander.$b$bWith those tasks out of the way my job will be much easier.

english.title: Keeping it Together
english.objectives: Speak with Shelly, find Assistant Brightstone, and check the Garrison Cache.
english.description: So much work to do... I don't even know where to start.$b$bMaking sure this garrison is operational is not an easy task.$b$bShelly still hasn't reported back to me, my assistant Brightstone and her crew are who knows where, ugh... I'm so caught up I haven't even had time to check our cache for resources.$b$bIf I were a mage, do you think I could use mirror images to do all of this at once?
english.progress: Мы можем поговорить чуть позже, командир? У меня сейчас совершенно нет времени на беседы.
english.completion: You did what? You are a life saver, commander.$b$bWith those tasks out of the way my job will be much easier.

objectiveDetails.description: 与助手布莱斯顿讨论她的工作伦理

text.title: 要塞战役：萨格雷
text.objectives: 到影月谷的索克雷萨高地找大法师茉德拉谈一谈。
text.description: 你好啊，$n。$B$B大法师卡德加有条重要的消息要传达给你。$B$B德莱尼遭受了惨重的背叛，其中一位首领——大主教奥萨尔竟然在为燃烧军团效力。$B$B在影月谷上方的群山之中，奥萨尔，也就是如今的索克雷萨，正在为他的邪恶计划招募新兵。$B$B大法师茉德拉是这项秘密行动的负责人，我们需要你帮忙完成任务。$B$B去跟她会合吧，她会告诉你细节。
text.completion: Greetings, $c. Khadgar told me to expect you.

english.title: Garrison Campaign: The Sargerei
english.objectives: Speak to Archmage Modera at Socrethar's Rise in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: Greetings, $n.$B$BArchmage Khadgar wishes you to hear an important message.$B$BThe draenei suffered a great betrayal when one of their leaders, Exarch Othaar, revealed himself to be working with the Legion.$B$BIn the hills above Shadowmoon Valley, Othaar, who now goes by the name Socrethar, gathers new recruits to his cause.$B$BArchmage Modera is in charge of this covert operation, which we need your help carrying out.$B$BMeet her in the field, and she will give you the details.
english.completion: Greetings, $c. Khadgar told me to expect you.

text.title: 要塞战役：萨格雷
text.objectives: 与布罗恩·天角对话，让他送你去影月谷。
text.description: 你好啊，$n。$B$B大法师卡德加有条重要的消息要传达给你。$B$B德莱尼遭受了惨重的背叛。他们的首领之一——大主教奥萨尔竟然在为燃烧军团效力。$B$B奥萨尔——就是现在的索克雷萨，就躲藏在影月谷上方的群山之中，仍在为他的邪恶计划征募新兵。$B$B大法师茉德拉是这项秘密行动的负责人，我们需要你帮忙完成任务。$B$B去跟她会合吧，她会告诉你细节。
text.completion: Greetings, $c. Khadgar told me to expect you.
text.completed: Speak to Archmage Modera at Socrethar's Rise in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Garrison Campaign: The Sargerei
english.objectives: Speak to Bron Skyhorn for a ride to Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: Greetings, $n.$B$BArchmage Khadgar wishes you to hear an important message.$B$BThe draenei suffered a great betrayal when one of their leaders, Exarch Othaar, revealed himself to be working with the Legion.$B$BIn the hills above Shadowmoon Valley, Othaar, who now goes by the name Socrethar, gathers new recruits to his cause.$B$BArchmage Modera is in charge of this covert operation, which we need your help carrying out.$B$BMeet her in the field, and she will give you the details.
english.completion: Greetings, $c. Khadgar told me to expect you.
english.completed: Speak to Archmage Modera at Socrethar's Rise in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 潜入萨格雷
text.objectives: 收集一顶萨格雷兜帽、一件萨格雷长袍和一双萨格雷软鞋。并用它们合成萨格雷伪装。穿上伪装，然后分别与缚魂者扎玛亚和学者拉安达交谈。
text.description: 我们已经有线人渗透进了萨格雷的高层，但我们需要你去帮助他。$B$B为了让他能继续潜伏，你需要把自己伪装成敌人。$B$B杀死萨格雷的成员，直到你收集到一顶兜帽、一件长袍和一双软鞋。再用它们组合成萨格雷伪装。$B$B穿上伪装后，作为新兵去向缚魂者扎玛亚报到。再对学者拉安达说出“影月谷下雨了”这句话。$B$B这句暗语会让他知道你是自己人。
text.progress: Yes, initiate?
text.completion: Welcome, my friend. I have managed to earn a bit of favor with the Sargerei, but they still guard their secrets closely.$B$BOnly the strongest will be accepted in the ranks of the Sargerei.$B$BSoulpriest Zamaya is the leader of our operations here. To secure our objectives, you must first win her trust.
text.completed: Speak to Anchorite Laanda at Socrethar's Rise.

english.title: Infiltrating the Sargerei
english.objectives: Collect a Sargerei Robe, Sargerei Cowl, and Sargerei Slippers to create a Sargerei Disguise. Don the disguise, then speak to Soulbinder Zamaya and Anchorite Laanda.
english.description: One of my men has already infiltrated the Sargerei's ranks, but I need you to help him.$B$BIn order to protect his cover, you will need to disguise yourself as one of the enemy.$B$BKill Sargerei until you collect a cowl, robe, and slippers to create a disguise.$B$BAfter donning the disguise, introduce yourself to Soulbinder Zamaya as a new student, then tell Anchorite Laanda that 'the rain falls on Shadowmoon.'$B$BThe secret phrase will identify yourself as an ally.
english.progress: Yes, initiate?
english.completion: Welcome, my friend. I have managed to earn a bit of favor with the Sargerei, but they still guard their secrets closely.$B$BOnly the strongest will be accepted in the ranks of the Sargerei.$B$BSoulpriest Zamaya is the leader of our operations here. To secure our objectives, you must first win her trust.
english.completed: Speak to Anchorite Laanda at Socrethar's Rise.

objectiveDetails.description: 与缚魂者扎玛亚谈一谈

text.title: 恼人的魔荚人
text.objectives: 获得8个木质长矛。$B$B假如你失去了你的伪装，杀死萨格雷成员以收集一顶萨格雷兜帽、一件萨格雷长袍和一双萨格雷软鞋，并用它们合成萨格雷伪装。
text.description: 啊，新兵。你准备好开始执行第一项任务了？$B$B南边的树林里潜伏着不少烦人的魔荚人。那些肮脏的家伙一直来我们的农田里挖东西，偷补给品，还捕食那些没脑子的受训者。$B$B它们都是些既恶心又恐怖的怪物，必须被消灭干净。$B$B<扎玛亚用怀疑的眼神盯着你。>$B$B别想给我谎报人头，完成任务后，把他们的长矛拿来作为证据。
text.progress: Those filthy creatures don't deserve to live.
text.completion: I expect no less from an initiate.
text.completed: Return to Soulbinder Zamaya at Socrethar's Rise.

english.title: Pesky Podlings
english.objectives: Collect 8 Wooden Spears.$B$BIf you lose your disguise, kill Sargerei enemies to collect a Sargerei Cowl, Sargerei Robe, and Sargerei Slippers to create a Sargerei Disguise.
english.description: Ah, initiate. Are you ready for your first task?$B$BThe woods to the south are filled with pesky podlings. The filthy things dig up our farms, steal supplies, and prey on unwitting trainees.$B$BThey are disgusting, horrible creatures which need to be eliminated.$B$B<Zamaya gives you a skeptical look.>$B$BI will require their spears as proof that you finished this task.
english.progress: Those filthy creatures don't deserve to live.
english.completion: I expect no less from an initiate.
english.completed: Return to Soulbinder Zamaya at Socrethar's Rise.

text.title: 索克雷萨语录
text.objectives: 阅读“艾瑞达的命运”、“统一的决心”以及“永恒的诺言”。
text.description: 萨格雷是索克雷萨的狂热追随者。从我收集到的情报来看，他是一位颇具说服力、令人信服的首领。$B$B许多新兵都把他的著作带在身上。$B$B我要你去阅读这些文字，然后回来向我报告。要是我们能弄清楚萨格雷的动机，也许就能将他们瓦解。$B$B我最后一次见到这些书是在湖边、喷泉附近的桌上以及靠近花园的房子里。
text.completion: I see... Socrethar is purely mad, but his reasoning is logical. No wonder so many draenei are turning to his cause.
text.completed: Return to Anchorite Laanda at Socrethar's Rise.

english.title: The Word of Socrethar
english.objectives: Read "The Eredar Destiny," "The Purpose of Unity," and "The Promise of Eternity."
english.description: The Sargerei follow Socrethar zealously. From what I can gather, he is a persuasive and compelling leader.$B$BMany of the initiates carry books of his writings.$B$BI need you to read these works and report back to me. If we can understand the Sargerei's motivations, perhaps we can undermine them.$B$BI last saw these books near the lake, on a table near the fountain, and in the house near the gardens.
english.completion: I see... Socrethar is purely mad, but his reasoning is logical. No wonder so many draenei are turning to his cause.
english.completed: Return to Anchorite Laanda at Socrethar's Rise.

text.title: 古树的威胁
text.objectives: 杀死旧苔。$B$B假如你失去了你的伪装。杀死萨格雷成员以收集一顶萨格雷兜帽、一件萨格雷长袍和一双萨格雷软鞋。并用它们合成萨格雷伪装。
text.description: 在我们西北边的树林住着一颗古树。$B$B我需要有人去解决掉这个麻烦。$B$B这个任务即便是对于像你这样的新兵来说，也应该是小菜一碟。
text.completion: Not bad.
text.completed: Return to Soulbinder Zamaya at Socrethar's Rise.

english.title: An Ancient Threat
english.objectives: Kill Eldermoss.$B$BIf you lose your disguise, kill Sargerei enemies to collect a Sargerei Cowl, Sargerei Robe, and Sargerei Slippers to create a Sargerei Disguise.
english.description: To the northwest, an Ancient has settled into a forest glade.$B$BI need someone to take care of this nuisance.$B$BThis should be a simple matter, even for an initiate like you.
english.completion: Not bad.
english.completed: Return to Soulbinder Zamaya at Socrethar's Rise.

text.title: 粉碎敌人
text.objectives: 摧毁6块邪能风暴水晶。
text.description: 在你假装遵从扎玛亚命令的同时，我们打算在萨格雷的鼻子底下大搞破坏。$B$B在这村庄周围到处都是邪能风暴水晶。敌人用这种水晶强化自己的力量。$B$B去破坏掉这些水晶，我们就能拖慢他们的行动。
text.completion: Very good. Our mission continues, undetected.
text.completed: Return to Anchorite Laanda at Socrethar's Rise.

english.title: Shattering the Enemy
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Felstorm Crystals.
english.description: While you carry out the pretense of obeying Zamaya's orders, we're going to sabotage the Sargerei under their very noses.$B$BAll around this village, you can find Felstorm Crystals. The enemy uses these objects to magnify their power.$B$BDestroy these crystals, and we'll slow their operations.
english.completion: Very good. Our mission continues, undetected.
english.completed: Return to Anchorite Laanda at Socrethar's Rise.

text.title: Weapons Of Our Enemies
text.objectives: Collect 4 Sargerei Weapons.$B$BIf you lose your disguise, kill Sargerei enemies to collect a Sargerei Cowl, Sargerei Robe, and Sargerei Slippers to create a Sargerei Disguise.
text.description: We are doing well, initiate. We are close to gaining access to the council's chambers.$B$BMeanwhile, our subterfuge will continue. Atop the hill to the northeast, you will find the Sargerei training grounds.$B$BFor months they have been hammering, forging, and crafting the finest weapons to equip into battle.$B$BWe can undo their work in only moments, $n.$B$BSteal their weapons. Let us see if they can still strike, then.
text.completed: Return to Anchorite Laanda at Socrethar's Rise in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Weapons Of Our Enemies
english.objectives: Collect 4 Sargerei Weapons.$B$BIf you lose your disguise, kill Sargerei enemies to collect a Sargerei Cowl, Sargerei Robe, and Sargerei Slippers to create a Sargerei Disguise.
english.description: We are doing well, initiate. We are close to gaining access to the council's chambers.$B$BMeanwhile, our subterfuge will continue. Atop the hill to the northeast, you will find the Sargerei training grounds.$B$BFor months they have been hammering, forging, and crafting the finest weapons to equip into battle.$B$BWe can undo their work in only moments, $n.$B$BSteal their weapons. Let us see if they can still strike, then.
english.completed: Return to Anchorite Laanda at Socrethar's Rise in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 与恶魔面对面
text.objectives: 击败伊沃卡兹，然后摧毁恶魔传送门。
text.description: 没时间了，$n。萨格雷在西边的山头上开启了召唤传送门。$B$B我相信他们是要用这道传送门将一整支恶魔大军输送到影月谷。$B$B我们必须不惜一切代价破坏他们的计划。用这枚奥术炸弹去摧毁传送门。$B$B尽管这样做也许会使我们暴露，可破坏传送门才是眼下的当务之急。
text.completion: <Mysteriously, Anchorite Laanda is gone. Did something happen here?>
text.completed: Return to Anchorite Laanda at Socrethar's Rise.

english.title: Facing Demons
english.objectives: Defeat Invokaz, and destroy the demon gate.
english.description: Time is running out, $n. The Sargerei have opened a summoning portal on the hill to the west.$B$BI believe they are going to use this portal to bring an army of demons here, to Shadowmoon Valley.$B$BWe must stop them before this happens, no matter what the cost. Use this arcane bomb to destroy the portal.$B$BWe may blow our cover, but stopping the portal is more important right now.
english.completion: <Mysteriously, Anchorite Laanda is gone. Did something happen here?>
english.completed: Return to Anchorite Laanda at Socrethar's Rise.

text.title: 索克雷萨之怒
text.objectives: 面对索克雷萨，然后从缚魂者扎玛亚手里取得萨格雷作战计划。
text.description: <你在卷轴上看到了学者拉安达留下的讯息。>$B$B这封信是我在匆忙之中写下的。我已经暴露了，很快就要被带去接受索克雷萨的处决。$B$B你必须接手我们的任务。我听说缚魂者扎玛亚手里有索克雷萨下一次攻击的详细计划。$B$B她现在还没对你起疑心，所以你应该能顺利进入主建筑。拜托了，快去找到那些计划书，$n！
text.progress: Don't worry about me.
text.completion: <Anchorite Laanda looks pale. He is not going to make it.>$B$B$n... thank you for all that you have done.
text.completed: Return to Anchorite Laanda at Socrethar's Rise.

english.title: Socrethar's Fury
english.objectives: Confront Socrethar, then collect the Sargerei Battle Plans from Soulbinder Zamaya.
english.description: <Upon opening the scroll, you find a message from Anchorite Laanda.>$B$BI write this message hastily. I've been discovered. I'm being taken in front of Socrethar.$B$BYou must carry on our mission. I've learned that Soulbinder Zamaya holds a detailed plan of Socrethar's next attack.$B$BShe still trusts you, so you should be able to enter the main building. Please, find those plans, $n!
english.progress: Don't worry about me.
english.completion: <Anchorite Laanda looks pale. He is not going to make it.>$B$B$n... thank you for all that you have done.
english.completed: Return to Anchorite Laanda at Socrethar's Rise.

text.title: 继续前进
text.objectives: 回你的要塞找卡德加的仆从。
text.description: <学者拉安达气若游丝。>$B$B你必须尽快去报告……卡德加。$B$B索克雷萨想要占领沙塔斯。他会不断募集追随者……$B$B谢谢你，陪我走完这最后一程……$B$B离开吧……我想休息了……
text.completion: I see... Socrethar's ambitions begin with Shattrath and Auchindoun, but they do not end there.$B$BThank you for bringing this information to me, $n.$B$BI will relay it to Archmage Khadgar immediately.

english.title: Forging Ahead
english.objectives: Return to Khadgar's Servant at your garrison.
english.description: <Anchorite Laanda's voice is barely a whisper.>$B$BYou must report back... to Khadgar.$B$BSocrethar means to take Shattrath. He will... continue to recruit followers... to his side...$B$BThank you for... helping me... in my final hour...$B$BLeave me... I would like to rest...
english.completion: I see... Socrethar's ambitions begin with Shattrath and Auchindoun, but they do not end there.$B$BThank you for bringing this information to me, $n.$B$BI will relay it to Archmage Khadgar immediately.

text.title: 继续前进
text.objectives: 回你在霜火岭的要塞找卡德加的仆从。
text.description: <学者拉安达气若游丝。>$B$B你必须尽快去报告……卡德加。$B$B索克雷萨想要占领沙塔斯。他会不断募集追随者……$B$B谢谢你，陪我走完这最后一程……$B$B离开吧……我想休息了……
text.completion: I see... Socrethar's ambitions begin with Shattrath and Auchindoun, but they do not end there.$B$BThank you for bringing this information to me, $n.$B$BI will relay it to Archmage Khadgar immediately.

english.title: Forging Ahead
english.objectives: Return to Khadgar's Servant at your garrison in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description: <Anchorite Laanda's voice is barely a whisper.>$B$BYou must report back... to Khadgar.$B$BSocrethar means to take Shattrath. He will... continue to recruit followers... to his side...$B$BThank you for... helping me... in my final hour...$B$BLeave me... I would like to rest...
english.completion: I see... Socrethar's ambitions begin with Shattrath and Auchindoun, but they do not end there.$B$BThank you for bringing this information to me, $n.$B$BI will relay it to Archmage Khadgar immediately.

text.title: 艾苏克就是我！
text.objectives: 从骨园暴食者身上获得$1oa份鬣蜥人甲壳。
text.description: 艾苏克使用的法术可以帮你成就大业，但在灵魂赐予我们力量前，必须做好准备工作。$b$b艾苏克需要好多好多鬣蜥人讨厌鬼身上的硬壳。为了便于你收集，艾苏克跟你说个秘密吧。$b$b靠近它们的隧道坑口，鬣蜥人就会鱼贯而出。这样你就能一下子干掉好多个了。
text.progress: Xuk Xuk.
text.completion: Ahh, yes. Xuk is one step closer to performing a miracle.
text.completed: Return to Bony Xuk at Breaker's Crown.

english.title: Xuk Me, Right?
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Goren Shells from Boneyard Gorgers.
english.description: The magics Xuk is weaving will let you perform great acts, but preparations must be made before the spirits will bless us with their power.$b$bXuk needs many shells from the pesky goren. To gather them, Xuk will share a secret.$b$bApproach their tunnel craters and the goren will pour out. This way, you kill many at once.
english.progress: Zack Zack
english.completion: Ah, yes. Zach is one step closer to performing a miracle.
english.completed: Return to Bony Xuk at Breaker's Crown.

text.title: More Materials
text.objectives: Collect $1oa Garrison Resources.
text.description: Building a garrison is no simple task, and it does not happen without the proper resources.$b$bWe need a lot more materials.$b$bIf you find anything in the field let me know. We need all the help we can get.
text.completed: Return to Baros Alexston at your Garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: More Materials
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Garrison Resources.
english.description: Building a garrison is no simple task, and it does not happen without the proper resources.$b$bWe need a lot more materials.$b$bIf you find anything in the field let me know. We need all the help we can get.
english.completed: Return to Baros Alexston at your Garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 花粉的力量
text.objectives: 收集$1oa份强效花粉。
text.description: 木精利用像巨大昆虫一样的生物来给花授粉。$B$B这些生物身上携带的花粉拥有多种强大的效用，应该能对你要塞的军队有所帮助。$B$B假如你给我带一些这种花粉来，我就能把它们转化为有用的东西。
text.progress: Do you have the pollen?
text.completion: Keep this up and we'll make a survivalist out of you yet.
text.completed: Speak with Rangari Kaalya at Deeproot in Gorgrond.

english.title: Pollen Power
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Potent Pollen.
english.description: The botani use monstrous insect-like creatures to pollinate their bloom.$b$bThe pollen they carry has a number of powerful properties that would be of use to your garrison forces.$b$bIf you bring me a reserve of this pollen I should be able to convert it to something of value.
english.progress: Ну что, пыльца у тебя?
english.completion: Keep this up and we'll make a survivalist out of you yet.
english.completed: Speak with Rangari Kaalya at Deeproot in Gorgrond.

text.title: 焚烧尸体
text.objectives: 焚烧$1oa具被覆盖的尸体。
text.description: 你不明白。但凡没被这些植物怪感染的东西，都会被它们催胖，然后变成肥料。$b$b我们最好去把它们的食物源头破坏掉。$b$b我看见这些木精把几具尸体放在了附近。也许把这些尸体烧掉会是个不错的办法。$b$b让我们看看它们能不能感染灰烬吧。
text.completion: Normally I'm not a violent dwarf, but I ain't about to sit by and get turned into a bush. And I ain't about to let others do the same.
text.completed: Speak with Burrian Coalpart in Evermorn Springs.

english.title: Burn the Bodies
english.objectives: Burn $1oa Mulching Bodies.
english.description: You don't understand. Anythin' these plant people don't infest they fatten up and then turn inta mulch.$b$bI say we take out their food source.$b$bThese botani got a few corpses lying around that I saw. Might be a good idea to burn those bodies.$b$bLet's find out if they can infest ash.
english.completion: Normally I'm not a violent dwarf, but I ain't about to sit by and get turned into a bush. And I ain't about to let others do the same.
english.completed: Speak with Burrian Coalpart in Evermorn Springs.

text.title: 斩除杂草
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa名繁花编织者。
text.description: 我们还在继续寻找塞林的族人，可这些木精的威胁性超出了我们的想象。$b$b感染自己的猎物……太可怕了。$b$b拜托你了，指挥官，如果你刚好进入西边的永晨之泉，就尽可能多杀死一些那样的怪物吧。$b$b别让它们再犯下这种恐怖的恶行了。让它们受到应有的惩罚。
text.completion: Well done, commander. At every turn you seem to demonstrate an efficiency with war that even our most seasoned exarchs might fight to be challenging.
text.completed: Return to Yrel at Deeproot.

english.title: Bushwhacker
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Bloom Weavers.
english.description: We are continuing the search for Thaelin's people, but these botani, they are a larger threat than we ever realized.$b$bTo infest their victims... monstrous.$b$bPlease, commander, if you find yourself in Evermorn Springs to our west, slay as many of those creatures as you can.$b$bStop them from committing such acts of horror. Bring them to justice.
english.completion: Well done, commander. At every turn you seem to demonstrate an efficiency with war that even our most seasoned exarchs might fight to be challenging.
english.completed: Return to Yrel at Deeproot.

text.title: 煤屑的复仇
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa名晨露大师。
text.description: 我肚子涨的都挥不动斧头了，虽然我也没有斧头。$B$B你瞧，我们有共同利益不是吗？密林深处的那些木精藏了一件秘密武器。你帮我向它们报仇，我就告诉你它们把那玩意儿藏哪了。
text.completion: Me mother always told me to eat me vegetables. I dunna think this is what she had in mind.
text.completed: Speak with Burrian Coalpart at Evermorn Springs.

english.title: Coalpart's Revenge
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Dew Masters.
english.description: I'm so full I can't swing an axe even if I had one.$b$bTell ya what, we got a mutual interest here. I need yer help to get a little vengeance on the big botani at the back of this bloom. In return, I'll point ya in the right direction fer gettin' a secret weapon the botani keep.
english.completion: Me mother always told me to eat me vegetables. I dunna think this is what she had in mind.
english.completed: Speak with Burrian Coalpart at Evermorn Springs.

text.title: 追踪黑铁矮人
text.objectives: 去永晨之泉找布里安·煤屑。
text.description: 你不在的时候，这边这位游侠帮我找到了其它几个朋友的线索。$B$B是布里安·煤屑和焦眉。$B$B问题是，他们的足迹一路通往西边的永晨之泉。$B$B拜托了，指挥官。你能去救救他们，免得他们变成花肥吗？
text.completion: Ah! It was terrible! They made me eat an' eat an' eat.$b$bDon' get me wrong, I enjoy a good meal but these plant people had me eatin' nuthin' but fruit.$b$bI canno' take it anymore.
text.completed: 去永晨之泉找布里安·煤屑。

english.title: Dark Iron Down
english.objectives: Find Burrian Coalpart in Evermorn Springs.
english.description: While you were away our rangari here found more clues leadin' to some of me other friends.$b$bBurrian Coalpart and Scorchbrow.$b$bProblem is, their trail heads right for Evermorn Springs to the west.$b$bPlease Commander, will ya get in there and save them from mulching?
english.completion: Ah! It was terrible! They made me eat an' eat an' eat.$b$bDon' get me wrong, I enjoy a good meal but these plant people had me eatin' nuthin' but fruit.$b$bI canno' take it anymore.
english.completed: Find Burrian Coalpart in Evermorn Springs.

text.title: 生命之泉
text.objectives: 获得乌托菲斯之水。
text.description: 我们来这儿是为了找一件武器，我们曾经看木精使用过它。$b$b当时汉瑟尔弄到了那件神器，但那东西需要一种特殊的水才能运作。而我和焦眉就是负责来弄这些水的。$b$b我们没想到这些水真的充满了生命，甚至汇聚成了一个元素。$b$b只要你从永晨之泉那件神器台座往里面的山谷走，就能找到那个怪兽。如果你能干掉它并弄到它的水，那么等我们找回神器的其它部分，就可以使用那件东西了。
text.progress: Now I see why some become Rangari. This is exciting.
text.completion: You are carrying something of great power on you. I could feel it as you approached.
text.completed: Return to Yrel at Deeproot in Gorgrond.
text.giverWindow: 生命之水的化身

english.title: The Life Spring
english.objectives: Collect Waters of Utrophis.
english.description: So we came here cause we needed a weapon we saw the botani using.$b$bHansel grabbed the artifact an' Scorchbrow an' I were supposed to grab the special water the thing runs on.$b$bWe didn't know that water so full of life forms an elemental.$b$bIf ya mosey up to the cauldron at the base of that fancy lookin' ancient artifact in Evermorn Springs, you'll be findin' this beast. If ya can kill it and get its water, we can use it when we get the rest of the artifact.
english.progress: Теперь я понимаю, почему дренеи становятся рангари. Это так интересно.
english.completion: You are carrying something of great power on you. I could feel it as you approached.
english.completed: Return to Yrel at Deeproot in Gorgrond.
english.giverWindow: Manifestation of living water.

text.title: 大逃亡
text.objectives: 清理鬣蜥人坑洞，并穿过坑洞到狂怒裂隙外面找雷克萨。
text.description: 一条鬣蜥人坑洞！$b$b等清理干净后，这个坑洞肯定能带我们离开这个暗无天日的深坑。
text.completion: Those goren tunnels have proven useful.
text.completed: Speak to Rexxar outside Fissure of Fury.

english.title: A Great Escape
english.objectives: Clear the goren tunnel and use it to meet with Rexxar outside the Fissure of Fury.
english.description: A goren tunnel!$b$bOnce the cap is cleared, it's certain to lead outside of this Light-forsaken pit.
english.completion: Эти туннели горенов оказались полезными.
english.completed: Speak to Rexxar outside Fissure of Fury.

text.title: 防患于未然
text.objectives: 在宾奇维斯拓殖点安放$1oa枚火焰炸弹。
text.description: 你看见宾奇维斯拓殖点建筑上的那些真菌了吗？过不了多久，就会有足够多的孢子被释放出来，感染整条海岸线！$b$b宾奇维斯拓殖点剩下的那些被感染者已经没救了，为了防止更大规模感染的爆发，还是长痛不如短痛吧。$b$b我制造了一些火焰炸弹，可以烧光那些真菌，但我需要你去放置这些炸弹，我来按下引爆器。$b$b可以把这项任务交给你吗？
text.completion: Good work!$b$bOk I need to just finish setting up the ignition mechanism and we'll be all set.

english.title: Preventing the Worst
english.objectives: Place $1oa Firebombs within Pinchwhistle Point.
english.description: Have you seen all the fungus on the buildings in Pinchwhistle Point? It's only a matter of time 'til it releases enough spores to infest the whole coastline!$b$bThe remaining infected that are in Pinchwhistle Point will be too far gone for us to save later on, so let's do the right thing and put them out of their misery and prevent an even worse outbreak.$b$bI made some firebombs that will burn the fungus down, but I'll need you to place them while I set up the detonator.$b$bAre you up for it?
english.completion: Good work!$b$bOk I need to just finish setting up the ignition mechanism and we'll be all set.

text.title: 深源之根
text.objectives: 去深源之根找塞林·暗砧。
text.description: 既然你已经都安顿下来，准备砍伐树木和灌木了，我想让你帮个忙。$b$b我来戈尔隆德是为了寻找一支由我黑铁矮人兄弟组成的远征队，他们是往这个方向来了。可惜我没能跟上。$b$b我打算到南边去找找。问题是南边到处都是木精、魔荚人、巨树和其它邪恶狂怒的植物。$b$b你的伐木营地里刚好有多余的人手。要是你能帮我找找我的朋友们，我发誓一定会竭尽全力为你提供帮助的。
text.completion: Ah good! Ya made it.$b$bThe lasses here insisted on comin' with, though they don't seem to like each other much.
text.completed: 去深源之根找塞林·暗砧。

english.title: Deeproot
english.objectives: Meet Thaelin Darkanvil at Deeproot.
english.description: Since yer all set up to take on trees and bushes now, I need ta ask for a favor.$b$bI came to Gorgrond in search of an expedition of me fellow Dark Irons that were headed this way. Sadly I lost 'em.$b$bI am goin' south to look for them. Thing is, south is nothing but botani, podlings, giant trees, and other mean, angry plants.$b$bYer lumber camp resources would be mighty appreciated. If ya help me look for me friends I swear we'll help ya in any way we can.
english.completion: Ah good! Ya made it.$b$bThe lasses here insisted on comin' with, though they don't seem to like each other much.
english.completed: Meet Thaelin Darkanvil at Deeproot.

text.title: 刀叶林地
text.objectives: 找到莱拉·灰趾、诺里·煤窖和盘须的下落。
text.description: 卡尔娅认为她追踪到了一批矮人的足迹。它们似乎去了北面的刀叶林地。$B$B问题是那里到处都是植物怪。对付植物怪可不是我的强项。$B$B你能帮我去调查一下吗？
text.completion: The plant people fattened up my friends with fruit an' honey an' mead. Seems they were fattenin' them up for sure.
text.completed: Return to Thaelin Darkanvil along the Imperial Road in Gorgrond.

english.title: The Razorbloom
english.objectives: Find clues to the whereabouts of Lera Ashtoes, Nori Sootstache, and Razzlebeard.
english.description: Kaalya thinks she picked up a trail. Seems a bunch of dwarves went north to Razorbloom by the signs.$b$bProblem is that place is filled with plant people. I ain't much use against plant people.$b$bAre you willing to investigate?
english.completion: The plant people fattened up my friends with fruit an' honey an' mead. Seems they were fattenin' them up for sure.
english.completed: Return to Thaelin Darkanvil along the Imperial Road in Gorgrond.

text.title: 被感染者
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa名被感染者。
text.description: 虽然达坎没说，但除了你找到的那些之外，还有更多游侠被木精带走了。$b$b他相信他们已经遇害了。我却认为他们遭到了更悲惨的对待。$b$b你也许有胆量进入刀叶林地。等你进去之后，你就会明白那些木精究竟怎么对付自己的……“囚犯”。$b$b让那些可怜的灵魂得到解脱吧。
text.completion: I thank you for doing what I could not.$b$bWhile it is the right thing to do, it is hard to loose the arrow when your target was once a friend.
text.completed: Return to Rangari Kaalya at Deeproot.

english.title: The Infested
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Infested.
english.description: D'kaan did not say it, but there were more rangari taken by the botani than the ones you found.$b$bHe believes they were slain. I fear worse.$b$bYou might dare to venture into the Razorbloom. If you do, you may discover what the botani do to their... "prisoners."$b$bGive these poor souls a proper release.
english.completion: I thank you for doing what I could not.$b$bWhile it is the right thing to do, it is hard to loose the arrow when your target was once a friend.
english.completed: Return to Rangari Kaalya at Deeproot.

text.title: 艾韵之音
text.objectives: 消灭艾韵之音。
text.description: 第25页 -$B$B这帮木精有个领袖，他？……呃……她？……呃……它？……管自己叫艾韵之音。$B$B木精似乎将原祖荆兽当作神明，而且只有木精中最有权威的翘楚才能代表原祖荆兽说话。$B$B当我们试图问它关于我们在基地里找到的那件神器时，它突然大发雷霆，并把莱拉和诺里都带走了，之后我就再也没见过他们。$B$B我现在有非常不好的预感。
text.completion: They mulched my friends? Those pointy branch wavers with their wee beady eyes! Thank ya for avenging ma friends.$b$bWe best be findin' the others before they get turned into plant food.
text.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil along the Imperial Road in Gorgrond.
text.giverWindow: 他代表原祖荆兽说话。

english.title: The Voice of Iyu
english.objectives: Slay the Voice of Iyu.
english.description: Journal Entry 25 -$b$bThe botani got themselves a leader who calls himself... er... herself... er... itself the Voice of Iyu.$b$bSeems the botani see the genesaur as gods and only the most bossy of the botani get to speak on behalf of the genesaur.$b$bWhen we tried askin' it about the artifact we found back at the base it got all angry and sent off Lera and Nori and I ain't seen either of them since.$b$bI got a bad feelin' about this thing.
english.completion: They mulched my friends? Those pointy branch wavers with their wee beady eyes! Thank ya for avenging ma friends.$b$bWe best be findin' the others before they get turned into plant food.
english.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil along the Imperial Road in Gorgrond.
english.giverWindow: He speaks for the genesaur.

text.title: 超级种子
text.objectives: 收集浓缩之种。
text.description: 木精们一直在用心保护这些种子。$b$b能感觉到有巨大的力量从这些小小的生命体里涌出。$b$b这些或许大有用处。
text.progress: What have ya found?
text.completion: I may not know much about farmin' but I do know a power source when I see it. These seeds are packin' quite a punch.$b$bWay to think on yer feet and grab 'em, Commander.
text.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil at Deeproot.

english.title: Super Seeds
english.objectives: Collect Enriched Seeds.
english.description: These seeds have been shielded with care by the botani.$b$bGreat power can be felt surging out of these tiny vessels of life.$b$bThese may prove useful.
english.progress: Что ты $gнашел:нашла;?
english.completion: I may not know much about farmin' but I do know a power source when I see it. These seeds are packin' quite a punch.$b$bWay to think on yer feet and grab 'em, Commander.
english.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil at Deeproot.

text.title: Pearing It Up
text.objectives: Destroy 10 Sugar Pears.$B$BIf you lose your disguise, kill Sargerei enemies to collect a Sargerei Cowl, Sargerei Robe, and Sargerei Slippers to create a Sargerei Disguise.
text.description: While you do Zamaya's work to earn her favor, we will secretly be sabotaging the Sargerei operation.$B$BIn the forests to the northwest, the podlings have gathered stolen pears from the farms. The little pests go crazy for the stuff.$B$BThe pears also happen to be a main food source for the Sargerei, so naturally, we're going to destroy the harvest.$B$BThat should take care of the podlings AND the draenei at the same time.
text.completion: Excellent! I admit I love the taste of those pears as well, but it is a small price to pay to destroy our enemy.
text.completed: Return to Anchorite Laanda at Socrethar's Rise in Shadowmoon Valley.
