text.title: 钢铁部落命令书
text.objectives: 在碎牙之殁的钢铁部落营地中寻找武器装配员的命令。
text.description: 灵魂在附近峭壁上的钢铁部落营地里发现了一些命令书。你在那的时候肯定没发现。能去调查一下吗？
text.completion: These orders are written with terrible handwriting.

english.title: Iron Horde Orders
english.objectives: Look for weaponization orders at the Iron Horde camp in Crushfang's End.
english.description: Spirit spotted some orders at the Iron Horde camp on the nearby bluff. You must have missed them when you were there. Could you look into it?
english.completion: These orders are written with terrible handwriting.

text.title: 解雇镇长
text.objectives: 杀死镇长努格·折箭
text.description: 这瓶子有着一个巨大的瓶塞，上面写着“镇长努格·折箭的财产”。$B$B当你注视着这个瓶子时，你听到附近的沼泽地里传来了重型机械的轰鸣声。$B$B你有必要去那里查探一下，假如镇长被感染了，那么他同样需要被消灭。
text.completed: 回风险海湾找利维特·急刹。

english.title: Firing the Mayor
english.objectives: Kill Mayor Nurg Boltsnap.
english.description: The bottle has a large stopper in it with the label "Property of Mayor Nurg Boltsnap."$b$bAs you gaze at the bottle you hear the sound of heavy machinery coming from the nearby marshland. $b$bAn investigation would be prudent. If the mayor has turned he will also need to be put down.
english.completed: Return to Rivett Clutchpop in Venture Cove.

text.title: 重拳相助
text.objectives: 找到黑铁矮人幸存者。
text.description: 布里安给了我们黑铁基地的坐标。他们把那儿称作茉艾拉堡垒。$B$B可是在那座建筑里却有鬣蜥人作乱。$B$B只要你一路往南就能看到那座建筑，上面有一门非常明显的大炮。$B$B等我把这辆该死的坦克整好，我们就会立刻跟上来的。
text.completion: Co... Commander? Well ain't you a sight for sore eyes?$b$bI didn't think anyone friendly was comin' for me.$b$bWe found an artifact that seemed pretty handy against the locals in the area but then those acid-mouthed roly polies showed up and started eatin' everything.$b$bHelp me up an' we can git to it.
text.completed: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands at Bastion Rise in Gorgrond.

english.title: A Heavy Helping Hand
english.objectives: Find Dark Iron Dwarf survivors.
english.description: Burrian gave us the coordinates of the Dark Iron base. They named it Moira's Reach.$b$bBut half way through buildin' it the base got infested with goren.$b$bIf you head south you should come to the structure. Just look for a big ol' cannon.$b$bWe will follow as soon as we get this bloody tank untangled.
english.completion: Co... Commander? Well ain't you a sight for sore eyes?$b$bI didn't think anyone friendly was comin' for me.$b$bWe found an artifact that seemed pretty handy against the locals in the area but then those acid-mouthed roly polies showed up and started eatin' everything.$b$bHelp me up an' we can git to it.
english.completed: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands at Bastion Rise in Gorgrond.

text.title: 昔日的老友，今日的敌人
text.objectives: 在奥鲁纳海岸边的村落与奥格瑞姆·毁灭之锤对质。
text.description:
真不敢相信！在黑手做了那么多坏事以后，奥格瑞姆竟然还在继续为他效力。

我们必须和他当面对质。和我一起去奥鲁纳海岸边的村落，我要好好跟我的老朋友谈谈。
text.completion: Orgrim will not stop this foolishness, so we must stop him.
text.completed: Speak to Durotan at Draka's Den.

english.title: Old Friends, New Enemies
english.objectives: Confront Orgrim Doomhammer at the village along Orunai Coast.
english.description:
I cannot believe Orgrim would continue to do Blackhand's bidding after all the destruction he has wrought.

We must confront him. Join me at the village along Orunai Coast and we will confront my oldest friend.
english.completion: Orgrim will not stop this foolishness, so we must stop him.
english.completed: Speak to Durotan at Draka's Den.

text.title: 食人魔外交
text.objectives: 在安葛洛什废墟消灭$1oa个安葛洛什食人魔。
text.description: 食人魔就是食人魔，不管是不是变作了鬼。安葛洛什食人魔也一样。$B$B就算有了他们的仪式书，他们也不会轻易向你交出他们的力量，除非你能证明自己。$B$B我跟食人魔打了一辈子了，所以我知道办法只有一个。$B$B那就是直接去杀掉他们。$B$B你消灭的安葛洛什食人魔鬼魂越多，他们就越尊敬你。
text.completion: Another successful negotiation.

english.title: Ogre Diplomacy
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Ango'rosh in the Ango'rosh Ruins.
english.description: Ogres are ogres. Spirits or not, the Ango'rosh are not different.$B$BEven with their ritual books, they won't relinquish their power to you until you prove yourself.$B$BI've fought ogres my entire life, and there's only one way to earn that.$B$BKilling them outright.$B$BThe more Ango'rosh spirits and their pets as you take out while you're there, the more respect you'll command among them.
english.completion: Another successful negotiation.

text.title: 解雇镇长
text.objectives: 杀死镇长努格·折箭
text.description: 自从僵尸疫情爆发以后，我就没见过镇长了。假如他也被感染了而且跑出了镇子，那可就要出大事了。再爆发一次僵尸疫情我们可遭不住！$B$B我们必须尽快找到他，别让他跑出镇子！在疫情爆发前，他曾经在海岸边操作他自己组装的伐木机。你也许能在那找到他。
text.completed: 回风险海湾找利维特·急刹。

english.title: Firing the Mayor
english.objectives: Kill Mayor Nurg Boltsnap.
english.description: Ever since this zombie outbreak began I haven't seen the mayor at all. If he is infected then we could be in for a huge problem if he can escape out of town. Damn, we could be in for another zombie outbreak even!$b$bWe got to find him and make sure he doesn't escape! He used to ride in his custom shredder down on the shore line before the fungus started covering up everything. You might find him down there.
english.completed: Return to Rivett Clutchpop in Venture Cove.

text.title: 肆虐的鬣蜥人
text.objectives: 在茉艾拉堡垒消灭$1oa个鬣蜥人。
text.description: 这些怪物来得太突然，我们根本没时间组织防御。它们直接冲着金属而去，我们的墙壁都被它们直接咬穿了。$B$B要是不快点削减他们的数量，整座碉堡就快要塌下来砸我们头上了。
text.completion: You give me blackrock orcs, troggs, er evil leper gnomes an' we'd be fine. But these acid munchin' beasts are the end of us.
text.completed: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands at Bastion Rise in Gorgrond.

english.title: Down the Goren Hole
english.objectives: Slay $1oa goren in Moira's Reach.
english.description: These beasts came at us so fast we didn't have time to mount a proper defense. They went right for the metal and chewed through any wall we had.$b$bIf we don't kill some of them soon they'll bring the whole fortress down on us.
english.completion: You give me blackrock orcs, troggs, er evil leper gnomes an' we'd be fine. But these acid munchin' beasts are the end of us.
english.completed: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands at Bastion Rise in Gorgrond.

text.title: The Pale Threat
text.objectives: Return to Farseer Drek'Thar.
text.description: While you have been fighting against the legions of the void within the Twisting Nether, I have been investigating the twisted, pale creatures that abide in Shadowfall Canyon.$b$bA shadowy haze has settled in the canyon, $n and I sense that a dark power has taken hold there.$b$bReturn to me from the Twisting Nether with haste and we shall speak more.
text.completed: Return to Farseer Drek'Thar.

english.title: The Pale Threat
english.objectives: Return to Farseer Drek'Thar.
english.description: While you have been fighting against the legions of the void within the Twisting Nether, I have been investigating the twisted, pale creatures that abide in Shadowfall Canyon.$b$bA shadowy haze has settled in the canyon, $n and I sense that a dark power has taken hold there.$b$bReturn to me from the Twisting Nether with haste and we shall speak more.
english.completed: Return to Farseer Drek'Thar.

text.title: 幽灵问题
text.objectives: 与先祖之地的灵魂沟通。
text.description: 长久以来，亡者的灵魂们都会被引往沃舒古。$B$B从我记事时起，这片森林就遍布着前往圣山中心朝圣的先祖们的灵魂。$B$B而现在，我恐怕此处发生的并不是我以往所见的灵行现象。$B$B前往先祖之地，与那里的灵魂进行沟通，就这个问题寻求他们的指引。
text.completion: The situation here is dire, $n, but I sensed that we would meet again.$b$bI do not hear the call of the void as loudly as the others, for I am not long dead and my body rests far from this place.$b$bWith time though, that will change.$b$bIf you are here to help, listen closely for time is short.
text.completed: I NEED TEXT

english.title: Spiritual Matters
english.objectives: Speak with the spirits at the Ancestral Grounds.
english.description: The spirits of the dead have long been drawn to Oshu'gun.$b$bAs long as I can remember, the woods have been filled with ancestral spirits making a ghostly pilgrimage to the heart of the mountain.$b$bHowever, I fear that what is transpiring here is not the normal spirit walk I have seen before.$b$bMake your way to the Ancestral Grounds and commune with the spirits there for guidance on this matter.
english.completion: The situation here is dire, $n, but I sensed that we would meet again.$b$bI do not hear the call of the void as loudly as the others, for I am not long dead and my body rests far from this place.$b$bWith time though, that will change.$b$bIf you are here to help, listen closely for time is short.
english.completed: I NEED TEXT

text.title: 沃舒古的召唤
text.objectives: 飞往幽魂林地。
text.description: 元素之灵已为你揭示了一个幻象，$n。$B$B我们将一同前往圣山沃舒古，解决那里的异常状况。$B$B假如你所见的幻象是真的，那么必定有巨大的危险在等待着我们。我会在沃舒古山脚下的幽魂林地等你。一旦你准备好启程，就和吉克斯莫·现钞说一声，他会带你飞往那里的。
text.completion: It has been many years since I have set foot within these woods.$b$bI was last here for the Kosh'harg many years ago when this place was shared amongst all clans. Those days have past and now only the Warsong banner flies here.
text.completed: Speak with Farseer Drek'Thar.

english.title: The Call of Oshu'gun
english.objectives: Fly to the Spirit Woods.
english.description: The elements have spoken and a vision has been revealed, $n.$b$bTogether we shall travel to the great mountain Oshu'gun and put an end to the dark disturbance there.$b$bIf what you saw in the vision is to be believed, then great danger awaits us.$b$bI will meet you in the Spirit Woods at the foot of Oshu'gun. When you are ready to depart, speak with Gixmo Moneycash and he will fly you there.
english.completion: It has been many years since I have set foot within these woods.$b$bI was last here for the Kosh'harg many years ago when this place was shared amongst all clans. Those days have past and now only the Warsong banner flies here.
english.completed: Speak with Farseer Drek'Thar.

objectiveDetails.description: 到幽魂林地与德雷克塔尔见面

text.title: 未雨绸缪
text.objectives: 收集末日之击炮弹。
text.description: 我们刚开张第一个造的就是顶上这门大炮。这地方看起来是安置大炮的绝佳场所。$B$B之后，我们在大炮周围盖起了基地，没想到半途中这帮吐着酸液的怪物从地下爬了出来。$B$B好在堡垒的上面部分也就是这座大炮已经建造完毕了，只是还没有装填炮弹。$B$B反正我们要下到最底层去，如果你路上有看到末日之击炮弹，不如把它们顺手拿了。$B$B装上炮弹后，就算事后用不着，也好过真要用的时候却发现没装炮弹。
text.progress: Ya got that ammo?
text.completion: While I hope we don' need to fire the big gun, I kinda hope we can fire the big gun.
text.completed: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands at the bottom of Moira's Bastion in Gorgrond.

english.title: Just In Case
english.objectives: Collect Doomshot.
english.description: When we set up shop the first thing we built was the cannon. Seemed like a good place fer it.$b$bWe started buildin' the base up around it when them chompin' acid spittin' varmints came crawlin' out of the ground.$b$bThe upside though is the cannon is built, just not loaded.$b$bWe have to go down to the bottom floor of this thing anyway so may as well grab some Doomshot if you see any on your way down.$b$bBetter to load the cannon and not need it than to need it and not have it loaded.
english.progress: Do you have ammunition?
english.completion: While I hope we don' need to fire the big gun, I kinda hope we can fire the big gun.
english.completed: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands at the bottom of Moira's Bastion in Gorgrond.

text.title: 原祖荆兽的意志
text.objectives: 取回原祖荆兽的意志。
text.description: 我们用尽了一切手段迎击鬣蜥人，但它们没完没了。$B$B有几个人从木精那里偷来了一件强大的神器。$B$B问题是我们没法让它发挥效力。现在那件神器就在堡垒的底部。要想拿到它，你必须从那些鬣蜥人身边经过，一路前往隧道后方，然后找到细小的分支隧道，前往地下更深处。$B$B只要你拿到它，它就归你了。
text.progress: Not fond of this place. If the plants ain't tryin' to kill you then the ground is tryin' to swallow ya up.
text.completion: That artifact was useful until it ran out of juice. Hopefully you got some seeds and water for it.
text.completed: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands at the bottom of Moira's Bastion in Gorgrond.

english.title: Will of the Genesaur
english.objectives: Recover the Will of the Genesaur.
english.description: When the goren attacked we threw everything we had at them but they just kept comin'.$b$bSo some of the lads went and stole a fancy artifact from the botani.$b$bProblem was we couldn't get it to work. Now the artifact is sitting at the bottom of the bastion. To get to it you got to go all the way to the back of the tunnels past all them goren and find the wee tunnel that takes you farther underground.$b$bIf you retrieve it, it is yours.
english.progress: Мне здесь совсем не нравится. Тут так: если тебя не пытаются убить растения, то сама земля стремится проглотить.
english.completion: That artifact was useful until it ran out of juice. Hopefully you got some seeds and water for it.
english.completed: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands at the bottom of Moira's Bastion in Gorgrond.

text.title: 艾韵
text.objectives: 击败艾韵。
text.description: 你听到那声音了吗？$b$b看来那头原祖荆兽想来抢回自己的“意志”。我就说这地方倒霉透了。$b$b我会把你带来的这些炮弹都装上，看看能不能给你提供火力支援。你最好快到地面上去解决掉它……
text.progress: How are the searches going?
text.completion: That was a challenge.
text.completed: Speak with Yrel at Bastion Rise in Gorgrond.
text.giverWindow: 原祖荆兽来了。

english.title: Iyu
english.objectives: Defeat Iyu.
english.description: Did ya hear that?$b$bSounds like that genesaur wants its 'will' back. I told ya this place is nuthin' but bad luck.$b$bI'll git that shot ya gave me loaded properly and see if I can't weaken that thing up. You better get up there and deal with it though...
english.progress: How are the searches going?
english.completion: That was a challenge.
english.completed: Speak with Yrel at Bastion Rise in Gorgrond.
english.giverWindow: The genesaur has come.

text.title: 新主人
text.completion: Battle-Bot 8000 owner acquired: $n.$B$BCurrent directive: Massage $n's enemies... to death.

english.title: New Owner
english.completion: Battle-Bot 8000 owner acquired: $n.$B$BCurrent directive: Massage $n's enemies... to death.

text.title: 鲜血流尽
text.objectives: 从血环之心的2个血环牢笼里救出奴隶。
text.description: <这名德莱尼人吐出了他的遗言。>$B$B他们把我们关在笼子里，抽……我们的血……来举行仪式……$B$B<他剧烈地咳嗽起来。>$B$B很多人……还在——$B$B——我的同胞们……$B$B<这名德莱尼人死去了。>
text.completion: Well done, $n.$b$bGiven, they are injured, half-starved, and poorly-equipped... but there is no blade so sharp as a vengeful spirit, no armor so thick as a righteous cause.

english.title: Bled Dry
english.objectives: Free the slaves from the 2 Bleeding Hollow Cages in Heartblood.
english.description: <The draenei spits out his last words.>$b$bThey kept us in cages. They... drain our blood, for... rituals...$b$b<He coughs violently.>$b$b...many left --$b$b    -- my... people...$b$b<The draenei dies.>
english.completion: Well done, $n.$b$bGiven, they are injured, half-starved, and poorly-equipped... but there is no blade so sharp as a vengeful spirit, no armor so thick as a righteous cause.

text.title: 为逝者复仇
text.objectives: 消灭6名血环兽人。
text.description: 血环氏族残忍地杀害了我们如此多的同胞。他们的暴行绝不能获得原谅。$B$B<这名哀伤的兽人抬头看着你。>$B$B让他们付出代价。
text.completion: I admire your sense of duty, $n. Even when your own survival hangs in the balance, you still find time to bring closure to a grieving widow. Well done.

english.title: Vengeance for the Fallen
english.objectives: Slay 6 Bleeding Hollow orcs.
english.description: Too many of my people have fallen at the hands of the Bleeding Hollow. Their cruelty cannot be forgiven.$b$b<The grieving orc looks up at you.>$b$bMake them pay.
english.completion: I admire your sense of duty, $n. Even when your own survival hangs in the balance, you still find time to bring closure to a grieving widow. Well done.

text.objectives: 消灭6名血环兽人。
text.description: 血环氏族残忍地杀害了我们如此多的同胞。他们的暴行绝不能获得原谅。$B$B<这名哀伤的德莱尼人抬头看着你。>$B$B让他们付出代价。
text.completion: I admire your sense of righteousness, $n. Even when your own survival hangs in the balance, you still find time to avenge a grieving widow. Well done.

english.objectives: Slay 6 Bleeding Hollow orcs.
english.description: Too many of my people have fallen at the hands of the Bleeding Hollow. Their cruelty cannot be forgiven.$b$b<The grieving draenei looks up at you.>$b$bMake them pay.
english.completion: I admire your sense of righteousness, $n. Even when your own survival hangs in the balance, you still find time to avenge a grieving widow. Well done.

text.title: 黑暗女王的礼物
text.completion:
I was bidden to find my way to you, and to swear my service. Whatever you need of me, I will offer. I take a particular pleasure in turning things to ashes.

The dark lady sends her regards.
text.giverWindow: 作为一名新晋的剑圣，纳什拉无疑是一位强大的战士和武器大师。

english.title: The Dark Lady's Gift
english.completion:
I was bidden to find my way to you, and to swear my service. Whatever you need of me, I will offer. I take a particular pleasure in turning things to ashes.

The dark lady sends her regards.
english.giverWindow: New to the rank of Blademaster, Na'Shra is a formidable warrior and master of arms.

text.title: 令人触景生情的遗物
text.objectives: 把蕾希的礼物带给泰罗克鸦巢的瑞沙德。
text.description: 我父亲的手镯多年来一直放在这里，结果竟被艾吉斯那个骗子给偷走了。$B$B谢谢你把它带回来给我，可我却不需要把它留作纪念了。带上我的祝福，拿走它吧。$B$B假如这世上还存在忠于利爪之王的鸦爪祭司，请把手镯拿给他们看。
text.progress: Hm? What's that you have there?
text.completion: Lithic actually spoke to you? Or, some shade of her at least... $B$BFascinating!
text.completed: Bring Lithic's Gift to Reshad in Veil Terokk.

english.title: A Sentimental Relic
english.objectives: Bring Lithic's Gift to Reshad in Veil Terokk.
english.description: My father's bangle sat here for ages before that imposter Ikiss stole it away.$B$BI thank you for returning it, but I have no need for keepsakes. Take it, with my blessing.$B$BIf there are still Talonpriests loyal to the true Talon King, please bring it to them.
english.progress: Хм? Что это там у тебя?
english.completion: Lithic actually spoke to you? Or, some shade of her at least... $B$BFascinating!
english.completed: Bring Lithic's Gift to Reshad in Veil Terokk.

text.title: 艾苏克的忧惧
text.objectives: 与嗜骨如命的艾苏克交谈，观察他与破坏者格洛的交流。
text.description: 灵魂开口对我说了话。它们相信那个名叫破坏者格洛的玛戈隆将加入我们的战斗，率领它的部众对抗钢铁部落。$b$b这是任何嘲颅氏族的成员都从不曾获得的荣耀，至少我是没有经历过。$b$b我会与那个玛戈隆交流，我们将一同消灭钢铁部落。
text.completion: The spirits of my ancestors have betrayed me! Their skulls are surely laughing.
text.completed: Speak to the Spirit of Bony Xuk at Gronn Canyon.

english.title: Zero Xuks Given
english.objectives: Speak with Bony Xuk to observe him communing with Gro the Uncreator.
english.description: The spirits have spoken to me. They believe the magnaron, Gro the Uncreator, will join our fight and lead his underlings against the Iron Horde.$b$bThis is an honor beyond any bestowed upon a Laughing Skull, at least in my time.$b$bI will commune with the magnaron, and together we shall destroy the Iron Horde.
english.completion: The spirits of my ancestors have betrayed me! Their skulls must be having fun now.
english.completed: Speak to the Spirit of Bony Xuk at Gronn Canyon.

objectiveDetails.description: 与嗜骨如命的艾苏克交谈

text.title: 严厉的提醒
text.objectives: 在苦痛山脊消灭$1oa个荒地住民。
text.description: 欢迎来到前线，外来者，这里是荒原与丛林生物相互厮杀的地方。$b$b既然它们双方都已经忘了嘲颅氏族的凶残，那我们就来提醒它们一下吧。$b$b我们是在残忍与无情的毁灭中活下来的。这正是戈尔隆德的生存之道。$b$b来吧！让我们瞧瞧你是否经受得住这片土地的残酷。
text.completion: I like killing things. And bones.
text.completed: Return to Bony Xuk at Affliction Ridge.

english.title: A Harsh Reminder
english.objectives: Kill $1oa denizens of the wasteland in Affliction Ridge.
english.description: Welcome to the front lines, outsider, where the wastelands and the jungle collide.$b$bWhen their forces forget about the ferocity of the Laughing Skull, this is where we come to make them remember.$b$bBy fierce and merciless destruction we survive. This is the way of Gorgrond.$b$bJoin in! Let us see if you can withstand the brutality of our land.
english.completion: Как же я люблю убивать всякую нечисть. И кости тоже люблю.
english.completed: Return to Bony Xuk at Affliction Ridge.

text.title: 防御能量
text.objectives: 前往圣光之墓寻找缚魂者图拉妮。
text.description: 很高兴能看到有部落的勇士加入这场战斗。$B$B奥金顿的防御已岌岌可危。没上前线的几位奥金尼灵魂祭司都在竭力维持防御。$B$B缚魂者图拉妮到附近的圣光之墓去取备用的水晶塔了，但她一直没回来。假如你能找到她并把水晶塔安全带回来的话，会对战局有很大帮助。
text.completion: You look like you can fight. We need to get out of here!
text.completed: 前往圣光之墓寻找缚魂者图拉妮。

english.title: Powering the Defenses
english.objectives: Find Soulbinder Tuulani in the Tomb of Lights.
english.description: It's good to see a Horde champion joining the fight.$B$BAuchindoun's defenses are faltering quickly. The few Auchenai soulpriests not on the front are working fervently to maintain them.$B$BSoulbinder Tuulani went inside the nearby Tomb of Lights to retrieve a backup power pylon and hasn't returned. If you can find her and get her and the pylon back here safely it would help greatly.
english.completion: You look like you can fight. We need to get out of here!
english.completed: Find Soulbinder Tuulani in the Tomb of Lights.

text.title: 測試任務
text.description: [PH]

english.title: Test Quest
english.description: [PH]

text.title: 刀塔赏金
text.objectives: 从杜隆坦的箱子里拿走你的那份战利品。
text.description:
能夺下这座要塞有你的一半功劳。因此我觉得你也有资格瓜分这里的财宝。

我让人给你准备了一个箱子。你想要什么就拿什么。
text.completion: This camp of yours could be fruitful, but it rests upon the footstep of Grom'gar. The Thunderlords are not likely to be welcome neighbors.
text.completed: 与杜隆坦交谈。

english.title: The Bounty of Bladespire
english.objectives: Take your share of the plunder from Durotan's chest.
english.description:
The sacking of this fortress is as much your victory as ours. It is only fair you should share in the bounty.

I had the men prepare a chest for you. Take what you will.
english.completion: This camp of yours could be fruitful, but it rests upon the footstep of Grom'gar. The Thunderlords are not likely to be welcome neighbors.
english.completed: Speak to Durotan.

text.title: 圣光天罚
text.objectives: 在古尔罗克消灭$1oa个恶魔。
text.description: 黑暗的奴仆无所不在，他们竭尽全力想让黑暗笼罩世界。圣光要我们来维持这世间的平衡。$B$B现在你拥有的力量足以彻底摧毁塔隆戈尔的那帮恶魔奴仆。把他们撕成碎片送回扭曲虚空吧！
text.progress: The demon henchmen of Theron's are already on their way to the Circle of the Void?
text.completion: Already I can feel the Light triumphing over darkness. We've done it!

english.title: Retribution for the Light
english.objectives: Kill $1oa demons in Gul'rok.
english.description: There are agents of darkness everywhere, fighting tooth and nail to envelop the world. The Light relies on us to balance the scale.$B$BYou have the power needed to destroy Teron'gor's demonic minions once and for all. Send them to the Twisting Nether in pieces!
english.progress: The demon henchmen of Theron's are already on their way to the Circle of the Void?
english.completion: Already I can feel the Light triumphing over darkness. We've done it!

text.title: 原祖荆兽的力量
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德的高山走廊与守备官玛尔拉德谈一谈。
text.description: 指挥官，你现在有了起源之水、原祖荆兽的意志和足够的种子，足以培养出一支大军了。更别提你还救了许多矮人的性命。$B$B总结下来，这次任务还是相当成功的。$B$B我会留下帮助这些矮人启动重建工作，顺便看看有什么能回收利用的。与此同时，你先回岗哨把神器带给玛尔拉德吧。
text.completion: Well done, Commander. Many of the orcs have tried to master the power of the genesaur but I have never heard of any of them reaching this level of success.$b$bThis should provide us a substantial advantage in the days ahead.
text.completed: 在戈尔隆德的高山走廊与守备官玛尔拉德谈一谈。

english.title: Power of the Genesaur
english.objectives: Speak with Vindicator Maraad at Highpass in Gorgrond.
english.description: Commander, you now have the Will of the Genesaur along with the genesis water and enough seeds to grow an army. Not to mention the lives of the dwarves you saved.$b$bI would call this mission a success.$b$BI can help the dwarves mop up their operation here and see what we can salvage. In the meantime, you may want to bring the artifact to Maraad back at the outpost.
english.completion: Well done, Commander. Many of the orcs have tried to master the power of the genesaur but I have never heard of any of them reaching this level of success.$b$bThis should provide us a substantial advantage in the days ahead.
english.completed: Speak with Vindicator Maraad at Highpass in Gorgrond.

text.title: A Heart Unbroken
text.objectives: Deliver the Heart of the Fury to Kalandrios.
text.description: Though Gordawg's body lays shattered and lifeless upon the ground, a crystal heart glows brightly. The large crystal appears to be fully intact and all that remains of the mighty earthen fury.$b$bPerhaps Kalandrios will know what to make of the crystal.
text.completed: Return to Farseer Drek'Thar.

english.title: A Heart Unbroken
english.objectives: Deliver the Heart of the Fury to Kalandrios.
english.description: Though Gordawg's body lays shattered and lifeless upon the ground, a crystal heart glows brightly. The large crystal appears to be fully intact and all that remains of the mighty earthen fury.$b$bPerhaps Kalandrios will know what to make of the crystal.
english.completed: Return to Farseer Drek'Thar.

text.title: 亘古之力
text.objectives: 与埃匹希斯挖掘场附近的黑暗占卜师拉斯托克交谈。
text.description: 究竟是什么样的力量能在眨眼间将一整座村庄化为废墟？信徒们声称那是鲁克玛的意志。$B$B彻头彻尾的谎言。$B$B事实上，他们根本什么都没做——只是误打误撞地在地上的洞里发现了这种力量而已。$B$B到西边的挖掘场附近来找我吧。要想击败他们，我们就必须先弄清他们的科技。
text.completion: Ah yes, you've arrived just in time.
text.completed: 与埃匹希斯挖掘场附近的黑暗占卜师拉斯托克交谈。

english.title: Power Unearthed
english.objectives: Speak with Darkscryer Raastok near the Apexis Excavation.
english.description: What power could reduce a village to ashes in the blink of an eye? The Adherents claim it is the will of Rukhmar.$B$BA lie, obviously.$B$BThey did nothing to earn such power - in truth, they stumbled upon it rather unwittingly, in a hole in the ground.$B$BCome and visit me near the excavation site just west of here. We must understand their technology if we are to defeat it.
english.completion: Ah yes, you've arrived just in time.
english.completed: Speak with Darkscryer Raastok near the Apexis Excavation.

text.title: 埃匹希斯的遗产
text.objectives: 从埃匹希斯卫士身上收集$1oa份太阳之核。
text.description: 尽管埃匹希斯文明早已逝去，但留下的遗产却被完好地保存在阿兰卡下方的古老密室中。$B$B休眠的机械卫兵军团、流淌着太阳能量的水晶、失传已久的魔法技术——埃匹希斯留下了蕴藏着巨大力量的宝藏，鲁克玛的信徒们已经开始对这些宝藏进行挖掘探索。$B$B被重新启动的机械卫兵现在就在挖掘场附近巡逻，把它们的核心给我带来。那些水晶是埃匹希斯科技的基础，也是决定我们敌人毁灭之力的关键所在。
text.progress: The Apexis had every advantage, and yet they vanished. What could have happened?
text.completion: Excellent. With these we can begin to understand.
text.completed: Return to Darkscryer Raastok near the Apexis Excavation.

english.title: Legacy of the Apexis
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Solar Cores from Apexis Guardians.
english.description: The Apexis are long gone, but their legacy lies preserved in ancient chambers beneath Arak.$B$BLegions of dormant constructs; crystals flush with solar energy; magical techniques lost to the ages - the Apexis left behind caches of immense power, which the Adherents of Rukhmar have begun to unearth.$B$BBring me the cores of the re-activated constructs patrolling the excavation site. Those crystals are the basis of Apexis technology, and the key to our enemy's devastating power.
english.progress: У апекситов было все, но их цивилизация все равно исчезла без следа. Что же могло произойти?
english.completion: Excellent. With these we can begin to understand.
english.completed: Return to Darkscryer Raastok near the Apexis Excavation.

text.title: 塑日者双子
text.objectives: 消灭塑日者维奥里克斯和塑日者卡拉什克斯。
text.description: 在我还在通天峰当卫士的时候，我负责保护维奥里克斯和卡拉什克斯这对双子姐妹。$B$B她们是稀世的天才。到了她们那个年纪，大部分太阳祭司都看不见字了。但她们却能召唤出由纯粹的日光所构成的魔仆来帮她们照亮书本几个小时。$B$B如今，她们发现了埃匹希斯文明的秘密，并带领挖掘队进入了两座古代大厅。$B$B进入那些大厅消灭这对姐妹，以免她们获得那些可怕的科技。
text.completion: <The core of this slumbering construct begins to hum softly.>
text.completed: Inspect the Inactive Apexis Guardian in the Apexis Excavation.
text.giverWindow: 塑日者双子。
text.giverTarget: 维奥里克斯和卡拉什克斯

english.title: Sol Sisters
english.objectives: Slay Sol-Shaper Veoryx and Sol-Shaper Krashyx.
english.description: When I was still a guard in Skyreach, I was tasked with protecting the sisters Veoryx and Krashyx.$B$BThey were prodigies. At an age when most sun acolytes could barely read, the sisters conjured familiars of pure sunlight to illuminate their textbooks in the small hours.$B$BNow they unravel the secrets of Apexis technology, and their excavation has just breached two ancient chambers.$B$BEnter those chambers and cut down the sisters before they reap the terrible rewards of their discovery.
english.completion: <The core of this slumbering construct begins to hum softly.>
english.completed: Inspect the Inactive Apexis Guardian in the Apexis Excavation.
english.giverWindow: The twin Sol-Shapers.

enders.name: 闲置的埃匹希斯毁灭者

text.title: 辛勤劳作
text.objectives: 使用幻影雕像来创造$1oa个被奴役的流亡者的幻影。
text.description: 阿卡拉兹鸦巢的幸存者们被迫帮助信徒们挖掘那些旨在夺取他们性命的兵器。$B$B任何想要逃走的人都会立刻被监督者用埃匹希斯炮塔烧成灰烬。$B$B有了这些幻影雕像，他们就没法知道哪些人跑了！只要在被奴役的工人身边放上一个，它就能创造出一份完美的复制品。它甚至还能将被复制的对象隐藏到阴影之中，方便他们安全逃脱！
text.progress: Потрясающе, правда? Моя идея.$B$BОбычное деревянное чучело и простенькое заклинание.
text.completion: Deception is the ultimate power. Remember this, $p.
text.completed: Return to Darkscryer Raastok near the Apexis Excavation.

english.title: Hardly Working
english.objectives: Use Illusion Effigies to create decoys for $1oa Enslaved Outcasts.
english.description: Those who were not incinerated at Veil Akraz are forced to help the Adherents excavate the very weapons aimed at their heads.$B$BAnyone trying to escape is vaporized by the overseer's Apexis turret.$B$BWith these effigies, they won't know anyone has left! Place one near an enslaved worker and observe as it creates a perfect copy. It even cloaks the subject in shadow, so they can slip away safely!
english.progress: Потрясающе, правда? Моя идея.$B$BОбычное деревянное чучело и простенькое заклинание.
english.completion: Deception is the ultimate power. Remember this, $p.
english.completed: Return to Darkscryer Raastok near the Apexis Excavation.

text.title: 召唤光束打击
text.objectives: 从监督者阿卡拉斯身上获得埃匹希斯控制器。
text.description: <太阳的能量在沉睡的构造体中流淌，周围的那些古代机械渐渐发出了代表生命力的轰鸣。现在关闭已经太迟了。$B$B在外面，一名鸦人监督者正在下达指令，他的每一条指令都伴随着一道埃匹希斯光束的声音，这些光束正在切割山脉。$B$B如果你能驾驭那座炮塔的话，就能让那些构造体失去威力。>
text.progress: <A comfortable-looking chair with a socket in the arm rest.>
text.completion: <The Apexis interface slides into place with a satisfying click. Seems this is the seat for taking full command of the turret.$B$BRifling through the cushions, you find a few spare coins, which you pocket.>
text.completed: Interact with the Command Chair at the Apexis Excavation.

english.title: Shot-Caller
english.objectives: Retrieve the Apexis Interface from Overseer Akrath.
english.description: <Solar energy courses through the slumbering constructs, their ancient servos whirring to life all around you. It is too late to shut them down now.$B$BOutside, an arakkoa overseer bellows commands, each answered by the buzz of an Apexis beam carving away at the mountain.$B$BThat turret would make short work of the constructs - if you can command it.>
english.progress: <There is a notch in the armrest of this comfortable chair.>
english.completion: <The Apexis interface slides into place with a satisfying click. Seems this is the seat for taking full command of the turret.$B$BRifling through the cushions, you find a few spare coins, which you pocket.>
english.completed: Interact with the Command Chair at the Apexis Excavation.

starters.name: 闲置的埃匹希斯毁灭者

text.title: 游侠卡尔娅，为你效命
text.completion: Commander, your skills at survival are to be commended but they have many blind spots.$b$bYou need a rangari like myself to help your forces or Draenor is going to eat you up like a goren with a rock.$b$bWill you accept my offer?

english.title: Service of Rangari Kaalya
english.completion: Commander, your skills at survival are to be commended but they have many blind spots.$b$bYou need a rangari like myself to help your forces or Draenor is going to eat you up like a goren with a rock.$b$bWill you accept my offer?

text.title: 融合仪式
text.objectives: 与卡拉迪奥斯交谈以开始融合仪式。
text.description: 到了让你接受融合仪式的时候了，$n。$B$B这个古老的萨满仪式在我出生前就存在很久了。被元素之灵选上是一份无上的荣耀。$B$B许多萨满祭司在仪式中看见了生动的幻像，通过凝聚这个世界的元素本身来体验这个世界。$B$B你若准备好了，就跟卡拉迪奥斯说一声开始仪式吧。
text.completion: <Farseer Drek'Thar listens closely as you speak of your vision.>$b$bI see... these are truly dark days. Cho'gall has invaded the heart of Oshu'gun, draining the naaru of its life. He seeks to destroy the naaru, birthing a dark, void god in its place.$b$bCho'gall must be stopped. Come, we must travel to the sacred mountain before it is too late.
text.completed: Return to Drek'Thar.

english.title: The Ritual of Binding
english.objectives: Speak with Kalandrios to begin the Ritual of Binding.
english.description: The time has come for you to undertake the Ritual of Binding, $n.$b$bThis ancient, shamanic rite has been practiced since long before I was born. To be chosen is a great honor.$b$bMany shaman see vivid elemental visions during the rite; experiencing this world through the very elemental bonds that hold it together.$b$bWhen you are ready, speak with Kalandrios to begin the rite.
english.completion: <Farseer Drek'Thar listens closely as you speak of your vision.>$b$bI see... these are truly dark days. Cho'gall has invaded the heart of Oshu'gun, draining the naaru of its life. He seeks to destroy the naaru, birthing a dark, void god in its place.$b$bCho'gall must be stopped. Come, we must travel to the sacred mountain before it is too late.
english.completed: Return to Drek'Thar.

text.title: 战歌的威胁
text.objectives: 偷取战歌攻击计划。
text.description: <这份攻击计划是用粘稠的黑色墨水在粗皮料镶边的羊皮纸上潦草写成的。>$B$B通告所有侦察骑兵岗哨：$B$B督军有令，所有侦察骑兵准备对踏入我们土地的部落入侵者展开全面进攻。具体攻击计划已分发到各个侦察骑兵岗哨。$B$B鲜血与荣耀属于战歌氏族！我们必将把部落入侵者践踏于我们的脚下！$B$B战歌氏族听从督军的一切命令！Lok'tar ogar！
text.progress: What do you have for me?
text.completion: <Blood Guard Ehanes looks over the attack plans.>$b$bHmm... I see. You have done well to retrieve these attack plans. With the plans in our hands, we will be more than prepared to counter the assault when it comes.
text.completed: Speak with Blood Guard Ehanes.

english.title: The Warsong Threat
english.objectives: Steal the Warsong Attack Plans.
english.description: <The attack plans are scrawled onto the parchment in thick, black ink and bound in rough leather.>$b$bTo all outrider stations:$b$bThe warlord has commanded that all outriders prepare for a full assault upon the Horde invaders in our land. Plans for the attack have been delivered to several of the remote outrider posts.$b$bBlood and glory shall be ours as we trample the Horde invaders beneath our feet!$b$bThe warlord commands and the Warsong obey! Lok'tar ogar!
english.progress: What do you have for me?
english.completion: <Blood Guard Ehanes looks over the attack plans.>$b$bHmm... I see. You have done well to retrieve these attack plans. With the plans in our hands, we will be more than prepared to counter the assault when it comes.
english.completed: Speak with Blood Guard Ehanes.

text.title: 自己人
text.objectives: 说服暗影贤者艾斯卡释放暗影猎手乌卡比。
text.description: 我在侦察这片土地的时候被这帮鸟人抓住了。$B$B我们沿着这座山建起了你的岗哨，让你可以在整座大陆上建立起影响力。$B$B但情况进展不利。$B$B我需要你的帮助，指挥官。你能不能告诉他们我没有恶意？这样我才好带你去参观你的岗哨。
text.completion: Thank da spirits you showed up. Dey hear my prayers.
text.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Ukambe in Veil Terokk.

english.title: One of Our Own
english.objectives: Speak to Shadow-Sage Iskar and convince him to let Shadow Hunter Ukambe free.
english.description: Da bird-men captured me while I was gettin' da lay a da land.$B$BWe been workin' on an outpost for you just round dis mountain so your will be spreadin' all over da continent.$B$BThings not be goin' well.$B$BI be needin' your assistance, commander. Can you tell dem that I mean no harm so I can be showin' you da outpost?
english.completion: Thank da spirits you showed up. Dey hear my prayers.
english.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Ukambe in Veil Terokk.

text.title: 炽热之座
text.objectives: 使用指挥椅控制埃匹希斯炮塔，消灭$1oa个埃匹希斯毁灭者和$2oa名信徒塑日者。
text.description: <埃匹希斯机械卫兵就要从古老的密室里冲出来大战一场了。鸦人一定会派出更多塑日者来支援它们。$B$B此时，控制器和炮塔发出了柔和的共鸣声。>
text.completion: Ahh, well done. Even with my condition, I could sense the carnage from here.$B$BIt must have been quite a show, kah-hah-haww.

english.title: Hot Seat
english.objectives: Use the Overseer's Chair to take control of the Apexis Turret and slay $1oa Apexis Destroyers and $2oa Adherent Sol-Shapers.
english.description: <Apexis constructs are about to emerge from their ancient chambers on a warpath. The arakkoa are sure to send more sol-shapers to support them.$B$BThe interface and the turret hum in soft resonance.>
english.completion: Ahh, well done. Even with my condition, I could sense the carnage from here.$B$BIt must have been quite a show, kah-hah-haww.

text.title: 自己人
text.objectives: 说服暗影贤者艾斯卡释放贾斯伯·菲尔。
text.description: 我在侦察这片区域的时候被这帮怪胎给抓住了。既然指挥官你也来了，我们的基地需要你的帮助。$B$B呃，另外，你能不能说服你这帮……朋友……放我走啊？$B$B他们，呃……不让我走。
text.completion: Now, uh... could we maybe forget this little incident happened, commander?$B$BBodrick and the other agents would never let me live this down.
text.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Ukambe in Veil Terokk.

english.title: One of Our Own
english.objectives: Speak to Shadow-Sage Iskar and convince him to let Jasper Fel free.
english.description: These wretched creatures captured me while I was scouting the area. Now that you're here, commander, we could really use your help back at base.$B$BOh, and any way you could convince your... friends... to let me go?$B$BThey, uh... won't let me leave.
english.completion: Now, uh... could we maybe forget this little incident happened, commander?$B$BBodrick and the other agents would never let me live this down.
english.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Ukambe in Veil Terokk.

text.title: 检阅你的部队
text.objectives: 在坠斧营地与暗影猎手乌卡比对话。
text.description: 坠斧营地离这儿不是很远。$B$B我会在地图上标出它的位置，我们在那里会合。
text.completion: Our lives for your will, commander.
text.completed: 在坠斧营地与暗影猎手乌卡比对话。

english.title: Inspecting the Troops
english.objectives: Speak to Shadow Hunter Ukambe at Axefall.
english.description: Axefall be just a moment's ride from here.$B$BI be markin' da location on your map and meet you dere.
english.completion: Our lives for your will, commander.
english.completed: Speak to Shadow Hunter Ukambe at Axefall.

text.title: 检阅你的部队
text.objectives: 在南港与贾斯伯·菲尔对话。
text.description: 南港离这儿不远，就在西南边。$B$B现在不是闲聊的时候。我们在那儿碰头吧，指挥官。
text.completion: I hope everything is to your liking. It's been one hell of a job.
text.completed: Speak to Jasper Fel at Southport.

english.title: Inspecting the Troops
english.objectives: Speak to Jasper Fel at Southport.
english.description: Southport lies not far from here to the southwest.$B$BNo time for chit-chat. I will meet you there, commander.
english.completion: I hope everything is to your liking. It's been one hell of a job.
english.completed: Speak to Jasper Fel at Southport.

text.title: 有何指令，指挥官？
text.objectives: 检查绘图桌并选择采用哪种岗哨建筑。
text.description: 指挥官，我们的状况报告……十分严峻。$B$B我们的补给几天内就会耗尽了，这前提还是我们的军队到那时还没被干掉。$B$B我们剩下的材料只够再盖一座旅店或一座货栈。$B$B旅店可以让我们在这里安置援军，而货栈则允许我们和附近的鸦人流亡者进行贸易往来，或许有助于我们补充给养。$B$B我把加兹鲁维的图纸留在绘图桌上了，我们都在等你的指示。
text.completion: Your will be done.$B$BFor the Horde!
text.completed: Return to Taskmaster Gornek in Axefall.

english.title: Orders, Commander?
english.objectives: Inspect the Drafting Table and choose which outpost structure to construct.
english.description: Commander, our status report is... regrettable.$B$BWe'll be out of supplies in a few days' time, and that's assuming we have any troops left by then. $B$BThere's just enough material left to put up an inn or a trading post.$B$BThe inn would allow us to station fresh troops here, but the trading post would open up potential supply routes with the outcasts nearby.$B$BI've left out Gazlowe's blueprints on the drafting table. We await your will.
english.completion: Your will be done.$B$BFor the Horde!
english.completed: Return to Taskmaster Gornek in Axefall.

text.title: 跟上改装车！
text.objectives: 在宾奇维斯拓殖点找到基姆兹·宾奇维斯。
text.description: 虽然基姆兹女士强悍得很，可只身一人前往宾奇维斯拓殖点还是太过危险了。要是我们的头儿也受到感染的话，士气一定会严重受挫。$b$b我得把这些船员送回零件工厂，所以我需要你去确保她的安全。$b$b她叔叔就待在油田另一侧的塔里，我想你应该去那找找她。
text.completion: I have good news and bad news.$b$bThe good news is my uncle's alive! The bad news is his leg is injured and we're surrounded by infected! With my hotrod wrecked we can't get him out of here.
text.completed: 在宾奇维斯拓殖点与基姆兹·宾奇维斯谈一谈。

english.title: Follow that Hotrod!
english.objectives: Find Kimzee Pinchwhistle in Pinchwhistle Point.
english.description: Miss Kimzee is one tough nugget but Pinchwhistle Point is too dangerous for her to handle alone. It'll be a catastrophe for morale if our boss gets infected.$b$bI need to get these crewmen back to the Gearworks so I need you to go and make sure she is alright.$b$bHer uncle's place is the tower just on the other side of the oil fields; I think you should look for her around there.
english.completion: I have good news and bad news.$b$bThe good news is my uncle's alive! The bad news is his leg is injured and we're surrounded by infected! With my hotrod wrecked we can't get him out of here.
english.completed: Speak with Kimzee Pinchwhistle in Pinchwhistle Point.

text.title: 有何指令，指挥官？
text.objectives: 检查绘图桌并选择采用哪种岗哨建筑。
text.description: 指挥官$n。见到你真是我的荣幸。$B$B我们这里情况比较艰苦，$G先生:女士;。补给最多只能再支持一周，前提是我们的部队在这一周里还没被干掉。$B$B我们手头的材料只够再盖一座旅店或一座货栈。$B$B旅店可以让我们在这里安置援军，而货栈则允许我们和附近的鸦人流亡者进行贸易往来。$B$B不管是盖哪一座，我们都需要你的授权。你来决定吧。
text.completion: Praise the Light you're here. I thought we were going to have to wait until a courier could reach you for a decision on this.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Willem in Southport.

english.title: Orders, Commander?
english.objectives: Inspect the Drafting Table and choose which outpost structure to construct.
english.description: Commander $n, it's an honor.$B$BWe're barely holding on, $Gsir:madame;. We have a week's supplies at best, assuming we have any troops left to supply in that time.$B$BWe have just enough material left to put up an inn or a trading post.$B$BThe inn would allow us to station reinforcements here, while the trading post would allow supply routes with the outcasts nearby.$B$BWe need your authorization for the project, commander. It's your decision.
english.completion: Praise the Light you're here. I thought we were going to have to wait until a courier could reach you for a decision on this.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Willem in Southport.

text.title: 老朋友
text.objectives: 在海军上将泰勒的要塞与贾斯伯·菲尔对话。
text.description: 先前我们在影月谷里为你建造要塞时，海军上将泰勒就奉命在内陆建造要塞了。他的落脚点就在北边不远处。$B$B我们两个可以过去借些补给品来填补下次货运到来前的空当。$B$B你觉得怎么样，指挥官？我想上将再次见到你一定会很激动的。
text.completion: What in the king's name happened here?
text.completed: Speak to Jasper Fel at Southport.

english.title: Old Friends
english.objectives: Speak to Jasper Fel at Admiral Taylor's Garrison.
english.description: Admiral Taylor was ordered to establish a garrison inland while we erected yours in Shadowmoon Valley. He settled just a short ways north of here.$B$BThe two of us could go there and borrow some supplies to tide us over before our next shipment.$B$BWhat do you say, commander? I'm sure the admiral will be thrilled to see you again.
english.completion: What in the king's name happened here?
english.completed: Speak to Jasper Fel at Southport.

text.title: 你的就是我的，我的还是我的
text.objectives: 在海军上将泰勒的要塞与暗影猎手乌卡比对话。
text.description: 在侦察途中，我还发现了其它一些东西，头儿。$B$B联盟在路的另一边建了一座要塞，但我很长时间没有看到有人进出那里了。$B$B现在或许是个绝佳的机会，我们可以去那里抢些东西来补充你的金库。$B$B你觉得如何？指挥官。我们一起干吧。
text.completion: Everyone be dead, mon. What did dis?

english.title: What's Theirs is Ours
english.objectives: Speak to Shadow Hunter Ukambe at Admiral Taylor's Garrison.
english.description: I found somethin' else while I was scoutin', boss.$B$BDa Alliance have a garrison just across da way, and der been no movement in or out of da place in a good while.$B$BDis be a golden opportunity to sack da place and bolster your coffers, commander.$B$BWhat do ya say? We do it together.
english.completion: Everyone be dead, mon. What did dis?

text.title: 被污染的花园
text.objectives: 除掉要塞矿井里的石牙。
text.description: 这座废弃的矿坑被鬣蜥人给占领了！他们的头领似乎是矿井深处的一个大块头。假如你能把他干掉，剩下的鬣蜥人可能就会作鸟兽散了。$B$B只要这些鬣蜥人不在，我们就能让这座矿井重新运作起来。

english.title: Tainted Garden
english.objectives: Kill Stonetooth in the Garrison Mine.
english.description: The abandonded mine shaft has been overrun with Goren!  They seem to be responding to commands from a big one further down in the mine.  If you can take him out, the rest will probably retreat.$b$bOnce you have those Goren cleared out, we can get that mine up and working!

text.title: 烈焰飞舞
text.objectives: 按下火焰炸弹起爆器，然后乘上基姆兹的飞行器。
text.description: 好吧$n，我们已经尽力救出了许多人，眼下要确保这场灾难不会进一步蔓延开来。$b$b火焰炸弹已经上好引线，随时可以引爆。$b$b基姆兹刚刚修理好飞行器，等我们完成这里的任务就可以立即飞回零件工厂了。$b$b既然苦活儿都是你干的，所以我想应该把引爆的荣誉留给你。
text.completion: $n, you did fantastic work.$b$bEveryone here at the Gearworks owes you big time for what you've done for us.$b$bHere, I want to give you little something. Think of it as a personal token of my gratitude.

english.title: Flame On
english.objectives: Use the Firebomb Plunger then ride on Kimzee's Flying Machine.
english.description: Alright $n, we've saved as many as we could but now we need to make sure this disaster doesn't spread any further.$b$bThe firebombs are wired up and ready to go.$b$bKimzee just finished work on the flying machine so we're ready to ride back to the Gearworks as soon as we're finished.$b$bYou've done all the hard work so I think you should get the honors of triggering it.
english.completion: $n, you did fantastic work.$b$bEveryone here at the Gearworks owes you big time for what you've done for us.$b$bHere, I want to give you little something. Think of it as a personal token of my gratitude.

text.title: 指挥官斯普林瓦尔奖励任务

english.title: Gate of the Setting Sun Reward Quest
Gate of the Setting Sun Reward Quest

text.title: 沃舒古的黑暗之心
text.objectives: 进入纳鲁圣所。
text.description: 我们离内殿不远了，$n。这股邪恶力量的真面目即将揭晓。$B$B我会将我的灵魂投射到殿内以便引导你，但击败盘踞在其中的邪恶力量是你的任务。$B$B愿卡拉迪奥斯的清风指引你的双臂，愿埃布留斯的智慧启迪你的感官，愿伊森拉图斯的火焰烧尽你的敌人。$B$B愿戈达乌的记忆成为你坚实的护盾。
text.completion: You have done well, $n.$b$bBy defeating the void god Decimatus, the destruction of this great valley has been avoided. The threat of the pale has subsided for now as well.$b$bThe loss of Gordawg will be felt throughout Nagrand, but someday a new earthen fury will take seat upon the Throne of Elements and balance will be restored.
text.completed: Return to Farseer Drek'Thar.

english.title: The Dark Heart of Oshu'gun
english.objectives: Enter the Sanctum of the Naaru.
english.description: We are not far from the inner chamber, $n. The truth behind the evil here awaits us.$b$bI can project my spirit into the chamber to guide you, but it will be up to you to defeat the evil that lays within.$b$bMay the wind of Kalandrios guide your arm, the wisdom of Aborius enlighten your faculties, and the flame of Incineratus burn your enemies.$b$bMay the memory of Gordawg be your shield.
english.completion: You have done well, $n.$b$bBy defeating the void god Decimatus, the destruction of this great valley has been avoided. The threat of the pale has subsided for now as well.$b$bThe loss of Gordawg will be felt throughout Nagrand, but someday a new earthen fury will take seat upon the Throne of Elements and balance will be restored.
english.completed: Return to Farseer Drek'Thar.

text.title: 我看见了亡者
text.objectives: 从鬼灵工人的身上获得布莱恩·费恩的图纸。
text.description: 这里的人都……死光了。$B$B这名建筑师的灵魂并不想与我们交战。他在死后也只不过想要工作而已。也许我们能破除他神智的迷雾，查明真相。$B$B我猜他的某张设计图应该就在这里其中一位鬼灵工人身上，给他看看设计图，或许就能让他恢复神智。
text.progress: I'd recognize one of my schematics anywhere.
text.completion: Thank you, friend.
text.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Ujambe in Admiral Taylor's Garrison.

english.title: I See Dead People
english.objectives: Retrieve Bryan Finn's Schematic from Spectral Laborers.
english.description: Everybody here be... dead.$B$BDis architect's spirit not be wantin' to fight us. Even in death he only be wantin' to work. Maybe we can break da haze over him and get to da bottom of dis.$B$BI bet one of da spectral laborers be havin' one of his schematics we can show to him to clear his mind.
english.progress: Я свой чертеж завсегда узнаю.
english.completion: Thank you, friend.
english.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Ujambe in Admiral Taylor's Garrison.

objectiveDetails.description: 把图纸拿给布莱恩·费恩看

text.title: 风暴烈酒酿造厂奖励任务
风暴烈酒酿造厂奖励任务

english.title: Temple of the Jade Serpent Reward Quest
Temple of the Jade Serpent Reward Quest

text.title: 我看见了亡者
text.objectives: 从鬼灵工人的身上获得布莱恩·费恩的图纸。
text.description: 他们……他们是鬼！所有人都是鬼！$B$B布莱恩曾经是我最好的朋友。他的神智被什么东西给迷惑住了，我们得帮他清醒过来，然后查明真相！$B$B他一直对自己的工作十分痴迷。也许给他看看他自己的图纸能起到效果。图纸可能在某个鬼灵工人身上。
text.progress: I'd recognize one of my schematics anywhere.
text.completion: Thank you, friend.
text.completed: Return to Jasper Fel in Admiral Taylor's Garrison.

english.title: I See Dead People
english.objectives: Retrieve Bryan Finn's Schematic from Spectral Laborers.
english.description: Th... they're ghosts! All of them!$B$BBryan was one of my best friends. Something is clouding his mind; we need to snap him out of it and get to the bottom of this!$B$BHe was always obsessed with his work. Maybe showing him one of his schematics would help. One of the spectral laborers might have one.
english.progress: Я свой чертеж завсегда узнаю.
english.completion: Thank you, friend.
english.completed: Return to Jasper Fel in Admiral Taylor's Garrison.

objectiveDetails.description: 把图纸拿给布莱恩·费恩看

text.title: 融合仪式
text.objectives: 与卡拉迪奥斯交谈以开始融合仪式。
text.description: 是该让你接受融合仪式的时候了，$n。去和卡拉迪奥斯谈谈，以开始这个仪式，我会在这里等你的。$b$b在这个仪式中，你将目睹一个元素幻象。等仪式结束再回来找我，我们还有很多话要说。
text.completion: <Vindicator Nobundo listens closely as you speak of your vision.>$b$bThese are grave images of which you speak, $n! If Cho'gall continues bleeding the naaru of its Light, K'ure will die and in the naaru's place a void god will emerge. Void gods are terrible creatures that live only to destroy!$b$bWe must travel to Oshu'gun immediately and put a stop to the threat of Cho'gall!
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Nobundo.

english.title: The Ritual of Binding
english.objectives: Speak with Kalandrios to begin the Ritual of Binding.
english.description: It is time for you to undergo the Ritual of Binding, $n. I will wait here as you speak with Kalandrios to begin the rite.$b$bDuring the ritual, you will experience the vision of the elements. Return to me when the ritual is complete, and we will speak more.
english.completion: <Vindicator Nobundo listens closely as you speak of your vision.>$b$bThese are grave images of which you speak, $n! If Cho'gall continues bleeding the naaru of its Light, K'ure will die and in the naaru's place a void god will emerge. Void gods are terrible creatures that live only to destroy!$b$bWe must travel to Oshu'gun immediately and put a stop to the threat of Cho'gall!
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Nobundo.

text.title: 王座的召唤
text.objectives: 与元素王座的元素之怒沟通。
text.description: 一个声音呼唤着我，让我从塔拉多不远千里来到此地。$B$B四周空无一人，那个声音却出现在我的脑海中。$B$B“元素王座需要你。”那个声音这样说。$B$B它自称卡拉迪奥斯，并一路指引我来到此地。$B$B我从未来过这个地方，也从未亲眼见过元素之怒；但这里却给了我一种奇妙的既视感。就好像我在某个被遗忘的梦境中看过这副情景。$B$B我们应该和这些元素之怒沟通一下，听听它们怎么说。
text.completion: I am not sure what to make of this.$b$bThe elements are no longer in balance? The great fury Gordawg is missing and must be found?$b$bThe furies appear noble, and deep within my soul their words ring true.$b$bI believe we aid should them in their cause.

english.title: Called to the Throne
english.objectives: Commune with the furies at the Throne of Elements.
english.description: I was far from here in Talador when the voice called out to me.$b$bI looked around but found myself alone. Again, I heard the voice as if it were a breeze in my mind.$b$b"You are needed at the throne," it whispered.$b$bThe voice called itself Kalandrios, and it guided me to this place.$b$bI had never been here before, nor had I yet beheld these furies with my eyes; yet this feels strangely familiar to me as if it happened long ago in a forgotten dream.$b$bWe should greet the furies and hear them out.
english.completion: I am not sure what to make of this.$b$bThe elements are no longer in balance? The great fury Gordawg is missing and must be found?$b$bThe furies appear noble, and deep within my soul their words ring true.$b$bI believe we aid should them in their cause.

objectiveDetails.description: 与守备官努波顿谈一谈

text.title: 努波顿的邀请
text.objectives: 在元素王座找到守备官努波顿。
text.description: 有人想让你去一趟元素王座，$n。$b$b守备官努波顿在风中听到了元素之怒的呼唤，并已动身前去与它们进行沟通。$B$B我不清楚元素之怒的目的，但兽人一直将它们视作高尚强大的魂灵。
text.completion: I am glad to see that you have arrived safely.$B$BCome, there is much work to be done here.
text.completed: 与努波顿交谈。

english.title: Nobundo Sends Word
english.objectives: Find Vindicator Nobundo at the Throne of Elements.
english.description: Your presence has been requested at the Throne of Elements, $n.$b$bVindicator Nobundo has heard the call of the furies upon the wind and made the journey to commune with the elements.$b$bI know not what the intentions of the furies are, but they are revered as noble and powerful spirits by the orcs.
english.completion: Хорошо, что ты $gдобрался:добралась; сюда в добром здравии.$B$BИдем, нам многое предстоит сделать.
english.completed: Speak with Nobundo.

text.title: 元素协调
text.objectives: 与四根元素之柱共鸣。
text.description: 就连现在，卡拉迪奥斯的声音依然在我脑海里回响。$B$B“来自艾泽拉斯的英雄必须与这片高地的元素共鸣。”$B$B在这片元素高地上有四根巨大的柱子，它们由有生命的岩石雕刻而成。将你的手放在这些石柱上，就能完成与元素的共鸣。$B$B你可以先上去，我会继续与这些元素之怒沟通，进一步了解它们的想法。
text.completion: I see a fire within your eyes and a wind upon your step, $n.$b$bIf what Kalandrios speaks is true, you have attuned your life energy with each of the elemental forces on Draenor.$b$bThe voice says that you are now ready to undertake the Ritual of Binding.$b$bReturn to me when your work upon the plateau is finished and we will speak further.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Nobundo.

english.title: Elemental Attunement
english.objectives: Attune to the four elemental pillars.
english.description: Even now, as we speak, the voice of Kalandrios continues to whisper to my mind.$b$b"The Hero of Azeroth must attune to the elements of the plateau."$b$bUpon the Elemental Plateau are four great pillars carved of living rock. Lay your hands upon the stone pillars and your soul will be attuned with the elements.$b$bI will continue to commune with the great furies and attempt to further understand their will while you journey to the plateau.
english.completion: I see a fire within your eyes and a wind upon your step, $n.$b$bIf what Kalandrios speaks is true, you have attuned your life energy with each of the elemental forces on Draenor.$b$bThe voice says that you are now ready to undertake the Ritual of Binding.$b$bReturn to me when your work upon the plateau is finished and we will speak further.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Nobundo.

text.title: 震荡大地的声音
text.objectives: 从厚皮裂蹄牛身上取得$1oa对厚皮耳朵。
text.description: 指挥官。我和这位游侠刚刚在这里讨论各种和“打猎”相关的技巧。$B$B我跟她说我们军情七处装备精良，足以应对各种特殊状况，其中当然也包括猎捕野生动物。$B$B但她似乎认为我们根本就不懂怎么在“她的地盘”上打猎。$B$B我们总不能就这样被她说，对不对？我们去猎几头裂蹄牛吧。
text.progress: It's unbelievable how arrogant these rangari can be.
text.completion: Twelve pairs, huh? That's pretty good, commander.$B$BUm, no, I think that's about how many I managed to bag. Yeah... about a dozen pairs of ears. Yep....

english.title: That Pounding Sound
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Pairs of Leatherhide Ears from Leatherhide clefthoof.
english.description: Commander. The rangari and I were just discussing the merits of various 'hunting' approaches.$B$BI assured her that the SI:7 are well-equipped to deal with any situation, even ones out in the wild.$B$BShe seems to think that we don't know what we're doing when it comes to bringing down game in 'her land.'$B$BWe're not going to let her get away with saying that, right? Let's take down some clefthoof.
english.progress: It's unbelievable how arrogant these rangari can be.
english.completion: Twelve couples, huh? Not bad, commander. $B$BAlthough ... just the same amount I managed to get. Yes ... about a dozen pairs of ears. Yeah ...

text.title: 捕风捉蹄
text.objectives: 从风蹄塔布羊身上取得$1oa个风蹄羊角。
text.description: 琪雅和我打赌比谁能更迅速地消灭目标，我们分别代表军情七处和游侠。$B$B你愿意来参与下注吗，指挥官？$B$B我选择塔布羊作为目标，因为它们凶猛而威严，德拉诺当地人都把它们当成是纳格兰壮丽景色的代表。
text.progress: This outsider really thinks she can come here and best me in my own land?$B$BOh... sorry, commander. Present company excluded, of course.
text.completion: Twenty-four, huh? That's fine work.$B$BI brought back fifty.$B$BI'll send someone out for the meat. Waste not, want not.

english.title: Shooting the Breeze
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Breezestrider Horns from Breezestrider talbuk.
english.description: Kia and I are having a spirited debate over who kills more efficiently: SI:7 or rangari.$B$BCare to get in on the wager, commander?$B$BI've been focusing on talbuk because of their fierce majesty. They truly encapsulate the grandeur of Nagrand as any native of Draenor knows.
english.progress: This outsider really thinks she can come here and best me in my own land?$B$BOh... sorry, commander. Present company excluded, of course.
english.completion: Twenty-four, huh? Great. $B$BI have fifty.$B$BNow I'll send someone for meat - why is it good to disappear?

text.title: 临别请求
text.objectives: 从要塞狂躁的幽灵身上收集$1oa份鬼灵精华，并用它们来说服爱丽丝·费恩接受她的命运。
text.description: 我也不知道发生了什么事。我和工友们是最先被杀害的。$B$B我的妻子是旅店的老板，跟我一样处在神志不清的状态。我能感觉到……还有其他人跟她在一起。$B$B拜托了，让镇民们获得宁静，然后将他们的精华带给我的妻子。那应该能把她从冰冷的深渊中带回来。
text.progress: Everything is so hazy... what happened? Who are you?
text.completion: We're... dead?

english.title: A Parting Favor
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Spectral Essences from restless spirits inside the garrison and use them to convince Alice Finn of her fate.
english.description: I don't know what happened. My crew and I must have been the first to fall.$B$BMy wife, the innkeeper, is in the same stupor you found me in. I can feel it... and there are others with her.$B$BPlease, give the townsfolk peace and show their essences to my wife. That should bring her back from that cold abyss.
english.progress: Everything is in a fog ... What happened? Who are you?
english.completion: We're... dead?

text.title: 这儿发生了什么？
text.objectives: 找来一份布莱恩·费恩的图纸。
text.description: 这名建筑师的灵魂没有主动攻击我们。或许我们能破除笼罩他神智的迷雾，让他告诉我们这里发生了什么。$B$B我猜这里这些亡灵农夫的身上可能带着他的设计图纸之类的东西，可以拿去给他看，以便他恢复神智。$B$B我认为这值得一试。
text.completed: 回海军上将泰勒的要塞找暗影猎手乌卡比。

english.title: What Happened Here?
english.objectives: Search for one of Bryan Finn's Schematics.
english.description: Dis architect's spirit not be wantin' to fight us. Maybe we can break da haze over his mind and find out what happened.$B$BI bet one of da undead peasants has one of his schematics or somethin' we can show to him to clear his mind.$B$BIt be worth a shot.
english.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Ujambe in Admiral Taylor's Garrison.

text.title: 戈隆追猎者洛卡什的投诚
text.objectives: 接受剑圣纳什拉的血誓。
text.description: 你帮了我一个大忙。我的剑将为你所用。$b$b我在此发下血誓：我将辅佐于你，用我的剑术和采矿技术为你的部队效劳。$b$B你愿意接受我的效忠吗？
text.completion: You have proven yourself more powerful than my previous leaders. My service is yours.
text.giverWindow: 作为一名新晋的剑圣，纳什拉无疑是一位强大的战士和武器大师。

english.title: Defection of Gronnstalker Rokash
english.objectives: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
english.description: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.$b$bI offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.$b$BWill you accept it?
english.completion: You have proven yourself more powerful than my previous leaders. My service is yours.
english.giverWindow: New to the rank of Blademaster, Na'Shra is a formidable warrior and master of arms.

text.title: 神秘合剂
text.objectives: 在你的要塞与艾尼尔交谈。
text.description: 这瓶中的液体显然是某种强效炼金药剂，但凭你目前的技术无法辨识其作用。$b$b听说你的要塞里有个日暮港的村民懂点德拉诺炼金知识。也许你可以问问他？
text.completion: Ah. I see you have found a creation of Draenor alchemy.
text.completed: 在你的要塞与艾尼尔交谈。

english.title: The Mysterious Flask
english.objectives: Speak to Aenir at your garrison.
english.description: The liquid swirling around inside the flask clearly has strong alchemical properties, but its nature is beyond your training.$b$bYou have heard that one of the Eventide villagers at your garrison has some knowledge of the alchemy of Draenor. Perhaps he could tell you more?
english.completion: О! Я вижу, тебе в руки попало творение дренорских алхимиков.
english.completed: Speak to the Aenir at your garrison.

text.title: 年轻的炼金师
text.objectives: 在碧影湿地找到阿巴萨。
text.description: 我那点微末的炼金本事都是从我阿姨那学的。假如你真想学德拉诺的炼金术，那就应该去找我表姐阿巴萨谈谈。我阿姨去世前就一直在教她炼金术。$B$B现在她跟她父亲和妹妹住在一起，在碧影湿地那边。
text.completion: Please. Help me. I need to find my father.
text.completed: 找到阿巴萨。

english.title: The Young Alchemist
english.objectives: Find Abatha at the Verdant Mire.
english.description: I learned a little about alchemy from my aunt. If you want to know more, though, you should speak with my cousin Abatha. She was apprenticing under my aunt before she passed away.$b$bAbatha lives near the Verdant Mire with her father and sister.
english.completion: Прошу. Помоги. Мне надо найти отца.
english.completed: Find Abatha.

text.title: 失踪的父亲
text.objectives: 在碧影湿地找到泰罗斯。
text.description: 我很乐意回答你关于炼金术的问题，但眼下我担心我的父亲。$b$b他出门去河下游打猎很久了，但却一直没回家。我得照看露米尔。你能帮我去找找他吗？
text.completion: Thank you, stranger. I don't think the razorfangs were happy that I was hunting the same prey.
text.completed: 找到泰罗斯。

english.title: The Missing Father
english.objectives: Find Telos in the Verdant Mire.
english.description: I would be happy to help with your alchemical inquiries, but right now I am worried about my father.$b$bIt's been quite some time since he went hunting down by the river, but he still hasn't returned home. I need to watch Lumiel. Will you please find him?
english.completion: Спасибо, $gнезнакомец:незнакомка;. Видимо, остроклыкам не понравилось, что я охочусь на ту же жертву.
english.completed: Find Telos.

text.title: 震惊的援助
text.objectives: 从震鳞鳗鱼身上收集100片震颤之鳞。
text.description: 自从我妻子去世后，我就独自苦苦支撑着这个家，所以当我接到震颤之鳞的订单后，我变得太过雄心勃勃。$b$b哎，反正我现在也没法在交货期限到来前捉到足够多的震鳞鳗鱼了。
text.progress: Thank you so much for finding my father.
text.completion: You did this for my family? After you saved our father? Thank you, $n.$B$BYou wished to know about Draenor alchemy? I will do my best to share my knowledge with you.
text.completed: Return to Abatha.

english.title: Shocking Assistance
english.objectives: Collect 100 Shockscales from Shockscale eels.
english.description: It's been a struggle to support the family since my wife died, and I got too ambitious when I got a contract for shockscales.$b$bAlas, there is no way I will hunt enough eels to fulfill it in time now.
english.progress: Thank you so much for finding my father.
english.completion: Ты $gсделал:сделала; это ради нашей семьи? После того, как $gспас:спасла; нашего отца? От всего сердца благодарю тебя, $n.$b$bХочешь обучиться дренорской алхимии? Я научу тебя всему, чему только сумею.
english.completed: Return to Abatha.

text.title: 裂蹄牛的女王
text.objectives: 从班塔尔身上取得班塔尔的犄角。
text.description: 拉尔告诉我，班塔尔竟然还在这里！或者说，在这个时间点上她还活着……我刚才是不是说了很奇怪的话？$B$B总之，这是我们的好机会，指挥官。我们可以击败一头更年轻，更强大的班塔尔，给这帮游侠点颜色看看。$B$B让拉尔知道真正的专家不是好惹的。
text.progress: Banthar's horn. Hemet would be green with envy to have another shot at such a powerful beast.
text.completion: Magnificent kill, commander. You've done us all proud.
text.completed: Return to Kia Herman at Telaari Station.
text.giverWindow: 比外域的更加年轻，更加强壮。把她的犄角带来。

english.title: Queen of the Clefthoof
english.objectives: Collect the Horn of Banthar from Banthar.
english.description: Laara told me that they have Banthar here! Or rather, that she's still alive back now. Did what I just said make any sense?$B$BThis is our chance, commander. We can defeat a younger, more powerful version of Banthar and really stick it to these rangari.$B$BWe'll show Laara how a true professional works.
english.progress: Banthar's horn. Hemet would be green with envy to have another shot at such a powerful beast.
english.completion: Magnificent trophy, commander. We're all proud of you.
english.completed: Return to Kia Herman at Telaari Station.
english.giverWindow: A younger, more powerful version than the one on Outland. Return with her horn.

text.title: 谜题的一条线索
text.objectives: 杀死旅店地下室中的恐怖畸体。
text.description: 我……我想起来了。执勤官布兰森让我们躲在旅店里……他说这里会安全的。$B$B然后……然后那个怪物就破门而入，打倒了我们所有人！$B$B我最后的记忆，是看着它往储藏室里去了。
text.progress: Is the creature dead?
text.completion: I will convince the others of our fate. There's no denying it anymore.
text.completed: Speak to Alice Finn in the Inn.

english.title: A Piece of the Puzzle
english.objectives: Kill the Horrific Aberration in the basement of the inn.
english.description: I... I remember now. Watch Commander Branson told us to stay in the inn... he said we would be safe here.$B$BThen...$B$BThen that THING broke through and slaughtered everyone!$B$BThe last thing I remember seeing was it descending into the larder.
english.progress: Is the creature dead?
english.completion: I will convince the others of our fate. There's no denying it anymore.
english.completed: Speak to Alice Finn in the Inn.

text.title: 谁弄丢了箭矢？
text.objectives: 把游侠箭矢交给塔拉岗哨的游侠拉尔。
text.description: <这只塔布羊的身体一侧插着一支箭矢，这支箭很明显是游侠制作的。游侠拉尔可能会对此感兴趣。>
text.completion: That's MY arrow! Where'd you get it?

english.title: Someone's Missing Arrow
english.objectives: Take the Rangari Arrow to Rangari Laara at Telaari Station.
english.description: <An arrow of rangari make is sticking out of the side of this talbuk. Perhaps Rangari Laara will be interested in your find.>
english.completion: Это же моя стрела! Откуда она у тебя?

text.title: 风蹄之王
text.objectives: 从“高个子”巴克身上找到“高个子”巴克的尾巴。
text.description: 让我猜猜，你是在一头塔布羊的侧腹上找到它的？$B$B<拉尔沉思了一会儿。>这支箭原本是为风蹄之王，“高个子”巴克准备的。当时我正准备射击的时候，另一头塔布羊——也就是你刚猎杀的那头——突然从一旁跳了出来。$B$B我建议去你找巴克试试。以前我猎捕它的时候，它似乎喜欢在南边孤寂瀑布的池塘边散步。
text.progress: How goes the hunt for Tall Buck?
text.completion: Well done, $n. You succeeded where I did not.$B$BPerhaps you outsiders aren't such bad hunters after all.
text.completed: Return to Rangari Laara at Telaari Station.
text.giverWindow: 纳格兰的塔布羊之王

english.title: King of the Breezestriders
english.objectives: Collect Tall Buck's Tail from Tall Buck.
english.description: Let me guess, you found it in a talbuk's flank?$B$B<Laara seems lost in thought for a moment.>$B$BThat arrow was intended for Tall Buck, king of the Breezestriders. Another talbuk - the one you killed - jumped in the way as I was taking my shot.$B$BI suggest you go after the king. When I was hunting him, he seemed fond of the pond at Lonely Falls to the south.
english.progress: How goes the hunt for Tall Buck?
english.completion: Отлично, $n. Ты $gдобился:добилась; успеха там, где это не удалось мне.$B$BВозможно, среди чужаков действительно есть хорошие охотники.
english.completed: Return to Rangari Laara at Telaari Station.
english.giverWindow: King of all the talbuk in Nagrand.

text.description: 元素之灵已为你揭示了一个幻象，$n。$B$B我们将一同前往圣山沃舒古，解决那里的异常状况。$B$B假如你所见的幻象是真的，那么必定有巨大的危险在等待着我们。$b$b我会在沃舒古山脚下的幽魂林地等你。一旦你准备好启程，就和吉克斯莫·现钞说一声，他会带你飞往那里的。
text.completion: These woods are sacred to the orcs and to my people as well.$b$bBeneath the great mountain of Oshu'gun lies the heart of Nagrand, the Genedar. This great dimensional vessel rescued my people from annihilation and brought us to this world.

english.objectives: Fly to the Spirit Woods.
english.description: The elements have spoken and a vision has been revealed, $n.$b$bTogether we shall travel to the great mountain Oshu'gun and put an end to the dark disturbance there.$b$bIf what you saw in the vision is to be believed, then great danger awaits us.$b$bI will meet you in the Spirit Woods at the foot of Oshu'gun.
