text.title: 谁弄丢了斧头？
text.objectives: 把霜狼大斧交给沃尔瓦的追猎者奥戈卡。
text.description: <这只塔布羊的身体一侧插着一柄飞斧，这柄斧头很明显是霜狼兽人制作的。追猎者奥戈卡可能会对此感兴趣。>
text.completion: That's MY axe! Where'd you get it?

english.title: Someone's Missing Axe
english.objectives: Take the Frostwolf Axe to Stalker Ogka at Wor'var.
english.description: <A throwing axe of frostwolf make is sticking out of the side of this talbuk. Perhaps Stalker Ogka will be interested in your find.>
english.completion: That's MY axe! Where'd you get it?

text.title: 风蹄之王
text.objectives: 从“高个子”巴克身上找到“高个子”巴克的尾巴。
text.description: 让我猜猜，你是在一头塔布羊的侧腹上找到它的？$B$B<奥戈卡沉思了一会儿。>这柄斧头原本是为风蹄之王，“高个子”巴克准备的。当我正瞄准他的时候，另一头塔布羊——也就是你刚猎杀的那头——突然从一旁跳了出来。$B$B我建议去你找巴克试试。以前我猎捕它的时候，它似乎喜欢在南边孤寂瀑布的池塘边散步。
text.progress: How goes the hunt for Tall Buck?
text.completion: Well done, $n. You succeeded where I did not.$B$BPerhaps you outsiders aren't such bad hunters after all.
text.completed: Return to Stalker Ogka at Wor'var.
text.giverWindow: 纳格兰的塔布羊之王

english.title: King of the Breezestriders
english.objectives: Collect Tall Buck's Tail from Tall Buck.
english.description: Let me guess, you found it in a talbuk's flank?$B$B<Ogka seems lost in thought for a moment.>$B$BThat axe was intended for Tall Buck, king of the Breezestriders. Another talbuk - the one you killed - jumped in the way as I was taking my shot.$B$BI suggest you go after the king. When I was hunting him, he seemed fond of the pond at Lonely Falls to the south.
english.progress: How goes the hunt for Tall Buck?
english.completion: Well done, $n. You succeeded where I did not.$B$BPerhaps you outsiders aren't such bad hunters after all.
english.completed: Return to Stalker Ogka at Wor'var.
english.giverWindow: King of all the talbuk in Nagrand.

text.title: 二把手
text.objectives: 在海军上将泰勒的要塞与爱德华爵士对话。
text.description: 等等……我还记得……$B$B爱德华爵士……当时他在喊……要去找谁。$B$B我……我不记得了。当时的惨叫声太多了……
text.completion: If today was any other day I'd have you court-martialed for being out of uniform.
text.completed: Speak to Sir Edward at Admiral Taylor's Garrison.

english.title: Second in Command
english.objectives: Speak to Sir Edward at Admiral Taylor's Garrison.
english.description: Wait... I remember something else.$B$BSir Edward... he was shouting... looking for someone.$B$BI... I can't remember who. There were so many screams...
english.completion: If today was any other day I'd have you court-martialed for being out of uniform.
english.completed: Speak to Sir Edward at Admiral Taylor's Garrison.

text.title: 战歌的威胁
text.objectives: 偷取战歌攻击计划。
text.description: <这份攻击计划是用粘稠的黑色墨水在粗皮料镶边的羊皮纸上潦草写成的。>$B$B通告所有侦察骑兵岗哨：$B$B督军有令，所有侦察骑兵准备对踏入我们土地的联盟入侵者展开全面进攻。具体攻击计划已分发到各个侦察骑兵岗哨。$B$B鲜血与荣耀属于战歌氏族！我们必将把联盟入侵者践踏于我们的脚下！$B$B战歌氏族听从督军的一切命令！Lok'tar ogar！
text.progress: What do you have for me?
text.completion: <Captain Washburn examines the attack plans, squinting at the lettering and holding the pages upside down.>$b$bHmm... I see... yes... indeed!$b$bThese are obviously attack plans, as you yourself have stated, but they are most likely written by kobold pyromancers.$b$bStrange though, I haven't seen any kobold pyromancers since my days in Azeroth. No matter! I assure you that the outpost is well armed and mostly fireproof!$b$bIf we are attacked, the outpost shan't fall. You have my word, commander!

english.title: The Warsong Threat
english.objectives: Steal the Warsong Attack Plans.
english.description: <The attack plans are scrawled onto the parchment in thick, black ink and bound in rough leather.>$b$bTo all outrider stations:$b$bThe warlord has commanded that all outriders prepare for a full assault upon the Alliance invaders in our land. Plans for the attack have been delivered to several of the remote outrider posts.$b$bBlood and glory shall be ours as we trample the Alliance invaders beneath our feet!$b$bThe warlord commands and the Warsong obey! Lok'tar ogar!
english.progress: What do you have for me?
english.completion: <Captain Washburn examines the attack plans, squinting at the lettering and holding the pages upside down.>$b$bHmm... I see... yes... indeed!$b$bThese are obviously attack plans, as you yourself have stated, but they are most likely written by kobold pyromancers.$b$bStrange though, I haven't seen any kobold pyromancers since my days in Azeroth. No matter! I assure you that the outpost is well armed and mostly fireproof!$b$bIf we are attacked, the outpost shan't fall. You have my word, commander!

text.title: 穿越扭曲虚空
text.objectives: 进入扭曲虚空。
text.description: 虚空仪式被阻止了，可黑暗能量仍在不断地流入各个仪式场的虚空道标之中。这只能有一个原因：这些道标的能量是由扭曲虚空直接供给的。$B$B切断这些虚空能量流的唯一方法就只有进入扭曲虚空，然后消除潜伏在那里的能量！$B$B使用那边的道标进入扭曲虚空。一旦你到了那里，就使用元素之怒赐给我们的萨满之石来联系我。$B$B愿圣光与你同在。

english.title: Through The Nether
english.objectives: Travel to the Twisting Nether.
english.description: The void rituals have been disrupted, but dark energy still flows into the nether beacons at the ritual sites. This can only mean that the beacons are being powered from within the Twisting Nether itself.$b$bThe only way to sever the flow of void energy to the beacons is to travel into the Twisting Nether and stop whatever power lurks there!$b$bUse a beacon to travel to the Twisting Nether. Once there, us the shaman stone given to us by the furies to contact me.$b$bLight be with you.

objectiveDetails.description: Speak with the image of Nobundo

text.title: 虚空的大军
text.objectives: 摧毁$oa只虚空生物。
text.description: 虚空恐魔的大军正向着沃舒古汇聚，并一一将它们的身躯奉献给虚空领主伊瓦里杜斯。每当那些虚空恐魔死亡，伊瓦里杜斯就会变得更加强大。那些下级的生物似乎纯粹是为了被虚空领主吞噬而存在的。$B$B伊瓦里杜斯的力量正在不断增强，我们必须趁在还能阻止它的时候将它消灭。$B$B尽可能地杀死那些虚空怪物以减缓伊瓦里杜斯的成长速度。我会尽快想出一个能与伊瓦里杜斯作战的方法。

english.title: The Void March
english.objectives: Destroy $oa Void Creatures.
english.description: Legions of void terrors are marching upon Oshu'gun and sacrificing themselves to the void lord Invalidus.$b$bAs they die Invalidus grows stronger. It is as if the lesser creatures only serve to feed the void lord.$b$bWe must stop Invalidus from becoming so powerful that it cannot be stopped.$b$bSlay as many void monsters as you can, to slow the growth of Invalidus. In the meantime, I will search for a way to encounter Invalidus before it is too late to stop it.

text.title: 停止召唤
text.objectives: 杀死所有的战歌仪式领袖。
text.description: 战歌萨满正使用元素之力来引导虚空能量。$B$B我虽然不是萨满，但也知道这种行为在大多数兽人氏族里是被禁止的。虚空之力是圣光的反面，是无序和毁灭的根源。$B$B这些仪式会削弱扭曲虚空与这个世界之间的壁障。要是不阻止这些仪式的话，这片土地很快就会被扭曲虚空的住民所填满。$B$B杀死那些主持这些黑暗仪式的萨满，迟了的话，毁灭就会降临到我们的头上。

english.title: Silence The Call
english.objectives: Slay the Warsong ritual leaders.
english.description: The Warsong shaman are using the elements to channel dark energy from the void.$b$bI am no shaman, but even I know that such practices are abhored by most orc clans. The power of the void is opposite to the Light, and a source of entropy and destruction.$b$bThese rituals thin the veil between our world and the Twisting Nether. Should the rituals continue, this land will soon be overrun by the denizens of the Twisting Nether.$b$bSlay the shaman leading these dark rituals before destruction falls upon us!

text.title: 笼罩沃舒古的阴影
text.objectives: 召唤并击败伊瓦里杜斯。
text.description: 虚空领主伊瓦里杜斯在沃舒古的山顶上吸食着亡者的灵魂。$B$B甚至那些死去的虚空恐魔也成为了它的食粮。$B$B我们必须立刻行动，否则这个怪物会变得越来越强大，让我们无法应付了。$B$B在扭曲虚空中的每一处仪式场地上，都有一颗充满了虚空能量的水晶。只要触碰这种水晶，伊瓦里杜斯就会注意到你的存在。$B$B准备好，伊瓦里杜斯会第一时间试图吸食你的灵魂。
text.completed: I need text

english.title: The Shadow Over Oshu'gun
english.objectives: Summon and defeat Invalidus.
english.description: The void lord Invalidus stands atop the peak of Oshu'gun gorging itself upon the souls of the dead.$b$bEven the fallen void terrors that you slew only served to feed the monster.$b$bIf we do not act now, Invalidus will grow too powerful to encounter alone.$b$bAt each of the ritual sites in the Twisting Nether, there is a crystal filled with the powers of the void. Disturb the void crystal and Invalidus will sense your presence.$b$bBe ready, Invalidus will waste no time in attempting to feed on your soul.
english.completed: I need text

text.title: 破坏仪式
text.objectives: 摧毁仪式图腾。
text.description: 战歌兽人在沃舒古的山脚下进行着黑暗的仪式。$B$B战歌萨满意图从圣山的中心吸取虚空能量来强化他们的氏族。$B$B我并不了解这虚空能量的源头……但这恐怕与飞船中濒死的纳鲁克乌雷有关。$B$B我们必须阻止这些战歌仪祭师，否则这个世界与扭曲虚空之间屏障将被撕裂。$B$B找到他们用来维持仪式的仪式图腾，并摧毁它们。

english.title: Disrupt The Rituals
english.objectives: Destroy the Ritual Totems.
english.description: Beneath the mountain of Oshu'gun the Warsong perform dark rituals.$b$bThe Warsong shaman seek to empower their clan by drawing upon a great source of void energy within the heart of Oshu'gun.$b$bThough I do not know for certain the source of this power...I fear that the dying naaru K'ure may be involved.$b$bThe Warsong rituals must be stopped or the veil that separates this world from the Twisting Nether will be ripped apart.$b$bLocate the ritual totems used to channel these rituals and destroy them.

text.title: 虚空迫近
text.objectives: 摧毁$oa道虚空传送门。
text.description: 战歌氏族吸取虚空能量的愚行削弱了我们的世界和扭曲虚空之间的壁障。$B$B扭曲虚空中正不断有传送门在打开，意图将虚空的怪物们引往德拉诺。$B$B一旦这些传送门彻底开始运作，各种各样的恶魔和虚空怪物将席卷纳格兰。$B$B快趁这些传送门还没开始运作前摧毁它们！
text.completed: I need text

english.title: The Nether Approaches
english.objectives: Collapse $oa Void Portals.
english.description: By drawing upon the power of the void, the Warsong have thinned the veil that shields our world from the Twisting Nether.$b$bPortals are opening within the nether that threaten to connect the terrors of the void to Draenor.$b$bShould these portals fully open, the path will be clear for all manner of demons and void creatures to rampage across Nagrand.$b$bGo and collapse the portals before they become functional!
english.completed: I need text

text.title: 幽灵问题
text.objectives: 与先祖之地的灵魂沟通。
text.description: 长久以来，亡者的灵魂都会被引往沃舒古。$B$B从我记事时起，这片森林就遍布着前往圣山中心朝圣的先祖们的灵魂。我担心那些前往圣山的灵魂很可能会被山中的不断滋长的虚空力量所吞噬。$B$B前往先祖之地，与那里的灵魂进行沟通，就这个问题寻求他们的指引。
text.completion: The situation here is dire, $n, but I sensed that we would meet again.$b$bI do not hear the call of the void as loudly as the others, for I am not long dead and my body rests far from this place.$b$bWith time though, that will change.$b$bIf you are here to help, listen closely for time is short.
text.completed: I NEED TEXT

english.title: Spiritual Matters
english.objectives: Speak with the spirits at the Ancestral Grounds.
english.description: The spirits of the dead have long been drawn to the mountain of Oshu'gun.$b$bAs long as I can remember, the woods have been filled with ancestral spirits making a ghostly pilgrimage to the heart of the mountain. I fear that the souls drawn to Oshu'gun are being consumed by the growing void within the mountain.$b$bMake your way to the Ancestral Grounds and commune with the spirits there for guidance.
english.completion: The situation here is dire, $n, but I sensed that we would meet again.$b$bI do not hear the call of the void as loudly as the others, for I am not long dead and my body rests far from this place.$b$bWith time though, that will change.$b$bIf you are here to help, listen closely for time is short.
english.completed: I NEED TEXT

text.title: The Pale Threat
text.objectives: Return to Vindicator Nobundo.
text.description: In the time that you have been fighting against the void, I have been exploring the disturbance within Shadowfall Canyon.$b$bA dark mist has settled in the canyon, $n; and I found twisted, pale creatures lurking there.$b$bWe have much to discuss. Return to me from the Twisting Nether and we will speak more.

english.title: The Pale Threat
english.objectives: Return to Vindicator Nobundo.
english.description: In the time that you have been fighting against the void, I have been exploring the disturbance within Shadowfall Canyon.$b$bA dark mist has settled in the canyon, $n; and I found twisted, pale creatures lurking there.$b$bWe have much to discuss. Return to me from the Twisting Nether and we will speak more.

text.title: 戈达乌的命运
text.objectives: 找回愤怒之心。
text.description: 拦在内殿前方的这个巨大的元素生物正是我们要寻找的大地之怒，我们原本要把它带回元素王座。$b$b眼前的戈达乌已沦为了古加尔的奴隶。看到这个伟大的生物失去了心智，被邪恶的力量奴役，让我备感痛心。$b$b但我们已经无法回头，为了继续前进，只有击败戈达乌。$b$b虽然这令我十分痛苦，但戈达乌必须被消灭。$b$b干掉戈达乌，把愤怒之心带回元素王座——那个它本该存在的地方。
text.progress: What of Gordawg? Has the great fury been brought to rest?
text.completion: Gordawg was a mighty ally. The elements will mourn the loss of the fury, but death was the only answer. Gordawg would not have wished to stay a slave to evil.$b$bThough Gordawg is no more, the heart of a fury is eternal and unbreakable. In time, this brightly glowing heart will take shape into a new earthen fury.$b$bSuch is the cycle of life upon the Elemental Plateau.
text.completed: Bring the Heart of the Fury to Kalandrios.
text.giverWindow: 只有死亡，才能帮助伟大的大地之怒摆脱古加尔的魔爪。

english.title: The Fate of Gordawg
english.objectives: Retrieve the Heart of the Fury.
english.description: Looming monstrously between us and the inner chamber is the great fury we have sought to return to the Throne of Elements.$b$bGordawg stands before us enthralled; a slave to Cho'gall. My heart is heavy with grief to see such a great creature mindless and enslaved by evil.$b$bThere is no going back, in order to push forward you must go through Gordawg.$b$bIt pains me, but Gordawg must be slain.$b$bSlay Gordawg and return the fury's heart to the Throne of Elements where it belongs.
english.progress: What of Gordawg? Has the great fury been brought to rest?
english.completion: Gordawg was a mighty ally. The elements will mourn the loss of the fury, but death was the only answer. Gordawg would not have wished to stay a slave to evil.$b$bThough Gordawg is no more, the heart of a fury is eternal and unbreakable. In time, this brightly glowing heart will take shape into a new earthen fury.$b$bSuch is the cycle of life upon the Elemental Plateau.
english.completed: Bring the Heart of the Fury to Kalandrios.
english.giverWindow: Death is the only way to free the great fury from Cho'gall's grasp.

text.title: 沃舒古的黑暗之心
text.objectives: 进入纳鲁圣所。
text.description: 在这些古老的吉尼达尔的残骸之中，有着通往飞船内殿的入口。那儿似乎也是虚空能量最为集中的地方。$B$B你必须进入内殿，消灭盘踞在其中的邪恶。伟大的纳鲁克乌雷也沉睡在那里，我对它如今的命运十分不安，但无论如何，邪恶必须被清除。$B$B愿圣光与你同在，$n。
text.completion: The fate of K'ure could not have been prevented.$b$bCho'gall accelerated the naaru's transition into a void god in hopes of bringing destruction upon Draenor. Cho'gall must be dealt with, but for now let us honor the memory of the great naaru K'ure.$b$bK'ure was truly the savior of my people, a friend to the virtuous, and a teacher of prophets.$b$bMay the great naaru ever live within our hearts.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Nobundo.

english.title: The Dark Heart of Oshu'gun
english.objectives: Enter the Sanctum of the Naaru.
english.description: Amongst the timeworn wreckage of the Genedar is the entrance to the vessel's inner chamber. The void energy appears to be most concentrated in that place.$b$bYou must enter the inner chamber and face whatever evil lurks within. I fear whatever fate may have befallen the great naaru K'ure in that place, but regardless the evil there must be purged.$b$bMay the Light be with you, $n.
english.completion: The fate of K'ure could not have been prevented.$b$bCho'gall accelerated the naaru's transition into a void god in hopes of bringing destruction upon Draenor. Cho'gall must be dealt with, but for now let us honor the memory of the great naaru K'ure.$b$bK'ure was truly the savior of my people, a friend to the virtuous, and a teacher of prophets.$b$bMay the great naaru ever live within our hearts.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Nobundo.

text.title: 白鬼的威胁
text.objectives: 消灭格雷希尔和$2oa个白鬼兽人。
text.description: 如果我们想要成功阻止古加尔毁灭纳鲁，就得沿着苍白地穴一路杀过去，那是一处黑暗蜿蜒的洞穴，里面满是白鬼作乱。$b$b白鬼是堕落的兽人，是与善良和神圣背道而驰的邪恶族群。要是继续任由他们在地下摆弄那些设备，他们的邪恶图谋就会变得一发而不可收拾。$b$b到苍白地穴里去，消灭里面那些邪恶的怪物，并除掉他们的首领格雷希尔。
text.completion: The Pale are wretched creatures that hate the Light and plot against the innocent. Without Greyseer to lead them, they will be disorganized and in chaos for a time.$b$bShould a new leader arise from within their ranks, we shall smite them down once more.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Nobundo.

english.title: The Pale Threat
english.objectives: Kill Greyseer and $2oa Pale orcs.
english.description: If we are to succeed in stopping Cho'gall from destroying the naaru, we will need to fight our way through the Underpale; a dark, winding cavern infested with the Pale.$b$bThe Pale are fallen orcs that despise all that is good and holy. The longer they are left to their devices beneath the ground, the further their dark plots progress.$b$bMake your way into the Underpale, slay the vile creatures within and take out their leader, Greyseer.
english.completion: The Pale are wretched creatures that hate the Light and plot against the innocent. Without Greyseer to lead them, they will be disorganized and in chaos for a time.$b$bShould a new leader arise from within their ranks, we shall smite them down once more.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Nobundo.

text.title: 黑暗禁锢
text.objectives: 释放$1oa个元素之灵。
text.description: 白鬼们正在坠影峡谷中组建一支受奴役的元素大军。许多元素已经落入了他们的魔掌，假如我们置之不理，受奴役的元素只会不断增加。$B$B我们必须阻止白鬼，并解放那些被他们奴役的元素。$B$B前往坠影峡谷，解放那些尚未被白鬼完全奴役的元素之灵。至于那些已经完全成为了傀儡的元素，我们只能对它们展现最后的仁慈，赐予它们迅速的死亡。
text.completion: You have done well to free the elemental spirits from their bonds. If Cho'gall and the pale seek an army of elemental slaves, they must not be allowed to succeed.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Nobundo.

english.title: Dark Binding
english.objectives: Free $1oa elemental spirits.
english.description: Even as we speak, the pale are enslaving an army of elementals in Shadowfall Canyon. Many have already been enslaved and if we do not lend our aid, more will follow.$b$bGo to Shadowfall Canyon and set free the elemental spirits which are not yet fully enthralled by the pale. As for those already enslaved, the only mercy we can give them now is a swift death.
english.completion: You have done well to free the elemental spirits from their bonds. If Cho'gall and the pale seek an army of elemental slaves, they must not be allowed to succeed.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Nobundo.

text.title: 悲惨的命运
text.objectives: 在刀叶林地里寻找托格·护耳、噬面者麦卡和没鼻子的查格。
text.description: 你们的狼后不许我远离她的视线。$b$b玛戈隆的孩子们或许是毁掉了我的村庄，可是原祖荆兽的孩子们却带走了我的族人。$b$b木精和它们的爪牙把我们的族人拖进了刀叶林地，即便我们能再见面，他们也肯定已经被折磨得面目全非了。$b$b既然你已经帮助过嘲颅氏族，我想让你再帮我个忙。$b$b进入刀叶林地，寻找我那些不久前被带走的族人。$b$b他们可能还活着。
text.completion: Dead? All dead? Dead and mulched and forgotten. No Chag with his missing nose or Meka with her love for chewing faces.$b$bAnd Torg, my beloved Torg. A son we had together. A son that is still missing.$b$bThe botani will pay for this. They will burn for this.
text.completed: Return to Kaz the Shrieker at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.

english.title: Mossy Fate
english.objectives: Search for Torg Earkeeper, Meka the Face Chewer, and Chag the Noseless in Razorbloom.
english.description: Your wolf queen will not let me out of her sight.$b$bThe children of the magnaron may have destroyed my village but it was the children of the genesaur who took my people.$b$bThe botani and their minions drag our people to the Razorbloom, and if we see them again, it is not as they were in life.$b$BYou have already helped the Skulls, so I ask your help again.$b$bEnter the Razorbloom and search for my people that were recently taken.$b$bPerhaps they may even be alive.
english.completion: Dead? All dead? Dead and mulched and forgotten. No Chag with his missing nose or Meka with her love for chewing faces.$b$bAnd Torg, my beloved Torg. A son we had together. A son that is still missing.$b$bThe botani will pay for this. They will burn for this.
english.completed: Return to Kaz the Shrieker at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.

text.title: 被感染者
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa名被感染的兽人。
text.description: 我明白卡兹迫切地想要救她的族人，可她的计划太过鲁莽，而且对我们有所隐瞒。$b$b我的任务是要确保她没有在酝酿任何针对我们的计划，结果我发现了这个……这个……恐怖的场面。$b$b木精究竟对这些兽人做了什么？$b$b这些被感染的灵魂理应得到安宁。让它们安息吧。
text.completion: These creatures... were not what I expected to see. I always knew Gorgrond to be a dangerous place, but I never could have guessed at how vile.$b$bThank you, commander, for your compassion in this.
text.completed: Return to Draka at the Beastwatch in Gorgrond.

english.title: The Infested
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Infested Orcs.
english.description: I understand Kaz's desire to rescue her people, but her plan is reckless and she is not telling us everything.$b$bI came along to make sure she wasn't devising a plan against us and now I see this... this... horror.$b$bWhat did the botani do to these orcs?$b$bThese infested souls need to be put to rest. Give them peace.
english.completion: These creatures... were not what I expected to see. I always knew Gorgrond to be a dangerous place, but I never could have guessed at how vile.$b$bThank you, commander, for your compassion in this.
english.completed: Return to Draka at the Beastwatch in Gorgrond.

text.title: 艾韵之音
text.objectives: 消灭艾韵之音。
text.description: 木精和它们卑鄙的爪牙不断地索取索取再索取。$b$b它们想要食物，就夺取了我们的土地；它们想要军队，就掳走了我们的族人。$b$b必须要让这些植物怪那灌木般的心脏感受到恐惧。$b$B去找出它们的首领——艾韵之音。那是代表它们原祖荆兽主人发言的木精。$b$b消灭掉木精备受倚重的首领，保住这片珍贵的林地。
text.completion: It isn't enough to kill the botani. They will always have greater numbers.$b$bYou must cut them deep and hard, where it hurts them the most.$b$bLike slaying their most sacred leader.
text.completed: Return to Kaz the Shrieker outside Razorbloom in Gorgrond.
text.giverWindow: 他为原祖荆兽代言。

english.title: The Voice of Iyu
english.objectives: Slay the Voice of Iyu.
english.description: The botani and their wretched minions take and take and take.$b$bThey want food, they take our land. They want an army, they take our people.$b$bIt is important to strike fear into the shrubby hearts of these plant people.$b$BLook for their leader, the Voice of Iyu. It is a botani who speaks on behalf of their genesaur master.$b$bKill their precious leader in the safety of his precious bloom.
english.completion: It isn't enough to kill the botani. They will always have greater numbers.$b$bYou must cut them deep and hard, where it hurts them the most.$b$bLike slaying their most sacred leader.
english.completed: Return to Kaz the Shrieker outside Razorbloom in Gorgrond.
english.giverWindow: He speaks for the genesaur.

text.title: 超级种子
text.objectives: 收集浓缩之种。
text.description: 木精小心地保护着这些种子。$b$b在这些微小的生命体里涌动着巨大的能量。$b$b这些也许很有用处。
text.progress: What have you found?
text.completion: Seeds. So simple to look at but in each the potential for untold amounts of destruction. Much like my son.$b$bYou were wise to take these.
text.completed: Speak with Kaz the Shrieker at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.

english.title: Super Seeds
english.objectives: Collect Enriched Seeds.
english.description: These seeds have been shielded with care by the botani.$b$bGreat power can be felt surging out of these tiny vessels of life.$b$bThese may prove useful.
english.progress: Что удалось найти?
english.completion: Seeds. So simple to look at but in each the potential for untold amounts of destruction. Much like my son.$b$bYou were wise to take these.
english.completed: Speak with Kaz the Shrieker at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.

text.title: 处死
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa名要塞叛徒。
text.description: 那帮叛徒！$B$B在你眼前的是依然忠于联盟和海军上将泰勒的最后一批战士。$B$B堵上我的名誉，绝不能让那帮叛贼逃走。$B$B你看起来已经准备充分，让他们瞧瞧战争时期我们是怎么对待叛徒的。
text.completion: Well fought. For the Alliance!
text.completed: Return to Sir Edward in Admiral Taylor's Garrison.

english.title: Punishable by Death
english.objectives: Kill $1oa garrison traitors.
english.description: Traitors, the lot!$B$BYou're looking at the last bastion of forces still loyal to Admiral Taylor and the Alliance.$B$BI'll be damned if the defectors get away clean.$B$BYou look like you're ready. Show them how we deal with their kind during times of war.
english.completion: Well fought. For the Alliance!
english.completed: Return to Sir Edward in Admiral Taylor's Garrison.

text.title: 装填弹药
text.objectives: 获得$1oa枚铁舰炮弹和$2oa门军械库火炮。
text.description: 叛军占领了军械库。我们手头只剩下几门没有炮弹的大炮。$B$B士兵，我要你去夺取弹药，好让这些玩意儿动起来。$B$B另外，要是你能再弄到一两门炮，那就再好不过了。
text.progress: I hope you're toting a cannon and some balls, soldier.
text.completion: Good job, soldier.
text.completed: Return to Lady Claudia in Admiral Taylor's Garrison.

english.title: Prime the Cannons
english.objectives: Recover $1oa Ironcoat Cannonballs and $2oa Armory Cannon.
english.description: The armory is lost to the traitors. All we have left are these few cannons with no ammunition.$B$BSoldier, I need you to recover cannonballs so we can get these things running.$B$BActually, one more cannon wouldn't hurt, either.
english.progress: Надеюсь, у тебя есть пушка и пара стальных ядер к ней, солдат.
english.completion: Good job, soldier.
english.completed: Return to Lady Claudia in Admiral Taylor's Garrison.

text.title: 祖尔格拉布（奖励目标）奖励任务
托维尔失落之城奖励任务

english.title: Lost City of the Tol'vir Reward Quest

text.title: 托维尔失落之城奖励任务

english.title: Lost City of the Tol'vir Reward Quest

text.title: 原祖荆兽的力量
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德的蛮兽岗哨与杜隆坦谈一谈。
text.description: 指挥官，你现在有了起源之水、原祖荆兽的意志和足够的种子，足以培养出一支大军了。更别提你还救了许多嘲颅成员的性命。$B$B总结下来，这次任务还是相当成功的。$B$B我会留下进一步调查这座堡垒，顺便看看有什么能利用的材料。$B$B与此同时，你先回岗哨把你找到的这些神器交给杜隆坦吧。等我们完成这里的工作就会追上你的。
text.completion: Well done, Commander. Many of the orcs have tried to master the power of the genesaur but I have never heard of any succeeding.$B$BYou have won us a powerful weapon for the next time we face the Iron Horde.
text.completed: 在戈尔隆德的蛮兽岗哨与杜隆坦谈一谈。

english.title: Power of the Genesaur
english.objectives: Speak with Durotan at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
english.description: Commander, you now have the Will of the Genesaur along with the genesis water and enough seeds to grow an army. Not to mention the Laughing Skulls you helped save.$b$bI would call this mission a success.$b$BI will investigate this fortress further and see if there are more materials we might glean from it.$b$bIn the meantime, you may want to bring these artifacts you have obtained to Durotan back at the outpost. I will catch up once we have finished here.
english.completion: Превосходно, командир. Многие орки пытались завладеть силой генезотавров, но, по-моему, никому еще не удалось этого добиться.$b$bЭто даст нам значительное преимущество, когда мы в следующий раз сойдемся с Железной Ордой.
english.completed: Speak with Durotan at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.

text.title: 花粉的力量
text.objectives: 收集$1oa份强效花粉。
text.description: 我们当中那些在戈尔隆德长大的人早就了解到了一些关于木精的秘密，可以用来种植我们自己的植物。$b$b因此没有哪个嘲颅成员会忍饥挨饿。$b$b掠食者就是关键所在。$b$b在永晨之泉外面，你可以找到各种类型的掠食者。干掉它们，把它们携带的花粉交给我，我就能为你的要塞培育出植物来。
text.progress: Few dare challenge the botani in the field of growing plants.
text.completion: Ah... yes, yes, yes. Fresh pollen. With a dash of a few secret ingredients you can feed an army with the food you could grow from this, if you know the secret ways.
text.completed: Speak with Kaz the Shrieker at Evermorn Springs in Gorgrond.

english.title: Pollen Power
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Potent Pollen.
english.description: Those of us who grew up in Gorgrond have long learned a few secrets of the botani that can be used to grow our own plants.$b$bThere is no such thing as a hungry Laughing Skull for this reason.$b$bThe ravagers are the key.$b$bOutside of Evermorn Springs you will find ravagers of every type. Slay them and bring me the pollen they carry, and I can cultivate it to be of use to your garrison.
english.progress: Немногие рискнут бросить вызов ботани там, где цветут растения.
english.completion: Ah... yes, yes, yes. Fresh pollen. With a dash of a few secret ingredients you can feed an army with the food you could grow from this, if you know the secret ways.
english.completed: Speak with Kaz the Shrieker at Evermorn Springs in Gorgrond.

text.title: 快刀
text.objectives: 找到快刀。
text.description: 你找到了很多嘲颅兽人。全是我的朋友和爱人，全都死了。但你还没找到我的宝贝快刀。$B$B他们肯定是把它带到永晨之泉去了。$B$B找到他，救出他。$B$B他是个好孩子，可不能变成花肥死了。$B$B我会集结一些掠食者，把那翻个底朝天。要是你比我先找到快刀，就去永晨之泉找我吧。
text.completion: The botani took my dad. They took my friends. And now they are making me eat fruit!$b$bWhy are they so mean?!$b$bDid you kill them all?$b$bI think you should kill them.
text.completed: 在永晨之泉找到快刀。

english.title: Cutter
english.objectives: Find Cutter.
english.description: You found many Laughing Skulls. All friends, all loved, all dead. But you did not find my precious Cutter.$b$bThey must have taken him to Evermorn Springs.$b$bFind him, and rescue him.$b$bHe is a good boy, and deserves a better death than infesting.$b$bI am going to round up some ravagers and take the place by air. Look for me in Evermorn if you find Cutter before I do.
english.completion: The botani took my dad. They took my friends. And now they are making me eat fruit!$b$bWhy are they so mean?!$b$bDid you kill them all?$b$bI think you should kill them.
english.completed: Find Cutter in Evermorn Springs.

text.title: The Best Poison
text.objectives: Collect $1oa Reaver Vines.
text.description: Do you like poisons? I am more of a "set everything on fire and loot what doesn't burn" kind of orc myself.$b$bBut I do know a thing or two about poisons.$b$bWhen you venture into the Razor Bloom, look for a pungent, violent plant that we call Reaver Vine. Under just the right circumstances, and FIRE, the vine will make a lovely poison. Bring me some and I shall concoct a lovely poison for you.
text.completed: Speak with Kaz at Razor Bloom in Gorgrond.

english.title: The Best Poison
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Reaver Vines.
english.description: Do you like poisons? I am more of a "set everything on fire and loot what doesn't burn" kind of orc myself.$b$bBut I do know a thing or two about poisons.$b$bWhen you venture into the Razor Bloom, look for a pungent, violent plant that we call Reaver Vine. Under just the right circumstances, and FIRE, the vine will make a lovely poison. Bring me some and I shall concoct a lovely poison for you.
english.completed: Speak with Kaz at Razor Bloom in Gorgrond.

text.title: 斩除杂草
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa名繁花编织者。
text.description: 卡兹在利用我们，我敢肯定这一点。她是嘲颅成员，不值得被信任。$b$b在我们有更深入的了解之前，我愿意暂时跟她合作。$b$b卡兹会要求你前往永晨之泉。到那之后，我建议你消灭任何遇到的木精。$b$b只有削减这些可怕敌人的数量，才有希望使将来的其他兽人免于被感染的命运。$b$b我会守着卡兹，密切观察她的动态。
text.completion: I had thought the Laughing Skull were planning something. Now I think I am beginning to understand.$b$bThey match savagery with savagery.
text.completed: Speak with Draka at Evermorn Springs.

english.title: Bushwhacker
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Bloom Weavers.
english.description: Kaz is using us, I am sure of it. She is a Laughing Skull and must NOT be trusted.$b$bFor now, I am willing to play along until we can learn more. $b$bKaz is going to ask for you to travel to Evermorn Springs. When there, I recommend you slay any botani you encounter.$b$bCulling the numbers of these horrific casters will hopefully save future orcs from such a infested fate.$b$bI will stay with Kaz and keep a close eye on her.
english.completion: I had thought the Laughing Skull were planning something. Now I think I am beginning to understand.$b$bThey match savagery with savagery.
english.completed: Speak with Draka at Evermorn Springs.

text.title: 快刀斩乱木
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa名晨露大师。
text.description: 他们竟然偷孩子？孩子？！$b$b要不是你救了卡兹的儿子，他已经跟其他人一样变成花肥了。$b$b你得向他们传递一条明确的信息。干掉他们最强大的晨露大师。把他们撕成碎片。$b$b让他们知道夺走我们的孩子是会遭殃的。
text.completion: They are lucky you are the one that killed them. I would have tried to carve pictures in their dead wood bodies.
text.completed: Speak with Draka at Evermorn Springs.

english.title: Cut Them Down
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Dew Masters.
english.description: They steal children? Children?!$b$bHad you not rescued Kaz's child, he would be reduced to mulch just like the others.$b$bYou should send them a message they will understand. Cut down their great dew casters. Rip them apart.$b$bLet them know that it is not okay to take our children.
english.completion: They are lucky you are the one that killed them. I would have tried to carve pictures in their dead wood bodies.
english.completed: Speak with Draka at Evermorn Springs.

text.title: 生命之泉
text.objectives: 获得乌托菲斯之水。
text.description: 听起来，你发现的这些……“矮人”……设法偷走了一件强大的木精神器。$b$b可那些蠢货却不知道需要用一种特殊的水来给它供能。$b$b在北边的永晨高地附近有一口井。$b$b你在那里可以找到一个守卫，它是被我们称作乌托菲斯的水元素生物。$b$b消灭它，然后取得它的精华，那样你距离掌握木精及原祖荆兽的力量就又近了一步。
text.progress: For years the Laughing Skull would not touch the sacred waters. We feared the wrath of the botani. We should have set them to burn long ago.
text.completion: The Waters of Utrophis. I have never held or smelled or tasted it before. But I have heard many stories, many legends.$b$bI was expecting something more grand.
text.completed: Return to Kaz the Shrieker at the Compost Heap.
text.giverWindow: 液体形态的生物。

english.title: The Life Spring
english.objectives: Collect the Waters of Utrophis.
english.description: It sounds like these... "dwarves"... you found managed to steal a powerful botani artifact.$b$bBut the fools didn't know they need a special water to power it.$b$bTo the north is a well along the Evermorn Rise.$b$bThere you will find a guardian, a creature of water we have named Utrophis.$b$bSlay it and take its essence and you will be one step closer to claiming the power of the botani and their genesaur.
english.progress: Много лет Веселые Черепа не заходили в священные воды. Мы боялись разозлить ботани. Надо было сжечь их давным-давно.
english.completion: The Waters of Utrophis. I have never held or smelled or tasted it before. But I have heard many stories, many legends.$b$bI was expecting something more grand.
english.completed: Return to Kaz the Shrieker at the Compost Heap.
english.giverWindow: A creature of liquid life.

english.title: The Forge of Souls Reward Quest
The Forge of Souls Reward Quest

text.title: 南方的野林
text.objectives: 去达克瑞姆找高等祭司雷努谈一谈。
text.description: 先是钢铁部落，再是影月兽人。现在南方又冒出了新的麻烦！$B$B我兄弟是南边达克瑞姆的灵龙骑士。$B$B他说那边沼泽里的怪物想要开始侵占陆地了。这个星球到底变成什么样了？$B$B无论如何，你看起来是个冒险家，假如你正好要去那，能否顺便帮我去看一看。
text.completion: Thank you for coming to our aid.

english.title: The Southern Wilds
english.objectives: Speak to Prelate Reenu at The Draakorium.
english.description: First the Iron Horde, then the Shadowmoon orcs, and now there's trouble brewing to the south!$B$BMy brother is a feyrider to the south, at the Draakorium.$B$BHe says that creatures from the swamp are venturing onto our lands. What is this world coming to?$B$BAnyway, you look like a seasoned adventurer. If you are heading that way, would you mind checking in over there?
english.completion: Thank you for coming to our aid.

text.title: 乌特加德之巅奖励任务
南部荒野
text.objectives: 去达克瑞姆找高等祭司雷努谈一谈。
text.description: 听说我们在达克瑞姆的朋友们遇到了糟糕的事情。这座城镇位于南方，坐落于一座沼泽附近。最近，沼泽中的一些危险生物开始侵犯城镇的边界。$B$B你看起来是个冒险家，假如你正好要去那，能否顺便帮我去看一看那边的居民是否安好？$B$B要是得到他们平安的消息，我就踏实多了。
text.completion: Ah, Prelate Luari sent you, did she? Such a sweet woman, always looking out for others.

english.title: The Southern Wilds
english.objectives: Speak to Prelate Reenu at The Draakorium.
english.description: I've heard disturbing news from our friends at The Draakorium, to the south.$B$BThe town lies near a swamp, and recently, dangerous creatures have been venturing near its borders.$B$BYou seem like a seasoned adventurer. If you are heading that way, would you mind checking in with our people there?$B$BI would feel much better if I knew they were safe.
english.completion: Ah, Prelate Luari sent you, did she? Such a sweet woman, always looking out for others.

text.title: 俄特加德之巔 - 額外目標獎勵
乌特加德之巅奖励任务
俄特加德之巔 - 額外目標獎勵
南部荒野
text.objectives: 去达克瑞姆找高等祭司雷努谈一谈。
text.description: 悬赏发布人：高等祭司雷努$B$B尊贵的联盟朋友们，达克瑞姆的德莱尼人民欢迎你。$B$B目前达克瑞姆正受到附近沼泽怪兽的侵袭。$B$B一支来自艾泽拉斯的车队日前刚经过这里，我们推测他们可能已经深入了危险地带。$B$B我们寻求任何能施以援手的冒险者，并将赠予丰厚的奖赏。
text.completion: Thank you for coming to assist us.

english.title: The Southern Wilds
english.objectives: Speak to Prelate Reenu at The Draakorium.
english.description: Posted by: Prelate Reenu$B$BNoble friends of the Alliance, the draenei of The Draakorium greet you peacefully.$B$BThe Draakorium is being attacked by enemies from the nearby swamps.$B$BAn Azerothian caravan passed through recently, and may have ventured into dangerous territory.$B$BAny capable adventurer who can assist us with this problem will be rewarded handsomely.
english.completion: Thank you for coming to assist us.

text.title: 钢铁部落来袭
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa名铁军步兵。
text.description: 我们接到报告，在袭击开始前，黑暗之门变成了红色。他们自称是“钢铁部落”，但看起来和我们所知的那个“部落”完全没有关系。$B$B他们的部队装备极为精良，兵员数量似乎无穷无尽。$B$B目前守望堡已经落入他们的手里。我们的前线部队需要你的帮助，$c。
text.completion: Good form, champion. I'm sure your presence on the field was inspiring for our troops.

english.title: Attack of the Iron Horde
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Ironmarch Grunts.
english.description: We received reports of the Dark Portal turning red right before the attack. They call themselves the Iron Horde, yet they seem to have no affiliation with the Horde we know.$b$bTheir army is extremely well equipped, and their numbers appear to be unending.$b$bThey have already taken Nethergarde Keep. Our troops on the frontlines could use your help, $c.
english.completion: Good form, champion. I'm sure your presence on the field was inspiring for our troops.

text.title: 兵临城下
text.objectives: 破坏$1oa辆钢铁攻城车。
text.description: 这些钢铁部落的火炮正在轰炸我们的部队。我不知道还能撑多久。我们的部队已经捉襟见肘了$B$B必须想办法阻止这些战争兵器。
text.completion: It will take the Iron Horde quite a while to get those demolishers operational again. Excellent work, $n.

english.title: Under Siege
english.objectives: Sabotage $1oa Iron Demolishers.
english.description: Those Iron Horde cannons are laying waste to our troops. I'm not sure how much more of this we can handle. Our forces are already spread too thin.$b$bThere has to be a way to stop those war machines.
english.completion: It will take the Iron Horde quite a while to get those demolishers operational again. Excellent work, $n.

text.title: 反侦察
text.objectives: 击败$1oa名钢铁部落斥候。
text.description: 我们的作战计划几乎无一能正常实行。我们被监视了。$B$B钢铁部落一定是在诅咒之地安插了斥候。胜利的机会正在从我们手中溜走。
text.completion: You killed how many scouts? No wonder we have been unable to execute our plans...
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Maraad at teh Shattered Beachhead in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Subversive Scouts
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Iron Horde scouts.
english.description: We have been unable to execute a vast majority of our battleplans. We are definitely being watched.$b$bThe Iron Horde must have scouts planted throughout the Blasted Lands. Victory is slipping away from us.
english.completion: You killed how many scouts? No wonder we have been unable to execute our plans...
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Maraad at teh Shattered Beachhead in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 终结斩杀
text.objectives: 击败$1oa名铁军处决者。
text.description: 我们第一时间赶过来……但是已经晚了。守望堡已经沦陷。钢铁部落将许多守望堡的战士扣为了俘虏。$B$B他们无疑正试图从那些战士身上拷问出重要情报。$B$B恐怕一旦他们得到想要的情报就会立刻杀了那些俘虏。我们时间紧迫。
text.completion: The prisoners are shaken up, but they are free. Their families are in your debt, $n.
text.completed: Return to Bodrick Grey at the Shattered Beachhead in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Ending Executions
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Ironmarch Executioners
english.description: We arrived as soon as we could... but we are too late. Nethergarde has fallen. The Iron Horde has taken a number of Nethergarde warriors prisoner.$b$bNo doubt they are trying to squeeze vital information out of our troops.$b$bI fear once they are done with their interrogation they will not hesitate to execute their prisoners. Time is running out.
english.completion: The prisoners are shaken up, but they are free. Their families are in your debt, $n.
english.completed: Return to Bodrick Grey at the Shattered Beachhead in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 净化斯坦索姆奖励任务
斯坦索姆的抉擇 - 額外目標獎勵

english.title: Culling of Stratholme - Bonus Objective Reward

text.title: 净化斯坦索姆奖励任务
海军上将泰勒
text.objectives: 去海军上将泰勒的农场找海军上将泰勒。
text.description: 海军上将泰勒已经查出了是谁在幕后搞鬼。他让我们想尽一切办法拯救幸存者……他想要自己一个人去处理这件事。$B$B之后我们就再也没有听到他的消息，但我们必须执行命令。$B$B我们请求你……找到他。他往农场那边去了。
text.completion: From one commander to another... thank you.$B$BWe've been through a lot together, haven't we, $n? Vashj'ir... the Jade Forest... Lion's Landing...$B$BI am truly honored that I could end my journey by your side.
text.completed: Speak to Admiral Taylor at Admiral Taylor's Farm.

english.title: Admiral Taylor
english.objectives: Find Admiral Taylor at Admiral Taylor's Farm.
english.description: Admiral Taylor had figured out who was behind all this. He told us to save who we could... he wanted to handle matters himself.$B$BWe never heard from him again, but we have our orders.$B$BPlease... please find him. He went towards the farm.
english.completion: From one commander to another... thank you.$B$BWe've been through a lot together, haven't we, $n? Vashj'ir... the Jade Forest... Lion's Landing...$B$BI am truly honored that I could end my journey by your side.
english.completed: Speak to Admiral Taylor at Admiral Taylor's Farm.

text.title: 达克萨隆要塞奖励任务
达克萨隆要塞奖励任务
有勇无谋？
text.objectives: 获取钢铁部落作战计划。
text.description: 现在我们应该反过来了解敌人的更多情报。$B$B我们的斥候识别出了钢铁部落的几位中级军官。他们的攻击方式非常有组织性和纪律性，这样的战术是不可能从单纯的游牧文化中自然领悟出来的。肯定是有人给这些军官提供了什么锦囊妙计。$B$B你是我执行这项任务的唯一一个人选，$n。
text.progress: Were you able to gain access to any battleplans?
text.completion: Let's take a look at these battleplans.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Maraad at the Shattered Beachhead in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Lunatic Lieutenants
english.objectives: Collect Iron Horde battleplans.
english.description: It is time we learned more about our new enemy.$b$bOur scouts have identified a number of the Iron Horde's lieutenants. Their attack is too organized to be run by tribal knowledge alone. Surely their lieutenants have access to secret battleplans. $b$bYou are the only soldier I can trust with this mission, $n.
english.progress: Were you able to gain access to any battleplans?
english.completion: Let's take a look at these battleplans.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Maraad at the Shattered Beachhead in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 火烧亡者
text.objectives: 烧光$1oa具尸体。
text.description: 我在这看见了许多尸体。卡兹总说要把尸体烧光。$b$b那样它们就不会变成卑鄙的绿怪物卷土重来了。$b$b我们应该烧光那些尸体。
text.progress: Хе-хе.
text.completion: That was stinky.
text.completed: Speak with Cutter at Evermorn Springs.

english.title: We Burn the Dead
english.objectives: Burn $1oa Bodies.
english.description: I saw lots of bodies here. Kaz always said to burn the bodies.$b$bThat way they can't come back as the mean greens.$b$bWe should burn the bodies.
english.progress: Хе-хе.
english.completion: That was stinky.
english.completed: Speak with Cutter at Evermorn Springs.

text.title: 铲除巨槌
text.objectives: 击败$1oa名巨槌食人魔。
text.description: 巨槌食人魔不断在刷新他们的智商下限。钢铁部落显然只是为了自己的阴谋在利用他们。$B$B但无论如何，我们要让这些食人魔看看，招惹联盟会有什么下场。该给这些巨槌食人魔一个教训了。
text.completion: It's important that our enemies understand what happens when you attack the Alliance. I'm glad you could be there to show them.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Maraad at the Shattered Beachhead in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Death to the Dreadmaul
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Dreadmaul Ogres.
english.description: The stupidity of the Dreadmaul ogres never ceases to amaze me. The Iron Horde is clearly using them to further their own nefarious agenda.$b$bRegardless, we must show the ogres what happens when you confront the Alliance. I think it's time we send the Dreadmaul ogres a message.
english.completion: It's important that our enemies understand what happens when you attack the Alliance. I'm glad you could be there to show them.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Maraad at the Shattered Beachhead in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 安卡赫特：古代王国奖励任务

english.title: Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom Reward Quest

text.title: 安卡赫特：古代王国奖励任务

english.title: Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom Reward Quest

text.title: 为了守望堡！
text.objectives: 把联盟旗帜插在守望堡。
text.description: 钢铁部落控制着守望堡。但他们还真以为我们不会回来夺回我们的地盘吗？$B$B我最精锐的部队已经迫不及待地想要让这些野蛮人泼洒鲜血了，但我们需要一位英雄来率领他们展开进攻，那就是你。
text.completion: The Iron Horde will learn to fear us, as they should.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Maraad in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: For Nethergarde!
english.objectives: Plant the Alliance flags inside Nethergarde Keep.
english.description: The Iron Horde controls Nethergarde Keep, but they are fools if they think we will not return to claim our land.$b$bMy best troops are more than eager to spill the blood of those savages, but we need a champion like yourself to lead the charge.
english.completion: The Iron Horde will learn to fear us, as they should.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Maraad in the Blasted Lands.

objectiveDetails.description: 把旗帜插在守望堡入口处
把旗帜插在守望堡正当中
把旗帜插在主要塞外面

text.title: 安卡罕特：古王國額外獎勵

english.title: Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom Bonus Reward

text.title: 烈士的遗物
text.objectives: 获得斯塔诺尔的剑、柯莉的杯子、科洛兰的盾牌。
text.description: 他们人太多了。卫兵挡不住他们……没人能挡住他们。那些野蛮人残忍地将那么多人的灵魂撕扯出他们的躯体。$B$B我们绝不能忘记那些为守护守望堡而献出生命的人们。假如你找到那些烈士们的遗物，请把它们带回来给我。
text.progress: Did you find anything?
text.completion: Thank you, $n. These mementos will forever remind us of the day we lost so many of our loved ones.

english.title: Mementos of the Fallen
english.objectives: Collect Strumner's Sword, Keri's Mug, and Krolan's Shield.
english.description: There were so many of them. The guards couldn't stop them... nobody could stop them. So many souls stripped of their bodies by those savages.$b$bWe must not forget those that gave their lives to try and defend Nethergarde. Please, if you find any mementos of the fallen, bring them back to me.
english.progress: Did you find anything?
english.completion: Thank you, $n. These mementos will forever remind us of the day we lost so many of our loved ones.

text.title: 歼灭者碎牙
text.objectives: 干掉歼灭者碎牙
text.description: 假如你带来的作战计划是真的，那么除钢铁部落外，巨槌食人魔同样要为这场惨剧负责。是该给这些食人魔提个醒了。$B$B这些食人魔和钢铁部落的主要联络人似乎是巨槌要塞里面一个叫碎牙的食人魔。$B$B杀了他就能给他们的作战计划带来巨大的打击。
text.completion: Toothsmash is dead? Good, I'm sure it will take the Iron Horde a while to find another ogre smart enough to help them with their efforts.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Maraad in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Toothsmash the Annihilator
english.objectives: Kill Toothsmash the Annihilator
english.description: If the battleplans you brought back are true, the Dreadmaul ogres are as much to blame for this devastation as the Iron Horde. It's time we send those ogres a message.$b$bIt looks like the Iron Horde's main contact is a large ogre in Dreadmaul named Toothsmash. Killing him will put a dent in their battleplans.
english.completion: Toothsmash is dead? Good, I'm sure it will take the Iron Horde a while to find another ogre smart enough to help them with their efforts.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Maraad in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 恩诺哈尔的复仇
text.objectives: 在巨槌食人魔的补给食物里下毒。
text.description: 他们……他们杀了我姐姐。这些禽兽不如的东西从大门口冲进来……然后……太可怕了。$B$B巨槌食人魔也和他们一道参与了这次攻击。他们都要付出代价。带上这瓶毒药，往他们的军粮里滴上几滴。这种毒药会缓慢地侵蚀他们的内脏，带来漫长而又痛苦的死亡。$B$B求求你，为了我的姐姐。这是他们应得的。
text.completion: I wish I could be there to watch their faces as they suffer. I hope they all die a slow horrible death.
text.completed: Return to Enohar Thnderbrew in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Enohar's Revenge
english.objectives: Poison the Dreadmaul ogre food supply.
english.description: They... they killed my sister. Those beasts marched right through the front gates and... it was horrible.$b$bThe Dreadmaul ogres stood beside them during the attack. They will all suffer. Here take this poison, place a couple drops in their rat stew. The poison will slowly eat away at their insides. Causing a prolonged and painful death, just like they deserve.$b$bPlease, for my sister.
english.completion: I wish I could be there to watch their faces as they suffer. I hope they all die a slow horrible death.
english.completed: Return to Enohar Thnderbrew in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 加玛克·折刃
text.objectives: 击败加玛克·折刃。
text.description: 通过你收集来的这些情报。我们得知这支入侵部队是由一名叫做加玛克·折刃的钢铁部落兽人所领导的。他就呆在欧卡里隆堡垒中的一个地下碉堡里。$B$B除掉他并不会使得我们立即赢得这场战争。但势必能切断钢铁部落的联络渠道。$B$B这能给我们争取宝贵的时间以集结更多的部队，并制定出一份作战计划来彻底铲除这一新的威胁。
text.completion: It was an honor fighting alongside of you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Maraad at the Shattered Beachhead in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Gar'mak Bladetwist
english.objectives: Kill Gar'mak Bladetwist.
english.description: With the intelligence you have gathered we have learned this assault is being led by a powerful Iron Horde orc named Gar'mak Bladetwist. He is hunkered down inside Okril'lon Hold.$b$bKilling him will not win this war, but it will surely break down the Iron Horde's communication. This will buy us valuable time while we gather more forces and outline a battleplan to deal with this new threat.
english.completion: It was an honor fighting alongside of you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Maraad at the Shattered Beachhead in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 末日之击
text.objectives: 收集$1oa颗末日之击炮弹。
text.description: 这枚可怕的巨型炸弹似乎正是这座堡垒的主炮所使用的炮弹。$B$B装填处一定位于较低的楼层，但这些炮弹没能及时运到那里。
text.progress: This loader can take a number of rounds of doomshot at a time.
text.completion: The rounds of doomshot fit into the weapon loader with ease.
text.completed: Bring the Doomshot to the Loading Assembly at Moira's Bastion.

english.title: Doomshot
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Doomshot.
english.description: This ominously large explosive appears to be ammunition for the primary cannon that the Bastion is built around.$b$bThe loading assembly must be on a lower floor, but this ammo did not make it that far.
english.progress: In this charging device, you can charge several fatal shells at once.
english.completion: The rounds of doomshot fit into the weapon loader with ease.
english.completed: Bring the Doomshot to the Loading Assembly at Moira's Bastion.

text.title: 乌特加德城堡奖励任务
失踪的伐木工
text.objectives: 在丛林之心里找到弗兰娜。
text.description: 我朋友当时跟我一起待在钻探机里。结果弗兰娜想把她所有的观察结果都记录下来，把损失降到最低。$b$b佩妮想让我告诉你她在哪儿。我也没法确定，但她当时就跟在我后面，恐怕没能出来。
text.completion: Frenna didn't make it out of Tangleheart.

english.title: Lost Lumberjack
english.objectives: Find Frenna within Tangleheart.
english.description: Me friend was in the mole machine wit' me. Good ol' Frenna tried to make the best of it by writin' all o' her observations down in a journal.$b$bPenny here wants me to tell ya where she is. I cannae say for sure, but she was followin' me outta here and I don't think she made it.
english.completion: Frenna didn't make it out of Tangleheart.

text.title: 拔苗助长
text.objectives: 从丛林之心的木精或古树身上收集$1oa份古树生长液。
text.description:
我发现这个名叫索尔顿的矮人当时就像脚下着火一样拼命地往丛林之心外面跑。

他说他的钻探机在这里钻了出来，他好不容易才死里逃生。还有个名叫弗兰娜的人留在里面，或许还活着。

我从他嘴里打听到了一件有用的事，丛林之心里的怪物手里有某种生长液，能大大加快种植速度。

另外，我要去找索尔顿的钻探机。等你完成任务后，到丛林之心里找我吧。
text.progress: Don't be such a sap. Get it?!
text.completion: You got it! You should be able to use this mole machine one way back to your outpost.

english.title: Growing Wood
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Ancient Growth Sap from botani or ancients within Tangleheart.
english.description:
I found this dwarf, Thuldren, runnin' out of Tangleheart like his boots were on fire.

Says his mole machine showed up here and he barely made it out alive. And another called Frenna might still be inside.

One useful thing he told me is that the creatures in there have sap that can be used to grow things real fast.

By the way, I'm gonna go lookin' for Thuldren's mole machine. Find me in Tangleheart when you're done.
english.progress: Нам нужны ростки надежды. Смекаешь?!
english.completion: You got it! You should be able to use this mole machine one way back to your outpost.

text.title: 肆虐的鬣蜥人
text.objectives: 在茉艾拉堡垒消灭$1oa个鬣蜥人。
text.description: 矮人就是蠢。他们难道不明白，如果你挖出一个深洞的话，就会招致鬣蜥人的攻击？$b$B要是你要到那个钢铁堡垒去的话，最好消灭掉一些鬣蜥人，否则它们一定会咬坏墙壁，造成塌方。$b$b我本想亲自去做的，可那些木精逼我吃掉的那一大堆水果到现在还哽在我的嗓子眼里。
text.completion: Goren, goren, gone!
text.completed: Speak with Cutter at the bottom of Moira's Bastion.

english.title: Down the Goren Hole
english.objectives: Slay $1oa goren in Moira's Bastion.
english.description: Dwarves are dumb. Don't they know that if you dig a deep hole you are going to have goren attack?$b$BIf you are going to go into that iron fort you better kill a bunch of goren otherwise they are going to chew the walls enough to cause a cave-in.$b$bI would do it myself but I'm still stuffed from all that fruit the botani made me eat.
english.completion: Goren, goren, gone!
english.completed: Speak with Cutter at the bottom of Moira's Bastion.

text.title: 第一章：花粉
text.objectives: 摧毁$1oa个花粉豆荚。
text.description:
在丛林之心里有些诡异的发光物体，似乎是各种带刺的生物给它们授的粉。

木精有时候会把豆荚里长出的东西全都收走。我也不知道那究竟是什么，但对我们来说也许十分危险。

- 弗兰娜
text.completion: Hey, nice job commander!

english.title: Chapter I: Plant Food
english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Pollen Pods.
english.description:
There are strange, glowing objects within Tangleheart, seemingly pollinated by a variety of stinging creature.

The botani sometimes collect whatever the pods produce. I can't be sure what it is, but it might be dangerous to us.

- Frenna
english.completion: Hey, nice job commander!

text.title: 原祖荆兽的意志
text.objectives: 取回原祖荆兽的意志。
text.description: 我相当确定，那些矮人把神器带到那座钢铁堡垒里去了。$b$b你打算把它找回来吗？
text.progress: Kaz said she wants me to hide for this fight.
text.completion: The genesaur is coming!
text.completed: Speak with Cutter at the bottom of Moira's Bastion.

english.title: Will of the Genesaur
english.objectives: Recover the Will of the Genesaur.
english.description: I am pretty sure those dwarves took the artifact in that iron fort there.$b$bAre you going to go get it?
english.progress: Kaz wants me to hide during this fight.
english.completion: The genesaur is coming!
english.completed: Speak with Cutter at the bottom of Moira's Bastion.

text.title: 艾韵
text.objectives: 击败艾韵。
text.description: 这有一头原祖荆兽！$b$b它想把神器夺回来。$b$b卡兹和德拉卡在地面上迎击它，但她们需要你的帮助。德拉卡说我可以留在这里负责开炮。所以我会负责这个。
text.completion: It was an honor to fight by your side today, commander.
text.completed: Speak with Draka at Bastion Rise.
text.giverWindow: 最原始的生命。

english.title: Iyu
english.objectives: Defeat Iyu.
english.description: There is a genesaur here!$b$bIt wants its artifact back.$b$bKaz and Draka are fighting it now on the surface but they need you. Draka said I could fire the big gun. So I will stay here and do that.
english.completion: It was an honor to fight by your side today, commander.
english.completed: Speak with Draka at Bastion Rise.
english.giverWindow: The most primal of life.

text.title: 尖啸者卡兹
text.completion: Commander, you go where you will and kill any who would stand in your way.$b$bI find this fun.$b$bI wish to join your... "followers"... as the lady wolf keeps calling them.$b$bMy home is crushed, my family mulched, and this place has lost its charm.$b$bLet me join you.

english.title: Kaz the Shrieker
english.completion: Commander, you go where you will and kill any who would stand in your way.$b$bI find this fun.$b$bI wish to join your... "followers"... as the lady wolf keeps calling them.$b$bMy home is crushed, my family mulched, and this place has lost its charm.$b$bLet me join you.

text.title: 乌特加德城堡奖励任务
魔枢（奖励目标）奖励任务

english.title: The Nexus - Bonus Objective Reward Quest

text.title: 第三章：焦木仪式
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa棵古树。
text.description:
我看见古树们举行过一种奇怪的仪式。它们走进火里，烧光它们枝干上的树叶，再烤焦它们的树皮。

我给这起了个名字叫“焦木仪式”。如果我们想削弱那些古树的力量，就必须在它们变得更强之前除掉它们。

- 弗兰娜
text.completion: You saw 'em burn off their own leaves? That'd be like me cutting off my cute-as-a-button pigtails!

english.title: Chapter III: Ritual of the Charred
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Ancients.
english.description:
I have seen a strange ritual performed by ancients. They step into fire, burning the leaves from their branches and charring their bark.

I call it the Ritual of the Charred. If we want to weaken the ancients, we can get rid of them before they become even stronger.

- Frenna
english.completion: You saw 'em burn off their own leaves? That'd be like me cutting off my cute-as-a-button pigtails!

text.title: 第二章：收割
text.objectives: 消灭收割者昂托根。
text.description:
我看到有一个生物在调教古树的树苗，给它们灌输愤怒和憎恨的情绪，让它们针对一切跟它们长得不像的生物。

也许丛林之心的古树之所以会显露出不同寻常的攻击性，都是这个木精的杰作。

除掉这个木精会不会对我们有好处呢？恐怕我一个人根本不是它的对手。

- 弗兰娜
text.completion: Big baddy botani busted? Works for me!

english.title: Chapter II: The Harvest
english.objectives: Kill Ontogen the Harvester.
english.description:
I have seen a creature working with the ancient saplings, imbuing them with anger and hatred toward creatures unlike them.

Perhaps it is this botani who is responsible for the unusually aggressive nature of ancients here in Tangleheart.

Would killing this botani do us good? I fear I would be no match for it alone.

- Frenna
english.completion: Big baddy botani busted? Works for me!

text.title: 木精的秘密
text.objectives: 护送快刀前往堆肥场找尖啸者卡兹。
text.description: 木精把那个大块头的独眼魔放在那，肯定是为了保护什么好东西。那个被它杀死的矮矮胖胖的怪物又是什么呢？$b$B虽然木精邪恶卑鄙，可它们却有些有趣的玩具。也许卡兹知道它是什么。$b$B我们现在能去找卡兹了吗？$b$B我在南边的山上看见过一处堆肥场。如果卡兹来找我的话，我敢打赌她肯定会从那找起。
text.completion: You found my Cutter! I shall gladly cut a thousand throats in your honor.
text.completed: 在堆肥场与尖啸者卡兹谈一谈。

english.title: Secrets of the Botani
english.objectives: Escort Cutter to Kaz the Shrieker at the Compost Heap.
english.description: The botani must have stuck that big ogron there to protect something fancy. And what was that stumpy looking creature that it killed?$b$BThe botani are mean, but they have some fun toys. Maybe Kaz might know what it was.$b$bCan we go find Kaz now?$b$bI saw a compost heap up the south hill. If Kaz came looking for me I bet she would start there.
english.completion: You found my Cutter! I shall gladly cut a thousand throats in your honor.
english.completed: Speak with Kaz the Shrieker at the Compost Heap.

text.objectives: 到你在霜火岭的要塞与洛坎交谈。
text.description:
指挥官，要塞刚收到了来自阿兰卡峰林的线报。据说那帮鸟人和碎手兽人之间正在酝酿一场战争。

等你在这里的工作完成以后，洛坎希望你能尽快回要塞与他面谈。
text.completion:
Welcome back, boss-mon.

I know you'll probably be wantin' to get things settled here first, but there's been some word of an uprisin' in Spires of Arak. There might be some allies to be made if we get involved.

Thought ya might want to know.

english.objectives: Speak to Rokhan at your garrison in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description:
Commander, scouts from Spires of Arak have brought back news to the garrison. There's word of a brewin' war between bird-men and the Shattered Hand orcs.

Rokhan's askin' for your presence when your work is done here, should ya be willin' sir.

It safe there.$B$BSafer, anyway.

text.title: 无人可信
text.objectives: 跟随玛拉达尔的印记，查证艾洛多尔被渗透的情况。
text.description: 自从我回来以后，一切都变了。这里到处都是低语声——没错，到处都是。玛尔拉德看不到，但艾洛多尔出现了恶魔能量的痕迹。我们被渗透了！$b$b我现在要去参加主教议会，但你必须去调查一下。我会点亮这里的恶魔能量痕迹，你沿着这些痕迹去追踪。要是我们当中真的有叛徒，他们一定会有藏身处之类的地方。找出来！我会和其他大主教一起等你的。

english.title: Trust No One
english.objectives: Follow Maladaar's trail to verify that Elodor has been infiltrated.
english.description: Nothing is the same since I returned. There is always whispering - everywhere, whispering. Maraad cannot see it, but there are even traces of fel energy here in Elodor. We have been infiltrated!$b$bI must attend to the Exarch Council, but I need you to investigate. Follow the traces of fel energy that I will illuminate. If there are truly traitors in our midst, they will have to have some sort of hideout. Find it! I will wait for you with the other Exarchs.
english.completion: A flesh-bound book lies on an unholy altar. Your skin crawls. Maladaar was right!
english.completed: Investigate the hidden altar at Elodor in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 来自阿兰卡峰林的消息
text.objectives: 到你在影月谷的要塞与伯德里克·格雷谈一谈。
text.description:
你不在的时候，有一个外表阴暗的人类来过这里。他说他是……格雷还是谁派来找你的……说是有一些关于阿兰卡峰林的情报你可能会感兴趣。

他已经先一步回你的要塞了，临走前要我把这些话带给你。

在你走之前，我们必须先感谢你在这里所做的一切。这里的战事你本可以袖手旁观，但你却带领你的军队帮助我们扭转了战局。对此我们表示衷心的感谢，我们永远不会忘记你的援助。
text.completion:
Welcome back, commander.

I know you'll probably want to get things settled here first, but there's been some word of an uprising in Spires of Arak. If we act fast, we might be able to make some new allies against the Iron Horde.

I'll have the scouts keep an ear out for any more news. That's it for now, sir.

english.title: News from Spires of Arak
english.objectives: Speak to Bodrick Grey at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description:
While you were gone, a rather shady looking human arrived at the outpost asking for you. He said he worked for... Grey was it?... and had some information regarding Spires of Arak that you would be interested in.

He was heading back to your garrison and asked that I passed along the message, and so I have.

And before you go, thank you for all you've done for us here, truly. You and your army have turned the tides of a war that you could have just as easily walked away from. We will not forget.
english.completion:
Welcome back, commander.

I know you'll probably want to get things settled here first, but there's been some word of an uprising in Spires of Arak. If we act fast, we might be able to make some new allies against the Iron Horde.

I'll have the scouts keep an ear out for any more news. That's it for now, sir.

text.objectives: 前往戈尔隆德的荒林洼地寻找伊瑞尔。与你要塞中的狮鹫管理员谈一谈，飞往那里。
text.description: 指挥官，伊瑞尔和玛尔拉德提供了一项战术性的建议。$B$B他们建议派出一支小规模远征队前往北方蛮荒的戈尔隆德。他们在那里安插的游侠报告说，那片土地可能潜藏着一些原始的秘密和古代知识，或许可以用来帮助我们找到钢铁部落的弱点，给敌人出其不意的打击。$B$B假如你愿意亲自前往，我就立刻给你准备一只狮鹫。
text.completion: Welcome to Gorgrond, Commander. We only just arrived ourselves.

english.objectives: Seek Yrel at the Wildwood Wash in Gorgrond. Speak with your Garrison Gryphon Master to fly there.
english.description: Commander, Yrel and Maraad have a tactical suggestion.$b$bThey recommend a small expedition group be sent into the savage wastelands of Gorgrond far to the north.$b$bReports from their rangari suggest that land may hold ancient secrets or primal knowledge that we might use to exploit weaknesses in the Iron Horde that our enemy would not expect.$b$bIf you wish to go I will have a gryphon prepared for you at once.
