Send me to the frontlines, wherever killing is needed.$B$BWith every enemy that I face, perhaps the pain will lessen.

text.title: 鲁尔坎
text.completion: Prophet Velen spoke highly of you, and I can see that your weapons are keen and your intent is just.$B$BI sense great potential within you. If you will allow it, I would warm my hands by your fire for a while.$B$BI would like to follow you and learn from your people. In return, I shall fight for you.$B$BWhat do you say, traveler?

english.title: Rulkan
english.completion: Prophet Velen spoke highly of you, and I can see that your weapons are keen and your intent is just.$B$BI sense great potential within you. If you will allow it, I would warm my hands by your fire for a while.$B$BI would like to follow you and learn from your people. In return, I shall fight for you.$B$BWhat do you say, traveler?

text.title: 何谓考古
text.objectives: 找到神秘的古器。
text.description: 身为考古学家，最重要的就是能在考古领域有了不起的大发现，并做出重大贡献。为什么？因为这能让你出名啊！$B$B连那个哈里森·琼斯都能闹出名气来，你为什么不能？$B$B悬槌食人魔在那个洞里藏了个大家伙。我们现在要去把它给弄来！$B$B带上这个传送信标进入那座洞穴的内部。一旦你找到了那件东西，就原地放下信标，我的团队会处理剩下的问题的。
text.completion: Great work back there! That's how real archaeology is done!$b$bIt's a good thing you came to me to learn the trade, kid. You've got talent and I'd hate to see it wasted on a putz like Harrison Jones!
text.completed: Return to Gazmolf Futzwangler.

english.title: A Lesson in Archaeology
english.objectives: Recover the Mysterious Artifact.
english.description: As an archaeologist, it's important to make great discoveries and contributions to the field. Why? Because that's how you make a name for yourself!$b$bEven that hack Harrison Jones has a somewhat reputable name. If he can do it, then you can too!$b$bThe Highmaul are hiding something big in that cave of theirs and we need to get in there and take it!$b$bTake this teleportation beacon and make your way to the back of the cave. Once you find the relic, place the beacon and my team will take care of the rest!
english.completion: Great work back there! That's how real archaeology is done!$b$bIt's a good thing you came to me to learn the trade, kid. You've got talent and I'd hate to see it wasted on a putz like Harrison Jones!
english.completed: Return to Gazmolf Futzwangler.

text.title: 尸检
text.objectives: 从死亡的游侠身上收集$1oa只游侠钱袋。
text.description: 我的整个小队都不见了。有些人显然是死了。但其他人……他们一定是在这片红土的深处。$B$B请你帮我搜寻队员们的遗体，他们身上都会带有一小包个人物品。我想要把这些东西带回给他们的家属。$B$B我要先前往沼泽深处，我们在那会和。
text.progress: The families of my squad need closure and we need more information on their deaths.
text.completion: Thank you for doing this $p.  Hopefully they can be cleaned of these foul spores that coat everything here.
text.completed: Speak with Khaano at Crimson Fen.

english.title: Scout Forensics
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Rangari Pouches from dead Rangari.
english.description: My entire squad is gone. Some are dead; that much is obvious. The others though... they must be further in.$b$bGo and search the bodies of my squad that you find, each will carry a small pouch of personal items. I would like to return these to their families.$b$bI will go ahead and meet you inside the marsh.
english.progress: Семьи членов моего отряда имеют право знать, что с ними случилось. Нам нужно больше информации об обстоятельствах их гибели.
english.completion: Thank you for doing this $p.  Hopefully they can be cleaned of these foul spores that coat everything here.
english.completed: Speak with Khaano at Crimson Fen.

text.title: 制者为王
text.objectives: 把埃匹希斯控制器交给泰罗克鸦巢的黑暗占卜师拉斯托克。
text.description: 埃匹希斯科技真是使人着迷啊，是吧？以太阳能为动力的机器。能量本身就已被灌注了魔法！$B$B实在是太了不起了！$B$B啊，可凡事总有漏洞。我想你已经发现了。$B$B能不能请你把控制器设备带到泰罗克鸦巢去？我很快就会带上埃匹希斯核心去找你。$B$B如果我的理论正确无误的话，我们也许就能用信徒自己的武器去对付他们！
text.progress: Did you bring the device?
text.completion: It will take some time, but this may be the key to our victory.
text.completed: Bring the Apexis Interface to Darkscryer Raastok in Veil Terokk.

english.title: Control is King
english.objectives: Bring the Apexis Interface to Darkscryer Raastok in Veil Terokk.
english.description: Apexis technology is fascinating, isn't it? Machines powered by solar energy. Energy which itself has been imbued with magic!$B$BSimply brilliant!$B$BAh, but there's always a catch. And I think you may have found it.$B$BBring the interface device back to Veil Terokk, will you? I'll be along shortly with the Apexis cores.$B$BIf my theory is right, we may be able to turn the Adherents' own weapon against them!
english.progress: Прибор у тебя?
english.completion: It will take some time, but this may be the key to our victory.
english.completed: Bring the Apexis Interface to Darkscryer Raastok in Veil Terokk.

text.title: [Deprecated]
text.objectives: Speak with Talonpriest Zellek in Veil Terokk.
text.completed: Speak with Talonpriest Zellek in Veil Terokk.

english.title: [Deprecated]
english.objectives: Speak with Talonpriest Zellek in Veil Terokk.
english.completed: Speak with Talonpriest Zellek in Veil Terokk.

text.title: 应有的尊重
text.objectives: 取回塞斯的羽毛和泰罗克的传说
text.description: 在斯克提斯被攻击前，有一帮信徒来过这里。我把自己伪装成了一只蘑菇骗过了他们，那帮白痴就这么从我眼前走过去了。$B$B但我在路另一头的那位邻居就没这么走运了。$B$B我记得他很喜欢读书。也许他的屋子里还留有一些有价值的情报，你可以带一些给瑞沙德看看。$B$B哦，顺便，帮忙拔一根他的羽毛放到泰罗克鸦巢附近的祭坛那里。他是个好人，我们这样做他也会高兴的。
text.progress: Here, I'll take them both for safekeeping.
text.completion: <Reshad presses the feather into the tome before sliding it into his robes.>$B$BWe have one more stop before the wayshrine...
text.completed: Speak with Reshad at the Terokkar Wayshrine.

english.title: All Due Respect
english.objectives: Retrieve the Feather of Syth and the Saga of Terokk.
english.description: A group of Adherents came 'round just before the attack on Skettis. Disguised myself as a mushroom, I did. The fools walked right past me.$B$BMy neighbor up the road was not so lucky.$B$BHe had a fondness for texts, if I recall. Might be valuable information in his hut, if you give Reshad a moment to rummage around.$B$BOh, and bring one of his feathers to the shrine near Veil Terokk, would you? He was such a dear, and I know it's what he'd want.
english.progress: У меня они точно будут в безопасности.
english.completion: <Reshad presses the feather into the tome before sliding it into his robes.>$B$BWe have one more stop before the wayshrine...
english.completed: Speak with Reshad at the Terokkar Wayshrine.

objectiveDetails.description: 殺死高生命力上限的怪
殺死稀有菁英/事件/小頭目

text.title: 为逝者复仇
text.objectives: 杀死$1oa只真菌侦察者。
text.description: 我……我差点就逃出去了。我们很多人……都死了。其他人……都迷失了心智。$B$B是这些笨重的孢子怪物干的，它们把我们拖到沼泽深处……阻止他们。
text.completion: Thank you for avenging my fallen friends. We will get to the bottom of this I swear!

english.title: Vengeance for the Fallen
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Fungal Lurchers.
english.description: I... almost made it out.  Most of us... dead. The others... they are no longer themselves.$b$bThese lurching spore beasts are the cause, dragging us further into the marsh... stop them.
english.completion: Thank you for avenging my fallen friends. We will get to the bottom of this I swear!

objectiveDetails.description: 殺死高生命力上限的怪
殺死稀有菁英/事件/小頭目

text.title: 神秘的豆荚
text.objectives: 把发光的红色豆荚带给戈尔隆德赤红沼泽的卡诺。
text.description: 这颗豆荚和在这附近其他尸体周围所生长的极为相似，但它却诡异地搏动着。卡诺可能会对它感兴趣的。
text.completion: I've seen these around on corpses and the beasts, but not as big.  Let me see it...

english.title: Mysterious Pod
english.objectives: Bring the Glowing Red Pod to Khaano at Crimson Fen in Gorgrond.
english.description: This pod is similar to the ones growing on or near the bodies around here, except this one is pulsating weirdly.$b$bThis is something Khaano would be interested in.
english.completion: I've seen these around on corpses and the beasts, but not as big.  Let me see it...

text.title: 让生者解脱
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个覆菌蹒跚者。
text.description: 你会发现，那些死去的人还算是幸运的。而那些尚还活着的人在里头到处游荡，攻击任何没被这种可怕的孢子感染的目标。$B$B我不忍心杀死他们，但或许你可以让这些可怜人获得解脱，我会感谢你的。
text.completion: Perhaps we shouldn't have wasted time on them, this place... drains me. Still it was a good deed you have done.
text.completed: Speak to Khaano at Crimson Fen.

english.title: Mercy for the Living
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Fungus Covered Shamblers.
english.description: You can see that the dead were the lucky ones. Those that live wander about attacking anything not infected with these vile spores.$b$bI cannot bring myself to slay them, but if you could bring mercy to those poor people I would be very grateful.
english.completion: Perhaps we shouldn't have wasted time on them, this place... drains me. Still it was a good deed you have done.
english.completed: Speak to Khaano at Crimson Fen.

text.title: 真菌的秘密
text.objectives: 采集$1oa颗荧光蘑菇。
text.description: 我渐渐觉得这里的真菌和生长在这里的生物有着某种强烈的……联系……其中某种特定的蘑菇尤其如此。$B$B我相信假若能弄到一些样品，就能追踪到这些恶心的真菌的源头……并且解决掉它。
text.progress: Where are my mushrooms?!
text.completion: Sadly, I'm growing used to the smell of these spores. In fact, they smell quite pleasant now. Perhaps if I eat these it will speed up our work here...
text.completed: Speak to Khaano at Crimson Fen.

english.title: The Secret of the Fungus
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Glowing Mushrooms.
english.description: I'm beginning to sense a strong... connection... between the fungus and the creatures that inhabit it. There are certain mushrooms that are stronger than others.$b$bI believe if I had some samples of these I could use them, track the source of this foul fungus and... deal with it.
english.progress: Where are my mushrooms ?!
english.completion: Sadly, I'm growing used to the smell of these spores. In fact, they smell quite pleasant now. Perhaps if I eat these it will speed up our work here...
english.completed: Speak to Khaano at Crimson Fen.

text.title: 恐怖的收割者
text.objectives: 从真菌践踏者身上收集$1oa枚孢子囊，并把他们带给卡诺。
text.description: 越往沼泽深处走，孢子的迷雾就越厚。但这些个子更大的真菌怪物肯定是关键。$B$B是的，干掉它们，把它们的孢子囊带来给我。它们能帮我……加深研究。
text.progress: Those pods are critical $n, I need them!
text.completion: I... I must consume these like the mushrooms. It will help me locate the source, I swear!
text.completed: Speak to Khaano at Crimson Fen.

english.title: A Grim Harvest
english.objectives: Bring Khaano $1oa Spore Pods from the Fungal Stompers.
english.description: The spores grow thick further into the marsh, but those larger fungus beasts are the key.$b$bYes, kill them and take their spore sacs. I will need them to refine my... search.
english.progress: Эти стручки очень важны, $p! Они мне необходимы!
english.completion: I... I must consume these like the mushrooms. It will help me locate the source, I swear!
english.completed: Speak to Khaano at Crimson Fen.

objectiveDetails.description: 摧毁一桶收集来的毒液

text.title: 第三章：焦木仪式
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa棵古树。
text.description:
我看见古树们举行过一种奇怪的仪式。它们走进火里，烧光它们枝干上的树叶，再烤焦它们的树皮。

我给这起了个名字叫“焦木仪式”。如果我们想削弱那些古树的力量，就必须在它们变得更强之前除掉它们。

- 弗兰娜
text.completion: Those ancients are crazy! Hard to believe they'd burn off their own leaves.
text.completed: Speak to Glirin within Tangleheart.

english.title: Chapter III: Ritual of the Charred
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Ancients.
english.description:
I have seen a strange ritual performed by ancients. They step into fire, burning the leaves from their branches and charring their bark.

I call it the Ritual of the Charred. If we want to weaken the ancients, we can get rid of them before they become even stronger.

- Frenna
english.completion: Those ancients are crazy! Hard to believe they'd burn off their own leaves.
english.completed: Speak to Glirin within Tangleheart.

text.title: 第二章：收割
text.objectives: 消灭收割者昂托根。
text.description:
我看到有一个生物在调教古树的树苗，给它们灌输愤怒和憎恨的情绪，让它们针对一切跟它们长得不像的生物。

也许这个木精就是让丛林之心的古树都变得那么具有攻击性的罪魁祸首。

除掉这个木精会不会对我们有好处呢？话是这么说，恐怕我一个人是对付不了那家伙的。

- 弗兰娜
text.completion: Ya took out the big nasty did ya? Yer sure to be causin' some real trouble out there!
text.completed: Speak to Glirin within Tangleheart.

english.title: Chapter II: The Harvest
english.objectives: Kill Ontogen the Harvester.
english.description:
I have seen a creature working with the ancient saplings, imbuing them with anger and hatred toward creatures unlike them.

Perhaps it is this botani who is responsible for the unusually aggressive nature of ancients here in Tangleheart.

Would killing this botani do us good? I fear I would be no match for it alone.

- Frenna
english.completion: Ya took out the big nasty did ya? Yer sure to be causin' some real trouble out there!
english.completed: Speak to Glirin within Tangleheart.

text.title: 拔苗助长
text.objectives: 从木精或古树身上收集$1oa份古树生长液。
text.description:
我们建了一座不错的伐木场，但我们需要更多的木材！

游侠告诉我，有些木精能使用一种生长液来随意操纵古树的生长速度。

你要是能弄点这种东西来，我就能让它们派上用场了。

什么？噢，这边这个格丽扎？她的滑翔机坠毁在这里了，而且她对伐木略知一二。我晚点会押送她回哨站。

我会到丛林之心找你的，前提是我能找得到。
text.progress: Glyza is good with tools.
text.completion: Sap? Who called me a sap?! Oh...
text.completed: Speak to Glirin within Tangleheart.

english.title: Growing Wood
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Ancient Growth Sap from botani or ancients.
english.description:
We got the lumber mill good an' built, but we be needin' more wood!

The Rangari tol' me there's botani usin' some kinda sap to grow ancients fast as you like.

Get yer hands on some o' that sap and I betcha I can put it work.

What? Oh, Glyza here? Found 'er crashed here and she knows a thing or two about lumberjackin'. I'll take her back to the outpost later.

I'll meet ya inside Tangleheart if I can find it.
english.progress: Glisa knows how to handle tools.
english.completion: Sap? Who called me a sap?! Oh...
english.completed: Speak to Glirin within Tangleheart.

text.title: 第一章：花粉
text.objectives: 摧毁$1oa个花粉豆荚。
text.description:
在丛林之心里有着奇怪的发光物体，像是被某种带刺的生物授了粉。

木精有时会把豆荚生成的所有东西全都拿走。我也不知道那究竟是什么，但或许对我们有威胁。

——弗兰娜
text.completion: Couldn't say what those spores were for, but I feel better knowin' they're gone.
text.completed: Speak to Glirin within Tangleheart.

english.title: Chapter I: Plant Food
english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Pollen Pods.
english.description:
There are strange, glowing objects within Tangleheart, seemingly pollinated by a variety of stinging creature.

The botani sometimes collect whatever the pods produce. I can't be sure what it is, but it might be dangerous to us.

- Frenna
english.completion: Couldn't say what those spores were for, but I feel better knowin' they're gone.
english.completed: Speak to Glirin within Tangleheart.

text.title: 寻心之旅
text.objectives: 调查赤红沼泽中的奇怪现象。
text.description: 我能感觉到这沼泽中有一股强大力量，$p。它就离这不远。$B$B我要把这些恶心的东西吃完，你先帮我过去看看吧。我会跟上的……
text.completion: This is unfortunate... I had hoped... Still we are closer now, we are on the right track to finishing this.$b$bNone too soon either, the screaming beasts are really getting to me...
text.completed: Speak to Khaano at Crimson Fen.

english.title: A Heartfelt Search
english.objectives: Investigate the strange presence in the Crimson Fen.
english.description: I can feel a powerful presence in the marsh $p, it is not far from here.$b$bGo see what is there while I finish my grim feast.  I will catch up...
english.completion: This is unfortunate... I had hoped... Still we are closer now, we are on the right track to finishing this.$b$bNone too soon either, the screaming beasts are really getting to me...
english.completed: Speak to Khaano at Crimson Fen.

objectiveDetails.description: 查看奇怪的真菌生长地

text.title: 沼泽之心
text.objectives: 跟随卡诺深入赤红沼泽，并应对出现的状况。
text.description: 我脑袋里的声响简直让我不堪忍受，可我必须坚持下去。有了这些孢子样本，我想我知道该何去何从了。 $b$b我会找到源头并传播……不对！是消灭它！我会竭尽全力！
text.completion: That is terrible news. I will warn off all scouts from venturing to the Crimson Fen from now on.  Thank you and I am glad you were not affected by the spores...
text.completed: Return to D'kaan at Highpass.

english.title: Heart of the Fen
english.objectives: Follow Khaano deeper into the Crimson Fen and deal with what comes.
english.description: The pounding in my head is almost unbearable but I must see this through. With all the spore samples I've taken I know where to go and what to do.$b$bI will find the source and spread... no! Destroy it! I will do what needs to be done!
english.completion: That is terrible news. I will warn off all scouts from venturing to the Crimson Fen from now on.  Thank you and I am glad you were not affected by the spores...
english.completed: Return to D'kaan at Highpass.

text.title: 何谓团队合作
text.objectives: 取得$oa件神秘的圣物。
text.description: 考古研究团队最重要的一项必备技能是团队合作。而团队合作的关键则在于知道何时该付出，何时该索取。$B$B悬槌食人魔正不断从这座峡谷中挖掘神秘的圣物。我想让你和这帮悬槌食人魔组成考古团队！$B$B记得我刚才说的必备技能吗？付出和索取。食人魔已经为我们付出了的劳动力，挖出了那些圣物。而你现在要做的，则是从他们手中索取那些东西，并把它们带给我！$B$B这就是团队合作！
text.progress: Have you retrieved the mysterious artifacts? It's all about teamwork!
text.completion: You did a great job, kid!$b$bI hope you learned something about teamwork today. Here's your cut, minus my teaching fee... the Steamwheedle Preservation Society service charge... and gratuity of course!
text.completed: Return to Gazmolf Futzwangler.

english.title: A Lesson in Teamwork
english.objectives: Retrieve $oa Mysterious Artifacts.
english.description: One of the most important skills an archaeology team needs is good teamwork. The key to teamwork is knowing when to give and when to take.$b$bThe Highmaul ogres have been excavating mysterious artifacts from the gorge. I want you to team up with the Highmaul ogres in the name of good archaeology!$b$bRemember what I said about giving and taking? The ogres have given us their hard work to excavate the artifacts. Now I want you to take those artifacts from them and bring them here!$b$bIt's teamwork!
english.progress: Have you retrieved the mysterious artifacts? It's all about teamwork!
english.completion: You did a great job, kid!$b$bI hope you learned something about teamwork today. Here's your cut, minus my teaching fee... the Steamwheedle Preservation Society service charge... and gratuity of course!
english.completed: Return to Gazmolf Futzwangler.

text.title: 挫骨扬灰
text.objectives: 焚烧$1oa具古树携种者的尸体。
text.description: 当这些携种者被杀死后，它们的种子会存活下来。继而长成新的携种者，这一过程用不了几年之久，在短短几小时内就能完成。$b$b如果把它们的遗骸留在这，哨站很快就会受到威胁。$b$b根据我们了解到的，必须烧光它们，才能避免这一恶果。
text.completion: The ancients should not be a problem for your outpost for some time.
text.completed: Speak to Rangari Erdanii within Affliction Ridge.

english.title: Seedbearers of Bad News
english.objectives: Burn $1oa Ancient Seedbearer corpses.
english.description: When these seedbearers are slain their seeds survive. From them spring new seedbearers, not over years, but hours.$b$bLeaving their remains here would soon cause the outpost to be overrun.$b$bWe have learned that burning their remains prevents this from happening.
english.completion: The Ancients won't slip into your outpost for long.
english.completed: Speak to Rangari Erdanii within Affliction Ridge.

text.title: 我们有伴了
text.objectives: 调查硫磺盆地中的钢铁部落营地。
text.description: 指挥官，我在附近发现了一些钢铁部落的士兵。$b$b即便是对他们来说，深入如此危险的领域也太过大胆了。$b$b要是我们对钢铁部落的出现置之不理的话，他们一定会对你的营地造成威胁。$b$b在我深入峡谷侦察的同时，能不能请你帮忙调查下他们的营地？
text.completion: Thank you, friend. I am in your debt.$B$BThis arrogant Iron Horde has made a dangerous enemy today.
text.completed: Speak to Rexxar at Sulfur Basin.

english.title: We Have Company
english.objectives: Investigate the Iron Horde camp in Sulfur Basin.
english.description: Commander, I've spotted Iron Horde soldiers nearby.$b$bIt is bold, even for them, to venture into such deadly territory.$b$bIf we do not deal with their presence, they will surely be a threat to your camp.$b$bWhile I scout deeper into the canyons, may I request your help in investigating the camp?
english.completion: Спасибо тебе, друг. Я перед тобой в долгу.$B$BСегодня заносчивая Железная Орда нажила себе опасного врага.
english.completed: Speak to Rexxar at Sulfur Basin.

text.title: 赤红沼泽的游侠
text.objectives: 去戈尔隆德的赤红沼泽附近找卡诺。
text.description: 戈尔隆德是个非常危险的地方。我派了几个小分队四处打探这里的各个区域。$B$B其中一支小队去了一个叫赤红沼泽的地方，但至今都还没回来。有可能的话，我希望你能找到这支失踪的部队，并把他们的报告带回来。
text.completion: D'kaan sent you? He's not likely to enjoy the report I have to give him.

english.title: Rangari in the Red
english.objectives: Find Khaano near the Crimson Fen in Gorgrond.
english.description: Gorgrond is a very dangerous place and I've sent scouting squads out to investigate various regions.$b$bI've sent one squad to the marsh called the Crimson Fen and they've not come back yet.  I'd like you to find the missing squad and get a report if possible.
english.completion: D'kaan sent you? He's not likely to enjoy the report I have to give him.

text.title: 赤红沼泽的割颅者
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德的赤红沼泽附近找到戈鲁科尔。
text.description: 戈鲁科尔跟他的人已经消失好几个星期了，他们只有在携带不了更多战利品和补给物资时才会回来。他之前从没离开过这么久。$b$b戈鲁科尔曾经提到过第一次在赤红沼泽狩猎时的经历，去看看他是否还活着。
text.completion: Marrow sent you, eh? Well we leave when I'm done here.

english.title: Skulltakers in Crimson Fen
english.objectives: Find Grulkor near the Crimson Fen in Gorgrond.
english.description: Grulkor and his group are often not seen for weeks, returning only when they can carry no more trophies and supplies. He has been gone too long this time.$b$bHe mentioned hunting in the Crimson Fen for the first time, see if he still lives.
english.completion: Marrow sent you, eh? Well we leave when I'm done here.

text.title: 塞斯的秘密
text.objectives: 获得安苏之眼。
text.description: 看来我们这位故去的朋友不单纯只是一位古书收集狂和魔幻色情小说爱好者。他真的收藏了一些有价值的东西。$B$B假如我没理解错这份记录的话，他声称自己找到了安苏之眼，也就是泰罗克被贬落后一直在使用的占卜宝珠。$B$B我们一定要拿到它！按照这份记录说的，他把那颗宝珠藏在了路那一头的一个掠食者巢穴里。
text.progress: To hold such a treasure. I wonder if that Sun-Talon had any idea of the significance?
text.completion: <Reshad gazes into the inky orb.>$B$BAmazing. To think Terokk used this very orb to commune with Anzu. One could become quite the darkweaver with an implement such as this.$B$BCome, let's get it safely to the Veil.
text.completed: Speak with Reshad at the Terokkar Wayshrine.

english.title: Syth's Secret
english.objectives: Retrieve the Eye of Anzu.
english.description: Our deceased friend here was hiding more than a love of old scrolls and erotic sorcery-fiction. He had something truly valuable.$B$BIf I'm reading his notes correctly, he claims to have found the Eye of Anzu - Terokk's scrying orb from the days after his fall.$B$BWe need that orb! The notes say he stashed it in a ravager den just up the road.
english.progress: This treasure ... Interestingly, did this Solar Claw even guess at its significance?
english.completion: <Reshad gazes into the inky orb.>$B$BAmazing. To think Terokk used this very orb to commune with Anzu. One could become quite the darkweaver with an implement such as this.$B$BCome, let's get it safely to the Veil.
english.completed: Speak with Reshad at the Terokkar Wayshrine.

text.title: 通缉令：基霍的断裂之爪
text.objectives: 从野蛮的基霍身上获得基霍的断裂之爪。
text.description: 悬赏发布人：监工高尼克$B$B有一只名叫基霍的虎人对坠斧营地构成了严重的威胁。$B$B它曾经趁着夜色潜入堡垒，消灭苦工，并将他们的尸体拖回他的傲土巢穴中。$B$B任何切下他的爪子并把它带来给我的人都将获得丰厚的奖励。
text.progress: Lok'tar, commander.
text.completion: The peons will sing songs of your glory, commander. Lok'tar ogar!
text.completed: Speak to Taskmaster Gornek at Axefall.

english.title: Wanted: Keeho's Severed Paw
english.objectives: Retrieve Keeho's Severed Paw from Keeho the Savage.
english.description: Posted by: Taskmaster Gornek$B$BThe saberon known as Keeho poses a serious threat to Axefall.$B$BHe has taken to slaughtering peons on the night shift and dragging their corpses to his den in the pridelands.$B$BAnyone who can bring me his severed paw as proof of his demise will be rewarded greatly.
english.progress: Lok'tar, commander.
english.completion: The peons will sing songs of your glory, commander. Lok'tar ogar!
english.completed: Speak to Taskmaster Gornek at Axefall.

text.title: 悬赏：切骨者的外壳
text.objectives: 从切骨者身上获得切骨者的外壳。
text.description: 悬赏发布人：奇尔加$B$B我出大价钱收购切骨者的外壳。$B$B我想打造时尚的掠食者装甲，但我自己却没有能力去捕捉这种野兽。$B$B别在上面戳太多窟窿。
text.progress: It is an honor to have you in my shop, commander.
text.completion: I am glad we can count on you, commander.
text.completed: Speak to Killga at Axefall.

english.title: Wanted: Spineslicer's Husk
english.objectives: Retrieve Spineslicer's Husk from Spineslicer.
english.description: Posted by: Killga$B$BI will greatly reward anyone who brings me Spineslicer's husk.$B$BI wish to fashion fine ravager armor, but do not have the skills to take down such a beast.$B$BDon't tear too many holes in it.
english.progress: It is an honor to have you in my shop, commander.
english.completion: I am glad we can count on you, commander.
english.completed: Speak to Killga at Axefall.

text.title: 暗影滋长
text.objectives: 与瑞沙德一起进入泰罗克鸦巢。
text.description: 泰罗克鸦巢就在前面。$B$B希望其他人也都安全抵达了那里。
text.completion: We owe you a great debt for delivering Reshad safely to us, $p.$B$BHowever, our struggle has only just begun.
text.completed: Speak with Shadow-Sage Iskar in Veil Terokk.

english.title: A Gathering of Shadows
english.objectives: Enter Veil Terokk with Reshad.
english.description: Veil Terokk is just ahead.$B$BLet us hope the others have made the journey safely.
english.completion: We owe you a great debt for delivering Reshad safely to us, $p.$B$BHowever, our struggle has only just begun.
english.completed: Speak with Shadow-Sage Iskar in Veil Terokk.

objectiveDetails.description: 与瑞沙德一同进入泰罗克鸦巢

text.title: 悬赏：毒钩
text.objectives: 消灭毒钩。
text.description: 悬赏发布人：胡托·羽风$B$B毒钩是阿兰卡上空的祸害。即使是高等鸦人也害怕它。她对我们空中运输路线造成了干扰，使得许多重要补给品无法运抵坠斧营地。$B$B我不需要她的死亡证明，只要阿兰卡峰林中再也听不到她的尖啸声。$B$B她在东北边的啸风峭壁筑巢。
text.completion: A thousand thanks to you, commander. I will call for more supply runs immediately.
text.completed: Speak to Hutou Featherwind at Axefall.

english.title: Wanted: Venombarb
english.objectives: Kill Venombarb.
english.description: Posted by: Hutou Featherwind$B$BVenombarb is feared in the skies above Arak, even by the high arakkoa.$B$BShe has made air travel difficult for our riders, preventing vital supplies from reaching Axefall.$B$BI require no proof of her demise, simply ensure her screech never again echoes among the spires.$B$BShe nests above the howling crag to the northeast.
english.completion: A thousand thanks to you, commander. I will call for more supply runs immediately.
english.completed: Speak to Hutou Featherwind at Axefall.

text.title: 悬赏：基霍的断裂之爪
text.objectives: 从野蛮的基霍身上获得基霍的断裂之爪。
text.description: 悬赏发布人：威勒姆中尉。$B$B一只名叫基霍的巨型虎人曾在夜间抢劫过南港。$B$B这让我们损失了不少人。$B$B任何除掉基霍并切下他的爪子来交差的人，我都愿意给他提供丰厚的奖励。
text.progress: Pleasure to see you, sir.
text.completion: Well done, commander. For the Alliance!

english.title: Wanted: Keeho's Severed Paw
english.objectives: Retrieve Keeho's Severed Paw from Keeho the Savage.
english.description: Posted by: Lieutenant Willem$B$BKeeho, a monstrous saberon, has taken to raiding Southport at night. We're losing men left and right.$B$BI offer a hefty bounty to anyone able to track down Kreeho and bring his severed paw to me.
english.progress: Я рад видеть тебя.
english.completion: Well done, commander. For the Alliance!

text.title: 悬赏：切骨者的外壳
text.objectives: 从切骨者身上获得切骨者的外壳。
text.description: 悬赏发布人：军需官朱莉$B$B我们已经没有多少资源能拿来维修部队的装甲了。$B$B我愿意花大钱收购那只大掠食者——切骨者的外壳。它能为我们提供数周的维修材料。
text.progress: Oh, commander! What an honor!$B$BHow can I help you?
text.completion: I didn't think anyone could actually kill the beast. Thank you, commander!

english.title: Wanted: Spineslicer's Husk
english.objectives: Retrieve Spineslicer's Husk from Spineslicer.
english.description: Posted by: Quartermaster Jolie$B$BWe're running out of supplies to repair our troops' armor.$B$BI'll pay handsomely for the husk of the mighty ravager Spineslicer. It would provide us with repair materials for weeks.
english.progress: Oh, commander! What an honor!$B$BHow can I help you?
english.completion: I didn't think anyone could actually kill the beast. Thank you, commander!

text.title: 悬赏：毒钩
text.objectives: 消灭毒钩。
text.description: 悬赏发布人：法罗格$B$B那个叫毒钩的家伙每天都在嘲讽我。叽叽喳喳地弄得我脑袋都要爆炸了。$B$B快来个人，谁都好，帮我干掉那只怪兽。我不需要你出示击败它的证据，我只想安静点。
text.progress: Shut her up... ek!
text.completion: By Muradin'sh beard... you actually killed the beasht. Praishe be to ye, commander ...hic!

english.title: Wanted: Venombarb
english.objectives: Kill Venombarb.
english.description: Posted by: Falrogh$B$BVenombarb taunts me every day. Screeching and killing me buzz.$B$BSomebody, anybody, kill the beast. I don't want proof, I want peace and quiet.
english.progress: Shut her up... ek!
english.completion: By Muradin'sh beard... you actually killed the beasht. Praishe be to ye, commander ...hic!

text.title: 要塞战役：沙塔斯的陷落
text.objectives: 在塔拉多的圣光高塔与大主教玛拉达尔交谈。
text.description: 你好啊，$n，我又从大法师卡德加那里带来了新的消息。$B$B我们不能再对索克雷萨在沙塔斯的出现置之不理了。他散播着危险的信念，不断地转化更多德莱尼人加入他的“新组织”。$B$B是该除掉他的时候了。$B$B大主教玛拉达尔在塔拉多的圣光高塔等你。祝你好运，$n。
text.completion: I am glad to see you, $n. Your aid will be invaluable in this critical hour.

english.title: Garrison Campaign: The Fall of Shattrath
english.objectives: Speak to Exarch Maladaar at the Spire of Light in Talador.
english.description: Greetings, $n. I bring another message from Archmage Khadgar.$B$BWe can no longer ignore Socrethar's presence at Shattrath. He spreads dangerous beliefs, converting more draenei to his "new order" with each passing day.$B$BThe time has come for us to confront him.$B$BExarch Maladaar should be expecting you at the Spire of Light in Talador. Good luck, $n.
english.completion: I am glad to see you, $n. Your aid will be invaluable in this critical hour.

text.title: 要塞战役：沙塔斯的陷落
text.objectives: 在塔拉多的圣光高塔与女伯爵莉亚德琳交谈。
text.description: 你好啊，$n，我又从大法师卡德加那里带来了新的消息。$B$B我们不能再对索克雷萨在沙塔斯的出现置之不理了。他散播着危险的信念，不断地转化更多德莱尼人加入他的“新组织”。$B$B是该除掉他的时候了。$B$B女伯爵莉亚德琳在塔拉多的圣光高塔等你。祝你好运，$n。
text.completion: I am glad to see you, $n. Your aid will be invaluable in this critical hour.

english.title: Garrison Campaign: The Fall of Shattrath
english.objectives: Speak to Lady Liadrin at the Spire of Light in Talador.
english.description: Greetings, $n. I bring another message from Archmage Khadgar.$B$BWe can no longer ignore Socrethar's presence at Shattrath. He spreads dangerous beliefs, converting more draenei to his "new order" with each passing day.$B$BThe time has come for us to confront him.$B$BLady Liadrin should be expecting you at the Spire of Light in Talador. Good luck, $n.
english.completion: I am glad to see you, $n. Your aid will be invaluable in this critical hour.

text.title: 夺回首都
text.objectives: 收集$1oa份萨格雷徽记。
text.description: 我们对沙塔斯的攻势进展良好，可索克雷萨却一直不愿现身。$B$B我们尽了最大努力也无法突破沙塔斯的内城。圆顶的防御设施实在太坚固了。$B$B但有一个办法或许可以把他引诱出来。击败他的副官和战士们，然后收集他们身上的荣誉勋章。$B$B索克雷萨是个非常骄傲的人，一旦我们向他展示他的得力战将死亡的证据，他就不得不现身。
text.progress: What I ask is no easy task, for his scions are formidable. How goes the offensive?
text.completion: Excellent. These insignias will surely bring Socrethar out of hiding.
text.completed: Return to Exarch Maladaar at the Spire of Light.

english.title: Reclaiming the City
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Sargerei Insignias.
english.description: The Shattrath offensive is going well, but Socrethar refuses to show himself.$B$BDespite our best efforts, we are unable to break into the inner city of Shattrath. The dome's defenses are simply too strong.$B$BHowever, we think we can lure Socrethar out of hiding. Defeat his lieutenants and warriors, and gather their medallions of service.$B$BWhen we show him proof of their demise, his pride will surely force him to face us.
english.progress: What I ask is no easy task, for his scions are formidable. How goes the offensive?
english.completion: Excellent. These insignias will surely bring Socrethar out of hiding.
english.completed: Return to Exarch Maladaar at the Spire of Light.

text.objectives: 收集$1oa份萨格雷徽记。
text.description: 我们对沙塔斯的攻势进展良好，可索克雷萨却一直不愿现身。$B$B我们尽了最大努力也无法突破他所在的沙塔斯内城。$B$B但有一个办法或许可以把他引诱出来。击败他的副官和战士们，然后收集他们身上的荣誉勋章。$B$B索克雷萨是个非常骄傲的人，一旦我们向他展示他的得力战将死亡的证据，他就不得不现身。
text.progress: What I ask is no easy task, for his followers are formidable. How goes the offensive?
text.completion: Excellent. These insignias will surely bring Socrethar out of hiding.
text.completed: Return to Lady Liadrin at the Spire of Light.

english.title: Reclaiming the City
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Sargerei Insignias.
english.description: The Shattrath offensive is going well, but Socrethar refuses to show himself.$B$BAnd despite our best efforts, we are unable to break into the inner city, where he resides.$B$BHowever, we think we can lure Socrethar out of hiding. Defeat his lieutenants and warriors, then gather their medallions of service.$B$BWhen we show him proof of their demise, his pride will surely force him to face us.
english.progress: What I ask is no easy task, for his followers are formidable. How goes the offensive?
english.completion: Excellent. These insignias will surely bring Socrethar out of hiding.
english.completed: Return to Lady Liadrin at the Spire of Light.

text.title: 索克雷萨之死
text.objectives: 消灭索克雷萨。
text.description: 去沙塔斯圆顶的入口处找我。$B$B我们将在那里向萨格雷的领袖发出挑战。假如他接受了挑战，那么他肯定会死在那。$B$B那个管自己叫索克雷萨的家伙曾经是我的兄弟。我只能希望在他的体内还存有一丝的光明。
text.completion: Finally, it is done. Othaar... my old friend... be at peace now.
text.completed: Return to Exarch Maladaar at the Spire of Light.

english.title: Socrethar's Demise
english.objectives: Kill Socrethar.
english.description: Meet me down by the entrance to the Shattrath dome.$B$BThere, we will issue our challenge to the Sargerei leader. If he accepts our challenge, it is there that he shall meet his end.$B$BThe creature that calls himself Socrethar was once my brethren. I can only hope that there is still some Light left within him.
english.completion: Finally, it is done. Othaar... my old friend... be at peace now.
english.completed: Return to Exarch Maladaar at the Spire of Light.

text.title: 愤怒与智慧
text.objectives: 在苦痛山脊与游侠艾达妮谈一谈。
text.description: 在东边野地里的怪物与西边荒原中的野兽间爆发着无休无止的争斗。$b$b假如任何一方占了上风，整个德拉诺都会在胜利者的手中沦陷。$b$b我把游侠艾达妮派到了这两支敌对力量交战的中心地带。她可能会需要你的帮助，指挥官。
text.completion: These creatures are relentless in their assault against one another.

english.title: Rage and Wisdom
english.objectives: Speak to Rangari Erdanii at Affliction Ridge.
english.description: An endless war wages between the creatures of the eastern wilds and the beasts of the western wasteland.$b$bShould one side overwhelm the other, all of Draenor would fall at the hand of the victor.$b$bI sent Rangari Erdanii to the heart of the battle between these two forces. It is likely that she will need your help, commander.
english.completion: Эти существа рвутся в бой друг с другом с неукротимой яростью.

objectiveDetails.description: 让游侠拉洁丝带你飞去找游侠艾达妮

text.title: 索克雷萨之死
text.objectives: 消灭索克雷萨。
text.description: 去沙塔斯圆顶的入口处找我。$B$B我们将在那里向萨格雷的领袖发出挑战。假如他接受了挑战，那么他肯定会死在那。$B$B我得承认，$n，这正是我所希望的结果。
text.completion: Finally, it is done. This creature of darkness shall torment us no longer. Shattrath is free of his taint.
text.completed: Return to Lady Liadrin at the Spire of Light.

english.title: Socrethar's Demise
english.objectives: Kill Socrethar.
english.description: Meet me down by the entrance to the Shattrath dome.$B$BThere, we shall issue our challenge to the Sargerei leader. If he accepts, it is there that he shall meet his end.$B$BI must admit, $n, I am looking forward to this.
english.completion: Finally, it is done. This creature of darkness shall torment us no longer. Shattrath is free of his taint.
english.completed: Return to Lady Liadrin at the Spire of Light.

text.title: 严厉的提醒
text.objectives: 在苦痛山脊消灭$1oa个荒地住民。
text.description: 欢迎来到前线，指挥官，荒原与丛林中的怪物激战正酣。$b$b下方的战斗正在如火如荼的进行着，可我相信一方已经开始占据优势了。这可不行。$b$b小戈隆们渐渐占了上风，必须在它们对高山走廊构成威胁前出手阻止。$b$b你去消灭掉一些小戈隆，我会到更加接近战斗的地方去。等你完成后就到苦痛山脊找我吧。
text.completion: You have a true talent for combat.
text.completed: Speak to Rangari Erdanii within Affliction Ridge.

english.title: A Harsh Reminder
english.objectives: Kill $1oa denizens of the wasteland in Affliction Ridge.
english.description: Welcome to the front lines, commander, where the wastelands and the jungle collide.$b$bThe battle below rages on, but I believe one side is beginning to overwhelm the other. This cannot be allowed to happen.$b$bThe gronnlings are gaining an upper hand and must be stopped before they pose a threat to Highpass.$b$bI will get closer to the battle while you thin their ranks. Meet me within Affliction Ridge when you are done.
english.completion: У тебя настоящий талант к битве.
english.completed: Speak to Rangari Erdanii within Affliction Ridge.

text.title: Nagrand - Treasure 011 - Golden Kaliri Egg - TSH

english.title: Nagrand - Treasure 011 - Golden Kaliri Egg - TSH

text.title: 求和赠礼
text.objectives: 将一箱清凉果带给阿兰卡峰林的暮色先知艾里扎尔。
text.description: 我们需要在峰林中迅速找到盟友。指挥官，我认为你最好去找点外援。$B$B有个鸦人孤身一人住在这里东南边的掠食者巢穴边上。那些掠食者却不攻击他——也许他对这些野兽的了解会对我们有帮助。$B$B我给你准备了我们最后一箱清凉果。我们尽力而为吧，$G先生:女士;。
text.completion: I believe we can come to an arrangement, savior of Skettis. But first...
text.completed: Speak to Dusk-Seer Irizzar outside Veil Terokk.

english.title: Peace Offering
english.objectives: Deliver the Crate of Cactus Apple Surprise to Dusk-Seer Irizzar in the Spires of Arak.
english.description: We need allies amongst these spires, and quickly. Commander, I believe it would be wise if you sought out aid.$B$BThere is a lone arakkoa outcast southeast of here living near a ravager nest. The ravagers do not attack him - I suspect he has information on the beasts we may be able to use.$B$BI have our last crate of cactus apple surprise ready for you. It is our best shot, $Gsir:madame;.
english.completion: I believe we can come to an arrangement, savior of Skettis. But first...
english.completed: Speak to Dusk-Seer Irizzar outside Veil Terokk.

text.title: 求和赠礼
text.objectives: 将一箱北郡波尔多酒带给暮色先知艾里扎尔。
text.description: 我们目前亟需能够与之通商的盟友。$B$B这里的东北边住着一个鸦人，他孤身一人呆在掠食者横行的地方……你觉得他有没有可能跟我们结盟呢？他能住在掠食者眼皮底下，肯定是有两手的。$B$B我愿意把我自己最后的一箱北郡波尔多酒贡献出来，希望这能帮你说服他做我们的朋友。
text.completion: I believe we can come to an arrangement, savior of Skettis. But first...
text.completed: Speak to Dusk-Seer Irizzar outside Veil Terokk.

english.title: Peace Offering
english.objectives: Deliver the Crate of Northshire Port to Dusk-Seer Irizzar.
english.description: We could really use an ally to trade with, commander.$B$BThere's an arakkoa outcast living in the middle of a ravager nest northeast of here... do you think he might ally with us? He must have some sort of secret to keeping those ravagers at bay.$B$BI have one last crate of my Northshire Port. Maybe that will help convince him that we're friendly.
english.completion: I think we can make a deal, savior; Skettisa. But first...
english.completed: Speak to Dusk-Seer Irizzar outside Veil Terokk.

text.title: 钢铁锁链
text.objectives: 击败布拉克上尉，并找到玛戈隆之心。
text.description: 我们要找的神器已经在我们的控制之下了。$b$b准备迎接战斗吧。如果他们确实学会了如何控制戈隆的话，这也许会比我预想的还要困难。$b$b只要你一抵达，我就会加入战斗，与你并肩作战。
text.progress: We have the artifact, and with it we will make the Iron Horde pay.
text.completion: Yes... Think of the orcs that will fall before us with this power...
text.completed: Speak to Vindicator Maraad at Highpass.

english.title: Chains of Iron
english.objectives: Defeat Captain Brak and find the Heart of the Magnaron.
english.description: The artifact we seek is within our grasp.$b$bBe prepared for a fight. If they truly have learned how to control gronn, this may be more difficult than I anticipated.$b$bI will join you in this battle as soon as you arrive.
english.progress: We have the artifact, and with it we will make the Iron Horde pay.
english.completion: О да... Теперь, когда в наших руках такая сила, орки ничего не смогут нам противопоставить...
english.completed: Speak to Vindicator Maraad at Highpass.

text.title: 全线校准
text.objectives: 骑在卡鲁背上，消灭$1oa名信徒。
text.description: 鸦语者助祭身上带有埃匹希斯控制器，只要足够靠近就行了。$B$B来，让我们展翅高飞，夺取晨曦平台。$B$B等全线校准后，我们就能让敌人自食苦果，看着那些尖塔像火炬一样熊熊燃烧！$B$B我很期待将你的功绩载入史册。
text.completion: Percy and I want to give you something as a token of our thanks. It's not much but please, take your reward.

english.title: When All Is Aligned
english.objectives: Fly upon Ka'alu and kill $1oa Adherents.
english.description: The ravenspeaker acolytes have been equipped with Apexis interfaces, they just need to get close enough.$B$BCome, let us take to the skies and secure the Terrace of Dawn.$B$BWhen all is aligned, we shall turn the false suns against one another and the spires shall burn like torches!$B$BI look forward to penning your actions into history.
english.completion: Мы с Перси хотим подарить тебе кое-что в знак нашей благодарности. Это мелочь, но, прошу, прими нашу скромную награду.

text.title: 哪里都有好买卖
text.objectives: 去阴郁沼泽与米克茜·焊爆谈一谈。
text.description: 指挥官，最近有对地精走私者姐妹——米克茜·焊爆和崔克斯·焊爆来过这里。他们要去东边的沼泽。$B$B她们带了钻探设备但却似乎没有携带任何武器，$G先生:女士;。$B$B让我赌什么都行，她们肯定有我们需要的材料，我们可以为她们提供保护来作为交换。$B$B我觉得去找找她们会是个好主意，$G先生:女士;。
text.completion: I don't know what you're doin' all the way out here, but mind helpin' a gal out since you're stopping by?
text.completed: Speak to Mixxy Weldblast in the Dread Bog.

english.title: Best Deals Anywhere
english.objectives: Speak to Mixxy Weldblast in Murkbog.
english.description: Commander, two goblin smugglers - Mixxy and Trixxy Weldblast - came through here recently and went off towards the bog to the east.$B$BThey had drilling equipment but weren't carrying any weapons, $Gsir:madame;.$B$BI'd bet anything that they'll have materials we'd want, and that they could use some protection in return.$B$BCommander, I think seeking them out would be a good idea.
english.completion: I don't know what you're doin' all the way out here, but mind helpin' a gal out since you're stopping by?
english.completed: Speak to Mixxy Weldblast in the Dread Bog.

text.title: 黏糊糊的处境
text.objectives: 获得$1oa枚浸水的电池。
text.description: 我们正把电池运往挖掘场，结果我却在半路上出了车祸！$B$B我姐姐甚至都没回头看一眼。我就是转弯的时候急了点，结果谁知就这样了！$B$B关键是，我车上的电池飞得到处都是，但我现在这个状况没法把它们都去捡起来。$B$B怎么说？你要帮忙吗？
text.progress: Do you have the batteries?
text.completion: You're a real doll. Let's get out of here.
text.completed: Return to Mixxy Weldblast in Murkbog.

english.title: Sticky Situation
english.objectives: Retrieve $1oa Submerged Batteries.
english.description: We were hauling batteries to the excavation site and I crashed my freakin' car!$B$BMy sister didn't even look back. I took the turn a little fast, so what? It happens!$B$BPoint is, the batteries went flying everywhere and I'm in no condition to lift them out.$B$BSo what do you say? Wanna help me out?
english.progress: Do you have the batteries?
english.completion: You're a real doll. Let's get out of here.
english.completed: Return to Mixxy Weldblast in Murkbog.

text.title: 丛林之心
text.objectives: 在丛林之心外面与佩妮·殴底谈一谈。
text.description:
你好啊，可人儿。我们的伐木场已经准备就绪，但是得找到快速伐木的办法才行。

嘲颅氏族提到了丛林之心，木精们在那里以极快的速度培育植物。

我现在就要去那看看。
text.completion: Hey! Looky what I found here.

english.title: Tangleheart
english.objectives: Speak to Penny Clobberbottom outside Tangleheart.
english.description:
Hey there, peach. We've got the lumber mill good and ready, but we gotta find a way of choppin' wood fast out here.

The Laughing Skull talked about Tangleheart, where the botani grow things quick as a quark.

I'm headin' there now.
english.completion: Hey! Looky what I found here.

text.title: 丛林之心
text.objectives: 在丛林之心外面与格林谈一谈。
text.description:
游侠们刚到这里不久，他们听嘲颅氏族提到了一个名叫丛林之心的地方。

看来那些邪恶至极的古树都是从那跑来的，而且木精正在用某种汁液使它们快速生长。

我想我们可以利用那些古树为你的哨站服务。嘿，木头就是木头，对吧？

到那见吧。
text.completion: Cheers! I found a goblin skulkin' about here. Think I'll keep 'er around. Says she knows things about lumberjackin'.

english.title: Tangleheart
english.objectives: Speak to Glirin outside Tangleheart.
english.description:
The Rangari have been here for a tick, and they hear tell from the Laughing Skull o' a place called Tangleheart.

Seems some really bad ancients come from there, and botani use a kind o' sap to grow them quickly.

I think we could use that for yer outpost. Hey, wood is wood, right?

I'll meet ya there.
english.completion: Cheers! I found a goblin skulkin' about here. Think I'll keep 'er around. Says she knows things about lumberjackin'.

text.title: Nagrand - Vignette Boss 012 - Redclaw the Feral

english.title: Nagrand - Vignette Boss 012 - Redclaw the Feral

text.title: 焊投兄弟
text.objectives: 去阴郁沼泽与费尔伯特·焊投谈一谈。
text.description: 指挥官，你出门的时候，两名侏儒走私者来过这里——迪尔伯特·焊投和费尔伯特·焊投两兄弟。他们要去东边的沼泽。$B$B他们有各种钻探设备但却似乎没有携带任何武器。$B$B你觉得为他们提供保护以换取他们的资源的主意如何？$B$B假如你愿意过去，我会帮你记录他们前往的地点。
text.completion: You're armed to the teeth! Say, would you be interested in helping a weary gnome out?

english.title: The Tinkertoss Twins
english.objectives: Speak to Filbert Tinkertoss in Murkbog.
english.description: Commander, two gnomish smugglers passed by while you were out - Filbert and Dilbert Tinkertoss. They were headed towards the bog to the east.$B$BThey had all sorts of drilling equipment but didn't seem to have any weapons.$B$BWhat do you think of offering them protection in exchange for some of their materials?$B$BI'll jot down where they were headed in case you decide to go.
english.completion: Ого! Да ты $Gвооружен:вооружена; до зубов! Ух, что за доспех! Слушай, не поможешь усталому гному в беде?

text.title: Nagrand - Vignette Boss 002 - Gar'lua the Wolfmother

english.title: Nagrand - Vignette Boss 002 - Gar'lua the Wolfmother

text.title: 黏糊糊的处境
text.objectives: 获得$1oa枚浸水的电池。
text.description: 我们前往挖掘场时被一支鸦人中队发现了，他们袭击了我们的车队。$B$B我兄弟乘乱逃走了，他真是个幸运儿。$B$B我不能把钻探机的电池留在这儿，但它们都掉进沼泽里了，我怎么也没办法把它们弄起来。$B$B你能帮我把它们弄来吗？
text.progress: Any luck?
text.completion: You're a lifesaver! Let's get these to the excavation site.
text.completed: Return to Filbert Tinkertoss in Murkbog.

english.title: Sticky Situation
english.objectives: Retrieve $1oa Submerged Batteries.
english.description: A squadron of arakkoa spotted us while we were en route to the excavation site and took out our caravan. My brother made it to safety in the chaos.$B$BLucky son of a tinker.$B$BI can't leave without the batteries for our drill, but they all fell into the bog and I can't even get them to budge.$B$BAny chance you could retrieve them for me?
english.progress: Any luck?
english.completion: Я навеки твой должник! А теперь поехали на место раскопок.
english.completed: Return to Filbert Tinkertoss in Murkbog.

text.title: Nagrand - Vignette Boss 015 - Gnarlhoof the Rabid

english.title: Nagrand - Vignette Boss 015 - Gnarlhoof the Rabid

text.title: 回归正轨
text.objectives: 去泽克鸦巢与崔克斯·焊爆谈一谈。
text.description: 你真是我的大救星！$B$B你瞧，你要不要先前往挖掘场，让我姐姐知道我就要过去了。我得先把所有事情都弄妥，然后弄一支车队来把这些都拖走。
text.completion: Oh, Mixxy sent you? What a relief. I'm not even armed!
text.completed: Speak to Trixxy Weldblast in Veil.

english.title: Back on Track
english.objectives: Speak to Trixxy Weldblast in Veil Zekk.
english.description: You're a lifesaver, I'll tell you what.$B$BSay, how about you go on ahead to the excavation site and let my sister know I'm on my way. I'll get everything neat and tidy and go get a new cart to lug these over.
english.completion: Oh, Mixxy sent you? What a relief. I'm not even armed!
english.completed: Speak to Trixxy Weldblast in Veil.

text.title: 回归正轨
text.objectives: 去泽克鸦巢与迪尔伯特·焊投谈一谈。
text.description: 现在，有了从沼泽地里弄出来的电池，我就能用无线电呼叫更多的旋翼机把它们带到营地里去。$B$B我在这边等他们来，不过你可以先去找我兄弟迪尔伯特，告诉他这里发生了些什么。他肯定担心死了。
text.completion: Oh, thank goodness. I don't even have any weapons!
text.completed: Speak to Dilvert Tinkertoss in Veil.

english.title: Back on Track
english.objectives: Speak to Dilbert Tinkertoss in Veil Zekk.
english.description: Now that the batteries are out of the bog I can radio in some more copters to take them to camp.$B$BI'll stay here until they arrive, but you should go ahead to my brother Dilbert and let him know what happened. He must be worried sick!
english.completion: О, наконец-то. У меня ведь и оружия-то нет!
english.completed: Speak to Dilvert Tinkertoss in Veil.

text.title: 灼烧伤口
text.objectives: 用烧灼火把来灼烧尼莎的伤口。
text.description: 你救了我最珍贵的伙伴尼莎。我欠你很大一份情。$B$B钢铁部落把我引开，害我们走散了。我决不会再犯同样的错误。$B$B他们把她伤的很重，但我们恐怕得先带给她更多的疼痛才能开始治疗工作。$B$B请你到附近的火堆里点根火把来灼烧她的伤口。$B$B我负责按住她。
text.progress: Nisha must make it through this.
text.completion: Thank you. Her wounds have closed.
text.completed: Return to Rexxar at Sulfur Basin.

english.title: Cauterizing Wounds
english.objectives: Use a Burning Log to cauterize Nisha's wounds.
english.description: You have saved my most precious companion, Nisha. I owe you a great debt.$b$bThe Iron Horde lured me away to separate us. I shall not make the same mistake again.$b$bThey have inflicted grievous wounds, and I fear we must cause her even more pain before the healing process can begin.$b$bPlease use a burning log from the nearby fire to cauterize her wounds.$b$bI will hold her down.
english.progress: Nisha must make it through this.
english.completion: Спасибо. Теперь ее раны закрылись.
english.completed: Return to Rexxar at Sulfur Basin.

text.title: 鸦爪祭司的仪式
text.objectives: 把泰罗克之锤放到泰罗克雕像上。
text.description:
那把锤子原先叫折喙者。在泰罗克最后的黑暗日子里，他手持折喙者发起了残忍无情的献祭行动。

那些暗无天日的往昔岁月令人不忍回想。

后来，人们把泰罗克封印到暗影深处，希望他能在那里得到安眠和治疗。

与他建立联系可不是件容易的事，因此，请允许我给你讲述他在还没受到这卑鄙的诅咒以前，那些辉煌卓越的丰功伟绩。

请把锤子放在雕像上。
text.completion: <As you place the gavel at the base of the effigy, Reshad speaks over your shoulder.>
text.completed: 把泰罗克之锤放到泰罗克雕像上。

english.title: Rites of the Talonpriests
english.objectives: Place Terokk's Gavel on the Effigy of Terokk.
english.description:
That gavel was once known as Beakbreaker. In his final, darkest days, Terokk used it to perform grim, damnable acts of sacrifice. 

It is best not to dwell on those days.

Terokk was sealed away deep within the shadows to rest, and perhaps to heal.

Making contact with him will take a great deal of effort, so in the meantime, allow me to tell you of his more glorious exploits. Before this wretched curse took hold.

Please, place the gavel upon the effigy.
english.completion: <As you place the gavel at the base of the effigy, Reshad speaks over your shoulder.>
english.completed: Place Terokk's Gavel on the Effigy of Terokk.

text.title: 利爪之王
text.objectives: 使用泰罗克雕像重现泰罗克与血鬃虎人的战斗。消灭$1oa名血鬃短齿战士、$2oa名成年血鬃虎人，以及虎王卡拉什。
text.description:
<随着瑞沙德开始讲述泰罗克的光辉岁月，你的眼神停在了插在雕像腰带两侧的一双利刃上。

它们原本只是斯克提斯两把平平无奇的佩剑而已，此刻却散发着力量，仿佛在与藏卷人的话语遥相呼应。>
text.completion: That was but one of many such tales.$B$BNo arakkoa living or dead has ever compared to the Talon King.
text.completed: Speak with Reshad in Veil Terokk.

english.title: The Talon King
english.objectives: Use the Effigy of Terokk to re-live Terokk's battle with the Bloodmane. Slay $1oa Bloodmane Shortfangs, $2oa Mature Bloodmane saberon, and Pridelord Karash.
english.description:
<As Reshad begins reciting a tale of Terokk's glory days, your eyes fall to the twin swords at the effigy's belt.

They had seemed so plain in Skettis, but now they thrum with power, as if reacting to the scrollkeeper's words.>
english.completion: That was but one of many such tales.$B$BNo arakkoa living or dead has ever compared to the Talon King.
english.completed: Speak with Reshad in Veil Terokk.

text.title: 雪中留字
text.objectives: 把被撕烂的日志交给你要塞中的洛坎。
text.description: 这张破旧的纸出自暗影猎手布加的日志。上面似乎画着血槌奴隶矿井入口的草图。你的要塞中的洛坎会对这个感兴趣的。
text.completion: Excellent work. Your service is always appreciated, $n.
text.completed: 回你的要塞找洛坎。

english.title: Writing in the Snow
english.objectives: Deliver the tattered journal page to Rokhan in your garrison.
english.description: This is a worn page from Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja's journal. It appears to be a sketch of the entrance of the Bloodmaul Slave Mines. Rokhan, in your garrison, would be very interested in this.
english.completion: Excellent work. Your service is always appreciated, $n.
english.completed: Return to Rokhan in your Garrison.

text.title: 雪中留字
text.objectives: 把被撕烂的日志交给你的要塞里的伯德里克·格雷
text.description: 这张破旧的纸来自欧文·加多克的日志。上面似乎画着血槌奴隶矿井入口的草图。你要塞中的伯德里克·格雷会对这个感兴趣的。
text.completion: Excellent work. Your service is always appreciated, $n.
text.completed: 回你的要塞找伯德里克·格雷。

english.title: Writing in the Snow
english.objectives: Deliver the tattered journal page to Bodrick Grey in your garrison.
english.description: This is a worn page from Owynn Graddock's journal. It appears to be a sketch of the entrance of the Bloodmaul Slave Mines. Bodrick Grey, in your garrison, would be very interested in this.
english.completion: Excellent work. Your service is always appreciated, $n.
english.completed: Return to Bodrick Grey in your garrison.

text.title: 自然而燃
text.objectives: 从古树身上收集$1oa份新鲜的木炭。
text.description: 哦，你有一处走私者巢穴？$B$B我是很想和你做交易，但伙伴你看，我的镭射加农炮有点问题。$B$B我跟你说啊，看见周围这些古树了没有？他们都被烤焦了，成了名副其实的木炭。带点这种焦炭来，好让我给这玩意儿充能，然后我们就可以开始交易了。
text.progress: If you've got the stuff, let's talk.
text.completion: That ought to do it! Nice work.
text.completed: Return to to Trixxy Weldblast in Veil Zekk.

english.title: All Natural
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Fresh Charcoal from ancients.
english.description: So you have a smuggler's den, huh?$B$BI'd love to trade with ya, toots, I really would, but my laser cannon isn't even functional right now.$B$BI'll tell you what. See all the ancients around here? They got toasted good by the arakkoa's weapon, and they're practically walking piles of charcoal.$B$BBring me some charcoal to power this thing and you've got a deal.
english.progress: If you've got the stuff, let's talk.
english.completion: That ought to do it! Nice work.
english.completed: Return to to Trixxy Weldblast in Veil Zekk.

text.title: 自然而燃
text.objectives: 从古树身上收集$1oa份新鲜的木炭。
text.description: 哦，你有一座货栈？$B$B太棒了！$B$B让我们做笔交易把。你帮我把我的镭射加农炮补充上能量，我就用一些这种……热线……超级黑曜石玻璃跟你换几把武器。$B$B这里的古树在被鸦人的武器轰过以后都变成了焦炭，你应该去弄点这个过来！
text.progress: Blasted refurbished goblin tech is always malfunctioning.
text.completion: That's... quite a bit of charcoal. Nicely done!
text.completed: Return to Dilbert Tinkertoss in Veil Zekk.

english.title: All Natural
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Fresh Charcoal from ancients.
english.description: Oh, you have a trading post?$B$BFantastic!$B$BLet's make a deal. You help me power up my laser cannon, and I'll trade some of this... thermo... ultra... obsidiglass with you for some weapons.$B$BThe ancients all around here are practically made of charcoal after the arakkoa weapon hit, you should go get some of that!
english.progress: Blasted refurbished goblin tech is always malfunctioning.
english.completion: Ого, сколько ты угля $Gпритащил:притащила;. Отлично!
english.completed: Return to Dilbert Tinkertoss in Veil Zekk.

text.title: 终结斩杀
text.objectives: 击败$1oa名铁军处决者。
text.description: 我们第一时间赶过来……但是已经晚了。钢铁部落将许多战士扣为了俘虏。$B$B他们无疑正试图从那些战士身上拷问出重要情报。$B$B恐怕一旦他们得到想要的情报就会立刻杀了那些俘虏。我们时间紧迫。
text.completion: Da prisoners be shaken up, but they are free. We be in your debt, $n.
text.completed: Return to Rokhan at the Shattered Landing in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Ending Executions
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Ironmarch Executioners
english.description: We arrived as soon as we could... but we be too late. Da Iron Horde has taken our warriors prisoner.$b$bNo doubt they be trying ta squeeze info out of da troops.$b$bI fear once they are done with da interrogation they gonna execute their prisoners. Time be running out.
english.completion: Da prisoners be shaken up, but they are free. We be in your debt, $n.
english.completed: Return to Rokhan at the Shattered Landing in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 钢铁部落来袭
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa名铁军步兵。
text.description: 我们接到报告，在袭击开始前，黑暗之门变成了红色。他们自称是“钢铁部落”。$B$B他们的部队装备极为精良，兵员数量似乎无穷无尽。$B$B目前欧卡里隆堡垒和守望堡都已经落入了他们的手里。我们的前线部队需要你的帮助，$c。
text.completion: Aka'Magosh, champion. I'm sure your presence on the field was inspiring for the troops.
text.completed: Return to Thrall at the Shattered Landing in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Attack of the Iron Horde
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Ironmarch Grunts.
english.description: We received reports of the Dark Portal turning red right before the attack. They call themselves the Iron Horde.$b$bTheir army is extremely well equipped, and their numbers appear to be unending.$b$bThey have already taken Okril'lon Hold and Nethergarde Keep. Our troops on the frontlines could use your help, $c.
english.completion: Aka'Magosh, champion. I'm sure your presence on the field was inspiring for the troops.
english.completed: Return to Thrall at the Shattered Landing in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 兵临城下
text.objectives: 破坏$1oa辆钢铁攻城车。
text.description: 这些钢铁部落的火炮正在轰炸我们的部队。我不知道还能撑多久。我们的部队已经捉襟见肘了。$B$B必须想办法阻止这些战争兵器。
text.completion: It will take the Iron Horde quite a while to get those demolishers operational again. Throm-Ka, $n.
text.completed: Return to Thrall at the Shattered Landing in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Under Siege
english.objectives: Sabotage $1oa Iron Demolishers.
english.description: Those Iron Horde cannons are laying waste to our troops. I'm not sure how much more of this we can handle. Our forces are already spread too thin.$b$bThere has to be a way to stop those war machines.
english.completion: It will take the Iron Horde quite a while to get those demolishers operational again. Throm-Ka, $n.
english.completed: Return to Thrall at the Shattered Landing in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 前往坦克的顶部
text.objectives: 与塞林·暗砧交谈，并护送他前往钢铁灭世者的顶部。
text.description: 我们绝不能冒重新激活黑暗之门的风险。现在是时候发起致命一击了。$b$b塞林此刻应该已经想出了开动那坦克的办法。把他带在身边，让坦克对准黑暗之门。我们会跟着你们的。
text.completion: This... I can work with this.

english.title: Taking a Trip to the Top of the Tank
english.objectives: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil, then escort him to the top of the Iron Worldbreaker.
english.description: We cannot risk the reactivation of the Dark Portal. Now is the time for the deathblow.$b$bThaelin should have figured out how to get that tank working by now. Take him with you, and turn that tank against the Dark Portal itself. We will follow behind you.
english.completion: This... I can work with this.

objectiveDetails.description: 爬上钢铁灭世者的后部链条

text.title: 反侦察
text.objectives: 击败$1oa名钢铁部落斥候。
text.description: 我们的作战计划几乎无一能正常实行。我们被监视了。$B$B钢铁部落一定是在诅咒之地安插了斥候。胜利的机会正在从我们手中溜走。
text.completion: You killed how many scouts? No wonder we have been unable to execute our plans...
text.completed: Return to Thrall at the Shattered Landing in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Subversive Scouts
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Iron Horde scouts.
english.description: We have been unable to execute a vast majority of our battleplans. We are definitely being watched.$b$bThe Iron Horde must have scouts planted throughout the Blasted Lands. Victory is slipping away from us.
english.completion: You killed how many scouts? No wonder we have been unable to execute our plans...
english.completed: Return to Thrall at the Shattered Landing in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 有勇无谋？
text.objectives: 获取钢铁部落作战计划。
text.description: 现在我们应该反过来了解敌人的更多情报。$B$B我们的斥候识别出了钢铁部落的几位中级军官。他们的攻击方式非常有组织性和纪律性，这样的战术是不可能从单纯的游牧文化中自然领悟出来的。肯定是有人给这些军官提供了什么锦囊妙计。$B$B你是我执行这项任务的唯一一个人选，$n。
text.progress: Were you able to gain access to any battleplans?
text.completion: Let's take a look at these battleplans.
text.completed: Return to Thrall at the Rise of the Defiler in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Lunatic Lieutenants
english.objectives: Collect Iron Horde battleplans.
english.description: It is time we learned more about our new enemy.$b$bOur scouts have identified a number of the Iron Horde's lieutenants. Their attack is too organized to be run by tribal knowledge alone. Surely their lieutenants have access to secret battleplans. $b$bYou are the only soldier I can trust with this mission, $n.
english.progress: Ну что, удалось достать боевые планы?
english.completion: Let's take a look at these battleplans.
english.completed: Return to Thrall at the Rise of the Defiler in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 进攻守望堡
text.objectives: 把部落旗帜插在守望堡。
text.description: 钢铁部落控制着守望堡。但他们还真以为我们会任由他们占据这一战略重地吗？$B$B我最精锐的部队已经迫不及待地想要让这些野蛮人泼洒鲜血了，但我们需要一位英雄来率领他们展开进攻，那就是你。
text.completion: The Iron Horde will learn to fear us, as they should.
text.completed: Return to Thrall at the Rise of the Defiler in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Attack on Nethergarde
english.objectives: Plant the Horde flags inside Nethergarde Keep.
english.description: The Iron Horde controls Nethergarde Keep, but they are fools if they think we will let them retain such a strategic position.$b$bMy best troops are more than eager to spill the blood of those savages, but we need a champion like yourself to lead the charge.
english.completion: The Iron Horde will learn to fear us, as they should.
english.completed: Return to Thrall at the Rise of the Defiler in the Blasted Lands.

objectiveDetails.description: 把旗帜插在守望堡入口处
把旗帜插在守望堡正当中
把旗帜插在主要塞外面

text.title: 歼灭者碎牙
text.objectives: 干掉歼灭者碎牙
text.description: 假如你带来的作战计划是真的，那么除钢铁部落外，巨槌食人魔同样要为这场惨剧负责。是该给这些食人魔提个醒了。$B$B这些食人魔和钢铁部落的主要联络人似乎是巨槌要塞里面一个叫碎牙的食人魔。$B$B杀了他就能给他们的作战计划带来巨大的打击。
text.completion: Toothsmash is dead? Good, I'm sure it will take the Iron Horde a while to find another ogre smart enough to help them with their efforts.
text.completed: Return to Thrall at the Rise of the Defiler in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Toothsmash the Annihilator
english.objectives: Kill Toothsmash the Annihilator
english.description: If the battleplans you brought back are true, the Dreadmaul ogres are as much to blame for this devastation as the Iron Horde. It's time we send those ogres a message.$b$bIt looks like the Iron Horde's main contact is a large ogre in Dreadmaul named Toothsmash. Killing him will put a dent in their battleplans.
english.completion: Toothsmash is dead? Good, I'm sure it will take the Iron Horde a while to find another ogre smart enough to help them with their efforts.
english.completed: Return to Thrall at the Rise of the Defiler in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 搜寻守望堡
text.objectives: 获得埃托克的战斧、妮卡的毒药瓶、监工史翠克的盾牌。
text.description: 钢铁部落攻下守望堡后，我们发动了攻击。当我们消灭了守望堡里的钢铁部落后，他们通过黑暗之门带来了更多的增援部队，甚至夺取了欧卡里隆堡垒。$B$B我们绝不能忘记那些在守望堡献出了生命的战士们。假如你找到那些烈士们的遗物，请把它们带回来给我。
text.progress: Did you find anything?
text.completion: Throm-Ka, $n. These mementos will forever remind us of our champions.
text.completed: Return to Okrilla at the Rise of the Defiler in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Ransacking Nethergarde
english.objectives: Collect Master Aitokk's Axe, Neka's Poison Flask, and Overseer Struk's Shield.
english.description: After the Iron Horde took Nethergarde we attacked. While we killed the Iron Horde at Nethergarde they brought more forces through the portal and took Okril'lon Hold. So many souls stripped of their bodies by those savages.$b$bWe must not forget those that gave their lives at Nethergarde. If you find any mementos of the fallen, bring them back to me.
english.progress: Удалось что-нибудь отыскать?
english.completion: Throm-Ka, $n. These mementos will forever remind us of our champions.
english.completed: Return to Okrilla at the Rise of the Defiler in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 铲除巨槌
text.objectives: 击败$1oa名巨槌食人魔。
text.description: 巨槌食人魔不断在刷新他们的智商下限。钢铁部落显然只是为了自己的阴谋在利用他们。$B$B但无论如何，我们要让这些食人魔看看，招惹真正的部落会有什么下场。该给这些巨槌食人魔一个教训了。
text.completion: It's important that our enemies understand what happens when you attack the true Horde. I'm glad you could be there to show them.
text.completed: Return to Thrall at the Shattered Landing in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Death to the Dreadmaul
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Dreadmaul Ogres.
english.description: The stupidity of the Dreadmaul ogres never ceases to amaze me. The Iron Horde is clearly using them to further their own nefarious agenda.$b$bRegardless, we must show the ogres what happens when you confront the true Horde. I think it's time we send the Dreadmaul ogres a message.
english.completion: It's important that our enemies understand what happens when you attack the true Horde. I'm glad you could be there to show them.
english.completed: Return to Thrall at the Shattered Landing in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 加玛克·折刃
text.objectives: 击败加玛克·折刃。
text.description: 通过你收集来的这些情报。我们得知这支入侵部队是由一名叫做加玛克·折刃的钢铁部落兽人所领导的。他就呆在欧卡里隆堡垒中的一个地堡里。$B$B除掉他并不会使得我们立即赢得这场战争，但势必能切断钢铁部落的联络渠道。$B$B这能给我们争取宝贵的时间以集结更多的部队，并制定出一份作战计划来彻底铲除这一新的威胁。
text.completion: It was an honor fighting alongside of you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Thrall at the Shattered Landing in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Gar'mak Bladetwist
english.objectives: Kill Gar'mak Bladetwist.
english.description: With the intelligence you have gathered we have learned this assault is being led by a powerful Iron Horde orc named Gar'mak Bladetwist. He is hunkered down inside Okril'lon Hold.$b$bKilling him will not win this war, but it will surely break down the Iron Horde's communication. This will buy us valuable time while we gather more forces and outline a battleplan to deal with this new threat.
english.completion: It was an honor fighting alongside of you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Thrall at the Shattered Landing in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 奥克莉拉的复仇
text.objectives: 在巨槌食人魔的食物供应里下毒。
text.description: 巨槌食人魔以为他们打败了我们？他们会付出代价的。带上这瓶毒药，往他们的军粮里滴上几滴。$b$b这种毒药会缓慢地侵蚀他们的内脏，带来漫长而又痛苦的死亡。这是他们应得的。
text.completion: I wish I could be there to watch their faces as they suffer. I hope they all die a slow horrible death.
text.completed: Return to Okrilla at the Rise of the Defiler in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Okrilla's Revenge
english.objectives: Poison the Dreadmaul ogre food supply.
english.description: The Dreadmaul ogres think they have bested us? They will all suffer. Here take this poison, place a couple drops in their rat stew.$b$bThe poison will slowly eat away at their insides. Causing a prolonged and painful death, just like they deserve.
english.completion: I wish I could be there to watch their faces as they suffer. I hope they all die a slow horrible death.
english.completed: Return to Okrilla at the Rise of the Defiler in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 我看到了死鸦人
text.objectives: 使用驱鬼者12000型，并消灭鸦爪祭司泽克的鬼魂。
text.description: 我现在遇到了一个非常诡异的问题，你或许能帮上忙。我都不知道该找谁了。$B$B我的工人们一直说他们撞见了以前这里的一个鸦人的鬼魂。$B$B我知道，我知道，这听起来太疯狂了。但你能不能用我的驱鬼者12000型去检查一下她的尸体？假如附近真的有鬼，它就能找到的。要是找不到，那肯定就是我的工人在浑水摸鱼了。
text.completion: Well, I'll be. Ghosts. Who knew?
text.completed: Return to Trixxy Weldblast in Veil Zekk.

english.title: I See Dead Arakkoa
english.objectives: Use the Ghostogrifier 12000 and kill the spirit of Talonpriest Zekk.
english.description: I've got a strange problem and I'm hoping you might be able to help. I don't know who else could help, to be honest.$B$BMy workers keep saying they're seeing the ghost of the arakkoa that used to head up this place.$B$BI know, I know, it's crazy but could you take my Ghostogrifier 12000 to her body and check?$B$BIf there's a ghost around here, it'll find it. If there's not, then my workers are trying to slack off on the clock.
english.completion: Well, I'll be. Ghosts. Who knew?
english.completed: Return to Trixxy Weldblast in Veil Zekk.

text.title: Nagrand - Vignette Boss 020 - Ancient Blademaster - TSH

english.title: Nagrand - Vignette Boss 020 - Ancient Blademaster - TSH

text.title: 我看到了死鸦人
text.objectives: 使用驱鬼者12000型，并消灭鸦爪祭司泽克的鬼魂。
text.description: 你既然来了，是否介意帮我解决一个头疼的问题呢？$B$B工人们一直说他们撞见了以前这里的一个鸦人头头的鬼魂。$B$B我是根本不信的，但你能不能用我的驱鬼者12000型去检查一下她的尸体？这玩意儿能证明我的工人们到底是不是疯了。
text.completion: You're kidding! What a world.
text.completed: Return to Dilbert Tinkertoss in Veil Zekk.

english.title: I See Dead Arakkoa
english.objectives: Use the Ghostogrifier 12000 and kill the spirit of Talonpriest Zekk.
english.description: Say, while you're here would you mind helping me out with a major problem?$B$BThe workers keep saying that they're seeing the ghost of the head arakkoa that used to be here.$B$BI don't believe it for a second but could you take my Ghostogrifier 12000 to her body and check?$B$BIf they're not crazy, it'll prove it.
english.completion: Не шутишь? Во дела! Чего только не бывает на свете!
english.completed: Return to Dilbert Tinkertoss in Veil Zekk.

text.title: 乌木猎手
text.objectives: 从乌木猎手身上取得活体激光球。
text.description: 一旦我们将激光炮台设置好，就能正式投入使用了，但眼下我们还缺一样东西。$B$B一个叫乌木猎手的孢子爬行者就在东南海岸的三角洲处游荡。它脸上有一个器官可以发射激光，比我们目前在用的激光发射器的火力要强很多。$B$B我们需要它。$B$B你负责去把它弄来，我们继续在这里设置炮台。
text.progress: I should probably have mentioned that the laser is pretty... potent.
text.completion: Perfection. Let's get it hooked up!
text.completed: Return to Trixxy Weldblast in Veil Zekk.

english.title: The Ebon Hunter
english.objectives: Collect an Organic Laser Apparatus from the Ebon Hunter.
english.description: The laser should be good to go once we get it set up, there's just one more thing I need.$B$BThere's a spore walker that hunts on the delta just southeast from here. It has an apparatus on its face that can fire a powerful laser - way more powerful than what we have hooked up.$B$BI want it.$B$BWe'll be mining faster than you can imagine once we get that bad boy hooked up!
english.progress: I should probably have mentioned that the laser is pretty... potent.
english.completion: Perfection. Let's get it hooked up!
english.completed: Return to Trixxy Weldblast in Veil Zekk.

text.title: 荣耀的证明：艾罗萨恩
text.objectives: 把战利品带到戈尔隆德的蛮兽岗哨，交给杜隆坦。
text.description: 击败艾罗萨恩后，你获得了一件值得拾取的战利品。$b$b把它带到蛮兽岗哨交给杜隆坦。
text.completion: One minute you are skirting the cauldrons avoiding the Gronn, the next a blast a steam followed by burning hot claws. Erosian's death should make our scouts lives a lot easier!

english.title: Trophy of Glory: Erosian
english.objectives: Take the trophy to Durotan at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
english.description: Defeating Erosian has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.$b$bTake this to Durotan at Beastwatch.
english.completion: Раньше разведчикам приходилось шастать между котлов, спасаясь от гроннов и одновременно рискуя попасть в раскаленные когти паровых элементалей. После смерти Эрозиана они вздохнут свободно!

text.completion: One minute you are skirting the cauldrons avoiding the Gronn, the next a blast a steam followed by burning hot claws. Erosian's death should make our scouts lives a lot easier!

text.description: 击败德斯克斯后，你获得了一件值得拾取的战利品。$b$b把它带到高山走廊交给玛尔拉德。
text.completion: You have defeated yet another deadly beast in Gorgrond.$B$BDessicus cared little on who he preyed upon, they all went into his salt pools forever. You have saved many lives $n!

text.title: 荣耀的证明：火山领主伊格尼斯
text.objectives: 把战利品带到戈尔隆德的蛮兽岗哨，交给杜隆坦。

text.title: 我惹上了……植物怪
text.objectives: 到荒林洼地找塞林·暗砧。
text.description: $p？见到你真是太好了。$b$b我当时正想甩掉那个原祖荆兽，结果就闯到这个游侠营地里来了。$b$b还没等我反应过来，大地就开始震颤，不知打哪冒出来好多愤怒的植物。$b$b我好不容易才从坦克里爬出来，眼睁睁地看着那个原祖荆兽把坦克像空啤酒杯那样抛了出去。$b$b我得沿路返回，找找我的坦克。$b$b等你完成这里的任务后，我们到那见吧。
text.completion: Ah perfect. I'll get this up an' runnin' in no time.
text.completed: 到荒林洼地找塞林·暗砧。

english.title: I Drew Aggro...culture
english.objectives: Meet Thaelin Darkanvil at the Wildwood Wash.
english.description: $p? Boy am I glad to see ya.$b$bI was tryin' ta ditch that genesaur when I stumbled across this rangari camp.$b$bNext thing I know, the ground is creepin' up and spittin' out all sorts of angry plants.$b$bI barely made it out of me tank before that genesaur threw it like it was an empty beer mug.$b$bI'm gonna make my way back to the road an' look fer me tank.$b$bI'll see ya there when yer done.
english.completion: Отлично. Теперь он у меня живо забегает.
english.completed: Meet Thaelin Darkanvil at the Wildwood Wash.

text.title: 原祖荆兽的破坏力
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个野性生长物。
text.description: 一开始有一台铁疙瘩开进我们的营地，接着就有一只原祖荆兽紧随其后，派了一大波混乱的生物来攻击我们。$b$b快去收拾掉原祖荆兽留下的烂摊子，好让我们能在离开之前抓紧时间回收物资。$b$b如果你是来帮忙的，那就快去消灭那些袭击我们的暴力植物吧，越多越好。
text.completion: A good start. The growth from a genesaur is pure chaos and must be culled whenever possible.

english.title: Wake of the Genesaur
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Wild Overgrowth.
english.description: One moment we see a great metal beast rolling into our camp, the next a genesaur follows it and sends a wave of pure chaotic life at us.$b$bThe manifestations left behind by the genesaur must be culled so we have time to salvage what we can before leaving.$b$bIf you are here to help, then start killing as many of the violent plants that are assailing us as possible.
english.completion: A good start. The growth from a genesaur is pure chaos and must be culled whenever possible.

text.title: 乌木猎手
text.objectives: 从乌木猎手身上取得活体激光球。
text.description: 我们要开始设置激光炮台了，但火力不够是穿透不了这玩意儿的。$B$B一个叫乌木猎手的孢子爬行者就在东南海岸的三角洲处游荡。它脸上有一个器官可以发射激光，比我们目前在用的激光发射器的火力要强很多。$B$B我们需要它。$B$B你负责去把它弄来，我们继续在这里设置炮台。
text.progress: By the way, that laser is very dangerous. Be careful!
text.completion: Alright, let's put this thing to use!
text.completed: Return to Dilbert Tinkertoss in Veil Zekk.

english.title: The Ebon Hunter
english.objectives: Collect an Organic Laser Apparatus from the Ebon Hunter.
english.description: We're ready to set up the laser, but we're going to need more firepower to cut through this stuff.$B$BThe Ebon Hunter stalks the delta just southeast from here. It has an apparatus on its face that can fire a laser way stronger than what we have hooked up.$B$BWe need that.$B$BYou should go get it while we set up the laser.
english.progress: By the way, that laser is very dangerous. Be careful!
english.completion: Отлично, пора испробовать эту штуковину!
english.completed: Return to Dilbert Tinkertoss in Veil Zekk.

text.title: 要塞战役：潜入调查
text.objectives: 在纳格兰的秘密营地找到珍妮·阿姆瑞尔。
text.description: 我的首席战地特工之一——珍妮·阿姆瑞尔已经潜入了纳格兰北部的钢铁部落阵地。$B$B她报告说，各个兽人氏族的督军们正在打算在莫高尔岗哨进行一场秘密会晤。$B$B这可能是我们获得他们未来行动计划的关键。$B$B我要你立刻去和珍妮·阿姆瑞尔接头。这也许是我们的机会，$n！
text.completion: <Judging by the marks on her body, the agent put up an impressive fight.>

english.title: Garrison Campaign: Deep Recon
english.objectives: Find Jeanine Amrell at the Hidden Camp in Nagrand.
english.description: One of my top field operatives, Jeanine Amrell, is stationed deep in Iron Horde territory in northern Nagrand.$B$BShe reports that the warlords of the orcish clans are planning to convene in secret at Mok'gol Watchpost.$B$BThis may be a critical opportunity for us to gain intel on their future plans.$B$BI need you to meet up with agent Amrell immediately. This may be our chance, $n!
english.completion: <Judging by the marks on her body, the agent put up an impressive fight.>

text.title: 督军议会
text.objectives: 找出是谁写了这张字条。
text.description: 经过一番仔细查看，你发现一张羊皮纸条裹在她的脖子上。$B$B上面潦草地写着几个愤怒的大字：$B$B“这就是胆敢反抗钢铁部落的下场！”
text.completion: I'm glad I found you, $n. I've been hiding out since the Warsong orcs ambushed our camp at the Hidden Camp.$B$BYou should have seen the fight that Jeanine put up. Even after they began torturing her, she never gave up that there were two of us.$B$BShe had a will of steel, that one.
text.completed: Speak to Flint Shadowmore at Mok'gol Watchpost in Nagrand.

english.title: The Warlord's Council
english.objectives: Find out who is behind the written note.
english.description: Upon closer inspection, you notice a piece of leather parchment looped around her neck.$B$BScrawled upon it angrily are the words:$B$B"WITNESS THE FATE OF THOSE WHO DEFY THE IRON HORDE!"
english.completion: I'm glad I found you, $n. I've been hiding out since the Warsong orcs ambushed our camp at the Hidden Camp.$B$BYou should have seen the fight that Jeanine put up. Even after they began torturing her, she never gave up that there were two of us.$B$BShe had a will of steel, that one.
english.completed: Speak to Flint Shadowmore at Mok'gol Watchpost in Nagrand.

text.title: 战斗计划
text.objectives: 找到高格里克的缩放模型、小型战争机器和塔纳安丛林地图。
text.description: 我设法拿到了珍妮的笔记本。她提到在附近的建筑中有几样关键物品需要调查，但还没写清楚就死去了。$B$B我们至少能跟着她留下的线索，继续调查下去。$B$B在营地里搜索情报。我会负责引开兽人的注意力。
text.completion: This is remarkable, $n. We now have direct proof of Grommash's intentions.$B$BPerhaps now, we can stay a step ahead of the Iron Horde. Great work!
text.completed: Speak to Bodrick Grey at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Plans of War
english.objectives: Find the Scale Model of Gorgorek, Miniature War Machine, and Map of Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: I managed to get my hands on Jeanine's notebook. She identified several key items in the nearby buildings to investigate, but couldn't follow up before her demise.$B$BThe least we can do is follow the lead that she left us.$B$BSearch the camp for the intelligence. I'll keep the orcs distracted.
english.completion: This is remarkable, $n. We now have direct proof of Grommash's intentions.$B$BPerhaps now, we can stay a step ahead of the Iron Horde. Great work!
english.completed: Speak to Bodrick Grey at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到格古瑞克等比模型

text.title: 拦截指令
text.objectives: 找到霜火岭任务指令、影月谷任务指令和阿兰卡峰林任务指令。
text.description: 情报是重中之重，朋友。我们对地狱咆哮的计划了解得越多，想要击败他们就会更加容易。$B$B那些莫高尔兽人总是充当地狱咆哮的信使，将他下达的任务指令从这里传送到德拉诺的各个哨站。$B$B去干掉这些骑兵，然后把你找到的任务指令全都带回来。
text.progress: Do you have something for me?
text.completion: Excellent work, $n.
text.completed: Return to Bodrick Grey at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Intercepting the Orders
english.objectives: Collect the Frostfire Mission Orders, Shadowmoon Mission Orders, and Spires of Arak Mission Orders.
english.description: Intelligence is the name of the game, friend. The more we know about Hellscream's plans, the easier it will be to thwart them.$B$BThe Mok'gol orcs often act as Hellscream's couriers, carrying mission orders from this place to his outposts all over Draenor.$B$BKill these riders, and recover any orders that you can find.
english.progress: Do you have something for me?
english.completion: Excellent work, $n.
english.completed: Return to Bodrick Grey at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 消灭兽群领袖
text.objectives: 消灭兽群领袖沃戈什
text.description: 莫高尔岗哨的所有行动都被交托给了一名人称兽群领袖沃戈什的强大战士。$B$B假如我们能除掉这名凶残的领袖，就能短暂地中断他们的情报联络。$B$B沃戈什在东北边的院子里巡逻。$B$B干掉他。
text.completion: I have heard many reports about Vor'gash. It is a relief to know he will trouble us no more.
text.completed: Return to Bodrick Grey at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Putting Down the Packleader
english.objectives: Slay Packleader Vor'gash.
english.description: Operations at Mok'gol Watchpost are entrusted to a mighty warrior named Packleader Vor'gash.$B$BIf we can take out this fierce leader, we can shut down their communications temporarily.$B$BYou can find Vor'gash patrolling the compound to the northeast.$B$BSlay him.
english.completion: I have heard many reports about Vor'gash. It is a relief to know he will trouble us no more.
english.completed: Return to Bodrick Grey at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 消灭兽群领袖
text.objectives: 消灭兽群领袖沃戈什
text.description: 莫高尔岗哨的负责人是兽群领袖沃戈什。$B$B我们干掉这家伙，就能中断他们的情报联络。$B$B沃戈什在东北边的院子里巡逻。$B$B干掉他。
text.completion: I know about dis Vor'gash. It be a relief ta know he won't trouble us no more.
text.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Rokhan at your garrison in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Putting Down the Packleader
english.objectives: Slay Packleader Vor'gash.
english.description: Da one in charge a Mok'gol Watchpost be Packleader Vor'gash.$B$BWe take him out, we shut dem down.$B$BYa ken find 'im patrolling da compound ta da nor'east.$B$BKill 'im.
english.completion: Я про Вор'гаша многое знаю. Теперь уж он нам не опасен. Здорово.
english.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Rokhan at your garrison in Frostfire Ridge.

english.description: Ya timin' be good, commanda.$B$BI sent one a ma shadow huntas deep inta da land 'a da enemy.$B$BHe reports dat da warlords be plannin' ta meet in secret at Mok'gol Watchpost.$B$BDis be our chance ta learn what Hellscream be up to.$B$BGo now, and meet wit Zasta. He will tell ya what to do next.
english.completion: <Down by the brutal wounds on his body, the dark hunter fought to the last. >

text.completion: I ben lookin' for ya, commanda. I knew you was comin', but dat nasty orc lady got ta ya afore I could give warnin'.$B$BAt least I could save ya. Poor Zasta. He never saw it comin'.
