english.title: The Warlord's Council
english.objectives: Find out who is behind the written note.
english.description: Upon closer inspection, you notice a piece of leather parchment looped around his neck.$B$BScrawled upon it angrily are the words:$B$B"WITNESS THE FATE OF THOSE WHO DEFY THE IRON HORDE!"
english.completion: I've been looking for you, commander. I knew you were coming, but the orchid hurt fast before she could warn me.$B$BWell, though I'd save you. Poor Zasta. He wasn't even expecting it.
english.completed: Speak to Shadow Hunter Kajassa at Mok'gol Watchpost in Nagrand.

text.title: 战斗计划
text.objectives: 找到高格里克的缩放模型、小型战争机器和塔纳安丛林地图。
text.description: 我设法找到了扎斯塔的笔记。他看见战歌首领们频频在附近的建筑中会面。扎斯塔认为这周围一定有关于钢铁部落计划的蛛丝马迹。$B$B至少我们能跟着他留下的线索继续调查下去。$B$B在营地里搜索情报。我会负责引开兽人的注意力。
text.completion: Now we have proof a Hellscream's intentions.$B$BMebbe now, we ken stay a step ahead a da Iron Horde. Gud work.
text.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Rokhan at your garrison in Frostfire Valley.

english.title: Plans of War
english.objectives: Find the Scale Model of Gorgorek, Miniature War Machine, and Map of Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: I managed ta recover Zasta's notes. He saw dey Warsong leaders meetin' often in dey nearby buildings. Zasta tinks dere be clues about dey Iron Horde's plans nearby.$B$BDey least we can do is follow dey lead he left us.$B$BSearch dey camp for dey intelligence. I'll keep dey orcs distracted.
english.completion: So we have a certificate of Hell's Creek's designs.Maybe now we can get ahead of the Iron Horde. Okay, great.
english.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Rokhan at your garrison in Frostfire Valley.

text.title: 拦截指令
text.objectives: 找到霜火岭任务指令、影月谷任务指令和阿兰卡峰林任务指令。
text.description: 情报是重中之重，指挥官。我们对地狱咆哮的计划了解得越多，想要击败他们就会更加容易。$B$B那些莫高尔兽人总是充当地狱咆哮的信使，将他下达的任务指令从这里传送到德拉诺的各个哨站。$B$B去干掉这些骑兵，然后把你找到的任务指令全都带回来。
text.progress: Ya have something for me?
text.completion: Dis is gud, $n. Dis be real gud.
text.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Rokhan at your garrison in Frostfire Valley.

english.title: Intercepting the Orders
english.objectives: Collect the Frostfire Mission Orders, Shadowmoon Mission Orders, and Spires of Arak Mission Orders.
english.description: Intelligence be da name a da game, commanda. Da more we know about Hellscream's plans, da easier it be ta mess dem.$B$BDa Mok'gol orcs be Hellscream's couriers, carrying mission orders from dis place ta his outposts all over Draenor.$B$BKill dese riders, an' recover any orders dat you ken find.
english.progress: Ya have something for me?
english.completion: Хорошо, $n. Прям вот очень хорошо.
english.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Rokhan at your garrison in Frostfire Valley.

text.title: 要塞战役：黑潮栖木
text.objectives: 前往黑潮栖木。
text.description: 我们接到报告说钢铁部落的战舰停靠在了影月谷正南边的一座小岛上。$B$B我们派了一些斥候过去，但却没有收到他们的报告。我们应该去调查一下。$B$B杜加尔·朗德瑞克为你准备了一只专程前往那里的狮鹫，指挥官。
text.completion: These savages have no honor, it is time we deal with the Iron Horde presence on this island.
text.completed: 前往影月谷正南方的黑潮栖木。

english.title: Garrison Campaign: Darktide Roost
english.objectives: Travel to Darktide Roost.
english.description: We are getting reports that Iron Horde warships are docking on a small island just south of Shadowmoon Valley.$b$bWe sent in some scouts, but we haven't heard back from them yet. It might be worth investigating.$b$bDungar Longdrink has a gryphon waiting for you when you are ready, commander.
english.completion: These savages have no honor, it is time we deal with the Iron Horde presence on this island.
english.completed: Travel to Darktide Roost just south of Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 蜥蜴屠夫
text.objectives: 从履岩蜥蜴或腐烂的蜥蜴身上收集$1oa份蜥蜴肉。
text.description: 蜥蜴肉是尼莎最喜欢的食物。她当时就在这狩猎，那群钢铁部落杂碎可能就是这么抓住她的。$b$b他们干嘛要大费周章地这样制服她呢？倘若携起手来，你跟我或许能找到答案，并让他们为自己的恶行受到应有的惩罚。$b$b眼下得先给尼莎找点吃的。我留下照顾她，你能给她弄点猎物来吗？
text.progress: <Nisha sniffs deeply.>
text.completion: <Nisha downs the meat in one gulp.>
text.completed: Speak to Rexxar at Breaker's Crown.

english.title: Basilisk Butcher
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Basilisk Meat from Stoneshamble Basilisks or Decaying Basilisks.
english.description: Basilisk is one of Nisha's favorite meals. This is where she hunts, and that's likely how those Iron Horde bastards were able to capture her.$b$bWhy would they go to the trouble to subdue her this way? Perhaps together, you and I might learn the answer as we punish them for their transgressions.$b$bFor now, Nisha's going to need some food. While I tend to her, will you do her hunting for her?
english.progress: <Nisha sniffs deeply.>
english.completion: <Nothing greedily swallows meat. >
english.completed: Speak to Rexxar at Breaker's Crown.

text.title: 要塞战役：黑潮栖木
text.objectives: 前往黑潮栖木。
text.description: 我们接到报告说钢铁部落的战舰停靠在了影月谷正南边的一座小岛上。$B$B我们派了一些斥候过去，但却还没有收到他们的报告。我们应该去调查一下。$B$B布罗恩·天角为你准备了一只专程前往那里的双头飞龙，指挥官。
text.completion: These savages have no honor, it is time we deal with the Iron Horde presence on this island.
text.completed: 前往影月谷正南方的黑潮栖木。

english.title: Garrison Campaign: Darktide Roost
english.objectives: Travel to Darktide Roost.
english.description: We is getting reports dat da Iron Horde warships be dockin' on a small island to da south of da Shadowmoon Valley.$b$bWe be sendin' some scouts, but we haven't heard back yet. We need ta be investigating.$b$bBron Skyhorn has a ryklak waitin' for ya when you be ready, commander.
english.completion: У этих дикарей нет чести. Пора нам разобраться с Железной Ордой.
english.completed: Travel to Darktide Roost just south of Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 安全措施
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个沼泽居民。
text.description: 这些电池的共振频率好像惊扰了当地的野生生物。刚刚……我好像就看到一只野猪在对着我舔嘴唇。$B$B我不会让你白干的，你能不能帮我……清除掉你在那底下见到的任何东西……甭管是什么，只管干掉它们，好吗？
text.completion: Fantastic! This is some good old-fashioned adventuring if I've ever seen it.
text.completed: Return to Filbert Tinkertoss in Murkbog.

english.title: Safety Measures
english.objectives: Kill $1oa bog denizens.
english.description: As it turns out, the resonance frequency of the batteries has really upset the local wildlife. I... I think one of the boars looked and me and licked its lips just a moment ago.$B$BI'll make it worth your time if you just... get rid of anything you come across down there. Doesn't matter what it is, just kill it, okay?
english.completion: Фантастика! Приключение, прямо как в старые добрые времена!
english.completed: Return to Filbert Tinkertoss in Murkbog.

text.title: 安全措施
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个沼泽居民。
text.description: 我掉进沼泽里的那些电池引来了一堆野生生物。要是不跟这些奇形怪状的家伙打上一架，是不可能赶走它们的。$B$B假如你有所准备的话，何不“照顾”一下附近的这些小动物呢？我可不想我去挖掘场的路上有一堆大怪兽跟着。$B$B我不会让你白干的。
text.completion: Now that's what I'm talking about. You're tough as nails.
text.completed: Return to Mixxy Weldblast in Murkbog.

english.title: Safety Measures
english.objectives: Kill $1oa bog denizens.
english.description: The batteries I lost in the bog have really ticked off the wild creatures. It's going to be impossible to remove them without fighting through who knows what.$B$BIf you're up for it, why don't you 'take care' of any critters you come across? I don't want some giant beast stalking me back to the excavation site.$B$BI'll make it worth your while.
english.completion: Now that's what I'm talking about. You're tough as nails.
english.completed: Return to Mixxy Weldblast in Murkbog.

text.title: 愤怒与智慧
text.objectives: 在苦痛山脊找嗜骨如命的艾苏克谈一谈。
text.description: 西边荒地中的野兽和东边荒野里的怪物一直在无止无休地互相争斗。$b$b假如一方占有了绝对优势，那么整个德拉诺都会沦为胜者的掌中物。$b$b嘲颅氏族想为自己被毁的村庄复仇。我已经引导他们去把恨意宣泄到附近的怪物身上，好让我们的哨站屹立不倒。$b$b指挥官，如果你愿意的话，就去监督他们吧。我对嘲颅氏族还没建立起多大的信任。
text.completion: I can see the future of my enemies in the bones. They're gonna die!

english.title: Rage and Wisdom
english.objectives: Speak to Bony Xuk at Affliction Ridge.
english.description: Beasts of the western wasteland fight an endless war with the creatures of the eastern wilds.$b$bIf one side were to overwhelm the other, all of Draenor would be doomed at the hand of the victor.$b$bThe Laughing Skull seek revenge for their destroyed village. I have directed them to aim their vengeance at the nearby creatures, that our outpost here might be preserved.$b$bIf you would, commander, oversee their efforts. I have not yet grown to trust the Laughing Skull.
english.completion: Я вижу судьбы своих врагов в костях. Все они умрут!

text.title: 布鲁托的兴趣
text.objectives: 接受剑圣纳什拉的血誓。
text.description: 你帮了我一个大忙。这柄利刃既是我的也是你的。$b$b我向你发下这个血誓：我愿助你一臂之力，把我掌握的利刃和采矿方面的知识都贡献给你的军队。$b$B你愿意接受吗？
text.completion: Now THAT is how you break out of a gladiator pit!$B$BYou are fun. Your weapons are covered in a rainbow of blood types.$B$BI am going to follow you now.
text.giverWindow: 作为一名新晋的剑圣，纳什拉无疑是一位强大的战士和武器大师。

english.title: The Interest of Bruto
english.objectives: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
english.description: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.$b$bI offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.$b$BWill you accept it?
english.completion: That's how you get out of a gladiator pit! You're interesting... There's so much blood on your weapon, you can tell the shades. Now I'll follow you.
english.giverWindow: New to the rank of Blademaster, Na'Shra is a formidable warrior and master of arms.

text.title: 瓦安达姆之拳
text.objectives: 接受剑圣纳什拉的血誓。
text.description: 你帮了我一个大忙。这柄利刃既是我的也是你的。$b$b我要为你送上这个血誓：我愿助你一臂之力，把我掌握的利刃和采矿方面的知识都贡献给你的军队。$b$B你愿意接受吗？
text.completion: For years the ogres would make me fight, kill, and salute. My soul bled with each salute.$B$BBut because of you, I will never again have to salute an ogre.$B$BYou have helped me win my freedom, so I choose to use that freedom to serve your banner.$B$BToday, I salute you, commander.
text.giverWindow: 作为一名新晋的剑圣，纳什拉无疑是一位强大的战士和武器大师。

english.title: The Fists of Vaandaam
english.objectives: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
english.description: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.$b$bI offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.$b$BWill you accept it?
english.completion: For years ogres made me fight, kill and greet them standing in the arena. With every greeting, my soul was bleeding. I will never have to greet an ogre again. You have helped; I will win my freedom, and I will use it to serve under your banner. Today I greet you, commander.
english.giverWindow: New to the rank of Blademaster, Na'Shra is a formidable warrior and master of arms.

text.title: 冲刺阶段
text.objectives: 逃至码头。
text.description: 如果说他们之前还没发火的话，现在一定是怒不可遏了。我们在这辆坦克上连一分钟都活不下去！$b$b赶快去跟其他人会合，离开这儿！！
text.completion: Against all odds, here we stand. Still alive, an entire army on our heels.$b$bOur ship is waiting. Shall we depart?

english.title: The Home Stretch
english.objectives: Escape to the docks.
english.description: If they weren't angry before, they sure are now. We won't survive a minute up on top o' this tank!$b$bLet's join up with the rest and get out of here!!
english.completion: Against all odds, here we stand. Still alive, an entire army on our heels.$b$bOur ship is waiting. Shall we depart?

泰罗克的贬落
text.objectives: 使用泰罗克雕像重现泰罗克被贬落时的情形。找到蕾希，集结$2oa名流亡者利爪卫士，消灭$3oa名疯狂的流亡者，再使用安苏之眼。
text.description:
<瑞沙德的声音再一次将你包围。>

泰罗克是一位力量强大而德高望重的王者，深受族人的爱戴。

可他身边的贤者却没有那么忠诚。为了夺取通天峰的控制权，他们密谋推翻他的统治。
text.completion: Since that day, the sages have remained in power in Skyreach, now calling themselves the Adherents of Rukhmar and claiming to be the heralds of Her will.
text.completed: Speak with Reshad in Veil Terokk.
text.giverWindow: 认真聆听泰罗克的贬落。

english.title: Terokk's Fall
english.objectives: Use the Effigy of Terokk to re-live Terokk's fall. Find Lithic, rally $2oa Outcast Talon Guards, slay $3oa Crazed Outcasts, and use the Eye of Anzu.
english.description:
<Once again, Reshad's voice envelops you.>

Terokk was a powerful and respected king, beloved by his people.

His sages, however, were not so loyal. Hungry for control of Skyreach, they conspired against him.
english.completion: Since that day, the sages have remained in power in Skyreach, now calling themselves the Adherents of Rukhmar and claiming to be the heralds of Her will.
english.completed: Speak with Reshad in Veil Terokk.
english.giverWindow: Listen carefully to the tale of Terokk's Fall.

text.title: 泰罗克的化身
text.objectives: 与泰罗克之影交谈来获得他的力量。消灭$1oa个碎手战士、$2oa个碎手地穴主宰，然后面对卡加斯·刃拳。
text.description:
关于往昔的梦境吵醒了我的长眠。在梦里，我又一次手刃了我的宿敌。又一次亲眼看着我心爱的女儿在我面前死去。

你就在那。我在这些梦境里感受到了你的存在。而你的过往也如画卷般在我眼前展开。

有人将我们的命运交织在了一起。如今，我的族人就是你要奋力保护的血亲，你的敌人也就是我不共戴天的仇敌。

碎手氏族已在刃拳堡集结。如果听之任之，他们就会为钢铁部落夺取这片土地。

接受我的力量吧，我们将一同粉碎他们的计划。
text.completion: The Shattered Hand is in shambles and the Avatar of Terokk now walks among us.$B$BWhen I promised you power back in Skettis, did you expect that it would come without any strings attached? Ha!
text.completed: Speak with Reshad in Veil Terokk.

english.title: The Avatar of Terokk
english.objectives: Speak with Shade of Terokk to accept his power. Slay $1oa Shattered Hand combatants, $2oa Shattered Pit-Masters, and confront Kargath Bladefist.
english.description:
My long sleep was disturbed by dreams of the past. I cut down my old enemies again. I watched my daughter die again.

You were there. I felt your presence in these dreams. And your past was revealed to me as well.

Someone has woven our fates together. My people are yours to protect, and your enemies are mine to destroy.

The Shattered Hand are rallied in Bladefist Hold. Left to their own, they would claim this land for the Iron Horde.

Take my power, and together we shall break them.
english.completion: The Shattered Hand is in shambles and the Avatar of Terokk now walks among us.$B$BWhen I promised you power back in Skettis, did you expect that it would come without any strings attached? Ha!
english.completed: Speak with Reshad in Veil Terokk.

text.title: 遗失的拼图
text.objectives: 把蕾希的礼物放到泰罗克雕像上。
text.description:
泰罗克的女儿蕾希是一位本领过人的女猎手，可她真正热爱的却是铸金工艺。

她亲手打制了这只手镯送给父亲，而她的父亲也贴身佩戴了许多年。直到蕾希辞世，他才将手镯取了下来，因为对女儿的思念太过沉重，令年老的国王无力负荷。

把手镯放到雕像上，我会给你讲述泰罗克的贬落。
text.completion: <You carefully hang the bangle upon the effigy's arm.>
text.completed: 与泰罗克雕像互动。

english.title: The Missing Piece
english.objectives: Place Lithic's Gift on the Effigy of Terokk.
english.description:
Terokk's daughter Lithic was a skilled huntress, but found her true passion in goldsmithing.

She forged this bangle as a gift for her father, and he wore it for many years. Only after Lithic passed away did he remove the bangle, for her memory was too much for the old king to bear.

Place the bangle upon the effigy, and I shall tell you of Terokk's fall.
english.completion: <You carefully hang the bangle upon the effigy's arm.>
english.completed: Interact with the Effigy of Terokk.

黑石深渊（禁闭室额外）奖励任务
黑石深渊（上层区）奖励任务

空投补给
text.objectives: 到你在影月谷的要塞与巴隆斯·阿历克斯顿谈一谈。
text.description: 你在下面的那些工人已经完成了采集作业，准备回你的要塞去了。这次你不用担心你车队的安全问题；我会派一名游侠在一路上暗中保护他们。$B$B主教们在注视着你们。$B$B等你回到要塞，你的补给应该就已经到了。祝你旗开得胜，$n！
text.completion: Commander! Zipfizzle arrived with your laborers in tow just moments ago. We've got a huge surplus of food, now, and promises of more where that came from.$b$bApparently the draenei threw in some other resources as well. Very good work, sir. What should we build next?
text.completed: 到你在影月谷的要塞与巴隆斯·阿历克斯顿谈一谈。

english.title: Supply Drop
english.objectives: Speak with Baros Alexston at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: Your laborers below have finished with the harvest and are ready to cart supplies back to your garrison. Don't worry about the safety of your caravan this time; I will dispatch a rangari detail to shadow them from the woods and protect them.$b$bThe Exarchs will always watch over you.$b$bYour supplies should be waiting for you when you return to your garrison. Good luck with your campaign, $n!
english.completion: Commander! Zipfizzle arrived with your laborers in tow just moments ago. We've got a huge surplus of food, now, and promises of more where that came from.$b$bApparently the draenei threw in some other resources as well. Very good work, sir. What should we build next?
english.completed: Speak with Baros Alexston at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 谋杀未遂
text.objectives: 与胡托·羽风对话，飞往暗影哨所。
text.description: 你的酒保伦祖尔要死了，指挥官。她身中剧毒，急需解毒剂。$B$B据你的一位斥候报告，他近来在附近发现了一位碎手兽人——那是我们最大的线索。$B$B在东边有个不起眼的鸦人营地，就位于一处碎手营地附近。我建议我们去那里展开搜寻。$B$B我已经跟你的飞行管理员谈过，让他送我们过去，时间紧迫，赶快动身吧。
text.completion: These corpses are fresh. Their killers must still be nearby.

english.title: Attempted Murder
english.objectives: Speak to Hutou Featherwind to secure a flight to Shadow's Vigil.
english.description: Your bartender Lunzul is dying, commander. She's been poisoned and needs an antidote immediately.$B$BOne of your scouts reported seeing a Shattered Hand orc nearby recently - that's our best bet.$B$BThere is a small arakkoa camp to the east that sits near a known Shattered Hand encampment. I suggest we start our search there.$B$BI've already spoken to your flight master about securing us a flight; every second counts.
english.completion: Трупы свежие. Убийцы, наверное, еще рядом.

text.title: 巨石之核（英雄难度）奖励任务
Internal: Default Invasion Reward
text.objectives: 击退毁灭者对你要塞的入侵。$B$B（再次与格里姆加中士交谈来开始行动）
text.description: 這一小時以來要塞不斷發生地震，我們一些斥候也還沒有回報。
text.completed: Speak with Sergeant Grimjaw in your garrison.
text.turninWindow: 格里姆加，镇子里最厉害的家伙……之类的。

text.title: 谋杀未遂
text.objectives: 与菲恩·迅风对话，飞往暗影哨所。
text.description: 考里格要死了，指挥官。他身中剧毒，急需解毒剂。$B$B据你的一位斥候报告，他于不久前在附近发现了一位碎手兽人——那是我们最大的线索。$B$B在东边有个不起眼的鸦人营地，就位于一处碎手营地附近。我们应该去那里展开搜寻。$B$B我已经跟你的飞行管理员谈过，让他送我们过去，时间紧迫，赶快行动吧。
text.completion: Aye, these corpses are definitely fresh. They can't have gone far.
text.completed: Speak to Hulda Shadowblade at Shadow's Vigil.

english.title: Attempted Murder
english.objectives: Speak to Firn Swiftbreeze to secure a flight to Shadow's Vigil.
english.description: Kolrigg is dyin', commander. He's been poisoned and needs an antidote before it's too late.$B$BOne o' yer scouts reported seein' a Shattered Hand orc nearby not long ago - I wager that's our best shot.$B$BThere's a small arakkoa camp tae the east that sits near a known Shattered Hand encampment. We should start our search there, $Gsir:madame;.$B$BI've already spoken to yer flight master about flyin' us out; every second counts.
english.completion: Aye, these corpses are definitely fresh. They can't have gone far.
english.completed: Speak to Hulda Shadowblade at Shadow's Vigil.

text.title: 竞技场的宣传
text.objectives: 与试炼竞技场的戴克希尔·死刃交谈。
text.description: 嗨，$g先生:女士;，这个榆木脑袋不放我进去。想要赚些外快吗？$B$B我的老板在给试炼竞技场的角斗比赛做宣传。$B$B你瞧着挺耐揍的，何不去参加比赛呢？
text.completion: Hey there, bub. Lucy sent you? Good kid.$B$BYeah... you look like you'll do nicely.

english.title: Bread and Circuses
english.objectives: Speak with Dexyl Deadblade at the Ring of Trials.
english.description: Hey, $g mister:lady;, this crumb-bum won't let me in. Interested in some cold, hard cash?$B$BMy boss is promoting fights at the Ring of Trials. You look like you could hold your own.$B$BYou should go fight.
english.completion: Hey there, bub. Lucy sent you? Good kid.$B$BYeah... you look like you'll do nicely.

text.description: 嗨，$g先生:女士;，这个榆木脑袋不放我进去。想要赚些外快吗？$B$B我的老板在给试炼竞技场的角斗比赛做宣传。$B$B你瞧着挺耐揍的，何不去参加比赛呢？
text.completion: Hey there, bub. Lucy sent you? Good kid.$B$BYeah... you look like you'll do nicely.

english.completion: Здравствуй, $Gдружище:подруга;. Тебя Люси прислала? Хорошая девочка.$B$BДа... ты как раз подойдешь.

text.title: 刺客的印记
text.objectives: 搜索警惕的流亡者的尸体，找到一处刺客的印记。
text.description: 他们的毒药比我想得还要强烈，我们必须找出制造它的那个兽人。$B$B刺客大师通常会在他们杀死的猎物身上留下他们独特的印记。一般都是为了博取名声之类的。$B$B这显然是这种刺客的杰作。$B$B我们应该分头找找这些流亡者的尸体上有没有留下什么印记，这或许可以帮我们找到毒药的制造者。我们在山下碰头吧，指挥官。
text.progress: Any luck? I couldn't find anything.
text.completion: What is it you found? Let me see that.
text.completed: Speak to Dark Ranger Velonara in Shadow's Vigil.

english.title: Assassin's Mark
english.objectives: Search Vigilant Outcast corpses for a Craftsman's Mark.
english.description: Their poison is more powerful than I thought. We need to find the orc responsible for making it.$B$BMaster assassins always leave their mark somewhere on one of their kills. It's a calling card; a claim to fame in their circles.$B$BThis was definitely the work of such an assassin.$B$BWe should split up and see if we can find some sign on one of the outcast corpses that will lead us to their creator. Rendezvous at the bottom of the hill, commander.
english.progress: Удалось что-нибудь найти? Мне – нет.
english.completion: Что там у тебя? Дай посмотреть.
english.completed: Speak to Dark Ranger Velonara in Shadow's Vigil.

text.title: 戈隆战术
text.objectives: 把武器装配员的命令带到毁灭者之冠，给雷克萨看一看。
text.description: 拉兹，$b$b你的任务是再去抓四只戈隆来进行武器化改造。$b$b你之前抓来的第一组，只有一只在整个过程中活了下来。$b$b其中一只像疯了似地攻击我们的士兵，我们只能出手将它消灭。另一只在适应环节遭遇了失败。最后一只则在睡梦中滚到了自己的火炮上。我们直到现在还没收拾完它留下的烂摊子。$b$b放心，你的努力不会白费的。$b$b-布拉克上尉
text.progress: Weaponizing gronn? If they succeed...
text.completion: This is grim news, $n.

english.title: The Gronn Strategy
english.objectives: Show the weaponization orders to Rexxar at Breaker's Crown.
english.description: Raz,$b$bYour orders are to capture four additional gronn for weaponization.$b$bOf your first group, only one survived the entire process.$b$bOne attacked our soldiers relentlessly and had to be put down. Another fell victim to a misfire while being fitted. Yet another rolled onto its cannons in its sleep. We're still cleaning up that mess.$b$bRest assured, your efforts are not in vain.$b$b- Captain Brak
english.progress: Weaponizing gronn? If they succeed...
english.completion: Это жуткая новость, $n.

text.title: 刺客的印记
text.objectives: 搜索警惕的流亡者的尸体，找到一处刺客的印记。
text.description: 我们得找到制造这种毒药的兽人，从而研制出解毒剂。$B$B刺客大师通常会在他们杀死的猎物身上留下他们独特的印记。通常是为了博取名声之类的。相信我，这正是刺客大师的杰作。$B$B我们分头找找这些流亡者的尸体上有没有留下什么印记，或许可以顺藤摸瓜地找到杀害它们的凶手。我们在山下碰头吧，指挥官。
text.progress: Did ye find anything?
text.completion: What's that? Let me have a look.
text.completed: Speak to Hulda Shadowblade in Shadow's Vigil.

english.title: Assassin's Mark
english.objectives: Search Vigilant Outcast corpses for a Craftsman's Mark.
english.description: We need tae find the orc responsible fer makin' the poison tae make an antidote.$B$BMaster assassins always leave their mark somewhere on one o' their kills. It's a claim tae fame o' sorts. An' trust me, this was the work of a master assassin.$B$BLet's split up and see if we can find some sign on one o' the outcast corpses that will lead us tae their killer. I'll meet ye at the bottom o' the hill, commander.
english.progress: Удалось что найти?
english.completion: What's that? Let me have a look.
english.completed: Speak to Hulda Shadowblade in Shadow's Vigil.

text.title: 肉肠需要骨头
text.completion: That's a good start. I'll throw these in the pot.$B$BBring me more.

english.title: Meatgut Needs Bones
english.completion: That's a good start. I'll throw these in the pot.$B$BBring me more.

text.title: 黑暗深渊（额外）奖励任务
艾泽拉斯最后的防线
text.objectives: 从黑暗之门基地的钢铁部落成员手中夺取钢铁部落信函。
text.description: 你曾击败过无数可怕的邪魔，又曾无数次绝处逢生，以胜利者的姿态凯旋。而今天，你再一次响应了命运的召唤，愿为拯救你深爱的世界而献出生命。$B$B你是艾泽拉斯最后的希望，$n。$B$B尽管眼前的挑战令人胆寒，但你是我心目中领导这次任务的不二人选。$B$B前线的敌人可能拥有能让我们致胜的情报。搜索并消灭他们！$B$B出发吧，$n！为了艾泽拉斯！
text.progress: На этом послании стоит метка клана Песни Войны.
text.completion: This folded letter, bearing the mark of Grommash Hellscream, looks promising...

english.title: Azeroth's Last Stand
english.objectives: Collect the Iron Horde Missive from one of the Iron Horde at the base of the Dark Portal.
english.description: Countless times you have battled against impossible odds and unspeakable evil - and returned the victor. Now, once more, you have answered the call of duty, prepared to risk your life to save the world that you love - our world.$B$BYou are Azeroth's last hope, $n.$B$BWhile the challenges that stand before us are daunting, there is no other that I would trust to lead this mission.$B$BThe enemy at the front may have the information we need to win this war. Seek and destroy!$B$BGo now, $n! For Azeroth!
english.progress: На этом послании стоит метка клана Песни Войны.
english.completion: This folded letter, bearing the mark of Grommash Hellscream, looks promising...

text.title: 为尼莎复仇
text.objectives: 击败$1oa名格罗姆卡步兵。
text.description: 自从我动身踏上狩猎之旅，钢铁部落就渐渐逼近，并巩固了自己的据点。$b$b<雷克萨的唇边泛起一抹微笑。>$b$b他们创造出了一个满是猎物的环境。$b$b我必须继续留下照顾尼莎。你替我去吧，朋友。让他们感受一下自己给尼莎带来的恐惧与痛苦。$b$b让他们的惨叫声响彻峡谷！
text.completion: Thank you, $n. Nisha is nearly returned to health.
text.completed: Return to Rexxar at Breaker's Crown.

english.title: Nisha's Vengeance
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Grom'kar Grunts.
english.description: Since I left on my last hunt, the Iron Horde have drawn nearer and reinforced their positions.$b$b<A grin spreads across Rexxar's lips.>$b$bThey've created a target-rich environment.$b$bI must continue nursing Nisha to health for now. You go in my stead, friend. Fill them with the fear and pain that they inflicted on her.$b$bMake their screams fill the canyon!
english.completion: Спасибо, $n. Ниша уже почти здорова.
english.completed: Return to Rexxar at Breaker's Crown.

text.title: 钢铁部落入侵！
text.objectives: 击退钢铁部落的入侵。
text.description: 远方有几股黑烟……钢铁部落来了。
text.progress: We must hold the line!
text.completion: The Iron Horde is a menace. Let's stamp out the rest of them. For the Horde!

english.title: Iron Horde Invasion!
english.objectives: Repel the Iron Horde invasion.
english.description: There's smoke on the horizon.... The Iron Horde is coming.
english.progress: We must hold the line!
english.completion: The Iron Horde is a threat to us all. We must finish it off completely. For the Horde!

text.objectives: 把证明带到戈尔隆德的高山走廊，交给游侠乔纳。
text.description: 这颗牙齿证明了你有消灭鬣蜥人的能力，你的角斗士朋友目击了你的战斗！把这颗牙齿带回去给乔纳，换取你应得的嘉奖！
text.completion: We are impressed with your ability to slay the goren. They are relentless and voracious and can overwhelm those are not prepared.

english.title: Proof of Strength: Goren Tooth
english.objectives: Take the proof to Rangari Jonaa at Highpass in Gorgrond.
english.description: This tooth is proof of your strength at slaying goren and your gladiator friend has born witness!$b$bTake the tooth back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!
english.completion: Мы приятно удивлены твоей ловкости в охоте на горенов. Они безжалостны и свирепы и с легкостью могут разделаться с тем, кто не готов к встрече с ними.

text.title: 格莱布林·迅爆
text.objectives: 把格莱布林·迅爆放下来。
text.description: 我吊在这很久了！$B$B我正从这片区域上空飞过，思考着我的财路，谁知道——砰！有个傻冒食人魔拿石头丢我！$B$B我的滑翔机坏了，然后我就在这里了……伙计，这实在太不舒服了。$B$B能放我下去吗？我会给你报酬的。
text.completion: Ouch... my leg is still asleep, that smarts... Greblin Fastfizzle's my name, archeology's my game.$B$BHow can I help?
text.completed: Speak with Greblin Fastfizzle at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.

english.title: Greblin Fastfizzle
english.objectives: Help Greblin Fastfizzle down.
english.description: I've been hanging here forever!$b$bI was flying around, surveying the area for Nixxie when -- blamo! One of those stupid ogres throws a rock right at me!$b$bMy glider busted and here I am... and boy is this uncomfortable.$b$bHelp me down will ya? I'll make it worth your while.
english.completion: Ох... Нога онемела... какая боль... Меня зовут Греблин Убыстрямс, я археолог.$b$bЧем могу помочь?
english.completed: Speak with Greblin Fastfizzle at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.

text.title: 威严的派克斯
text.objectives: 接受剑圣纳什拉的血誓。
text.description: 你帮了我一个大忙。这柄利刃既是我的也是你的。$b$b我要向你发下血誓：我愿助你一臂之力，把我掌握的利刃和采矿方面的知识都贡献给你的军队。$b$B你愿意接受吗？
text.giverWindow: 作为一名新晋的剑圣，纳什拉无疑是一位强大的战士和武器大师。

english.title: Peckers the Majestic
english.objectives: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
english.description: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.$b$bI offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.$b$BWill you accept it?
english.giverWindow: New to the rank of Blademaster, Na'Shra is a formidable warrior and master of arms.

text.title: 毒药的力量
text.objectives: 审讯收割围栏里的碎手兽人，问出“G.V.”的名字和所在地。
text.description: G.V.？我们必须找到他的全名和所在！$B$B对此我倒是有个主意。$B$B<维罗娜拉拿出一个小瓶子。>$B$B这是我最后一瓶凌虐毒素。我们经常用它来从囚犯身上逼问出我们想要的情报。$B$B它的毒性……相当强。$B$B在你的武器上涂一些这个，然后去前方的碎手营地。用你平常的方式招呼他们，并向他们询问答案——剩下的部分，就交给毒药来解决。我已经受够这些兽人了。
text.completion: This Gardul Venomshiv is as good as dead.
text.completed: Speak to Dark Ranger Velonara at Shadow's Vigil.

english.title: The Power of Poison
english.objectives: Interrogate Shattered Hand orcs in the Harvesting Pits to find out the name and location of "G.V.".
english.description: G.V.? We need a name and a location. Not damned initials.$B$B<Velonara pulls out a small vial.>$B$BThis is my last vial of wracking poison. We use it to extract information from prisoners. It is... potent.$B$BCoat your weapon with it and head into the Shattered Hand camp just ahead. Engage them as normal and demand answers - the poison will take care of the rest. I've had enough of these orcs.
english.completion: The Gardoul Poisonous Knife may consider himself dead.
english.completed: Speak to Dark Ranger Velonara at Shadow's Vigil.

text.objectives: 把证明带到戈尔隆德的蛮兽岗哨，交给断肢。
text.description: 这颗牙齿证明了你有消灭鬣蜥人的能力，你的角斗士朋友目击了你的战斗！把这颗牙齿带回去给断肢，换取你应得的嘉奖！
text.completion: We are impressed with your ability to slay the goren. They are relentless and voracious and can overwhelm those are not prepared.

text.title: 德拉诺英雄地下城奖励任务
藏品资本化
text.objectives: 获得一枚赤牙项链、一枚紫牙项链和一座食人魔残破石像。
text.description: 我正在寻找珍贵的宝物。那种可以揭开德拉诺最伟大的历史之谜，让热砂保护协会赚的盆满钵满的宝物。姑娘们都爱钱，你懂我的意思吗？$B$B所以，你去帮我找宝物，我呢则帮你……等下，你是来干啥的？
text.progress: What do you find? Anything worth selling? Err.. preserving.
text.completion: Nice! What did you get?$B$BA necklace, not bad.. another necklace, good. A giant rock in the shape of an ogre head?$B$B<Greblin seems puzzled, he glances up at you.>$B$BSeriously? This is a rock in the shape of an idiot. Whatever, the necklaces look good.$B$BNot a bad find overall.
text.completed: Return to Greblin Fastfizzle at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.

english.title: Preservation Capitalization
english.objectives: Collect a Redtooth Necklace, Purpletooth Necklace, and an Ogre Bust.
english.description: I'm looking for precious artifacts. The kind of artifacts that can help solve some of the greatest mysteries of Draenor, and make the Steamwheedle Preservation Society a ton of moolah. And ladies love the moolah, know what I'm sayin?$b$bSo, get me the artifacts, I'll get the ladies, and you get... wait, what are you looking for again?
english.progress: What do you find? Anything worth selling? Err.. preserving.
english.completion: Отлично! Что у тебя?$b$bОжерелье? Неплохо... Еще одно, чудесно. Огромный камень в виде головы огра?$b$b<Греблин озадаченно смотрит на вас.>$b$bСерьезно? Камень в форме идиота? Ну да ладно. Ожерелья неплохие.$b$bВ общем, достойный улов.
english.completed: Return to Greblin Fastfizzle at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.

text.title: 进击食人魔
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个食人魔和$2oa个独眼魔。
text.description: 这帮食人魔挡了热砂集团挖宝藏的财路。$B$B他们凶残、暴虐又难闻。而且坦白说，他们弄坏了我的滑翔机，我恨不得宰了他们。$B$B你要不要帮我个忙，把他们从德拉诺的表面抹掉？$B$B这能让大家都活得更好，至少是能让我活得更好。
text.completion: Oh, that's way better.$B$BMaybe next time they'll think twice before they throw a rock at someone. Err... I mean if they weren't so dead and everything.
text.completed: Return to Greblin Fastfizzle at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.

english.title: Ogre Onslaught
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Ogres and $2oa Ogron.
english.description: Those ogres are standing in the way of a full Steamwheedle Preservation excavation.$b$bThey are brutal, violent, horrible smelling beasts. And if I'm being completely honest with myself, I'm pretty mad they broke my glider.$b$bDo me a favor will ya? Wipe 'em off the face of Draenor.$b$bIt will make everyone's life easier, or at the very least, it will make my life easier.
english.completion: О, это гораздо лучше.$b$bБудут знать, как кидаться камнями. Э-э... Ну, то есть знали бы, если были бы живы.
english.completed: Return to Greblin Fastfizzle at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.

text.title: 布洛奇约的覆灭
text.objectives: 消灭布洛奇约。
text.description: 我这里已经快搞定了，但凭良心说，我可不想就这么走了。$b$b我发现一个名叫布洛奇约的独眼魔，他手上戴着一枚昂贵的指环。简直昂贵到了价值连城的地步。$b$b如果我能把它交给妮可茜，她肯定不会亏待我的。
text.progress: Did you take care of Brokyo?
text.completion: You got the ring? Nice! The Steamwheedle Preservation Society is going to make some serious moolah on this stuff.$B$BNixxie will be pleased.
text.completed: Return to Dizzy Shiftspark at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.

english.title: Brokyo Beatdown
english.objectives: Kill Brokyo.
english.description: I'm almost done here, but I can't leave in good conscience.$b$bI spotted an ogron named Brokyo that is wearing a priceless ring. Priceless as in crazy expensive.$b$bI'm sure Nixxie will give me a promotion if I bring that ring back to her.
english.progress: Did you take care of Brokyo?
english.completion: Кольцо у тебя? Отлично! За это добро Археологическое общество Хитрой Шестеренки выручит отличные деньги.$b$bНикси будет довольна.
english.completed: Return to Dizzy Shiftspark at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.

text.title: 突袭黑潮栖木
text.objectives: 破坏钢铁部落的活动，并收集情报。
text.description: 钢铁部落现在有地精了？干掉他们！
text.completed: Return to Candace Thomas in your Garrison.

english.title: Assault on Darktide Roost
english.objectives: Disrupt the Iron Horde and gather intelligence on them.
english.description: The Iron Horde has Goblins now? Take them out!
english.completed: Return to Candace Thomas in your Garrison.

text.title: 突袭黑潮栖木
text.objectives: 破坏钢铁部落的活动，并收集情报。
text.description: 钢铁部落现在有地精了？干掉他们！
text.completed: Return to Rokhan in your Garrison.

english.objectives: Disrupt the Iron Horde and gather intelligence on them.
english.description: The Iron Horde has Goblins now? Take them out!
english.completed: Return to Rokhan in your Garrison.

text.title: 要塞战役：破碎悬崖
text.objectives: 找到格莱布林·迅爆。
text.description: 嘿，你好啊！你是这要塞的指挥官对吧？我是代表热砂保护协会来的。$b$b我们想在纳格兰开展一项极其重要的挖掘项目。可惜当地的食人魔给我们添了不少麻烦。$b$b就在不久前，我们团队中一位最优秀的保护者在当地勘探时失踪了。他已经是我们协会这星期失去的第三位成员了！$b$b我们的设备还真执行不了救援任务……那你怎么想？我们非常需要你的帮助。
text.completion: You're looking for what now? I mean, yeah sure... whatever. Just get me down alright?
text.completed: 在纳格兰的破碎悬崖与格莱布林·迅爆谈一谈。

english.title: Garrison Campaign: The Broken Precipice
english.objectives: Find Greblin Fastfizzle.
english.description: Hey there! You're the commander of this keep, right? I represent the Steamwheedle Preservation Society.$b$bWe've been trying to get a very important excavation up and running in Nagrand. Unfortunately, we've had trouble with ogres in the area.$b$bIn fact, one of our best preservationists recently went missing while surveying the area. He's the third society member we've lost up there this week!$b$bWe aren't really equipped for a rescue mission... so whad'ya say? We could really use the help.
english.completion: You're looking for what now? I mean, yeah sure... whatever. Just get me down alright?
english.completed: Speak with Greblin Fastfizzle at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.

text.title: 卡德加的召唤
text.objectives: 在赞加拉的卡德加的法师塔与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
text.description: <这股不定形的奥术能量似乎正带人游览你的要塞。>$B$B指挥官$n！我奉大法师卡德加之命来召唤你。$B$B大法师有非常紧急的事物要与你详谈。他非常担心这个世界对艾泽拉斯造成的威胁，并想要你帮他彻查这些威胁。他的法师塔位于塔拉多的赞加拉沼泽中。请去那里见他，不会耽误你很长时间的。
text.completion: <The Archmage looks damp and uncomfortable.>$b$bI apologize for the conditions here, $n. I had no choice. I summoned this tower at the optimal confluence of arcane energies. My hope is to finish my work here before all my books get musty.$b$bSo then! Let's get to it.
text.completed: 在赞加拉的卡德加的法师塔与大法师卡德加谈一谈。

english.title: Call of the Archmage
english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.
english.description: <The amorphous blob of arcane energy appears to be giving people a tour of your garrison.>$b$bCommander $n! I was sent here to summon you.$b$bArchmage Khadgar has a very urgent favor to ask. He is gravely concerned about additional threats this world may hold for Azeroth, and he will need your assistance pursuing them. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.$b$bThis will not take long.
english.completion: <The Archmage looks damp and uncomfortable.>$b$bI apologize for the conditions here, $n. I had no choice. I summoned this tower at the optimal confluence of arcane energies. My hope is to finish my work here before all my books get musty.$b$bSo then! Let's get to it.
english.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: 卡德加的任务
text.objectives: 在赞加拉的卡德加的法师塔与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
text.description: 这个世界对我们的世界造成了许多威胁。其中最首要的自然是钢铁部落——你的要塞和你的军队正在全力对抗这个敌人。但就我个人而言，我还有另外一个目标。$B$B古尔丹。$B$B过来坐一下，尝点魔法点心。我会在帮你制造指环时，告诉你我的计划……
text.completion: Your ring is finished. This is but the first step - with more time together we'll be able to create a ring of legendary power. But first things first!$b$bGul'dan could be hiding anywhere, but if we can locate any of his lieutenants I think I know a way to flush him out. Let's begin by gathering the magical reagents I'll need.

english.title: Khadgar's Task
english.objectives: Speak with Khadgar within his tower in Zangarra.
english.description: This world poses many dangers to our own. Chief among them is the Iron Horde - your garrison and the full might of your army is directed at this foe. But for myself I have a different target in mind.$b$bGul'dan.$b$bHere, make yourself comfortable. Have some mana strudel. I will share my plan as I create your ring...
english.completion: Your ring is finished. This is but the first step - with more time together we'll be able to create a ring of legendary power. But first things first!$b$bGul'dan could be hiding anywhere, but if we can locate any of his lieutenants I think I know a way to flush him out. Let's begin by gathering the magical reagents I'll need.

text.title: 烈焰之核
text.objectives: 从血槌炉渣矿井的戈洛克身上取得烈焰之核[仅限英雄难度]。
text.description: 与艾泽拉斯相比，德拉诺是一个相对年轻的星球。塑造出这星球本身的原始力量依然存在于此——只要你懂得如何去寻找。$B$B我要你去帮我找一颗烈焰之核。血槌食人魔向来用这种东西来使熔岩之怒听命于他们，不过你我能够把这玩意儿用在更好的地方。$B$B进入血槌炉渣矿井，从戈洛克身上“要”一个来。毕竟，死掉的食人魔才是好食人魔。
text.progress: Have you been to the Slag Mines yet?$B$BHonestly, who mines slag anyway? What do they do with it?
text.completion: <Khadgar rolls the fiery orb back and forth between his hands.>$B$BDo you know how to use this, $n?$B$BMe neither. Sometimes you just have to improvise as you go.

english.title: Core of Flame
english.objectives: Acquire a Core of Flame from Gug'rokk in the Bloodmaul Slag Mines [Heroic only.]
english.description: Compared to Azeroth, Draenor is a young world. The primal forces that shaped and bent the land are still accessible - if you know where to look.$b$bI need you to find for me a Core of Flame. The Bloodmaul Ogres have been known to use these to bend molten furies to their will, but you and I can find a much better use for one.$b$bEnter the Bloodmaul Slag Mines and acquire one from Gug'rokk. He won't need it anymore after you kill him.
english.progress: Have you been to the Slag Mines yet?$B$BHonestly, who mines slag anyway? What do they do with it?
english.completion: <Kadgar rolls the fire sphere in the palms of his hand. >$b$bYou know how to use it, $n? $b$bWell, I don't know. Okay, let's improvise, sometimes there's nothing else.
